examples.en: The unsolicited ads appear prominently on the screen and are a pet peeve for many users.
examples.zh: 不请自来的广告显眼地出现在屏幕上，对于许多使用者来说是个恼人的事。

examples.en: This is a pet peeve of mine.
examples.zh: 这是我个人的一点小小忌讳。

examples.en: I have a particular pet peeve about an analysis-level document that mentions "the system."
examples.zh: 我对提到“系统”的分析级文档感到特别头疼。

examples.en: It also explains all the ludonarritive dissonance (another pet peeve of mine) in Tomb Raider.
examples.zh: 它还解释了《古墓丽影》中所有的游戏体验不和谐（我的另一个烦恼）。

examples.en: Of course, if you read the blog, you know this is a pet peeve of mine.
examples.zh: 当然，如果您阅读了该博客，您就会知道这是我最讨厌的事情。

examples.en: It then addresses a pet peeve of many in Beijing: "When entering an elevator...let people walk out before you enter, " it said.
examples.zh: 然后，它解决了北京许多人的一个烦恼：“进入电梯时……先让人们走出去，然后再进入，”它说。

etymology.rootMeaning: v. 惹恼；（使）恼怒；n. 惹人生气的原因
etymology.explanation: 现有词源记录可追溯至古拉丁语/古希腊语词形，经演变进入现代英语。
etymology.memory: 先记核心义“惹恼；（使）恼怒；n. 惹人生气的原因”，再结合高频搭配与经典例句巩固词形。

words.analysis: 【细微含义与使用场景】指让人感到烦恼、厌烦或生气的特定琐事或坏习惯。最常见的固定搭配是“pet peeve”，特指“个人最不能忍受的小毛病或小忌讳”（如有人嚼东西出声、电梯里不让人先出来等）。口语及日常交流高频，感情色彩偏负面，但语气多为日常抱怨而非强烈仇恨。【助记方法】联想 pet（宠物/小癖好）+ peeve（烦恼）→ 像宠物一样常伴身边的私人小烦恼 → 最讨厌的小毛病。

examples.en: My thoughts were beginning to digress.

examples.en: Let me digress for a moment and tell you a short story.
examples.zh: 请允许我暂时离开话题一会儿，我给你讲个小故事。

examples.en: To digress for a second, French and German banks will also have to raise capital.
examples.zh: 顺便说一句，法国和德国的银行也必须筹集资金。

examples.en: By the way, our first guest who came to us directly from the Howard Stern show, but I digress.
examples.zh: 顺便说一下，我们的第一位客人是直接从霍华德·斯特恩秀中来到我们这里的，但我离题了。

examples.zh: 他们中的大多数人将其视为出售黄金时事通讯的一种方式，但我离题了。

words.meaning: n. 苦工，单调乏味的苦差事
words.analysis: 带有强烈感情色彩的名词，指枯燥、劳累、重复且没有任何创造性或乐趣的工作（如家务活或机械搬运）。书面与日常写作中常与机械化、自动化（消除苦差事）结合使用。助记：drudge (做苦工的人) + -ery -> 苦差事。

examples.en: Automation and AI can free human workers from repetitive daily drudgery.
examples.zh: 自动化和人工智能可以将人类员工从重复性极高的日常苦差事中解放出来。

examples.en: Washing machines significantly reduced the domestic drudgery of early households.
examples.zh: 洗衣机极大地减轻了早期家庭繁重的洗涤劳作。

examples.en: He found the endless data entry to be sheer administrative drudgery.
examples.zh: 他发现无休止的数据录入纯粹是单调乏味的行政苦差。

examples.en: She dreamt of pursuing an artistic career to escape the drudgery of factory work.
examples.zh: 她梦想着追求艺术事业，以摆脱工厂工作的沉闷与枯燥。

examples.en: Creative writing provided an outlet for him amidst the drudgery of his accounting job.
examples.zh: 在枯燥的会计工作之余，创意写作成为了他的宣泄渠道。

synonyms.note: 解析：单调乏味的工作。区别：Drudgery 强调工作不仅单调乏味，而且繁重辛苦；Plodding 侧重于工作或行走的步伐沉重、单调、缓慢，缺乏灵感。
解析：苦差事。区别：Drudgery 侧重枯燥繁重；Grind 是口语用词，指极其枯燥、令人疲惫的日常重复性工作或学习。
解析：单调繁重的体力活。区别：Drudgery 可指任何繁重苦闷的工作；Donkeywork 多指不需要技巧、纯粹消耗体力的粗重活。

phrases.zh: 消除单调乏味的苦差事
繁重的家务活
日常的枯燥苦工
摆脱繁重的苦差

examples.en: Vouchsafe me a spirit of faith and knowledge.
examples.zh: 赐予我信心和一颗有知识的心灵。

examples.en: God of the all-round light, please vouchsafe the strength that we are not encroached on evilly, in front of the goodness shield, all the evil spirits will be drive away!
examples.zh: 全能的光明之神啊，请赐予我们不受邪恶侵害的力量，在至善的灵盾面前，所有邪魔都将远离！

examples.en: He does not vouchsafe the details.
examples.zh: 他没有透露细节。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of vouchsafe.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“允诺；赐予；vi. 屈尊；俯就”的概念提供了全新的视角。

examples.en: Recent academic studies have highlighted the significance of vouchsafe in modern research.
examples.zh: 最近的学术研究强调了“允诺；赐予；vi. 屈尊；俯就”在现代科学研究中的重要意义。

examples.en: Her articulate argument demonstrated a deep understanding of vouchsafe.
examples.zh: 她清晰有力的论证展现了对“允诺；赐予；vi. 屈尊；俯就”的深刻理解。

etymology.rootMeaning: vt. 允诺；赐予；vi. 屈尊；俯就
etymology.explanation: 现有词源记录可追溯至古拉丁语/古希腊语词形，经演变进入现代英语。
etymology.memory: 先记核心义“允诺；赐予；vi. 屈尊；俯就”，再结合高频搭配与经典例句巩固词形。

words.analysis: 【细微含义与使用场景】正式书面语及文学词汇。包含两层高贵或高高在上的语意：一是出于慷慨或恩赐“赐予、给予”（如 vouchsafe an answer / vouchsafe a smile）；二是“屈尊俯就”。语气极其庄重严肃，多见于经典文学、宗教文本或具讽刺色彩的正式陈述。【助记拆解】vouch（保证）+ safe（安全/确信）→ 担保并赐予对方许可或回答 → 赐予，屈尊给予。

examples.en: Two of the three alphabets are ancient Egyptian scripts that stop being used: the hieroglyphic and the demotic.
examples.zh: 三种文字中的两种都是古埃及文字，即象形文字及埃及通俗语，它们现在已经停止使用了。

examples.en: It contains the same exact text written in three different alphabets: Greek, demotic, hieroglyphic.
examples.zh: 它包含了完全相同的文本，用三种不同的字母书写：希腊语，通俗语，象形文字。

examples.en: The Rosetta Stone was remarkable because, as I said, on it was the same text in three different alphabets: Greek, demotic and hieroglyphic.
examples.zh: 罗塞塔石碑是值得重视的，因为正如我所说，那上面的是三种不同的字母系统书写的相同文字内容：希腊语，通俗语和象形文字。

examples.en: And he revelled in that most demotic and subversive music, jazz.
examples.zh: 他还陶醉于最通俗、最具颠覆性的音乐——爵士乐。

examples.en: But in its brutal structure of white power and black penury, apartheid also contained visceral drama, stories of humanity willing and waiting to break out in a demotic exuberance which in his township work Mr Fugard caught so well.
examples.zh: 但在白人权力和黑人贫困的残酷结构中，种族隔离也包含了发自内心的戏剧，以及人性愿意并等待在民众繁荣中爆发的故事，福加德先生在他的乡镇作品中很好地捕捉到了这一点。

examples.en: America 's journalists can be a little prudish.
examples.zh: 美国的新闻记者可能会有些古板。

examples.en: But it is also a land so prudish that its film industry has only recently started to show kisses on screen.
examples.zh: 但这也是一个如此拘谨的国家，其电影业直到最近才开始在银幕上展示吻戏。

examples.en: Which, it has to be said, is really rather prudish of them.
examples.zh: 不得不说，他们实在是太拘谨了。

examples.en: Since copyright law allows for prudish nannies, according to professor Doris Long of Chicago's John Marshall Law School, the judge in Colorado could decide in ClearPlay's favor.

examples.zh: 用讽刺文章进行嘲讽；讽刺或挖苦。

examples.en: Mark Twain, our first post-modernist, even took the time to satirize the experience in Innocents Abroad.

examples.zh: 现在我必从你颈项上折断他的轭，扭开他的绳索。

examples.en: And globalization will strengthen, not sunder, this relationship, possibly even winning new paramours for the outfit along the way.

examples.en: The divers had difficulty navigating through the murky water of the river.
examples.zh: 潜水员很难在河里浑浊的水中辨别方向。

examples.en: The scandal dragged the company into the murky world of political corruption.
examples.zh: 这场丑闻将公司拖入了政治腐败的黑暗世界中。

examples.en: Details of the offshore transaction remain murky despite months of investigation.
examples.zh: 尽管调查了数月，该离岸交易的细节依然扑朔迷离。

examples.en: He had a murky background that raised immediate suspicion among federal investigators.
examples.zh: 他有着复杂的背景，立即引起了联邦调查人员的怀疑。

examples.en: Sunlight barely penetrated the murky depth of the dense rainforest canopy.
examples.zh: 阳光几乎无法穿透茂密热带雨林树冠下阴沉的深处。

synonyms.note: 多云的, 浑浊的。区别：Cloudy 常用指天空多云或液体不透明；murky 侧重因光线暗淡或泥沙显得阴暗、浑浊，带压抑色彩。
泥泞的, 浑浊的。区别：Muddy 专门指含有泥土而变得浑浊或泥泞的；murky 涵盖水质浑浊，也指光线昏暗或情况不明朗。
黑暗地的, 阴郁地的。区别：Mirky 是 murky 的变体拼写，含义相同；murky 更为常见。
浑浊的, 污浊的。区别：Turbid 是较为正式的用语，多指液体中悬浮大量沉积物而浑浊；murky 也可形容气氛或动机的不透明。

【细微含义与使用场景】
1. 物理环境：指水浑浊不透明（murky waters）或天气昏暗迷茫（murky sky）。
2. 政治/商业/道德：比喻内幕复杂、充满不可告人秘密或不道德的暗箱操作（murky past 复杂的过去, murky dealings 黑暗交易）。
【助记方法】murk（黑暗、阴暗）+ -y → 昏暗的、浑浊的。

words.meaning: n. 十四行诗；v. 创作十四行诗
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】欧洲传统诗歌体裁，源自意大利语 sonetto（意为“小歌曲/小声音”）。结构严格，包含14行，遵循特定的押韵格式（如彼特拉克体 abba abba cdecde 或莎士比亚体 abab cdcd efef gg）。常用于表达爱情、哲学冥想与生命思考。
【IT/AI/技术含义】Anthropic 的 Claude 模型家族中，中量级高效主力模型命名为 Claude 3.5 Sonnet，寓意优雅、精炼且富有艺术感与逻辑美。
【助记方法】son（声音/歌声，同 sound, song）+ net（小）→ 优雅的小诗歌 → 十四行诗。

examples.en: Shakespeare's Sonnet 18 opens with the immortal line, 'Shall I compare thee to a summer's day?'
examples.zh: 莎士比亚第18首十四行诗以名句“我能否将你比作璀璨的夏日？”开篇。

examples.en: The poet mastered the strict rhyming structure of the Italian sonnet during his studies in Florence.
examples.zh: 这位诗人在佛罗伦萨游学期间掌握了意大利十四行诗严谨的押韵结构。

examples.en: Claude 3.5 Sonnet balances high performance with fast execution speed, making it popular among developers.
examples.zh: Claude 3.5 Sonnet 在高性能与快速执行速度之间取得了平衡，深受开发者欢迎。

examples.en: In literature class, students were asked to analyze the Volta or thematic turn in a Renaissance sonnet.
examples.zh: 在文学课上，学生们被要求分析文艺复兴时期十四行诗中的转折（Volta）或主题转换。

examples.en: He penned a passionate sonnet to commemorate their wedding anniversary.
examples.zh: 他写下了一首深情款款的十四行诗，以纪念他们的结婚纪念日。

examples.en: The collection features over a hundred sonnets dedicated to nature and spiritual reflection.
examples.zh: 该诗集收录了一百多首献给自然与心灵冥想的十四行诗。

words.meaning: v. 教唆，怂恿，伙同（犯罪）
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】特指在犯罪、违法或不道德行为中向他人提供鼓励、协助或支持（常用搭配 aid and abet）。主要属于法律与刑法术语，也可用于日常文学中表达怂恿不良行为。
【历史典故/词源】源自古法语 abeter（唆使，诱使），由 a-（向）+ beter（用犬诱捕，煽动咬）构成，引申为“唆使猎犬围猎”。
【专业领域特殊含义】在刑法中，aid and abet 为固定双词协同术语（教唆与协助犯罪），指虽未直接实施核心犯罪行为但参与谋划、提供便利或心理鼓励的协同犯罪行为。
【助记方法】a（去）+ bet（赌博/煽动）→ 煽动别人去下注/干坏事 → 怂恿，教唆。

phrases.zh: 唆使并协助（犯罪）

synonyms.note: 煽动，鼓动。区别：incite 侧重激起愤怒或暴乱情绪；abet 侧重在具体违法或不当行为中提供协助或鼓励。
唆使，策动。区别：instigate 侧重发起、策划或挑起坏事；abet 侧重支持已有的坏事。

examples.en: The unique column design has diagonal bracing at each end and tabs that bolt into the floors above and below.
examples.zh: 独特的柱形设计在每一头都有对角线支撑，使其与上下楼层通过螺栓进行连接。

examples.zh: 他们在为漫长的法律诉讼作准备。

examples.en: Businesses globally are bracing for more contraction.
examples.zh: 全球企业正准备迎来更多收缩。

examples.zh: 当我向你告别夏天时，我正准备迎接即将到来的暴风雨。

examples.en: Francis' bracing manifesto came Thursday in the form of an encyclical, a letter traditionally addressed from St.
examples.zh: 方济各周四以通谕的形式发表了令人振奋的宣言，这封信传统上是由圣方济各寄出的。

examples.zh: 说到某某股票时，也应该采用同样无情镇静的手段。

examples.en: Calm and unflappable, he has proved an efficient manager, handling a disparate collection of ministers adeptly.
examples.zh: 事实证明，他冷静而镇定，是一位高效的管理者，能够熟练地处理不同的部长群体。

examples.en: "I prided myself on being unflappable even in the most chaotic of circumstances, " he wrote.
examples.zh: 他写道：“我为自己即使在最混乱的情况下也能镇定自若而感到自豪。”

examples.zh: 他咳嗽一声，吐了口痰。

examples.zh: 她吃了一口食物，突然又吐了出来。

examples.en: The only thing he spat out was the main-mast, for it stuck in his teeth.
examples.zh: 他唯一吐出来的东西是主桅，因为它卡在他的牙齿里了。

examples.en: Japan's finance minister was involved in a public spat with his own ministry in Tokyo.

words.meaning: adj. （饮食）有节制的，适度的；生活俭朴的
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】特指在饮食、欲望或生活习惯上保持高度的自律与节制（an abstemious meal / lifestyle），不贪图享受。感情色彩明确褒义，多用于形容品格高尚、生活素雅的人或作风。
【历史典故/词源】源自拉丁语 abstemius，由 abs-（离开，远离）+ temetum（烈酒）构成。本义是“远离烈酒的”，后扩展为“饮食节制的”。
【专业领域特殊含义】在伦理学与清修文化研究中，形容自我约束、不纵欲的禁欲生活态度；在营养学中形容低热量、适度的饮食习惯。
【助记方法】abs（离开）+ tem（酒/甜食）+ ious（形容词后缀）→ 远离酒肉甜食的 → 有节制的，节俭的。

phrases.zh: 节制而俭朴的生活方式
有节制的饮食
节俭的习惯
保持节制

examples.en: Despite his immense wealth, he led a quiet and abstemious life.
examples.zh: 尽管拥有巨额财富，他却过着清静而有节制的生活。

examples.en: Her abstemious eating habits helped her maintain good health throughout her old age.
examples.zh: 她有节制的饮食习惯帮助她在整个晚年保持健康。

examples.en: Monks in the monastery adhere to a strictly abstemious regimen.
examples.zh: 修道院里的僧侣遵循极其严格节制的养生作息。

examples.en: He was abstemious at the banquet, partaking only of bread and water.
examples.zh: 他在宴会上非常克制，只吃了一点面包和水。

examples.en: An abstemious life allowed the philosopher to focus entirely on his intellectual pursuits.
examples.zh: 有节制的生活使这位哲学家能够全神贯注于其学术追求。

synonyms.note: 节制的，适度的。区别：temperate 通用于饮食、脾气或气候的适度；abstemious 侧重饮食与生活享受上的自律。
严厉的，简朴的。区别：austere 侧重生活条件苦行僧式的艰苦与毫无装饰。

confusables.note: n. 节制，节俭
adj. 有雄心的

words.meaning: v. 潜逃，逃匿，携款潜逃
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】指为了逃避法律制裁、债务或追捕而秘密且迅速地“潜逃、逃匿”，尤其是带着钱款或贵重物品潜逃（abscond with money / funds）。属于法律、刑侦与新闻报道高频词，含有贬义。
【历史典故/词源】源自拉丁语 abscondere（隐藏，藏匿），由 ab-（离开，隐藏）+ condere（放置，保存，同 recondite/store）构成。本义是“藏匿起来”，后引申为“潜逃隐匿”。
【专业领域特殊含义】在金融刑法中，absconding debtor / executive 指“潜逃的债务人/高管”；在保释制度中，abscond from bail 指“弃保潜逃”。
【助记方法】abs（离开）+ cond（藏，同 hide）→ 藏起来逃走 → 潜逃，携款潜逃。

phrases.zh: 携款潜逃
越狱潜逃
弃保潜逃
潜逃的嫌疑人

examples.en: The treasurer absconded with millions of dollars from the charity fund.
examples.zh: 财务主管卷走慈善基金数百万美元潜逃。

examples.en: He absconded to a non-extradition country after being released on bail.
examples.zh: 他在获保释后潜逃至一个没有引渡条约的国家。

examples.en: The suspect absconded before police could execute the arrest warrant.
examples.zh: 在警方执行逮捕令前，嫌疑人已潜逃无踪。

examples.en: Investors lost their savings when the founder of the crypto exchange absconded.
examples.zh: 加密货币交易所创始人携款潜逃，导致投资者血本无归。

examples.en: Several prisoners attempted to abscond during the transfer.
examples.zh: 几名犯人在押解转移途中企图潜逃。

synonyms.note: 逃跑，逃走。区别：flee 为通用词，可指因危险而逃跑；abscond 侧重秘密潜逃以逃避法律或带着财物逃跑。
撤营，潜逃。区别：decamp 侧重突然拔营撤走或偷偷溜走。

words.meaning: adj. 专有的，专利的；所有权的；n. 所有权；所有者
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】强调某一产品、技术、软件或规范归特定个人或公司独家所有，未经许可不得复制或使用（与 open-source 相对）。书面语及商务/法律/科技语境中高频使用。
【感情色彩】中性，商业竞争中常象征独家核心竞争力，但有时也隐含“封闭/垄断”。
【IT/AI扩展】在软件与AI领域，proprietary software / proprietary model（专有软件/专有模型，如 OpenAI GPT-4）与 open-weight / open-source（开源）形成鲜明对比；proprietary format 表示专有数据格式。
【助记方法】来自 proprietor（业主、所有者）+ -ary，意为“属于所有者的” -> 专有的。

examples.en: The tech giant guards its proprietary algorithms with strict non-disclosure agreements.
examples.zh: 这家科技巨头通过严格保密协议保护其专有算法。

examples.en: Unlike open-source alternatives, proprietary software usually requires a paid license.
examples.zh: 与开源替代品不同，专有软件通常需要付费授权。

examples.en: The device uses a proprietary charging cable that is incompatible with standard USB ports.
examples.zh: 该设备使用专有充电线，与标准USB接口不兼容。

examples.en: Companies invest heavily in R&D to develop proprietary products and gain a market edge.
examples.zh: 公司在研发上投入重金以开发专有产品并赢得市场优势。

examples.en: The company claims a proprietary right to the manufacturing process.
examples.zh: 该公司声称对该制造工艺拥有专有所有权。

examples.en: They developed a proprietary AI model fine-tuned on medical imaging data.
examples.zh: 他们开发了一个在医学影像数据上微调的专有AI模型。

synonyms.note: n. 所有权，业主身份。Proprietorship 侧重于所有权这种法律状态或业主的身份；Proprietary 通常是形容词，侧重于专有的、专利的性质。

examples.en: The flippancy of your answer peeved me.

examples.en: He's an impartial and perspicacious judge.

examples.zh: 福布斯亚洲编辑蒂姆·弗格森向我转发了最近对异常敏锐的加里·席林的采访。

examples.en: More perspicacious neighbors, the Paulsens among them, suspected that Joey also enjoyed being the smartest person in the house.

words.meaning: v. 拖延，耽搁，习惯性拖延
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】特指明知有负面后果却仍然习惯性地推迟、拖延必须完成的任务。属于负面心理现象（与简单的 reschedule 或 postpone 不同，procrastinate 强调情绪上的逃避与不理性延迟）。
【历史典故/词源】源自拉丁语 pro-（向前、推到）+ crastinus（明天的，来源于 cras 明天）→ 总是说“明天再做” → 拖延。
【助记方法】pro（向前）+ crastin（明天）+ ate → 把事情一直推到明天去做 → 拖延症。

examples.en: Many students tend to procrastinate on writing term papers until the night before the deadline.
examples.zh: 许多学生往往会把撰写期末论文拖延到截止日期的前一天晚上。

examples.en: Psychologists explain that people often procrastinate not out of laziness, but due to fear of failure.
examples.zh: 心理学家解释说，人们拖延往往不是出于懒惰，而是出于对失败的恐惧。

examples.en: If you continue to procrastinate, the accumulated workload will eventually overwhelm you.
examples.zh: 如果你继续拖延，累积的工作量最终会让你不堪重负。

examples.en: Break your complex goals into smaller manageable steps so you won't be tempted to procrastinate.
examples.zh: 将复杂的目标拆解为更容易管理的小步骤，这样你就不会总想拖延了。

examples.en: He procrastinated for months before finally scheduling his mandatory health checkup.
examples.zh: 他拖延了几个月，最终才预约了强制体检。

examples.en: Tackling the hardest task first thing in the morning is an effective way to overcome the urge to procrastinate.
examples.zh: 清晨第一件事就攻克最难的任务，是克服拖延冲动的有效方法。

synonyms.note: 解析：拖延，搪塞。区别：procrastinate 指因懒惰或逃避而无故推迟；stall 强调故意使用手段停顿或拖延，带有策略性。
解析：磨蹭，拖拉。区别：procrastinate 侧重于心理上的推脱；drag one's feet 是习语，强调不情愿、行动迟缓、缺乏热情。
解析：行动缓慢，拖沓。区别：与 drag one's feet 含义相同，强调因为抵触情绪而故意放慢做事速度。
解析：犹豫不决，吞吞吐吐。区别：procrastinate 是拖延行动；shillyshally 侧重于在决定时摇摆不定、浪费时间。

examples.en: The church seems to be on the brink of schism.
examples.zh: 该教会看来处于分裂的边缘。

examples.en: In the 15th century a schism opened in the world of beer.
examples.zh: 15世纪，啤酒界开始了一次强烈的意见分歧。

examples.en: We are much too apt to look at schism in our church as an unmitigated evil.
examples.zh: 我们很容易把自己教会中的分派看成是一种十恶不赦的罪恶。

examples.en: The schism comes at a bad time for the still-fragile (and still-oil-addicted) global economy.
examples.zh: 对于仍然脆弱（并且仍然沉迷于石油）的全球经济来说，这次分裂来得不是时候。

examples.en: They have warned Mr Netanyahu that the bill, if passed, would cause a schism throughout Jewry.
examples.zh: 他们警告内塔尼亚胡先生，该法案如果获得通过，将导致整个犹太人的分裂。

examples.en: The schism that opened between Francis and the centrist members of the order has never healed.
examples.zh: 方济各与修道会中间派成员之间的分裂从未弥合。

examples.en: The word "serendipity" was coined by Horace Walpole in an 1854 letter, from a tale of three princes who "were always making discoveries, by accident, of things they were not in search of".
examples.zh: “Serendipity”这个词，是在1854年由霍勒斯·沃波尔在一封信中创造的，这个词源于一个关于三个王子的故事，他们“总是意外地发现那些他们无意寻找的东西”。

examples.en: Some of the best effects in my garden have been the result of serendipity.
examples.zh: 我花园里最珍贵的几件物品是机缘巧合之下意外所得。

examples.en: This is the kind of serendipity you want!
examples.zh: 这正是那种你心心期盼的命中注定！

examples.en: Photographers and travellers have to stumble upon each other in a bit of serendipity.
examples.zh: 摄影师和旅行者必须在一些偶然的机会中偶然相遇。

examples.en: But rather than intent-driven searches like those on Amazon, Fancy is all about serendipity.
examples.zh: 但与亚马逊上的那些以意图为导向的搜索不同，Fancy 完全是为了意外发现。

examples.en: How can we replicate this and create more serendipity without being in the same office?
examples.zh: 我们怎样才能复制这一点并在不在同一个办公室的情况下创造更多的机缘呢？

examples.en: Greed is a miser's preponderant characteristic.
examples.zh: 贪婪是一个守财奴的主要特点。

examples.en: Melancholy is the preponderant mood of the poem.
examples.zh: 忧郁的感情是该诗的基调。

examples.en: Livestock husbandry in grassland is the preponderant industry in Inner Mongolia.
examples.zh: 草原畜牧业是内蒙古的优势产业和基础产业。

examples.en: In Asia, e-business is even more preponderant than in America and it is likely to stay that way.
examples.zh: 在亚洲，电子商务甚至比美国更占主导地位，而且很可能会保持这种状态。

examples.en: But he said a "preponderant" number of peers had expressed concerns about the review which they felt was a lost opportunity.
examples.zh: 但他表示，“绝大多数”同行对此次审查表示担忧，他们认为这是一次失去的机会。

examples.en: Rectilinear double window forms a counterpoint to face's preponderant circularity.
examples.zh: 直线双窗与面部的圆形形成对比。

examples.en: The play was greeted with tepid applause.
examples.zh: 这台戏只得到了零落的掌声。

examples.en: If your child's temperature rises, sponge her down gently with tepid water.
examples.zh: 如果你孩子的体温升高，用湿海绵沾温水轻轻地擦洗她。

examples.en: The official American response to Mr Papandreou has been tepid.
examples.zh: 美国官方对帕潘德里欧先生的回应一直是不冷不热。

examples.en: Prices closed near the session low and saw tepid short covering in a bear market.
examples.zh: 价格收盘接近盘中低点，熊市中空头回补不温不火。

examples.en: Radio Shack and Apple highlighted tepid North American smartphone sales during the autumn quarter.
examples.zh: Radio Shack 和苹果公司强调了秋季季度北美智能手机销售不温不火的情况。

examples.en: In any event, your food was at best tepid by the time it reached the table.
examples.zh: 无论如何，当你的食物到达餐桌时，充其量只是温热的。

examples.en: Although a man of blood and violence, Richard was too impetuous to be either treacherous or habitually cruel.
examples.zh: 虽然理查德是一个血腥暴力的人，但他过于冲动，既不奸诈，也不惯于残忍。

examples.en: He was young and impetuous.
examples.zh: 他年轻，易冲动。

examples.en: James Purnell An impetuous young minister.
examples.zh: 詹姆斯·珀内尔年轻浮躁的大臣。

examples.en: His style is consensus-building, his decision-making less unilateral and impetuous than Kan or, particularly, Hatoyama.
examples.zh: 他的风格是建立共识，他的决策不像菅直人，尤其是鸠山那样单方面和鲁莽。

examples.en: The Germans tend to see Mr Chirac, who became president in 1995, as impetuous and bulldozing.
examples.zh: 德国人往往认为 1995 年就任总统的希拉克是一个性格浮躁、咄咄逼人的人。

examples.en: Murtaza is impetuous, arrogant and convinced of a right to lead conferred by birth.
examples.zh: 穆尔塔扎性格急躁、傲慢，并坚信与生俱来的领导权。

examples.en: The conversation went off on a tangent.
examples.zh: 谈话突然偏离了正题。

examples.en: In this paper base tangent length is put forward and lead angle calculating formula is deduced.
examples.zh: 这篇文章提出了公法线长度并推导出超前角的计算公式。

examples.en: It is really the tangent plane.
examples.zh: 它确实就是切平面。

examples.en: Goldman is going off on a tangent and is not really discussing any real challenges.
examples.zh: 高盛偏离了主题，并没有真正讨论任何真正的挑战。

examples.en: "I'm sorry, but I feel you guys were off on a tangent there, " Robinson said.
examples.zh: “我很抱歉，但我觉得你们离题了，”罗宾逊说。

examples.en: The bum was moving at a tangent now, off the sidewalk, into the street.
examples.zh: 流浪汉此时正在偏离人行道，进入街道。

examples.en: She shouted over the growing din.
examples.zh: 她对着越来越大的喧嚣声喊叫。

examples.en: The din from the commodity pits on the Chicago exchanges is growing louder.
examples.zh: 芝加哥商品交易所的喧嚣声越来越大。

examples.en: "Quiet, you scugs," he cried, "or I'll cast anchor in you." And at once the din was hushed.
examples.zh: “安静点，你们这帮混蛋，”他叫道，“不然我就朝你们抛锚了。”嘈杂声立刻停止了。

examples.en: The speaker cuts through the din to beam messages to the captain's ears only.
examples.zh: 扬声器穿透喧嚣，只将信息传送到船长的耳朵里。

examples.en: Just like other top athletes, tennis players can apparently concentrate amid the din of the crowd.
examples.zh: 就像其他顶级运动员一样，网球运动员显然可以在人群的喧嚣中集中注意力。

examples.en: And their voices often get drowned out by the unruly din of the digital masses.
examples.zh: 他们的声音常常被数字大众不守规矩的喧嚣淹没。

examples.en: We shall ignore factors extraneous to the problem.
examples.zh: 我们应该撇开与此问题无直接联系的因素。

examples.en: We do not want any extraneous information on the page.
examples.zh: 我们不希望这一页上有任何无关的信息。

examples.en: To avoid delays, she wanted the disaster relief legislation to be kept free of extraneous matters.
examples.zh: 为避免延误，她希望无关紧要的事不被掺杂进灾害救济立法程序中。

examples.en: Even after tossing out all extraneous data, Bird's computers will be storing 15 petabytes a year.
examples.zh: 即使扔掉所有无关数据后，Bird 的计算机每年仍将存储 15 PB 的数据。

examples.en: The dedicated bayonet lens hood (LH3-01) can be attached to block out extraneous light.
examples.zh: 可安装专用卡口镜头遮光罩（LH3-01）以阻挡外部光线。

examples.en: We must move beyond the divisive and extraneous issues that currently define public debate.
examples.zh: 我们必须超越目前公共辩论中存在的分歧和无关问题。

examples.en: He was so solicitous of his guests.
examples.zh: 他是如此挂念自己的客人们。

examples.en: solicitous and considerate than you.
examples.zh: 细心和体贴。

examples.en: They were solicitous and intent, watching her every move.
examples.zh: 他们殷勤又热心，对她每一个移动都很小心看护。

examples.en: One wants to love this place with its townhouse setting, romantic lighting and solicitous service.
examples.zh: 人们想要爱上这个地方，因为它的联排别墅环境、浪漫的灯光和殷勤的服务。

examples.en: Mr. Karp was unusually solicitous, asking Mr. Howey what kind of deal he would accept.
examples.zh: 卡普先生异常热心，询问豪伊先生愿意接受什么样的交易。

examples.en: The helpful, solicitous staff happily stows skis in a storage area and presents them efficiently on request.
examples.zh: 乐于助人、热心的工作人员很乐意将滑雪板存放在存储区，并根据要求高效地提供它们。

examples.en: Interest in the occult tended toward ceremonial magic rather than witchcraft.
examples.zh: 对神秘学的兴趣趋向于仪式性魔术而非巫术。

examples.en: Religious and occult predictions, however, boast no causal logic whatsoever.
examples.zh: 但是，宗教和神秘的预言没有任何因果逻辑。

examples.en: Since his death, various occult organizations have adopted him as a model figure or even as a powerful deity.
examples.zh: 自从他死后，各种各样的神秘组织把他当作模范甚至是一个强大的神。

examples.en: Cleopatra emerged as stand-in for her occult, alchemical land, the intoxicating address of sex and excess.
examples.zh: 克利奥帕特拉成为了她神秘的、炼金术般的土地、令人陶醉的性和放纵的代言人。

examples.en: Glorifying and promoting the occult as a Christmas attraction is not only very tasteless but sad and very dangerous.
examples.zh: 颂扬和宣传神秘学作为圣诞节的吸引力不仅非常无味，而且令人悲伤且非常危险。

examples.en: One of them is denying she was ever really involved in the occult.
examples.zh: 其中之一否认她曾经真正参与过神秘学。

words.meaning: v. 删节，缩短（书籍/文章）；剥夺，限制（权利）
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】特指对著作、辞典或长篇文章进行删繁就简的“删节、节略”（an abridged edition）；在法律宪政语境中指“削减、剥夺或限制”公民合法的权利或自由（abridge rights / freedom）。正式表达，学术与法律高频。
【历史典故/词源】源自古法语 abregier（缩短），经由晚期拉丁语 abbreviare 演变而来，与 abbreviate 同源。
【专业领域特殊含义】在宪法与人权法中，Congress shall make no law... abridged the freedom of speech（不得通过法律限制言论自由）；在出版业中指“出版缩写删节版”。
【助记方法】a（使）+ bridge（桥/缩短距离）→ 像建桥缩短路程一样 → 缩短，删节。

phrases.zh: 删节版，节本
剥夺/限制公民权利
删节词典
限制言论自由

examples.en: The 800-page biography was abridged for high school students.
examples.zh: 这部长达800页的人物传记为高中生作了删节改编。

examples.en: The constitution prohibits any law that abridges the freedom of the press.
examples.zh: 宪法禁止通过任何削减新闻自由的法律。

examples.en: You can listen to the abridged audiobook version during your daily commute.
examples.zh: 你可以在日常通勤期间听这部有声书的删节精简版。

examples.en: Emergency powers should not be used to abridge fundamental civil liberties.
examples.zh: 紧急权力不应被用来剥夺基本的公民自由。

examples.en: The author approved the request to abridge her novel for the theater production.
examples.zh: 作者批准了为舞台剧改编而删节其小说的请求。

synonyms.note: 浓缩，精简。区别：condense 侧重保留精华的精简；abridge 侧重删除次要章节或限制权利。
缩减，削减。区别：curtail 侧重缩短时间、支出或活动规模。

examples.en: Are you willing to vouch for him?
examples.zh: 你愿意为他担保吗？

examples.en: I can vouch for her ability to work hard.
examples.zh: 我保证她能够努力工作。

examples.en: He cannot vouch for the accuracy of the story.
examples.zh: 他不能证明报道的准确性。

examples.en: These are people you know and you feel that you can vouch for their good intentions.
examples.zh: 这些人是您认识的人，并且您觉得您可以保证他们的良好意愿。

examples.en: I've been traveling like a madman lately and can vouch for full planes and busy airports.
examples.zh: 我最近像疯子一样旅行，可以保证飞机满员和繁忙的机场。

examples.en: Is there really no one from Cranbrook that Romney can persuade to vouch for him?
examples.zh: 罗姆尼真的无法说服克兰布鲁克人为他提供担保吗？

examples.zh: 这里有一个很大的障碍。

examples.en: The snag with all these ideas is that the data are not widely and quickly available.
examples.zh: 所有这些想法的障碍是数据不是广泛和快速可得的。

examples.en: There is just one small snag—where is the money coming from?
examples.zh: 只有一个小问题—钱从哪儿来？

examples.en: Just a few weeks ago, Inkling was able to snag investments from McGraw-Hill and Pearson.
examples.zh: 就在几周前，Inkling 获得了 McGraw-Hill 和 Pearson 的投资。

examples.zh: 问题在于需要大量聪明的计算机编程才能做到这一点。

examples.en: That inaugural trip hit a snag when bandits stole the group's food and horses.
examples.zh: 当土匪偷走了他们的食物和马匹时，第一次旅行遇到了障碍。

examples.en: The medical prognosis was bleak.
examples.zh: 医疗预后不良。

examples.en: The doctor's prognosis was that Laurence might walk within 12 months.
examples.zh: 该医生的预后是劳伦斯可能在12个月之内能走动。

examples.en: The prognosis is for more people to work part-time in the future.
examples.zh: 预计将来会有更多人从事兼职工作。

examples.en: "Doctors have told me that my prognosis for recovery is very good, " he said.
examples.zh: “医生告诉我，我的康复前景非常好，”他说。

examples.en: She has ordered a medical certificate to be compiled explaining his "current position and prognosis".
examples.zh: 她已下令编制一份医疗证明，解释他的“目前状况和预后”。

examples.en: Stewart's move speaks to the lure of cable television--and the dismal prognosis for local stations' finances.
examples.zh: 斯图尔特的举动说明了有线电视的诱惑以及当地电视台财务状况的悲观预测。

examples.zh: 但是他漫长职业生涯的收场却很不体面。

examples.zh: 她的罪孽，她的耻辱，便是她深扎于此地的根。

examples.en: The ignominy of his debut occurred as he joined the actors on stage to receive applause.
examples.zh: 当他与演员一起上台接受掌声时，他的首次亮相就出现了耻辱。

examples.en: The index also reflects fears that other large funds will suffer the same ignominy as Bear's.
examples.zh: 该指数还反映出人们担心其他大型基金将遭受与贝尔斯登同样的耻辱。

examples.en: So how does the world's top cricket team slide from glory into ignominy so quickly?
examples.zh: 那么世界顶级板球队为何如此迅速地从荣耀滑落到耻辱呢？

examples.en: High fever or severe sleep deprivation can sometimes cause vivid hallucinations.
examples.zh: 高烧或严重睡眠匮乏有时会导致逼真的幻觉。

examples.en: Reducing AI hallucination is a primary target for developers building reliable LLMs.
examples.zh: 减少 AI 幻觉是开发者构建可靠大语言模型的主要目标。

examples.en: The patient reported hearing voices, which the doctor identified as an auditory hallucination.
examples.zh: 患者报告听到声音，医生认定这是听幻觉。

examples.en: Certain psychedelic substances are known to produce intense perceptual hallucinations.
examples.zh: 已知某些迷幻物质会产生强烈的感官幻觉。

examples.zh: 由于语言模型容易产生幻觉，用户必须核实其生成的事实。

etymology.rootMeaning: v. 使产生幻觉
etymology.explanation: hallucination 直接建立在 hallucinate 之上，是它的派生形式；现有词源记录可追溯到 1640 年代；词形经拉丁语 hallucinationem 进入或影响英语。

cognates.meaning: 使产生幻觉

etymology.memory: 把 hallucinate 串成词族，比较词性、后缀和核心义的变化。

words.analysis: 【词源&细微含义】源自拉丁语 alucinari（精神恍惚、漫游）。医学与心理学指在没有外部刺激时感官产生的虚幻感知（如视觉、听觉幻觉）。【IT/AI特殊含义】在人工智能（如大语言模型 LLM）领域，hallucination 指模型凭空捏造事实、输出看似合理却完全错误信息的现象（LLM hallucination），是当下 AI 安全与可信度的核心焦点概念。【使用场景&感情色彩】医学、心理学及 AI 前沿技术通用中性/专业术语。【助记】halluci（发迷/狂想）+ -ation（名词后缀）→ 幻觉。

examples.en: Nesta's chief executive, Jeremy Newton, said it was an advert for what interactive education could achieve.
examples.zh: 内斯塔的首席执行官杰里米·牛顿（Jeremy Newton）表示，这是互动教育所能实现的目标的广告。

examples.en: The decision was made by TfL that evening not to run the advert, he said.

examples.en: He is plodding on with negotiations.
examples.zh: 他正进行艰苦的谈判。

examples.en: I watched her plodding her way across the field.
examples.zh: 我注视着她步履艰难地穿过田野。

examples.en: Round a bend in the canal came plodding a solitary horse, stooping forward as if in anxious thought.
examples.zh: 在水渠的一个拐弯处，一匹孤独的马拖着沉重的步子走过来，它向前弯着腰，仿佛心事很重。

examples.en: Collison is a plodding, uninspired piece of "faction" covering those same events of 32 years ago.
examples.zh: 科里森是一个缓慢、平淡的“派别”，报道了 32 年前的同样事件。

examples.en: Yet across the Rhine the preference is for plodding progress rather than grands projets.
examples.zh: 然而，莱茵河彼岸的人们更喜欢缓慢的进展，而不是宏伟的项目。

examples.en: They also enact the political philosophy Mr Blunkett sketched in a recent, plodding book.
examples.zh: 他们还践行了布伦克特在最近一本缓慢的书中概述的政治哲学。

examples.en: We were tucked away in a secluded corner of the room.
examples.zh: 我们被藏在那房间的一个隐蔽角落里。

examples.en: Tiny secluded beaches can be found off the beaten track.
examples.zh: 极小的与世隔绝的海滩能在鲜有人至之处找到。

examples.en: He lives in a secluded five-bedroom luxury villa.
examples.zh: 他住在一幢僻静的、有5间卧室的豪华别墅里。

examples.en: This drives people like me off the beaten track and onto the more secluded walks.
examples.zh: 这促使像我这样的人离开人迹罕至的地方，走上更僻静的步道。

examples.en: The secluded compound is tucked behind gates, situated at the end of a winding 1, 800-foot-long driveway.
examples.zh: 这座僻静的大院隐藏在大门后面，位于一条 1, 800 英尺长的蜿蜒车道的尽头。

examples.en: Guest rooms are arranged around an inner courtyard of private gardens and a secluded swimming pool.
examples.zh: 客房围绕私人花园的内部庭院和僻静的游泳池布置。

examples.zh: 血液开始在伤口的边缘凝固。

examples.en: The antibodies will bind to the glycophorin and cause the blood cells to coagulate.
examples.zh: 抗体将会捆住血型糖蛋白并使血细胞凝固。

examples.en: An enzyme that occurs in gastric juice causes milk to coagulate.
examples.zh: 胃液中的一种酶能使乳类凝结。

examples.en: Unlike oil, the dye has the same density as the surrounding water, does not coagulate or form slicks, and is not subject to chemical breakdown by bacteria or other forces.
examples.zh: 与油不同，染料与周围的水具有相同的密度，不会凝结或形成浮油，并且不会受到细菌或其他力的化学分解。

examples.en: On a continent in which power tends to coagulate at the top and rarely spreads to regional and local levels, Rwanda preaches a gospel of free enterprise and private sector job creation.
examples.zh: 在这片权力往往集中在高层、很少扩散到地区和地方层面的大陆上，卢旺达宣扬自由企业和私营部门创造就业机会的福音。

examples.en: "Proud and insolent youth," said Hook, "prepare to meet thy doom."
examples.zh: “傲慢无礼的年轻人，”胡克说，“准备迎接你的厄运吧。”

examples.en: "Insolent girl!" said Elizabeth to herself.
examples.zh: “无礼的小妞儿！”伊丽莎白自言自语地说。

examples.en: This was a race of manly men, but insolent and impious.
examples.zh: 这时的人类雄伟刚毅，但却骄横不虔。

examples.en: One well-connected insider has told me that many in the American Jewish community think Mr Netanyahu has been brazen and insolent, that his tactic has backfired.
examples.zh: 一位人脉广泛的内部人士告诉我，美国犹太社区的许多人认为内塔尼亚胡先生厚颜无耻、无礼无礼，他的策略适得其反。

examples.en: This comment is as interesting as it is boldly insolent.
examples.zh: 这个评论既有趣又大胆无礼。

examples.en: Nothing in the manner of the film-making is as witty or insolent as the scene in which Banksy has a red London phone booth carved up, welded into a dogleg, and put back where it stood.
examples.zh: 在电影制作方式中，没有什么比班克斯将伦敦红色电话亭雕刻出来、焊接成狗腿，然后放回原处的场景更诙谐或无礼的了。

examples.zh: 她建议，当出了岔子时，企业应该拿出实物来平息顾客的烦躁情绪，而不是提供什么代金券。

examples.en: To assuage his wife's grief, he took her on a tour of Europe.
examples.zh: 为了缓解妻子的悲伤，他带她去欧洲旅游了一趟。

examples.en: The booming economy seems to have done little to assuage this underlying generational sense of anxious urgency, especially for those who have college debt.
examples.zh: 蓬勃发展的经济似乎并没有怎么缓解这一代人，尤其是那些背负大学债务的人的潜在焦虑感。

examples.en: Relying on foreign resources may also assuage government concerns about having enough food, he said.
examples.zh: 他说，依赖外国资源也可能缓解政府对粮食充足的担忧。

examples.en: So, once again, the perpetrators of the crime are trying to assuage the victims.
examples.zh: 因此，犯罪者再次试图安抚受害者。

examples.en: But that did little to assuage fears among EU citizens with savings deposits at banks.
examples.zh: 但这并没有缓解在银行储蓄存款的欧盟公民的担忧。

examples.en: Jean Valjean directed upon her that heartrending smile to which he occasionally had recourse.
examples.zh: 冉阿让向她苦笑，有时他就这样笑着。

examples.en: With Cosette, and behind her, there had entered a man with white hair who was grave yet smiling, though with a vague and heartrending smile.
examples.zh: 在珂赛特后面陪着她进来的是一位白发老人，态度庄重，但含着微笑，可这是一种捉摸不定和沉痛的微笑。

examples.en: Janeway's tales of the brave and pious deaths of thirteen Christian boys and girls were nothing if not heartrending.
examples.zh: 珍妮薇讲述了十三个基督徒男孩和女孩勇敢而虔诚地死去的故事，如果不是令人心碎的话，那也算不上什么。

examples.en: And in recent NFL history, few seasons have been as heartrending as the one experienced by the 2011 Patriots.
examples.zh: 在近年 NFL 历史上，很少有哪个赛季能像 2011 年爱国者队所经历的那样令人心碎。

examples.en: Much better is the heartrending, tragic-comic scene when Eckhart's Howie takes it upon himself to show the house to prospective buyers, only to fall apart when they come to the nursery.
examples.zh: 更好的是当埃克哈特饰演的豪伊亲自向潜在买家展示房子时，令人心碎、悲喜剧的场景，但当他们来到托儿所时却崩溃了。

etymology.rootMeaning: adj. 悲惨的；令人心碎的

words.meaning: adj. 坚定的；忠诚的；坚固的；vt. 止住；止血；n. （Staunch）人名；（英）斯汤奇

phrases.zh: 坚定的；忠诚的；坚固的；vt. 止住；止血；n. （Staunch）人名；（英）斯汤奇的关键方面

examples.en: He's a staunch supporter of controls on government spending.
examples.zh: 他是政府开支控制的坚定支持者。

examples.en: He is a staunch supporter of amateurism in intercollegiate athletics.
examples.zh: 他坚决支持把学院之间的体育活动业余化。

examples.en: The red plum blossom shows her quality in her staunch will.
examples.zh: 红梅以坚定不移的信念表现她的品格。

examples.en: He voiced staunch opposition to gay marriage when it was legalised in Argentina in 2010.
examples.zh: 2010年同性婚姻在阿根廷合法化时，他表示坚决反对。

examples.en: It also offers a small section of meat dishes, including the English breakfast, to keep staunch carnivores satisfied.
examples.zh: 它还提供一小部分肉类菜肴，包括英式早餐，让顽固的肉食者满意。

examples.en: It's no secret Rove is both a staunch Republican and a John McCain supporter.
examples.zh: 众所周知，罗夫既是坚定的共和党人，又是约翰·麦凯恩的支持者。

examples.en: Yes, yes, she often dwells a recluse in large cities!
examples.zh: 是的，是的，她常常隐居在大城市里！

examples.en: His widow became a virtual recluse for the remainder of her life.
examples.zh: 他的遗孀在其余生成了一名实际上的隐居者。

examples.en: She spent the last forty years of her life as a recluse.
examples.zh: 她在人生的最后四十年都过着隐士般的生活。

examples.en: Because Hughes was supposed to be a recluse, Irving thought his hoax would never be discovered.
examples.zh: 由于休斯被认为是一位隐士，欧文认为他的骗局永远不会被发现。

examples.en: L. history, ended his life a recluse, sleeping on the floor of the Pittsburgh Amtrak station.
examples.zh: L.历史，以隐士的身份结束了自己的生命，睡在匹兹堡美铁车站的地板上。

examples.en: For example, a recluse billionaire in China might want to buy it and hide it.
examples.zh: 例如，中国的一位隐士亿万富翁可能想购买并隐藏它。

phrases.zh: 忠告；劝诫；vi. 劝告的关键方面

examples.en: Exhort her to confess the truth!
examples.zh: 劝诫她招认真情吧！

examples.en: And young men who refuse to grow up need peers and mentors who will exhort them to act like men.
examples.zh: 还有那些拒绝长大的年轻的小伙子们需要来自同龄人和导师们的劝告，告诫他们要像个男人的样子生活。

examples.en: In line with the promise of this age, I want to exhort each of the graduates here to take on an issue.
examples.zh: 秉承这个时代带给人类的希望，我想敦促在座的每一位毕业生，接受一个问题的挑战。

examples.en: The main activity of its adherents is to exhort other Muslims to lead holier lives.
examples.zh: 其追随者的主要活动是劝告其他穆斯林过更圣洁的生活。

examples.en: Instead of fearing global competition, as Mr Kerry appears to, Mr Bush will exhort Americans to embrace it.
examples.zh: 布什先生不会像克里先生那样担心全球竞争，而是会劝告美国人接受它。

examples.en: In response to survey results like this, executives exhort managers to spend even more time with their employees.
examples.zh: 针对这样的调查结果，高管们劝告经理们花更多的时间与员工相处。

examples.en: It helps the drone to give coffee.
examples.zh: 它帮助无人机送咖啡。

examples.en: Who should be allowed to have a drone?
examples.zh: 应该允许谁拥有无人机？

examples.en: In minutes, a drone will do tasks for you.
examples.zh: 几分钟后，无人机就会为你完成任务。

examples.en: And specifically, there's an allegation out there that you're going to give drone strikes a pass.
examples.zh: 具体来说，有一种指控称你将放过无人机袭击。

examples.en: National security experts said many questions remained about U.S. counterterrorism policy, including drone strikes.
examples.zh: 国家安全专家表示，美国反恐政策仍存在许多问题，包括无人机袭击。

examples.en: The White House ordered an evaluation of the drone program during the summer of 2011.
examples.zh: 2011 年夏天，白宫下令对无人机计划进行评估。

phrases.zh: 忧心忡忡的；饱经忧患的；疲倦的的关键方面

examples.en: Her face was careworn with anxiety.
examples.zh: 她因焦虑而面露忧心之色。

examples.en: The old woman had a careworn look on her face.
examples.zh: 老妇脸上露出忧心忡忡的神色。

examples.en: The Nordic detective is often careworn and rumpled.
examples.zh: 北欧的侦探经常疲惫而不修边幅。

examples.en: We are fearful and careworn: experience tells us, we say, that this might not work.
examples.zh: 我们感到恐惧和忧虑：经验告诉我们，我们说，这可能行不通。

examples.en: He joins in, prospers, gets some private tuition from his careworn teacher (Julie Walters), and ends up auditioning for the Royal Ballet.
examples.zh: 他加入了，并取得了成功，从他忧心忡忡的老师（朱莉·沃尔特斯饰）那里得到了一些私人补习，最后参加了皇家芭蕾舞团的试镜。

words.meaning: adj. 吸引人的，极有魅力的，引人入胜的

phrases.zh: 精彩绝伦/引人入胜的表演
扣人心弦的故事情节
令人着迷的叙述

examples.en: The novel presents a riveting narrative about survival during wartime.
examples.zh: 这部小说呈现了一段关于战争时期生存的扣人心弦的叙事。

examples.en: Her riveting speech held the entire audience spellbound from start to finish.
examples.zh: 她引人入胜的演讲从头到尾让全场听众为之倾倒。

examples.en: The documentary provided a riveting glimpse into deep-sea exploration.
examples.zh: 这部纪录片展现了深海探索的令人着迷的景象。

examples.en: Critics praised the lead actor for giving a deeply emotional and riveting performance.
examples.zh: 影评人称赞男主角给出了情感深刻且极其吸引人的表演。

examples.en: It was such a riveting thriller that I finished reading it in one sitting.
examples.zh: 这是一本如此引人入胜的惊悚小说，我一口气就读完了。

synonyms.note: 【解析】饰钮，大头钉。【区别】riveting作动词指用铆钉固定；stud也有用饰钮装饰之意，但侧重点缀散布。
【解析】集中，浓缩。【区别】riveting (动词)强调将目光注意力死死钉在某处；concentrate泛指集中精神或聚集。
【解析】聚焦，焦点。【区别】riveting强调不可抗拒的吸引力使人全神贯注；focus强调调整视角使某事物清晰或关注于某点。
【解析】中心，集中于。【区别】riveting带有被强烈吸引的被动意味；center强调把某物作为活动的中心或重点。

examples.en: Azazel Jacobs directed this maudlin yet feel-nothing feature, which risks giving independent filmmaking a bad name.
examples.zh: 阿扎泽尔·雅各布斯执导了这部伤感而又毫无感觉的影片，这可能会给独立电影制作带来坏名声。

examples.en: It was her vanity that disgusted me, the way she undercut the confession with a preening, maudlin joke.
examples.zh: 让我厌恶的是她的虚荣心，她用一个自命不凡、伤感的笑话削弱了她的坦白。

examples.en: Sometimes it doesn't work, as in the maudlin "Please Don't Call It Love, " with its weepy, sleepy violin.
examples.zh: 有时它不起作用，就像在伤感的“请不要称之为爱”中，小提琴的声音令人哭泣、昏昏欲睡。

words.meaning: v. 强调，突出，使更明显；加重音符号
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】指通过对比、对比配色、语气或结构排布使某种特征、优势、矛盾或细节“变得更加突出、鲜明醒目”（accentuate the positive / contrast / features）。感情色彩中性，文学、服装设计、演讲与写作高频词。
【历史典故/词源】源自拉丁语 accentus（重音，调子），由 ad-（向）+ cantus（歌唱，同 chant/accent）构成。本义是“为发音加上重音/调子”。
【专业领域特殊含义】在设计与时尚界，accentuate one's figure 指“凸显身材线条”；在语言学中指“打重音/加重音符号”。
【助记方法】accent（重音/强调）+ uate（动词后缀）→ 加上重音符号使之醒目 → 强调，突出。

phrases.zh: 强调积极一面
突出对比
突出关键特征
加剧/凸显趋势

examples.en: The tight dress was designed to accentuate her slender figure.
examples.zh: 这件紧身连衣裙旨在凸显她苗条的身材。

examples.en: The speaker used vivid examples to accentuate the urgency of the problem.
examples.zh: 演讲者用生动的例子强调了该问题的紧迫性。

examples.en: Dark walls can accentuate the artwork displayed in the gallery.
examples.zh: 深色的墙壁能够烘托突出画廊里展出的艺术品。

examples.en: Economic inequality was accentuated by the prolonged economic downturn.
examples.zh: 长期的经济衰退加剧突显了经济不平等。

examples.en: Makeup can be used to accentuate natural facial features.
examples.zh: 化妆可以用来突出自然的面部特征。

synonyms.note: 强调。区别：emphasize 为通用词；accentuate 侧重视觉上或形象上的突出显眼。
突出，使显著。区别：highlight 侧重吸引对重点的注意。

examples.zh: 而且他们居然还有脸抱怨！

examples.zh: 他竟厚颜无耻地指责记者利用一场悲剧来谋求他们的私利。

examples.zh: 我们先从《纽约时报》驻喀布尔记者卡洛塔·加尔开始。

examples.en: They don't really, in their ivory towers, understand how pernicious drug crime is.
examples.zh: 身处象牙塔里，他们并不真正懂得毒品犯罪多么有害。

examples.en: The kind of paper that purports to show that people who eat more than one kilo of broccoli a week were 1.17 times more likely than those who eat less to suffer late in life from pernicious anaemia.
examples.zh: 这类论文声称，每周吃超过一公斤西兰花的人晚年患恶性贫血的几率是那些吃得少的人的1.17倍。

examples.en: The impact on macroeconomic policy was equally pernicious.
examples.zh: 它对于宏观经济政策同样有害。

examples.en: In other words, if economics counts, it's better to make good laws than pernicious walls.
examples.zh: 换句话说，如果经济因素重要的话，制定好的法律比有害的围墙更好。

examples.en: The pernicious agricultural protectionism that prevails in all major developed countries must be dismantled.
examples.zh: 必须废除所有主要发达国家普遍存在的有害农业保护主义。

examples.en: In the early stage there is a particularly pernicious problem to be faced in public accounting.
examples.zh: 在早期阶段，公共会计面临着一个特别严重的问题。

examples.en: The British charachter is often said to be phlegmatic. ;
examples.zh: 英国人的性格常被说成 是冷漠的.

examples.en: Or consider the phlegmatic, a person who is indifferent to interactions with the child.
examples.zh: 或者来看看粘液质，这样的一个人并不关心与孩子的互动。

examples.en: Some are nervous but Finn was calm, unruffled and phlegmatic and he looked like he belonged.
examples.zh: 有些人很紧张，但芬恩却很平静、沉着、冷静，他看起来很归属。

examples.en: Hard to be phlegmatic when the cards are stacked and the capricious gods are pissed and feeling vindictive.
examples.zh: 当牌堆成堆，反复无常的诸神生气并感到报复时，你很难保持冷静。

examples.en: He was an unassuming man, steady, phlegmatic, with a thick brush of white hair and a craggy outdoorsman's face.
examples.zh: 他是一个谦逊的人，稳重，冷漠，一头浓密的白发，一张崎岖不平的户外人士的脸。

examples.en: Tony is very cagey about his family.
examples.zh: 托尼对自己家的事讳莫如深。

examples.en: He is cagey about what he was paid for the business.
examples.zh: 他遮遮掩掩的，不愿说出在这桩生意中挣了多少。

examples.en: Don't be cagey or vague in headlines.
examples.zh: 不要在标题上小心谨慎和含糊不清。

examples.en: After a cagey opening, Scotland goalkeeper Alan Martin had to save twice in the 15th minute.
examples.zh: 在开局谨慎后，苏格兰门将阿兰·马丁在第 15 分钟两次扑救。

examples.zh: 前 45 分钟是一场谨慎的比赛，真正的机会非常宝贵。

examples.en: With a shaved head and regulation black clothes he is a friendly, if somewhat cagey, individual.

examples.en: An exacting job; became more exigent over his pronunciation.
examples.zh: 要求严格的工作；对他的发音要求更加苛刻。

examples.en: It is necessary and exigent to enhance the management of construction material.
examples.zh: 加强建筑材料管理工作是进行造价控制的迫切需要；

examples.en: The removal of heavy metals sewage sludges is a problem that is exigent to be solved.
examples.zh: 重金属的去除是污水污泥处理中亟待解决的问题。

examples.en: The lawsuit adds a powerfully exigent dimension to the issues we touched on last week.
examples.zh: 这起诉讼为我们上周谈到的问题增添了一个非常紧迫的维度。

examples.en: Of course Spain has done well to fund itself, but the raw fact is that the economy is still exigent.
examples.zh: 当然，西班牙在融资方面做得很好，但最根本的事实是经济仍然紧迫。

examples.en: We have recently extended our special programs for primary dealers beyond the end of the year, based on our assessment that financial conditions remain unusual and exigent.
examples.zh: 根据我们对财务状况仍然不寻常和紧迫的评估，我们最近将针对一级交易商的特别计划延长到了年底之后。

examples.en: A person regarded as mentally dull; a dolt.
examples.zh: 被认为迟钝的或呆滞的人。

examples.en: He's a first-class dolt who insists on doing things his way.
examples.zh: 他是一等的傻瓜，坚持要以自己的方式做事情。

examples.en: You can fight all day, but want dolt thinks he can beat God?
examples.zh: 你们可以天天抗争，但哪个笨蛋以为他能战胜上帝？

examples.en: Reilly playing a hapless dolt who rises to the top by imitating every popular style at exactly the right moment, from Elvis to Dylan to the Fab Four.
examples.zh: 赖利扮演一个倒霉的傻瓜，他通过在适当的时刻模仿各种流行风格（从猫王到迪伦到披头士四人组）而登上顶峰。

examples.en: Tye got us to Dolt Tower in about six hours.
examples.zh: 泰伊在大约六个小时内带我们到达了多尔特塔。

examples.en: The artist and his sparely-drawn strip have taken knocks over the years, but Dilbert's piercing take on corporate life far outdates revered parodies like The Office and Office Space, and some whiny critic wouldn't be the first dolt Dilbert encountered in his long, long career.
examples.zh: 多年来，这位艺术家和他那幅简洁的漫画饱受批评，但呆伯特对企业生活的尖锐看法远远超过了《办公室》和《办公空间》等受人尊敬的模仿作品，一些爱发牢骚的评论家不会是呆伯特在他漫长的职业生涯中遇到的第一个傻瓜。

examples.zh: 政府对是否修改现行法律存有疑虑。

examples.en: Executives say they are leery of the proposed system.
examples.zh: 行政人员们说他们对拟建的系统持怀疑态度。

examples.en: They were leery about investing in a company controlled by a single individual.
examples.zh: 他们不太放心把资金投向一间由一人独自操控的公司。

examples.en: And many remain leery of what appears invasive, hackable, and scary about implantables and ingestibles.
examples.zh: 许多人仍然对植入物和摄入物的侵入性、可破解性和可怕性持怀疑态度。

examples.en: Already, the housing market has been depressed by the scaling back of credit by leery banks.
examples.zh: 由于警惕的银行缩减信贷规模，房地产市场已经陷入低迷。

examples.en: Leery of this unstable, clingy woman, Ms Homes agrees to speak only on the telephone.
examples.zh: 霍姆斯女士对这个不稳定、粘人的女人心存戒心，同意只通过电话交谈。

examples.zh: 这是对俄罗斯人的序曲。

examples.en: Usher: No, even the overture hasn't started yet.
examples.zh: 招待员：没有，连序幕都没有开始呢。

examples.en: Still, many lawmakers remain unconvinced by China's overture.
examples.zh: 仍有许多议员依然不相信中国作出的姿态。

examples.en: At one point in 2001 Google officials even met with Overture to compare notes, Overture officials say.
examples.zh: Overture 官员称，2001 年，Google 官员甚至曾与 Overture 会面交换意见。

examples.en: To counter the uninvited overture, Overland implemented a poison-pill plan a week after Advanced Digital's announcement.
examples.zh: 为了反击这种不请自来的提议，在 Advanced Digital 宣布这一消息一周后，Overland 实施了一项毒丸计划。

examples.en: Once the retailers had retained counsel (and paid some legal bills), they made a settlement overture.
examples.zh: 一旦零售商聘请了律师（并支付了一些法律费用），他们就提出了和解建议。

examples.en: Not everyone was convinced by such bombast.
examples.zh: 并不是每个人都相信这种夸大其词。

examples.en: There was no bombast or conceit in his speech.
examples.zh: 他的发言里没有浮夸或自负。

examples.en: His speech was full of bombast.
examples.zh: 他的讲演通篇是夸夸其谈。

examples.en: Lee, an officer of exceptional indolence and bombast whose incompetence likely lengthened the campaign by months.
examples.zh: 李是一位极其懒惰和夸夸其谈的军官，他的无能可能使战役延长了几个月。

examples.en: Mr Gonzales will probably fight terror much as his predecessor did, though with less bombast.
examples.zh: 冈萨雷斯先生可能会像他的前任那样打击恐怖主义，但不会那么夸张。

examples.en: But such bombast is now wearing thin as orders for the new Airbus roll in.
examples.zh: 但随着新型空客飞机订单的不断增加，这种夸夸其谈现在已经不再那么重要了。

examples.en: Women, don't banish your man to the couch or stomp off to pout in the spare bedroom.
examples.zh: 女人，不要把你的男人打发到沙发上，也不要在空闲的卧室里跺脚噘嘴。

examples.en: If we could banish all such preconceptions when we read, that would be an admirable beginning.
examples.zh: 如果我们在阅读时能摈弃所有这些先入之见，那将是一个极好的开端。

examples.en: Don't banish certain foods.
examples.zh: 不要杜绝特定食品。

examples.en: Rooney is keen to banish the memories of the England's 2006 World Cup exit.
examples.zh: 鲁尼渴望消除英格兰队2006年世界杯出局的记忆。

examples.en: Chief executives understand that it is impossible to banish insider trading without crippling the markets themselves.
examples.zh: 首席执行官们明白，在不损害市场本身的情况下消除内幕交易是不可能的。

examples.en: However, earworms did seem similar to intrusive thoughts in relation to attempts to banish them.
examples.zh: 然而，耳虫似乎确实与试图驱逐它们的侵入性想法相似。

words.meaning: n. 座右铭，格言，警句；格言主题；【名】 （Motto）（英）莫托，（意、西）莫托（人名）

phrases.zh: 奥林匹克格言
校训

examples.en: 'Live and let live.' That's my motto.
examples.zh: “待人宽如待己。”这就是我的座右铭。

examples.en: The school's motto is: 'Duty, Honour, Country'.
examples.zh: 这所学校的校训是：“责任、荣誉、国家”。

examples.en: "Stay true to yourself" has always been his motto.
examples.zh: “忠于自己”一直是他的座右铭。

examples.en: Life, fervor, taking things to the limit - that's their motto, according to Toni.
examples.zh: 托尼表示，生活、热情、将事情推向极限——这是他们的座右铭。

examples.en: For too many teachers, the motto seems to be: When in doubt, walk out.
examples.zh: 对于太多的老师来说，座右铭似乎是：当有疑问时，走出去。

examples.en: His family's motto had been "two wheels good, four wheels bad" for many years, he said.
examples.zh: 他说，多年来，他的家族的座右铭是“两个轮子好，四个轮子坏”。

examples.en: Maven: I admit - it sounds crazy.
examples.zh: 美芬：我承认。听上去很疯狂。

examples.en: Maven: What's wrong with my haircut?!?
examples.zh: 美芬：我的发型怎么啦？！

examples.en: Maven: No padding and lots of people get hurt.
examples.zh: 美芬：恩，没有护垫，很多人会受伤。

examples.en: We'll hear from consumer advocate and safety maven Joan Claybrook about what this means.
examples.zh: 我们将听听消费者权益倡导者和安全专家琼·克莱布鲁克 (Joan Claybrook) 的讲述这意味着什么。

examples.en: But the judge barred Penney from using the home maven's name in promoting the collection.
examples.zh: 但法官禁止彭尼使用这位家居专家的名字来宣传该系列。

examples.en: Other billionaires, such as media maven Oprah Winfrey, made their fortunes against far greater odds.
examples.zh: 其他亿万富翁，例如媒体专家奥普拉·温弗瑞，是在困难得多的情况下发家致富的。

examples.en: He did so at great risk to himself, and he paid the ultimate price when the Illuminati were tipped off by some of the song titles on the Dangerous album.
examples.zh: 他冒着非常巨大的风险在他《Dangerous》专辑中，利用几首歌的标题影射光明会，最终他为此付出了代价。

examples.en: The anger and discontent at the problems of the world is understandable, as you have been led into the planned chaos and failure scripted by the Illuminati.
examples.zh: 对于世界问题的“愤怒”和“不满”是可以理解的，由于你们被“光照派”带入“混乱”和“失败”的计划中。

examples.en: Skeptics say there's no evidence to support the existence of the Illuminati, but conspiracy theorists say that the lack of evidence actually proves the group exists.
examples.zh: 怀疑者说，没有证据表明光照派确实存在，但是阴谋论者说，缺少证据恰恰就证明了这个组织的存在。

examples.en: No, Goldman Sachs and Ben Bernanke are not an Illuminati planning a takeover of the free market system.
examples.zh: 不，高盛和本·伯南克并不是计划接管自由市场体系的光明会。

examples.en: This caught the attention of the tech company illuminati.
examples.zh: 这引起了科技公司光明会的注意。

examples.en: That certainly will be fodder for the conspiracy theorists, yes, although I suspect that those who insist on the Illuminati, the Rosicrucians and the Grey Lizards will think that 150 companies is far too dispersed a conspiracy.
examples.zh: 是的，这肯定会成为阴谋论者的素材，尽管我怀疑那些坚持光明会、蔷薇十字会和灰蜥蜴会的人会认为 150 家公司过于分散是一个阴谋。

phrases.zh: 灌输；教导的关键方面

examples.en: I wouldn't say that she was trying to indoctrinate us.
examples.zh: 我不认为她在竭力向我们灌输信仰。

examples.en: You indoctrinate republicans!
examples.zh: 你，去教育共和党人！

examples.en: The writer wants to indoctrinate the readers with the idea.
examples.zh: 作者想把这种想法灌输给读者。

examples.en: Like people everywhere, when given the opportunity, Israelis seek out information sources that inform rather than indoctrinate and empower rather than demoralize them.
examples.zh: 与世界各地的人们一样，一旦有机会，以色列人就会寻找信息来源，以提供信息而不是灌输，赋予他们权力而不是使他们士气低落。

examples.en: Fox Business Network anchor Lou Dobbs recently accused the upcoming movie, The Secret World of Arrietty, which is based on the Mary Norton book, The Borrowers, as well as The Lorax, based on a book by Dr. Suess, as tools by the liberal media to indoctrinate children.
examples.zh: 福克斯商业网主播卢·多布斯最近指责即将上映的电影《阿丽埃蒂的秘密世界》（根据玛丽·诺顿的书《借款人》改编）以及根据苏斯博士的书改编的《洛拉克斯》是自由派媒体向儿童灌输思想的工具。

examples.en: The audience is bounced from gag to gag and conversation to conversation; there is no time for audience reflection.
examples.zh: 插科打诨和一段又一段的对话让观众目不暇接，根本没有时间认真思考。

examples.en: It was just a gag—we didn't mean to upset anyone.
examples.zh: 这只是逗着玩—我们并未想使任何人不高兴。

examples.en: Each gag was rewarded with a generous belly-laugh.
examples.zh: 每一次插科打诨都引来一阵捧腹大笑。

examples.en: We wrinkle our noses, gag, perhaps get hungry or sexually aroused, or inhale more deeply.
examples.zh: 我们会皱鼻子、作呕，可能会感到饥饿或性唤起，或者吸气更深。

examples.en: Apparently Tom Hanks is a genuinely nice guy and went along with the gag.
examples.zh: 显然汤姆·汉克斯是一个真正的好人，并且同意这个笑话。

examples.en: The public defender's office refused to disclose the costs, citing the gag order and attorney-client privilege.
examples.zh: 公设辩护人办公室以禁言令和律师与委托人之间的特权为由，拒绝透露费用。

phrases.zh: 执拗的，固执的；棘手的，难以去除的的关键方面

examples.en: He is obstinate and determined and will not give up.
examples.zh: 他固执、坚决，不会放弃。

examples.en: Don't be stupid and obstinate, like a goat.
examples.zh: 不要像山羊一样又笨又固执。

examples.en: This obstinate refusal made Heidi very angry.
examples.zh: 这顽固的拒绝让海蒂很生气。

examples.en: Beyond this obstinate spine of rock that the Colorado has not yet managed to grind down, the river enters Canyonlands National Park.
examples.zh: 穿过科罗拉多河尚未磨碎的顽固岩石脊，河流进入峡谷地国家公园。

examples.en: The release, sent to local and national media, said Mr. McDonough had fear of "big brother" government and called him obstinate.
examples.zh: 这份发给当地和国家媒体的新闻稿称，麦克唐纳害怕“老大哥”政府，并称他很顽固。

examples.en: The Military-Industrial Complex proves an obstinate foe for the Deficit Reduction Committee.
examples.zh: 事实证明，军工联合体是削减赤字委员会的顽敌。

examples.en: Tablets are newer and just beginning to pervade the market.
examples.zh: 平板电脑较新且刚刚开始蔓延于市场。

examples.en: However, biases against women still pervade many places on the Internet.
examples.zh: 但是，网络上对于女性的歧视仍然屡见不鲜。

examples.en: Expressionist graphics, decisive slogans and modernist wit pervade these images.
examples.zh: 表象派作家生动的，坚定的标语和现代主义作者遍及街头的风趣画作。

examples.en: What is clear is that the Social Enterprise will pervade every part of your organization.
examples.zh: 显而易见的是，社会企业将渗透到组织的每个部分。

examples.en: Worst still are the high cost variable annuities with mutual fund clones that pervade the governmental defined contribution plans.
examples.zh: 最糟糕的是政府固定缴款计划中充斥着模仿共同基金的高成本可变年金。

examples.en: Americans generally co-exist peacefully with the corporations whose activities pervade our daily lives.
examples.zh: 美国人通常与那些其活动渗透到我们日常生活中的公司和平共处。

examples.en: Patience and submission are the only comforts that are left to a poor people who groan under tyranny unless they are strong enough to break the yoke.
examples.zh: 坚忍与顺从是可怜的人儿仅有的慰籍，她们在暴行面前只能低声抽泣，除非她们有力量挣脱枷锁。

examples.en: The introduction attempts to yoke the pieces together.
examples.zh: 引言试图将各部分硬拼凑在一起。

examples.en: "Too much too soon either results in injury or burnout," says Mary Yoke, PhD, a faculty member in the kinesiology department at Indiana University in Bloomington.
examples.zh: 印第安纳大学布鲁明顿分校运动机能学系教师玛丽·约克博士说道：“太多或太快的运动都会导致身体受伤或过度劳累。”

examples.en: Upon reaching this speed, you lift the yoke back, pitch up 10 degrees, and you're flying.
examples.zh: 达到这个速度后，你将操纵杆向后抬起，向上倾斜 10 度，然后你就开始飞行了。

examples.en: Other important animal tools include the saddle, bridle, the stirrup, the yoke, the whip.
examples.zh: 其他重要的动物工具包括马鞍、缰绳、马镫、轭、鞭子。

examples.en: West Bengal's government sees the rickshaw trade as an outworn symbol of the colonial yoke.
examples.zh: 西孟加拉邦政府将人力车贸易视为殖民枷锁的过时象征。

words.meaning: n. 懊悔，自责

phrases.zh: 懊悔，自责的关键方面

examples.en: I felt guilty and full of remorse.
examples.zh: 我感到内疚，并且非常懊悔。

examples.en: He seemed to feel no remorse at all.
examples.zh: 他当时似乎一点也不感到懊悔。

examples.en: He was full of remorse and asked Beatrice what he could do to make amends.
examples.zh: 他悔恨不已，问比阿特丽斯他可以做点什么来弥补。

examples.en: Lerner said he was sending Moton home and she has shown remorse for her crimes.
examples.zh: 勒纳说，他将把莫顿送回家，她已经对自己的罪行表示悔恨。

examples.en: Instead, he produces the admission of remorse from Avery in a long scene with a psychiatrist.
examples.zh: 相反，他在与一位精神科医生的长镜头中让艾弗里承认了悔恨。

examples.en: Mr Fenwick said Mr Sowden had "shown no remorse for his violent behaviour and actions".
examples.zh: 芬威克表示，索登“对自己的暴力行为没有表现出悔意”。

examples.en: She bears an uncanny resemblance to Dido.
examples.zh: 她跟迪多长得离奇的相似。

examples.en: I had an uncanny feeling I was being watched.
examples.zh: 我有种被人监视的奇怪感觉。

examples.en: Tony was unnerved by the uncanny familiarity of her face.
examples.zh: 托尼被她不寻常的熟悉面孔弄得心烦意乱。

examples.en: The essence of the Saban money touch is an uncanny ability to parlay small properties into big ones.
examples.zh: 萨班金钱接触的本质是一种将小财产转化为大财产的不可思议的能力。

examples.en: To the uncanny, the new Dell looks pretty much like the old Dell.
examples.zh: 令人惊奇的是，新的戴尔看起来与旧的戴尔非常相似。

examples.en: By contrast, on television, where he has been appearing more frequently, he acts with uncanny sang-froid.
examples.zh: 相比之下，他在电视上出现的频率更高，表现得异常冷静。

examples.en: Raymond: that it is possible for open source cultures in some respects to ossify enough that good work is locked out.

examples.zh: 他说：“因为只为少数人服务、不能让所有人发挥出最好水平的经济体将会僵化并被抛在后面，因此机会平等是经济上的必要条件。”

examples.en: They knew enough to understand how hard they could push without breaking things (the rate of return they demanded would soon ossify into a ritualized expectation of stable growth rates, a big enabler of the rise of a middle class that could basically withdraw from the risk frontier).
examples.zh: 他们足够了解自己可以在不破坏事物的情况下努力推动（他们所要求的回报率很快就会僵化为对稳定增长率的仪式化预期，这是中产阶级崛起的重要推动力，而中产阶级基本上可以退出风险边界）。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of ossify.

含义：必需的，必要的。区别：Needful 词义与 Requisite 相近，但较少使用，常带有些许古风或文学色彩；Requisite 是现代较为常用的正式词汇。
含义：要求的，必须的。区别：Required 侧重于因规则、命令或法律而被要求做某事；Requisite 则侧重于某物由于自身性质而是必不可少的。
含义：必需品，必然性。区别：Necessity 作为名词，强调客观上不可或缺的事物；Requisite 既可作形容词也可作名词，多指达成某事的前提或必备条件。

etymology.rootMeaning: 作为 requisite 构词基础的词形；核心义参见“必需品”
etymology.explanation: requisite 直接建立在 requirere 之上，是它的派生形式；现有词源记录可追溯到 1600 年；词形经拉丁语 requisitus 进入或影响英语。

cognates.meaning: 先决条件的, 必要的；先决条件, 必备条件

etymology.memory: 把 requirere → prerequisite 串成词族，比较词性、后缀和核心义的变化。

words.analysis: 【细微含义与使用场景】正式书面语、公文、学术及商务场合。表示某种资格、条件、工具或技能为达成某特定目的所“绝对必需”的。【特殊含义】经常搭配 prerequisite（先决条件），两者的区别在于 prerequisite 强调事前必须满足的前置条件，而 requisite 侧重事物本身不可或缺的必备要素。【助记方法】词根 re-（反复/强调）+ quis/ques（寻找，要求，如 request, require）+ -ite -> 被强烈要求的 -> 必需的，必需品。

examples.zh: 她的突然出现似乎一点也没有令他不安。

examples.zh: 他们以谎言和宣传扰乱良好的社会秩序。

examples.zh: 这些温室气体会扰乱气候的辐射平衡。

examples.zh: 一波又一波的运动再次扰乱了人群，将那些不太警惕的人推到了后面。

examples.zh: 在阴暗潮湿的工厂里苦作的人们精疲力竭了，无法享受家庭生活。

examples.en: The kitchen was dank and cheerless.
examples.zh: 厨房阴暗而沉闷。

examples.en: The basement in our house is dark and dank, so it is full of mold.
examples.zh: 我们家的地下室又暗又潮湿，里面长满了霉。

examples.en: Cold fronts whip the Duirinish and Trotternish peninsulas, giving Skye a dank, mysterious personality.
examples.zh: 冷锋袭击了杜里尼什半岛和特罗特尼什半岛，给斯凯岛带来了潮湿、神秘的个性。

examples.en: The wrong orientation can ruin the courtyard's purpose, making it look cold and dank.
examples.zh: 错误的朝向可能会破坏庭院的用途，使其看起来又冷又潮湿。

examples.en: Or visiting the dank dungeons of Fort McHenry, home of "The Star-Spangled Banner, " in Baltimore Harbor.
examples.zh: 或者参观位于巴尔的摩港的麦克亨利堡潮湿的地牢，这里是“星条旗永不落”的故乡。

phrases.zh: 不祥之兆

examples.en: There were ominous dark clouds gathering on the horizon before the storm hit.
examples.zh: 风暴来临前，地平线上聚集着阴森压顶的乌云。

examples.en: The sudden, ominous silence in the courtroom rendered everyone motionless.
examples.zh: 法庭内突然出现的令人不安的死寂让所有人屏息凝神。

examples.en: Economists warned that the rising unemployment figures were an ominous sign for the nation's recovery.
examples.zh: 经济学家警告称，不断上升的失业数字对国家经济复苏而言是个不祥之兆。

examples.en: He spoke in an ominous low whisper that chilled her to the bone.
examples.zh: 他用令人毛骨悚然的低沉压抑的声音低语着，让她感到脊背发凉。

examples.en: The company's declining quarterly revenue presented an ominous outlook for its future.
examples.zh: 该公司季度营收的下滑为其未来前景蒙上了一层阴影。

synonyms.note:
解析：指有害的、恶意的、预示灾祸的。
区别：Ominous 泛指不祥的兆头，未必带有明显的主观恶意；Baleful 则强烈暗示主观上的恶意、阴险或带来毁灭性伤害的意图。

解析：指外貌或态度令人生畏的、冷酷的。
区别：Ominous 侧重于预示未来会发生不好的事情；Forbidding 则侧重于某人或某物当前的外表、态度让人感到难以接近或心生畏惧。

解析：指具有威胁性的、恐吓的。
区别：Ominous 暗示一种隐约的、不祥的预兆；Menacing 则表现出更直接、更明显的物理或暴力上的威胁。

解析：指威吓的、具威胁性的。
区别：Ominous 是常用词，侧重预兆；Minacious 是 menacing 的同义词，但更为生僻和正式，主要强调带有威胁的性质。

etymology.rootMeaning: adj. 恶兆的, 不吉利的, 预兆的
etymology.explanation: 现有词源记录可追溯到 1580 年代；词形经拉丁语 ominosus 进入或影响英语；从现代构词看可辅助拆为 omin + -ous（形容词后缀，表示具有某种性质）。

words.analysis:
【细微含义与领域】文学与新闻高频词。形容某种迹象、氛围或声音预示着危险、不幸或灾难即将来临，给人带来阴森不安的压迫感。
【感情色彩与场景】消极/阴暗感情色彩。常见于文学作品的环境描写、政治分析（如不祥的政治局势）以及新闻对危机的前兆报道。
【词源与历史典故】源自拉丁语 omen（预兆）。在古罗马时期，占卜官通过观察鸟类飞行或闪电来解读神明的预兆，预示坏事的迹象即为 ominous。
【助记方法】omin (看作 omen 预兆) + ous (充满...的形容词后缀) -> 充满不祥预兆的 -> 不吉利的。

examples.en: All my desired was to aggrandize my estate.
examples.zh: 我所希望的只是扩充我的家业。

examples.en: We aswell hope to aggrandize our business with you.
examples.zh: 我们也盼望与贵公司扩展贸易往来。

examples.en: For Trump, the U.S. presidential race, must be amazingly enticing as a self promotional tool and a way to further aggrandize his limitless ego.
examples.zh: 对于特朗普来说，美国总统竞选作为一种自我推销工具和进一步强化他无限自我的方式一定具有惊人的吸引力。

examples.en: In a zero-sum world, you may envy or blandish others, but you cannot trust them, because you can assume they are seeking to aggrandize themselves at your expense.
examples.zh: 在零和世界中，你可能会嫉妒或奉承他人，但你不能信任他们，因为你可以假设他们正在以牺牲你的利益为代价来谋取自身利益。

words.meaning: v. 使全神贯注；使沉溺；正式誊写；独占（市场）
words.analysis: 【细微含义与使用场景】1. 最常用含义：使某人全神贯注/吸引全部注意力（passively used: be engrossed in sth）；2. 法律/历史：用大号字体正式誊写文件（engross a bill）；3. 历史经济：囤积、垄断商品。常用在阅读、学习、工作或艺术欣赏场景。【助记】en-（使...入）+ gross（大/整体）-> 吸收全部大局/注意力 -> 使全神贯注。

examples.en: The detective novel completely engrossed her, making her forget the time and miss her stop.
examples.zh: 这部侦探小说完全吸引了她，让她忘了时间甚至坐过了站。

examples.en: He was so engrossed in his research that he failed to notice the room filling with smoke.
examples.zh: 他太专注于自己的研究，以至于没有注意到房间里浓烟弥漫。

examples.en: The fascinating presentation engrossed the audience from start to finish.
examples.zh: 这场精彩纷呈的演讲从头到尾吸引了全场观众的注意力。

examples.en: In medieval scriptoriums, scribes would carefully engross official royal charters.
examples.zh: 在中世纪的抄写室里，抄写员会精心誊写官方的皇家宪章。

examples.en: Children are often engrossed in video games for hours without moving.
examples.zh: 孩子们往往沉迷于电子游戏数小时一动不动。

synonyms.note: 解析：使沉浸，浸泡。区别：Engross 侧重于完全吸引了某人的注意力；Steep 侧重于长时间深深沉浸在某种氛围、研究或传统中。
解析：沉浸，陷入。区别：Engross 强调事物独占注意力；Immerse 侧重于全身心陷入某活动中，如同将物体没入液体。
解析：吞没。区别：Engross 用于注意力；Engulf 侧重于被巨大的自然力量（如水、火）或强烈情绪完全包围吞没。
解析：投入，跳入。区别：Engross 指被动被吸引；Plunge 侧重于猛力跳入水中或突然使陷入某种紧急状态或行动中。

examples.en: Some of his first interviews with the press were rather maladroit.
examples.zh: 他刚开始接受的一些新闻采访，显得相当笨拙。

examples.en: We knew that he had some problems somewhere from his maladroit movements.
examples.zh: 从他笨拙的动作我们就知道了他身体某处有问题。

examples.en: Our new supervisor is clever in matters in which his predecessor was maladroit.
examples.zh: 我们的新主管在他的前任做得笨拙的事上很聪明。

examples.en: No matter that Mattis is maladroit, he is respected by fellow collectors, in part for having solved a vexing art world mystery.
examples.zh: 尽管马蒂斯笨手笨脚，但他仍受到其他收藏家的尊重，部分原因是他解决了艺术界一个令人烦恼的谜团。

examples.en: In this one, a graduate student in art, Evelyn (Rachel Weisz), a fire-breathing free spirit, unaccountably takes up with an overweight and maladroit undergraduate, Adam (Paul Rudd).
examples.zh: 在这部电影中，艺术研究生伊芙琳（蕾切尔·薇兹饰）是一位喷火式自由精神的人，她莫名其妙地与一个超重且笨手笨脚的本科生亚当（保罗·路德饰）发生了关系。

examples.en: It is worth noting that this maladroit and shortsighted policy may have profound political costs to the Bush Administration -- even as they are incurring significant strategic costs to the nation.
examples.zh: 值得注意的是，这种笨拙和短视的政策可能会给布什政府带来深远的政治成本——尽管它们正在给国家带来巨大的战略成本。

examples.en: A mob of zombies will stalk the night, and a handful of zesty firms will dance at dawn.
examples.zh: 一群僵尸企业将在夜间大行其道，而少量的阳光企业则在清晨舞步蹁跹。

examples.en: Eating anywhere in China can be such a zesty, tasty experience that words do no justice.
examples.zh: 中国任何一个地方的美味佳肴都会让你大饱口福，流连忘返，妙不可言。

examples.en: Dig in to chilli poppers (zesty large chillies oozing melted cheese) or chicken satay with curly fries.
examples.zh: 大吃一顿辣椒(辣椒从灿烂的奶酪里渗出)或者吃些鸡肉沙爹和炸薯条。

examples.en: Lots of little, exotic seasonal tastes add up to a zesty kaiseki feast at Sugiyama .
examples.zh: 杉山的怀石料理盛宴融合了许多异域风情的时令风味。

examples.en: The early summer season of crisply hopped, grapfruity, zesty, sherbety, golden session ales is upon us.
examples.zh: 初夏时节，啤酒花清脆，葡萄柚味浓郁，果子露味浓郁，金色的艾尔啤酒即将到来。

examples.en: The atmosphere is zesty: dark wood, vintage Italian posters and red-and-white checked table cloths.
examples.zh: 气氛热烈：深色木材、复古意大利海报和红白格子桌布。

words.meaning: v. 猛然转向，改变方向；(话题/立场) 突然偏离 n. 转向，偏离
words.analysis:
【细微含义】指车辆、飞禽或运动物体突然拐弯；或引申指谈话、政策、态度突然偏离原有的轨迹（veer off course / veer into...）。
【使用场景】驾驶与航海、政治政策讨论、文学描写。
【感情色彩】中性（描述动作）或略带担忧色彩（往往暗含失去了原本稳定的轨道）。
【IT/AI含义】在自动驾驶（Autonomous Driving）与机器人轨迹规划中，veer 表示偏离期望航线。
【助记方法】veer 发音像“微斜/急转”，联想车轮猛转的方向转变。

examples.en: The bus driver swerved to avoid the dog, causing the vehicle to veer into the opposite lane.
examples.zh: 公交车司机为了避让狗而猛打方向，导致车辆驶入了对向车道。

examples.en: The conversation veered away from business and turned to personal memories.
examples.zh: 谈话偏离了公事，转向了个人回忆。

examples.en: Market sentiment veered sharply from extreme optimism to deep concern.
examples.zh: 市场情绪从极度乐观急剧转向深刻担忧。

examples.en: The storm caused the small fishing boat to veer off course.
examples.zh: 暴风雨导致这艘小渔船偏离了航线。

examples.en: In autonomous vehicle tests, the car must not veer out of its designated lane.
examples.zh: 在自动驾驶测试中，车辆绝对不能偏离其指定车道。

synonyms.note: v. 突然转向，转弯。Veer 侧重于方向或风向的改变；Swerve 强调为了躲避障碍物等而突然、急剧地转向。
v. 偏航，急转向。Veer 侧重于逐渐或突然改变方向；Sheer 常指船只等突然偏离航线。
v. 弯曲，呈曲线形。Veer 指方向上的改变；Curve 指沿着曲线轨迹移动或自然弯曲。
v. 倾向，趋向。Veer 侧重于具体的方向转变或意见的突然改变；Trend 侧重于总体的发展趋势或走向。

vi. 断，裂开”

examples.en: You hear talk about American business being flabby.
examples.zh: 你会听到有关美国经济发展无序的议论。

examples.en: This exercise is great for getting rid of flabby arms.
examples.zh: 这个练习对减除手臂的赘肉极为有效。

examples.en: A few weeks of aerobics will firm up that flabby stomach.
examples.zh: 几个星期的有氧健身运动将使松弛的腹部结实。

examples.en: General Motors is trimming down, Ford is still flabby, and Chrysler has had a setback.
examples.zh: 通用汽车正在裁员，福特仍然疲软，而克莱斯勒则遭遇了挫折。

examples.en: To understand how Japan's once-mighty electronics industry has grown so flabby, consider the story of NEC.
examples.zh: 要了解日本曾经强大的电子工业为何变得如此萎靡，请考虑 NEC 的故事。

examples.en: You often bump into visiting vets, middle-aged men with flabby muscles and military tattoos.
examples.zh: 你经常会遇到来访的兽医、肌肉松弛、有军事纹身的中年男子。

examples.en: I wandered about in a desultory fashion.
examples.zh: 我漫无目的地四处游荡。

examples.en: Lynne made desultory conversation with Irene and Alex.
examples.zh: 琳恩与艾琳和艾利克斯漫谈。

examples.en: China's record of protecting its rare species has been desultory.
examples.zh: 中国在保护其珍惜物种方面有着令人失望的记录。

examples.en: On arrival in Jakarta, desultory passport inspectors may keep him waiting in line for an hour.
examples.zh: 抵达雅加达后，杂乱无章的护照检查员可能会让他排队等待一个小时。

examples.en: The two Palestinian factions, bitter rivals for years, have made various desultory efforts to settle their differences.
examples.zh: 巴勒斯坦两派多年来一直是宿敌，为解决分歧做出了各种断断续续的努力。

examples.en: The Santiago summit will still happen, and probably launch the talks, but their progress will be desultory.
examples.zh: 圣地亚哥峰会仍将举行，并可能启动谈判，但进展将是断断续续的。

examples.en: The airport ground crew tried to dissuade the pilot from taking off.
examples.zh: 机场地勤曾试图劝阻飞行员起飞。

examples.en: You'd better dissuade him from doing that.
examples.zh: 你最好劝阻他别那样干。

examples.en: I tried to dissuade him from giving up his job.
examples.zh: 我劝过他，让他不要放弃自己的工作。

examples.en: Some analysts said the downgrade isn't likely to dissuade many investors when it attempts another sale.
examples.zh: 一些分析师表示，当该公司尝试再次出售时，降级不太可能阻止许多投资者。

examples.en: Higher prices may dissuade emerging-market nations from purchasing jewelry and may also stimulate the scrap market.
examples.zh: 价格上涨可能会阻止新兴市场国家购买珠宝，也可能刺激废品市场。

examples.en: My point is not to try and dissuade people who would like to go from going.
examples.zh: 我的观点不是试图劝阻那些想去的人。

examples.en: We tried to help you expedite your plans.
examples.zh: 我们试图帮你加快你的计划。

examples.en: We have developed rapid order processing to expedite deliveries to customers.
examples.zh: 我们已创造了快速处理订单的方法以便迅速将货物送达顾客。

examples.en: The facilitating agencies expedite the clearance of international cargo.
examples.zh: 中介机构加快国际货物清关。

examples.en: May said the airlines have taken numerous steps to expedite travel through the airports.
examples.zh: 梅表示，航空公司已采取多项措施来加快机场的旅行速度。

examples.en: But I also believe that an On-Off relationship, if done correctly, can expedite a commitment.
examples.zh: 但我也相信，如果处理得当，断断续续的关系可以加速承诺。

examples.en: If your item is in high demand, this is a great option to expedite a sale.
examples.zh: 如果您的商品需求量很大，这是加快销售的绝佳选择。

examples.en: I don't mean to disparage your achievements.
examples.zh: 我并不想贬低你的成就。

examples.en: You should not disparage good manners.
examples.zh: 你不应该轻视好的风度。

examples.en: Don't disparage her attempts to become an actress.
examples.zh: 别贬低她想成为一名女演员的努力。

examples.en: Far be it from an editor of FORBES GLOBAL to disparage choices made in the "content" marketplace.
examples.zh: 《福布斯全球》的编辑绝不会贬低“内容”市场中的选择。

examples.en: The wave of accounting and management scandals has invited some abroad to disparage anew the American model.
examples.zh: 一波又一波的会计和管理丑闻让国外一些人重新贬低美国模式。

examples.en: Later, Mr Kubrick was to disparage formal learning, as self-educated people sometimes do.
examples.zh: 后来，库布里克先生贬低了正规学习，就像自学成才的人有时所做的那样。

examples.en: To have such notions about God is absurd and impious.
examples.zh: 对上帝有这样见解的人是荒谬的，是不敬的。

examples.en: This was a race of manly men, but insolent and impious.
examples.zh: 这时的人类雄伟刚毅，但却骄横不虔。

examples.en: To be impious is to disrespect those things a person or a society CARES most deeply about.
examples.zh: 不虔诚就是蔑视那些，人们或社会最在意的事务。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of impious.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“不虔诚的；不孝的；不敬的”的概念提供了全新的视角。

examples.en: Recent academic studies have highlighted the significance of impious in modern research.
examples.zh: 最近的学术研究强调了“不虔诚的；不孝的；不敬的”在现代科学研究中的重要意义。

examples.en: Her articulate argument demonstrated a deep understanding of impious.

examples.en: I have had enough obloquy for one lifetime.
examples.zh: 我一辈子受够了诽谤。

examples.en: "His long public life, so singularly checkered with good and evil, with glory and obloquy" (Macaulay).
examples.zh: 他长期从事公务，好的和坏的，光荣和受辱交错，盛衰无常(麦考利)。

examples.en: He has faced obloquy and condemnation from Israel and Jewish groups worldwide in the wake of its findings.
examples.zh: 由于该报告所揭露的内容，他遭到以色列人以及全世界的犹太团体的毁谤和谴责。

examples.en: The obloquy deepened in the ensuing days, during which it was reported that the cell phones of families of British soldiers killed in Iraq and Afghanistan may also have been hacked.
examples.zh: 在接下来的几天里，这种诽谤进一步加深，据报道，在伊拉克和阿富汗阵亡的英国士兵家属的手机也可能遭到黑客攻击。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of obloquy.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“毁谤；耻辱；谩骂”的概念提供了全新的视角。

examples.en: Recent academic studies have highlighted the significance of obloquy in modern research.
examples.zh: 最近的学术研究强调了“毁谤；耻辱；谩骂”在现代科学研究中的重要意义。

examples.en: She fancies herself a bohemian.
examples.zh: 她自命为一个放荡不羁的艺术家。

examples.en: She has a fine collection of Bohemian glass.
examples.zh: 她收藏了一批做工精细的波希米亚玻璃制品。

examples.en: We splurged on Bohemian glass for gifts, and for ourselves.
examples.zh: 我们花了很多钱买了波希米亚玻璃制品，用来送人和给自己用。

examples.en: Located in an imposing art deco building in San Telmo, Moreno captures the city's bohemian heritage.
examples.zh: 莫雷诺 (Moreno) 位于圣特尔莫 (San Telmo) 一座雄伟的装饰艺术建筑内，体现了这座城市的波西米亚传统。

examples.en: Here cobbled alleys lead to synagogues, bohemian cafes and restaurants with live klezmer (Jewish folk music).
examples.zh: 这里的鹅卵石小巷通向犹太教堂、波西米亚咖啡馆和提供现场 klezmer（犹太民间音乐）表演的餐厅。

examples.en: Once upon a time SoHo was a Bohemian paradise filled with artists and art making.
examples.zh: 曾几何时，SoHo 是一个充满艺术家和艺术创作的波西米亚天堂。

examples.en: He spoke in sepulchral tones.
examples.zh: 他说话语气阴沉。

examples.en: Do you hear it's sepulchral tone?
examples.zh: 你是否听到那阴森森的音调？

examples.en: Then a sort of sepulchral transformation straightened up this centenarian as erect as a young man.
examples.zh: 这时一种阴森森的变态使这个百岁老人象年轻人一样竖直了身子。

examples.en: But some of the guests find the atmosphere more than a tad sepulchral, and hanker for the hotel's crumbling past.
examples.zh: 但一些客人发现这里的气氛不仅仅是有点阴森，而且还怀念酒店摇摇欲坠的过去。

examples.en: At the Bergdorf branch, when we visited, we found much mauve velvet, a sepulchral hush and an air of mystery--but no customers.
examples.zh: 当我们参观波格多夫分店时，我们发现了很多淡紫色的天鹅绒、一种阴森的寂静和一种神秘的气氛——但没有顾客。

examples.en: Lord Justice Leveson, sepulchral in tone, has delivered conclusions that could, or so many fear, become the death knell of a free press.
examples.zh: 莱维森大法官语气阴郁，他得出的结论可能会成为自由媒体的丧钟，或者让很多人担心。

examples.en: "He did it awfully well," said the crestfallen Rat.
examples.zh: “他装得太好了。”水鼠垂头丧气地说。

examples.en: He gathered himself up and sneaked off, crushed and crestfallen.
examples.zh: 他爬起来，偷偷溜走了，他被压垮了，垂头丧气。

examples.en: Hamilton looks crestfallen.
examples.zh: 汉密尔顿看起来垂头丧气。

examples.en: Not surprisingly, my friends looked somewhat crestfallen after I unloaded all these numbers on them.
examples.zh: 毫不奇怪，当我把所有这些数字都卸给我的朋友们后，他们看起来有些垂头丧气。

examples.en: Even Cincinnati has reason to be crestfallen as its ranking fell precipitously from 24 last year.
examples.zh: 就连辛辛那提也有理由感到沮丧，因为它的排名从去年的第 24 位急剧下降。

examples.en: She did not win a game in the final set and looked entirely crestfallen in defeat.
examples.zh: 她在决胜盘中一盘未胜，看上去因失败而垂头丧气。

examples.en: I am not a man to equivocate.
examples.zh: 我不是一个模棱两可的人。

examples.en: I'm not a man to equivocate.
examples.zh: 我不是模棱两可的人。

examples.en: She seemed to equivocate on some things like whether illegal immigrants should be able to get driver's licenses.
examples.zh: 她似乎在一些问题上模棱两可，比如非法移民是否应该能够获得驾驶执照。

examples.en: Not once did Ms. Currie equivocate on the central fact Ms. Lewinsky asked her to retrieve the gifts.
examples.zh: 柯里女士在莱温斯基女士要求她取回礼物的核心事实上没有一次含糊其辞。

examples.en: "I am not one of those who believe we should moderate, equivocate or otherwise abandon our principles, " Jindal said.
examples.zh: 金达尔说：“我不是那些认为我们应该温和、模棱两可或以其他方式放弃我们原则的人之一。”

examples.zh: 味道从刺鼻的到辛辣的不等，有胡椒的后味。

examples.en: Joyfully, the car speeds on, with Windows open to enjoy the tangy Estonian air.
examples.zh: 令人快乐的，汽车快速行驶着，车窗开着，让人尽情享受爱沙尼亚清新的空气。

examples.en: "How funny, " says Piers. "Yours is rougher, but crispy and tangy, I prefer it.
examples.zh: “太有趣了，”皮尔斯说，“你的苹果吃起来虽然更粗糙，但是它的口感更脆，香味也更浓郁，我更喜欢这种感觉。

examples.en: With the reds, Vaynerchuk steered toward wines that are fruity and tangy with acidity.
examples.zh: 对于红葡萄酒，维纳查克倾向于果香浓郁、酸度浓郁的葡萄酒。

examples.en: Finish things with the fresh, tangy lemon sorbet drizzled with a house made limoncello.
examples.zh: 最后享用新鲜、浓郁的柠檬冰糕，淋上自制的柠檬酒。

examples.en: And Variety shouts, The Departed pulses with energy, tangy dialogue and crackling performances from a fine cast.
examples.zh: 《综艺》大呼过瘾，《无间行者》充满活力，对话激烈，演员阵容精彩，表演精彩。

examples.en: The ethics committee may take a decision to admonish him or to censure him.
examples.zh: 道德规范委员会可能决定对他进行警告或批评。

examples.en: The dead whisper to us, they console us, they admonish us.
examples.zh: 逝者会向我们低语，他们会给我们以安慰和告诫。

examples.en: Our profile continued to admonish us for having skipped the step.
examples.zh: 软件的属性继续提醒跳过的步骤。

examples.en: Separately, he did also admonish Syria for blocking access to the site and withholding documentation.
examples.zh: 另外，他还警告叙利亚阻止访问该网站并扣留文件。

examples.en: At the same time, they kicked out the committee chairman and two other Republicans who'd voted to admonish DeLay.
examples.zh: 与此同时，他们驱逐了委员会主席和另外两名投票警告迪雷的共和党人。

examples.en: When he headed the FDA, Frank Young would frequently admonish his minions that sometimes common sense should trump established policies or rules.
examples.zh: 当弗兰克·杨领导 FDA 时，他经常告诫他的下​​属，有时常识应该胜过既定的政策或规则。

examples.en: This was their mother at her worst. Her voice was strident, she was ready to be angry at anyone.
examples.zh: 这是他们的母亲最糟糕的情形。她声音刺耳，随时会对人发脾气。

examples.en: He is a strident advocate of nuclear power.
examples.zh: 他是发展核能的坚定拥护者。

examples.en: The bluff strident words struck the note sailors understood, and they cheered him lustily.
examples.zh: 水手们听明白了他直率而粗鲁的话语，他们热烈地为他欢呼。

examples.en: Now, it has this strident connotation, you know, a little bit man-hating maybe or whatever.
examples.zh: 现在，它具有强烈的含义，你知道，可能有点讨厌人类或其他什么。

examples.en: She said the mother also expressed some rather strident views about the U.S. government.
examples.zh: 她说，这位母亲还对美国政府表达了一些相当尖锐的观点。

examples.en: It was striking how strident these leaders were about what needs to be done.
examples.zh: 令人惊讶的是，这些领导人对于需要采取的行动的态度是多么强硬。

words.meaning: n. 享乐主义，寻欢作乐，纵欲

phrases.zh: 享乐主义，寻欢作乐，纵欲的关键方面

examples.en: The age of hedonism is being ushered out by a new era of temperance.
examples.zh: 享乐主义的时代正被一个注重节制的时代所取代。

examples.en: The terms hedonism and eudaimonism bring to mind the great philosophical debate, which has shaped Western civilization for over 2,000 years, about the nature of the good life.
examples.zh: 享乐主义和幸福说这两个术语让人想起了关于美好生活本质的伟大哲学辩论，这个辩论塑造了2000多年的西方文明。

examples.en: That view is called hedonism.
examples.zh: 这种观点被称为“享乐主义。”

examples.en: One reason: We're just about the first generation to learn universal hedonism in our youth.
examples.zh: 原因之一：我们是第一代在年轻时学习普遍享乐主义的人。

examples.en: Not that there's any point in sermonizing about such a self-consciously anarchic celebration of adolescent hedonism.
examples.zh: 说教这种自觉无政府主义的青春期享乐主义庆祝活动并不是有任何意义。

examples.en: So will serious reflection, with its attendant uncertainty and anxiety, replace all that defiant hedonism?
examples.zh: 那么，严肃的反思以及随之而来的不确定性和焦虑会取代所有那些挑衅的享乐主义吗？

examples.en: He had noticed nothing untoward.
examples.zh: 他没有注意到有何特殊情况。

examples.en: That's the plan—unless anything untoward happens.
examples.zh: 计划就这么定了—除非出现异常情况。

examples.en: The surveyor's report didn't highlight anything untoward.
examples.zh: 测量员的报告没有强调有出乎意料的困难。

examples.en: The same official said the building manager told internal affair investigators nothing untoward happened.
examples.zh: 这位官员表示，大楼经理告诉内务调查人员，没有发生任何不愉快的事情。

examples.en: Their neighbours were again shocked at the idea that they might be involved in anything untoward.
examples.zh: 他们的邻居再次对他们可能卷入任何不愉快的事情感到震惊。

examples.en: Binoche did something equally untoward in Louis Malle's "Damage" -- not a laugh riot, admittedly.
examples.zh: 比诺什在路易斯·马勒的《伤害》中也做了一些同样令人不快的事情——诚然，这并不是一场大笑。

phrases.zh: 隐性基因
隐性失业

examples.en: Sickle-cell anaemia is passed on through a recessive gene.
examples.zh: 镰状细胞贫血通过隐性基因遗传给后代。

examples.en: This apparent anomaly is partially explained by the fact that most founder mutations are recessive: only a person with copies of the affected gene from both parents becomes ill.
examples.zh: 大多数明显的创始人突变都是隐性的，可以解释这种明显的异常现象：只有双亲都拥有受影响基因副本的人才会生病。

examples.en: The subspecies Acinonyx jubatus guttatus may also have been a variation due to a recessive gene.
examples.zh: 亚种猎豹也可能是一种隐性基因变异。

examples.en: The mild-eyed actor Ryan Reynolds is perhaps too recessive for starring roles in the movies.
examples.zh: 眼神温和的演员瑞恩·雷诺兹对于在电影中担任主演来说可能过于隐性。

examples.en: Such stealth traits are readily handled by classic genetics--in the form of recessive genes.
examples.zh: 这种隐形特征很容易通过经典遗传学以隐性基因的形式处理。

examples.en: But far from being economically recessive as they are now, these countries grew by leaps and bounds.
examples.zh: 但这些国家远非像现在这样经济衰退，而是实现了突飞猛进的增长。

phrases.zh: （论据等）站不住脚的；不能维持的；不能租赁的；难以防守的的关键方面

examples.en: This argument is untenable from an intellectual, moral and practical standpoint.
examples.zh: 从知识、道德和现实的角度来看，这种论点是站不住脚的。

examples.en: That is clearly an untenable view, since editors can often intensify reader interest in a news topic by giving it frequent coverage.
examples.zh: 这显然是站不住脚的观点，因为编辑通常可以通过频繁报道来增强读者对新闻话题的兴趣。

examples.en: Once man came to be seen as developing in the process of evolution, the idea of a substance which is contained in his essence seemed untenable.
examples.zh: 一旦人类被看作是在进化过程中发展起来的，那么“人类是包含在他的本质中的一种物质”的观点似乎就站不住脚了。

examples.en: Your escape route is clearly defined: Sell those municipal bonds whose headline risk is untenable.
examples.zh: 你的逃生路线很明确：出售那些总体风险难以维持的市政债券。

examples.en: Fairness norms may make paying some employees less than others untenable in the workplace.
examples.zh: 公平规范可能会使某些员工的工资低于其他员工，这在工作场所是站不住脚的。

examples.en: "EFH's capital structure is untenable, " says Carl Blake, analyst at bond research firm Gimme Credit.
examples.zh: 债券研究公司 Gimme Credit 的分析师 Carl Blake 表示：“EFH 的资本结构是站不住脚的。”
