examples.en: Laboratory tests show that secretions from the bodies of these millipedes are rich in two chemicals that are potent mosquito repellents, and mosquitoes carry parasites that debilitate capuchins.
examples.zh: 实验室测试表明，这些千足虫体内的分泌物富含两种化学物质，这两种物质是有效的驱蚊剂，而蚊子携带的寄生虫会削弱卷尾猴的能力。

examples.en: The key is to not let it debilitate you.
examples.zh: 关键在于不要让恐惧影响到你。

examples.en: These diseases blind, maim, disfigure, debilitate, and disable.
examples.zh: 这些疾病会使人失明、残疾、毁容、虚弱和丧失能力。

examples.en: The symptoms of IBD tend to wax and wane, but can seriously debilitate some patients.
examples.zh: IBD 的症状往往时强时弱，但会使一些患者严重虚弱。

examples.en: Kenyan forces are engaged in a fight in Somalia to debilitate the militants.
examples.zh: 肯尼亚军队正在索马里进行战斗，以削弱武装分子的力量。

examples.en: If I take risks and lose so big that I debilitate myself then my family and my friends will surely suffer.
examples.zh: 如果我冒险并损失惨重，以致使自己变得虚弱，那么我的家人和朋友肯定会受苦。

words.meaning: v. 躲避，回避（问题、责任）；侧步避开；n. 侧跳；横跨一步
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】口语与新闻评论中高频使用。比喻性地指通过巧妙、甚至滑头的手段绕过难题、规则或敏感问题（sidestep an issue/question），或物理上侧跳避开障碍物。
【感情色彩】常带轻微否定意味，指不正面回答或逃避义务。
【助记方法】side（侧面）+ step（迈步），向侧面迈步 -> 闪躲避开。

examples.en: The politician managed to sidestep tough questions about tax increases during the interview.
examples.zh: 该政治家在采访中巧妙地回避了关于加税的棘手问题。

examples.en: He dexterously sidestepped the defender to score a brilliant solo goal.
examples.zh: 他敏捷地横跨一步闪过防守队员，攻入了一粒精彩的单挑进球。

examples.en: Attempts to sidestep environmental regulations could result in severe corporate fines.
examples.zh: 企图规避环保法规可能会导致巨额的企业罚款。

examples.en: Instead of solving the disagreement, management chose to sidestep the conflict entirely.
examples.zh: 管理层没有解决争议，而是选择彻底回避了这场冲突。

examples.en: She sidestepped the puddle on the sidewalk without slowing her pace.
examples.zh: 她侧步避开了人行道上的水坑，脚下脚步丝毫未减。

synonyms.note:
定义：规避，避免作正面答复。
区别：Sidestep 侧重于通过巧妙地改变话题来回避问题；Hedge 侧重于通过含糊其辞、模棱两可的方式来避免做出明确承诺或直接回答。

定义：回避，敷衍，捏造。
区别：Sidestep 是巧妙避开问题；Fudge 是通过含混不清的语言、敷衍或篡改事实来掩盖问题、逃避责任。

定义：逃避，躲避，规避。
区别：Sidestep 常带有机智避开的意味；Evade 强调使用计谋或不诚实的手段逃避法律责任、义务或直接提问。

定义：推迟，拖延，使反感。
区别：Sidestep 是在当下巧妙避开某事；Put off 则是将某事或决定延期到未来处理。

examples.en: Modern capitalist economy follows its own immanent laws.
examples.zh: 现代资本主义经济遵循着它自己的固有法则。

examples.en: In vice, the attraction of the abnormal creates troubling anxiety: the spirit seems to have become blood and stirs in the flesh like an immanent force.
examples.zh: 在邪恶中，异常事物的吸引创造出令人不安的焦虑：精神似乎已经变成了血液，像一股内在的力量搅动着肉体。

examples.en: This is the most perfect immanent action possible to nature.
examples.zh: 这是最完美的内在行动可能性质。

examples.en: So while the Glazer family is not in immanent danger of losing Manchester United the way Tom Hicks and George Gillett lost Liverpool, they do not have a lot of breathing room.
examples.zh: 因此，虽然格雷泽家族并没有像汤姆·希克斯和乔治·吉列失去利物浦那样面临失去曼联的内在危险，但他们没有太多的喘息空间。

examples.en: His immanent presence surrounds us and sustains us.
examples.zh: 他内在的存在包围着我们并支撑着我们。

examples.en: On most planets murder is a misdemeanor; on some it is a praiseworthy act.
examples.zh: 在多数的星球上，谋杀都属于轻罪范畴；在一些星球上，谋杀是值得广为传颂的壮举。

examples.en: The case is now being investigated as filing a false report, a misdemeanor.
examples.zh: 警方现已将此案定性为谎报案情的轻罪行为。

examples.en: Graves, Hunt's attorney, had earlier asked that the charges be reduced to a misdemeanor.
examples.zh: 亨特的律师格雷夫斯早些时候要求将指控减轻为轻罪。

examples.en: Mr. Webber eventually pleaded guilty to a criminal contempt misdemeanor and performed community service.
examples.zh: 韦伯先生最终承认犯有藐视法庭轻罪，并从事社区服务。

examples.en: Mr. Snipes was tried on felony and misdemeanor tax charges, but only was convicted of misdemeanors.

examples.en: Her husband is an incorrigible flirt.
examples.zh: 她的丈夫是个积习难改的调情老手。

examples.en: "Sunita, you are incorrigible!" he said.
examples.zh: “苏尼塔，你真是屡教不改啊！”，他说道。

examples.en: We all do it: Human beings, by nature, are incorrigible mimics.
examples.zh: 我们都在模仿，模仿是人类的天性。

examples.en: This incorrigible criminal is not producing his ghastly weapons for the fun of it.
examples.zh: 这个不可救药的罪犯制造他可怕的武器并不是为了好玩。

examples.en: Is one industry especially incorrigible on this issue or have a higher risk?
examples.zh: 是否有一个行业在这个问题上特别不可救药或者风险较高？

examples.en: Its incorrigible breaches of the euro area's fiscal rules have already upset the European Commission and neighbouring euro members.
examples.zh: 它对欧元区财政规则的无可救药的违反已经让欧盟委员会和邻近的欧元成员国感到不安。

examples.en: Updike outlived his friend by twenty-seven years-long enough to offer his own encomium at Cheever's funeral, and in.
examples.zh: 厄普代克比他的朋友多活了二十七个春秋——并在奇弗的葬礼上宣读了他写的溢美吊辞(吊辞见纽约人杂志)。

examples.en: In this genre there is no praise of individual; it is a laudation of the collective Athenians, which is turned into an encomium of the greatness of the polis.
examples.zh: 在这文类之中并没有对个别之人的赞扬，而是对雅典人整体歌颂，而这又进一步的晚话成为对市民城邦之伟大的咏叹。

examples.en: To be accurate, my encomium to "Koch" wasn't attributed to me but to The Wall Street Journal.
examples.zh: 准确地说，我对“科赫”的赞扬不是我自己的，而是《华尔街日报》的。

examples.en: Author Craig Childs, a naturalist who was born in the Sonoran Desert, has written an encomium to this precious fluid.
examples.zh: 作者克雷格·柴尔兹 (Craig Childs) 是一位出生于索诺兰沙漠的博物学家，他为这种珍贵的液体写了一篇赞歌。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of encomium.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“赞美，称赞；赞辞”的概念提供了全新的视角。

examples.en: Recent academic studies have highlighted the significance of encomium in modern research.
examples.zh: 最近的学术研究强调了“赞美，称赞；赞辞”在现代科学研究中的重要意义。

examples.en: His analysis was rooted in a somewhat tendentious reading of French history.
examples.zh: 他的分析植根于对法国历史带有倾向性的解读。

examples.en: Yet this is tendentious.
examples.zh: 然而，这话是有倾向性的、不够客观。

examples.en: The tendentious track is upwards.
examples.zh: 这痕迹是朝着上方的。

examples.en: If the host or anchor is tendentious, all the more reason to look out.
examples.zh: 如果主持人或主播有倾向性，就更要小心了。

examples.en: There the sometimes-boastful authorial voice intervenes and tendentious theories are floated on currents of old hearsay.
examples.zh: 那里有时会出现自吹自擂的作者声音，而带有倾向性的理论则随着古老的道听途说而浮现。

examples.en: The Standard piece offers up some genuine examples of faulty fact-checking in service of its tendentious argument.
examples.zh: 《标准》文章提供了一些错误事实核查的真实例子，为其倾向性论点服务。

examples.en: She has tried to superimpose her own attitudes onto this ancient story.
examples.zh: 她想把自己的看法加入这个古老的故事里。

examples.en: You can superimpose the lettering directly onto one of your pictures.
examples.zh: 你可以把这些文字直接叠印在你的一张照片上。

examples.en: In fact, you could even superimpose your logo onto the image instead of a corner.
examples.zh: 实际上，您甚至可以用您的徽标取代角来叠加到图像上。

examples.en: And he showed off wonky-looking prototype spectacles that can superimpose movies inside the wearer's field of vision.
examples.zh: 他还展示了看起来很奇怪的原型眼镜，可以在佩戴者的视野内叠加电影。

examples.en: This can then be used to superimpose a separately filmed scene or visual effects to create a composite.
examples.zh: 然后，这可以用于叠加单独拍摄的场景或视觉效果以创建合成图像。

examples.en: Dexter and Reppa made no attempt whatsoever to superimpose an alien directorial concept on Poulenc's tragic tale of martyrdom.
examples.zh: 德克斯特和雷帕并没有试图在普朗克的殉难悲剧故事上强加一种陌生的导演概念。

examples.en: We should inure ourselves to hard life.
examples.zh: 我们应该使自己习惯艰苦生活。

examples.en: Explain: in general, this operation will be inure in 4 to 24 hour.
examples.zh: 说明：一般情况下，操作后解析生效时间在4 - 24小时之内。

examples.en: She found, however, that it was one to which she must inure herself.
examples.zh: 不过她觉得，她必须使自己习惯于这磨砺。

examples.en: "This may serve to inure the public consciousness to the war before it begins, " says Spear.
examples.zh: 斯皮尔说：“这可能有助于在战争开始之前让公众意识到战争。”

examples.en: And hopefully some of it did it rub off on the institution rather than inure entirely to the person.
examples.zh: 希望其中一些能够对机构产生影响，而不是完全适应个人。

examples.en: When we finally figure out how to level the playing field for women in the workplace, not only will the benefits inure to women but to men and to business more broadly.
examples.zh: 当我们最终弄清楚如何在工作场所为女性提供公平的竞争环境时，好处不仅会惠及女性，也会惠及男性和更广泛的企业。

examples.en: You slant the pen with an angle of 30 degrees on the paper when you're writing.
examples.zh: 你书写的时候笔身是倾斜的，和纸张形成30度的倾角。

examples.en: Each book, paper, or presentation that presents a set of patterns introduces the pattern concept with a different slant.
examples.zh: 那些展示了模式集合的每一本书、论文或展示都使用不同观点介绍了模式概念。

examples.en: To help generate lift to keep midwater, the top of the tail extends farther back than the bottom, creating a slant along the back edge.
examples.zh: 为了保持在水中不至于沉底，尾部的顶端比底端向后延伸，沿着后端形成一个斜面，产生提力。

examples.en: It tells the Hanukkah story as a Zionist parable with a typical Guthriec(ph) little guy slant.
examples.zh: 它以犹太复国主义寓言的形式讲述了光明节的故事，带有典型的古斯里克（ph）小人物倾向。

examples.en: If you're like us, you're probably taking an ever-increasing interest in gadgets with an eco slant.
examples.zh: 如果您像我们一样，您可能对具有生态倾向的小玩意越来越感兴趣。

examples.en: Once again, please forgive the narrow slant of this email, both in content and geography.
examples.zh: 再次请原谅这封电子邮件在内容和地理位置上的狭隘倾向。

words.meaning: n. 对等；平等；平价；奇偶性
words.analysis: 1) 社会/经济：地位、薪酬或权利的平等等同（purchasing power parity 购买力平价）；2) 物理/数学/计算机：偶数或奇数的性质，以及错误检测中的奇偶校验（parity bit / parity check）；3) 竞技/产品：水平相当（feature parity 功能对等）。正式书面语、金融、IT、物理学核心词汇。1) 计算机硬件/网络：奇偶校验位 (parity bit/check, RAID parity)；2) 软件产品管理：跨端功能平级 (feature parity)；3) 量子物理：宇称 (parity)。助记：par (同等/平价，如 par value) + -ity → 平等/对等/奇偶性。

examples.en: The mobile app team worked hard to achieve feature parity with the web desktop platform.
examples.zh: 移动端应用团队努力工作，以实现与Web桌面端平台的功能对等。

examples.en: Economic comparisons between countries often rely on purchasing power parity rather than market exchange rates.
examples.zh: 国家之间的经济对比往往依赖购买力平价而非市场汇率。

examples.en: RAID 5 storage arrays use distributed parity to rebuild data in case a drive fails.
examples.zh: RAID 5存储阵列使用分布式奇偶校验，以便在硬盘故障时重建数据。

examples.en: The company has committed to achieving gender pay parity across all engineering departments by next year.
examples.zh: 该公司已承诺在明年之前在所有工程部门实现男女同工同酬（薪酬对等）。

examples.en: The parity bit is used in serial communications to detect single-bit errors in transmitted data.
examples.zh: 奇偶校验位用于串行通信中，以检测传输数据中的单比特错误。

examples.en: Physicists were shocked when experiments demonstrated parity violation in weak nuclear interactions.
examples.zh: 当实验证实弱相互作用中存在宇称不守恒时，物理学家感到震惊。

synonyms.note: 平行，同等。Parity指平价、同等、势均力敌（常用于经济、军事）；而para通常作为前缀表示“在旁边”、“类似”等，很少作为独立名词作“同等”解。

examples.en: Avarice is the bane to happiness.
examples.zh: 贪婪是损毁幸福的祸根。

examples.en: However, for many businesses, inventory is a bane.
examples.zh: 但是，对一些领域来说，库存是灾难的来源。

examples.en: Modern tourism in Egypt is both a boon and a bane.

examples.en: Her advice appeared to be disinterested.
examples.zh: 她的建议似乎是客观公正的。

examples.en: A solicitor can give you disinterested advice.

examples.en: We had both become jaded, disinterested, and disillusioned.
examples.zh: 我们两人都变得厌倦、了无兴趣且心灰意冷了。

examples.en: In volatile times, traders use turrets more, say two not entirely disinterested turret vendors.
examples.zh: 两位并非完全无私的炮塔供应商表示，在动荡时期，交易员会更多地使用炮塔。

examples.en: And compared with many other politically active armies, Turkey's has played a disinterested role.
examples.zh: 与许多其他政治上活跃的军队相比，土耳其军队发挥了公正的作用。

examples.en: As Dr Tenne himself would admit, he is hardly a disinterested party in this debate.
examples.zh: 正如坦纳博士本人承认的那样，他在这场辩论中并不是一个无私的一方。

words.meaning: v. 磨损，擦伤；侵蚀，削弱（信心/耐心）
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】物理上指通过摩擦、刮擦使物体表面受损或脱落（abrade the skin / metal surface）；引申指精神、信心、耐心因长期消耗而“逐渐被侵蚀/削弱”（abrade one's confidence）。专业性强，常用于工程学、地质学、医学与比喻表达。
【历史典故/词源】源自拉丁语 abradere（刮掉），由 ab-（离开，去掉）+ radere（刮，擦，同 erase/razor）构成。
【专业领域特殊含义】在地质学中，abrasion 指“风蚀/水蚀磨蚀作用”；在材料工程中，abrasion resistance 指“耐磨性”；在医学中指 skin abrasion（皮肤擦伤）。
【助记方法】ab（离开/去掉）+ rad（刮/擦，同 razor 剃刀）+ e → 刮掉一层皮 → 磨损，擦伤。

phrases.zh: 擦伤皮肤
削弱信心
磨损表面
磨料颗粒

examples.en: Rough ropes can abrade the skin on your hands if you don't wear gloves.
examples.zh: 如果不戴手套，粗糙的绳子会擦伤手上的皮肤。

examples.en: Years of harsh winds have abraded the surface of the ancient monument.
examples.zh: 多年的狂风侵蚀了这座古老纪念碑的表面。

examples.en: Constant criticism began to abrade her self-confidence.
examples.zh: 持续不断的批评开始侵蚀她的自信心。

examples.en: Glaciers move slowly down valleys, abrading the rocks beneath them.
examples.zh: 冰川在山谷中缓慢移动，磨蚀着下方的岩石。

examples.en: The friction from the tight shoe abraded his heel during the hike.
examples.zh: 徒步过程中，紧绷的鞋子摩擦损伤了他的脚后跟。

synonyms.note: 侵蚀，腐蚀。区别：erode 侧重水流、风力渐进式侵蚀；abrade 侧重物理摩擦刮擦。
擦伤，磨损。区别：chafe 侧重因皮肤或衣服反复摩擦引发发红发痛。

examples.en: Money is fungible.

examples.en: Your daughter has discovered that money is fungible.
examples.zh: 你的女儿发现钱是可以互换的。

examples.en: But it cannot be traded to third parties, and it is not entirely fungible.
examples.zh: 但它并不能交易给第三方，也就不完全是种可交换的资产。

examples.en: But money is fungible, and allocation of funds to one project frees up money for another.
examples.zh: 但金钱是可以替代的，将资金分配给一个项目可以为另一个项目腾出资金。

examples.en: People are not fungible and bring a myriad of talents not reflected in statistics.
examples.zh: 人是不可替代的，并且带来了统计数据中无法反映的无数才能。

examples.en: When it comes to matters of budgets with Congress they say all numbers are fungible.
examples.zh: 当谈到国会的预算问题时，他们说所有数字都是可以互换的。

examples.en: After the major operation, the patient spent three weeks in the hospital to recuperate.
examples.zh: 大手术后，患者在医院休养了三星期以恢复健康。

examples.en: Athletes need adequate rest days between competitions to allow their bodies to recuperate.
examples.zh: 运动员在比赛之间需要充足的休息日，以便让身体得到休养恢复。

examples.en: The business hopes to recuperate its investment costs within the first two years of operation.
examples.zh: 该企业希望在运营的前两年内收回其投资成本。

examples.en: She took a peaceful vacation by the seaside to recuperate from mental burnout.
examples.zh: 她在海边度过了一个宁静的假期，以摆脱职场倦怠、恢复精神。

examples.en: His doctor advised him to stay off work for a month to fully recuperate.
examples.zh: 他的医生建议他休假一个月以完全康复。

synonyms.note: 恢复, 复原。用法区别：Recuperate 更侧重于生病或劳累后经过休息，使身体健康或体力逐渐恢复；Recover 是更通用的词，不仅可指健康恢复，还能指找回失物、经济复苏等。
补偿, 收回。用法区别：Recuperate 主要指健康或精神的恢复；Recoup 主要用于财务方面，指收回成本、弥补亏损或重新获得失去的金钱。

etymology.rootMeaning: 作为 recuperate 构词基础的词形；核心义参见“恢复”
etymology.explanation: recuperate 直接建立在 recuperare 之上，是它的派生形式；现有词源记录可追溯到 1540 年代；词形经拉丁语 recuperatus 进入或影响英语。
etymology.memory: 先记核心义“恢复”，再用常用搭配和例句巩固词形，避免编造不存在的词根。

words.analysis: 【细微含义与场景】1. 健康/医疗：指在疾病、手术、创伤或过度劳累后休养并恢复元气（recuperate from illness/surgery）。比 recover 更强调休养生息的过程。2. 商业/财务：收回投资或挽回经济损失（recuperate one's losses）。【助记】re-(重新) + cuper(拿取，与 recuperation 同源) -> 重新找回健康或钱财 -> 恢复、挽回。

examples.zh: 接着，他又加了一句最要命的话：“我们仍在跳舞。”

examples.en: The first-generation Coda car looks like a generic, midsize Asian sedan.
examples.zh: 第一代Coda汽车外观与普通中型亚洲轿车一样。

examples.zh: Coda文件系统是改进原始的AFS系统的第一次尝试。

examples.en: The CODA Sedan can also be charged for free at most public charging stations.
examples.zh: CODA Sedan 还可以在大多数公共充电站免费充电。

examples.en: Techs and Greens will probably be attracted to the CODA Sedan, at least on paper.
examples.zh: 技术人员和环保人士可能会被 CODA 轿车所吸引，至少在纸面上是这样。

examples.en: Last week, Coda Holdings filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection after selling just 100 all-electric sedans.
examples.zh: 上周，Coda Holdings 在仅销售 100 辆全电动轿车后根据美国破产法第 11 章申请破产保护。

examples.en: He is an extremely pleasant and obliging man.
examples.zh: 他这人非常和蔼可亲，且乐于助人。

examples.en: They were very obliging and offered to wait for us.
examples.zh: 他们非常热情，主动提出等候我们。

examples.en: He is very obliging. He's sure to help if you ask him.
examples.zh: 他好说话儿，求求他准行。

examples.en: Certain strictures, like obliging men to wear traditional robes, are a small price to pay.
examples.zh: 某些限制，比如强迫男人穿传统长袍，只是付出的一个很小的代价。

examples.en: It is rare to see a koala, although rock wallabies and goannas are more obliging.
examples.zh: 虽然岩袋鼠和巨蜥比较友善，但很少能看到考拉。

examples.en: During our stay, the food was uniformly delicious and the service prompt and exceptionally obliging.
examples.zh: 在我们住宿期间，食物非常美味，服务及时且非常周到。

examples.en: The parliament also agreed to ban websites that "incite excessive thinness" by promoting extreme dieting.
examples.zh: 议会还同意封禁那些推广极端的节食来“诱使追求骨感体型”的网站。

examples.en: A private bid could incite hostile buyers into action.
examples.zh: 私下竞标有可能刺激敌对买家采取行动。

examples.en: For example, some countries ban speech that could incite hatred.
examples.zh: 例如，一些国家禁止发表可能引起仇恨的言论。

examples.en: None of this will amount to a hill of beans except to swing sentiment and incite panic.
examples.zh: 除了摇摆情绪和煽动恐慌之外，这一切都无济于事。

examples.en: Any one event can incite a flurry of attention, with incessant reiteration of the original allegations.
examples.zh: 任何一个事件都可能引起一阵关注，并不断重申最初的指控。

examples.en: The use of cyberwar evokes strong emotional reaction and can incite action on cybersecurity topics.
examples.zh: 网络战争的使用会引起强烈的情绪反应，并可能引发针对网络安全主题的行动。

examples.en: The town is perched on the edge of a steep, precipitous cliff.
examples.zh: 该镇坐落在一个陡峭的悬崖边上。

examples.en: The stock market's precipitous drop frightened foreign investors.
examples.zh: 该股市价格猛跌让外国投资者恐惧。

examples.en: Could there be a mountain more precipitous than this?
examples.zh: 山之险峻，宁有逾此？

examples.en: Since the death of Alexander the Great in 323 BC the slide has been precipitous.
examples.zh: 自从亚历山大大帝于公元前 323 年去世以来，这种下滑一直在急剧下滑。

examples.en: Perry appears almost desperate to win back conservative voters and reverse his precipitous drop.
examples.zh: 佩里似乎几乎不顾一切地想赢回保守派选民并扭转他的急剧下滑。

examples.en: These show, for example, the precipitous decline of Conservative support among the professional and managerial classes.
examples.zh: 例如，这些表明专业人士和管理阶层对保守党的支持急剧下降。

examples.en: He was an understudy to Charlie Chaplin on a tour of the U.S.
examples.zh: 他曾是查理•卓别林美国巡演的替角。

examples.en: A momentary hush; the orchestra leader varies his rhythm obligingly for her, and there is a burst of chatter as the erroneous news goes around that she is Gilda Gray's understudy from the Follies.
examples.zh: 短暂的安静；乐队指挥亲切地为她变换节奏，当她是吉尔达·格雷在《愚蠢》里的替补演员的错误消息传开时，大家议论纷纷。

examples.en: While the star is recuperating from her illness, her role will be played by her understudy.
examples.zh: 当明星正在休养恢复健康时，她的角色由候补演员代替。

examples.en: Nancy Seabrooke was understudy for the role of Mrs Boyle for 6, 240 performances, appearing just 72 times.
examples.zh: 南希·西布鲁克 (Nancy Seabrooke) 曾作为博伊尔夫人这一角色的替补，共演出了 6, 240 场，但只出场了 72 次。

examples.en: Connacht fly-half Andy Dunne start at fly-half with Ulster's Niall O'Connor as his understudy on the bench.
examples.zh: 康诺特半场安迪·邓恩 (Andy Dunne) 在半场首发，阿尔斯特队的尼尔·奥康纳 (Niall O'Connor) 替补坐在替补席上。

examples.en: Timothy Warmen, the understudy playing him that night, would have chewed all the scenery in a normal production.
examples.zh: 那天晚上扮演他的替补演员蒂莫西·沃曼（Timothy Warmen）可能会咀嚼正常制作中的所有场景。

examples.en: A fine drizzle began to veil the hills.
examples.zh: 蒙蒙细雨渐渐笼罩了群山。

examples.en: Clouds had come down and it was starting to drizzle.
examples.zh: 云压了下来，开始下起了毛毛雨。

examples.en: The drizzle had now stopped and the sun was breaking through.
examples.zh: 细雨已经停了，太阳露出了脸。

examples.en: The downpour is now a drizzle, and the clouds have moved on to swallow other mountains.
examples.zh: 倾盆大雨现在变成了毛毛雨，云彩已经吞没了其他山峰。

examples.en: It's decadent enough to be served plain, with a drizzle of olive oil and sea salt.
examples.zh: 它的味道足够颓废，可以直接食用，撒上一点橄榄油和海盐。

examples.en: For the final, uphill hour of walking a steady drizzle soaks through our clothes.
examples.zh: 在徒步的最后一个小时，绵绵细雨浸湿了我们的衣服。

examples.en: My memories are within me, imperishable.
examples.zh: 我的记忆刻在心间，永不磨灭。

examples.en: It is that state which is tranquil, final, and imperishable.
examples.zh: 它是这样的状态它是平静的，最终的，和不灭的。

examples.en: You allowed your kingly power to vanish, Shajahan, but your wish was to make imperishable a tear-drop of love.
examples.zh: 沙杰汗①，你宁愿听任皇权消失，却希望使一滴爱的泪珠②永存。

examples.en: Gold is imperishable and (relatively) inexpensive to store.
examples.zh: 黄金是不朽的，而且储存起来（相对）便宜。

examples.en: The world in which we are needful of human relations not despite, but because of, the way their own cravings for the infinite and the imperishable impose on us the limitations by which we grow and learn?
examples.zh: 在这个世界中，我们需要人际关系，不是尽管，而是因为，他们对无限和不朽的渴望强加给我们成长和学习的局限性？

examples.en: Toad ceased his frivolous antics at once.

examples.en: Whereas Mr McCain supports curbs on frivolous lawsuits, trial lawyers back Mr Obama with open wallets.

examples.en: Dahn, Lee and the other defendants have denied the charges and called the allegations frivolous.
examples.zh: 达恩、李和其他被告否认了这些指控，并称这些指控毫无意义。

words.meaning: vt. & vi. 给……作注解，标注
words.analysis: 由前缀 an- (ad-, 向) + note (标记) + -ate 构成，指在文本、图像或数据上添加解释性说明或元数据。书面语与技术语境高频。在计算机与AI领域，特指对机器学习数据集进行数据标注（如给图像标框、给文本打标签）。助记：an(一) + note(笔记) + ate -> 做笔记/写注解。

examples.en: Scholars continue to annotate the classic text with detailed historical commentary.
examples.zh: 学者们继续用详细的历史注释来注解这部经典文本。

examples.en: Engineers need to annotate thousands of images to train the autonomous driving model.
examples.zh: 工程师需要标注数千张图像来训练自动驾驶模型。

examples.en: The software allows users to annotate PDF documents directly on screen.
examples.zh: 该软件允许用户直接在屏幕上对 PDF 文档进行批注。

examples.en: She spent the afternoon annotating her lecture notes before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前，她花了一个下午的时间批注她的演讲笔记。

examples.en: Linguists annotate corpora to analyze syntactic patterns in natural language.
examples.zh: 语言学家标注语料库以分析自然语言中的句法模式。

synonyms.note: 解析：加脚注。区别：Annotate 指对文本进行全面的评注、注释，不限位置；Footnote 特指在书页底部添加注释。

words.meaning: adj. 相连的，邻接的，连续的
words.analysis:
详细解析：
1. 细微含义：强调空间、地理或结构上彼此直接接触、共享边界、无缝相连接（touching or sharing a boundary）。如美国本土48州被称为 "the contiguous United States"。
2. 使用场景：地理、法律、数学、计算机科学。
3. IT含义：在计算机数据结构与内存管理中，指“连续的内存地址/空间”（contiguous memory allocation），极其高频。
4. 词源/助记：con-（共同）+ tig/tact（接触，同 touch, contact, tangible）+ -uous → 互相接触在一起的 → 相连的、邻接的。

examples.en: Alaska and Hawaii are not part of the contiguous United States.
examples.zh: 阿拉斯加和夏威夷不属于美国本土毗连的48州。

examples.en: The two properties share a contiguous border along the river.
examples.zh: 这两处地产沿着河流共享一条相连的边界。

examples.en: Arrays store elements in contiguous memory locations, allowing fast index-based access.
examples.zh: 数组将元素存储在连续的内存位置中，从而允许基于索引的快速访问。

examples.en: The nature reserve consists of five contiguous tracts of forest.
examples.zh: 该自然保护区由五块相连的森林地块组成。

examples.en: The country claims sovereignty over its territorial sea and contiguous zone.
examples.zh: 该国申明对其领海和毗连区拥有主权。

examples.en: Fragmented memory makes it impossible to allocate a large contiguous block of memory.
examples.zh: 内存碎片化导致无法分配大块连续的内存空间。

synonyms.note:
定义：直接的，紧邻的，立即的。
区别：Contiguous 专指地理或空间上紧密相连、相邻接的；Immediate 空间上指最靠近的，也广泛用于时间（立即）和因果。

examples.zh: Lowe 1994 年的专辑《The Impossible Bird》帮助他卷土重来，获得了沉睡般的成功，并重新确立了他作为一位可爱的、愤世嫉俗的流行音乐元老政治家的地位。

examples.zh: 起床。结果：起得太早，大骂奸商做假安眠药。

examples.en: Characterized by transparent clearness; pellucid.
examples.zh: 有清澈特征的；透明的。

examples.en: Locals depend on the pellucid waters for food, irrigation and hygiene.
examples.zh: 清澈的河水是当地居民的饮水、灌溉及生活卫生等问题的依靠。

examples.en: Bagehot's vocabulary is certainly pellucid, in that the words mean exactly what he intends, unlike the mysterious utterances of adolescents or the various impenetrable professional jargons of today.
examples.zh: 白芝浩的词汇当然是清晰的，因为这些词的意思正是他想要表达的，不像青少年的神秘话语或当今各种难以理解的专业术语。

examples.en: Using NCVM (Non-Conductive Vapor Metallization) technology, an innovative coating process that produces a colorful metallic veneer, LG Aurora notebooks have a pellucid, glossy exterior that provides genuine value to customers through improved scratch resistance and a strengthened cover.
examples.zh: LG Aurora 笔记本电脑采用 NCVM（非导电气相金属化）技术，这是一种创新的涂层工艺，可产生彩色金属饰面，具有透明、有光泽的外观，通过改进的防刮性和强化的外壳为客户提供真正的价值。

examples.en: Never fear: Littleneck sources its seafood from more pellucid waters up and down the New England coast, and is a full block away from the canal, in a gritty, rapidly developing area where live-music spots and an artisanal pie shop stand beside warehouses and a forbidding old-time social club.
examples.zh: 不用担心：利特内克从新英格兰海岸上下更清澈的水域采购海鲜，距离运河整整一个街区，位于一个快速发展的砂砾地区，仓库和令人生畏的老式社交俱乐部旁边有现场音乐场所和手工馅饼店。

examples.en: Did she usurp his place in his mother's heart?
examples.zh: 她夺取了他在他母亲心目中的地位吗？

examples.en: Industrialism began to usurp the production and distribution functions of the family.
examples.zh: 工业化生产已开始篡夺家庭生产和分配的功能。

examples.en: Powerful entities threaten reality's foundation as they seek to usurp the Raven Queen 's position.
examples.zh: 强大的存在威胁著真实的基础，他们正图谋篡夺鸦后的位置。

examples.en: Mr. Rivers worried that the corporal's father would see him as trying to usurp his role.
examples.zh: 里弗斯先生担心下士的父亲会认为他试图篡夺他的角色。

examples.en: Who was this Sonny Werblin to usurp the Church of Halas and snatch the boy away?
examples.zh: 这个桑尼·沃布林是谁，竟然篡夺了哈拉斯教会并抢走了男孩？

examples.en: Egypt's secular opposition accuses President Morsi of seeking to usurp power - a charge he denies.
examples.zh: 埃及世俗反对派指责总统穆尔西试图篡夺权力，但他否认了这一指控。

examples.en: There were the two somber figures still following him, though their black sacks were drenched and dripping with water.
examples.zh: 有两个阴森的人影仍跟在他后面，尽管他们的黑麻袋都湿透了，还在滴水。

examples.en: Prime Minister Tony Blair was somber.
examples.zh: 而英国首相布莱尔则是忧心忡忡。

examples.en: In fact, he sounded somber and contrite.
examples.zh: 事实上，他的声音听起来又沮丧又后悔。

examples.en: He at least made the right choice for someone who could fire up a somber crowd.
examples.zh: 对于一个能够激起忧郁人群的人来说，他至少做出了正确的选择。

examples.en: In a brief, somber finale, all look forward to a brighter, more peaceful time ahead.
examples.zh: 在简短而阴沉的结局中，所有人都期待着未来更加光明、更加和平的时光。

examples.en: Sabres forward Steve Ott expects there to be a somber mood inside the arena in Boston.
examples.zh: 军刀队前锋史蒂夫·奥特预计波士顿球馆内将会出现阴郁的气氛。

examples.en: The treatment will be tried out on human beings only after it has been shown to be safe and foolproof in animals.
examples.zh: 该疗法只有在动物身上证明安全、万无一失后才会在人体上试用。

examples.en: If you are considering a supplement, read the list of ingredients, she says, although this is not always foolproof.
examples.zh: 她说，如果你正在考虑服用补充剂，请阅读成分清单，但这并不总是万无一失的。

examples.en: The system is not 100 per cent foolproof.
examples.zh: 该系统不是百分之百不出毛病的。

examples.en: There's no such thing as a foolproof trading indicator, but here's one that comes remarkably close.
examples.zh: 不存在万无一失的交易指标，但这里有一个非常接近的指标。

examples.en: Therein lies the most important lesson of all to any aspiring restaurateur: success is never foolproof.
examples.zh: 对于任何有抱负的餐馆老板来说，最重要的教训是：成功从来都不是万无一失的。

examples.en: This is obviously not a foolproof way to figure out what your co-workers make.
examples.zh: 这显然不是一个了解同事收入的万无一失的方法。

examples.en: He was far too canny to risk giving himself away.
examples.zh: 他很精明，不会冒险暴露自己。

examples.en: Its founder Rodolphe Julian was a canny businessman.
examples.zh: 其创始人鲁道夫·朱利安是一位精明的商人。

examples.en: Fressange is a canny businesswoman who knows how to market her brand: herself.
examples.zh: Fressange 是一个精明的商人，她知道如何推销她的品牌：那就是通过她自己的方式。

examples.en: The canny politician knows that to achieve one thing he often has to say quite another.
examples.zh: 精明的政治家知道，为了实现一件事，他常常不得不说另一件事。

examples.en: The canny smaller brother of Scotland's two giant banking delinquents registered its first full-year loss.
examples.zh: 苏格兰两大银行业拖欠银行的精明兄弟首次出现全年亏损。

examples.en: As deputy, he built a reputation as a canny strategist, plotting the DUP's election campaigns.
examples.zh: 作为代表，他因策划民主统一党的竞选活动而赢得了精明战略家的声誉。

examples.en: Ogre that he was, he spoke like an epicure.
examples.zh: 他虽是个吃人恶魔，说话倒像个美食家。

examples.en: This cookery book is writes by a real epicure.
examples.zh: 这本食谱是由一位真正的美食家写的。

examples.en: This cookery book has been written by a real epicure.
examples.zh: 这本食谱是由一位真正的美食家写的。

examples.en: Mr Spitz offers the reader a portrait of an epicure, and of a life profoundly full, blessed and well lived.
examples.zh: 斯皮茨先生向读者描绘了一位美食家的肖像，以及一种极其充实、幸福和美好的生活。

examples.en: Prior to the next meeting, focused on "Edible Brooklyn: The Cookbook" (Sterling Epicure, 2011), I logged on to the group's page and found evidence of feverish cooking.
examples.zh: 在下一次会议之前，我登录了该小组的页面，发现了狂热烹饪的证据，重点是“可食用的布鲁克林：烹饪书”（Sterling Epicure，2011）。

examples.en: The findings echo early results from the decade-long Epicure 2 study, published last month, which also showed improved survival rates for babies born at 24 and 25 weeks, but not for those born earlier.
examples.zh: 这些发现与上个月发表的长达十年的 Epicure 2 研究的早期结果相呼应，该研究也显示 24 周和 25 周出生的婴儿的存活率有所提高，但早产婴儿的存活率却没有提高。

examples.en: This paper introduced Dais medi-edible plant, cultivation methods, harvest and process, and resource protection of Cibotium barometz(L)J.
examples.zh: 介绍了傣族药食植物金毛狗的栽培方法、采收加工以及资源保护。

examples.zh: 杰克穿过人群来到祭台上。诺姆跟着他，带着格蕾丝的阿凡达。

examples.zh: 我们 15 名观众在大理石讲台上观看。

examples.en: Just follow the money of the people on this dais and you'll see a response.
examples.zh: 只要关注这个讲台上人们的钱，你就会看到回应。

examples.en: The cherubic feather falls in my front.
examples.zh: 天使的羽毛降落在我的面前。

examples.en: Noe has a cherubic face and a dazzling smile.
examples.zh: 诺一有着小天使般可爱的圆脸蛋，笑起来特别灿烂。

examples.en: Do you think of tiny cherubic angels, like the ones that dot Sunday school materials?
examples.zh: 你认为小小天使神色，像那些斑点星期日教材？

examples.en: In my cherubic youth I used to wonder why so many venture capitalists opposed a reduced capital gains tax.
examples.zh: 在我天真的青年时代，我曾经想知道为什么这么多风险投资家反对降低资本利得税。

examples.en: Bongeka scrunched up her cherubic face as she flipped through the clothing catalog, noting aloud that only one of the Brooks Brothers models was black.
examples.zh: 邦吉卡在翻阅服装目录时皱起她那张天真的脸，大声指出布鲁克斯兄弟的模特中只有一位是黑人。

examples.en: To top it off, a group of cherubic sixth-graders from St.
examples.zh: 最重要的是，一群来自圣路易斯的六年级小学生。

examples.zh: 一位评论家对这位哲学家的新著作的回应，并不是说它所采取的立场是异端邪说，就像有些人断言的那样，而是对任何对这个话题有所了解的人来说，它都不是什么新鲜事。

examples.en: I made the then heretical suggestion that it might be cheaper to design new machines.
examples.zh: 我提出了当时被当做旁门左道的建议，说设计新机器或许更省钱。

examples.en: The Church regards spirit mediums and people claiming to speak to the dead as heretical.
examples.zh: 该教堂把灵媒和自称能与死者交谈的人都视为异端。

examples.en: In early 1983, with 11 million Americans out of work, this was heretical thinking.
examples.zh: 1983 年初，1100 万美国人失业，这是异端思想。

examples.en: He is also a Mormon, a group viewed as heretical by many on the Christian right.
examples.zh: 他也是摩门教徒，这个团体被许多基督教右翼视为异端。

examples.en: In the 1960s Mr Rakowski publicly opposed the death penalty, then a heretical and dangerous stance.
examples.zh: 20 世纪 60 年代，拉科夫斯基先生公开反对死刑，这在当时是一种异端且危险的立场。

examples.zh: 酒的香味让他流口水；其他那些车夫之间诙谐和友好使他感觉孤独。

examples.en: Their eyes were full of friendliness and bonhomie.
examples.zh: 他们的眼睛里充满了友善与和蔼。

examples.zh: 尽管这里的友善气氛像维加斯埃菲尔铁塔一样是假的，但这并不重要。

examples.en: The bonhomie quickly dissipated in a torrent of acrimony and blame that has recently become public.
examples.zh: 这种和蔼可亲的气氛很快就在最近公开的尖酸刻薄和指责中消失了。

examples.zh: 通过消费，人们开始理解、灌输意义，并对世界上遇到的物体采取行动。

examples.zh: 轻松的旋律和流行音乐的安排甚至逐渐注入了一种音乐的情色的感觉。

examples.en: Schools should foster children's interest in sports to instill into them the values of teamwork and sportsmanship.
examples.zh: 学校应该培养孩子们对运动的兴趣，以教导他们合作和体育精神的价值。

examples.en: How do you instill in your daughter a can-do spirit and these kinds of high standards?
examples.zh: 您如何向您的女儿灌输积极进取的精神和这些高标准？

examples.en: This fact must instill some jealousy among their finned brethren, like the striped bass.
examples.zh: 这一事实必定会在它们的有鳍同胞（如条纹鲈鱼）中灌输一些嫉妒。

examples.en: Businesses set up a Facebook to build a relationship with its customers and instill loyalty.
examples.zh: 企业建立 Facebook 是为了与客户建立关系并灌输忠诚度。

examples.en: The scent of that crispy brown turkey, fluffy mashed potatoes, savory stuffing, and assorted vegetables made my mouth water.
examples.zh: 脆皮棕色火鸡、蓬松的土豆泥、开胃的馅料以及什锦蔬菜的香味让我口水直流。

examples.en: Our mouths and tongues have taste buds, which are receptors for the five basic flavors: sweet, salty, sour, bitter, and umami, or what is more commonly referred to as savory.
examples.zh: 我们的嘴巴和舌头上都有味蕾。味蕾是五种基本味道的感受器：甜、咸、酸、苦和鲜味，也就是通常所说的咸味。

examples.en: Sweet biscuits, chips and high-fat savory biscuits.
examples.zh: 甜饼干，薯条和高蛋白风味饼干。

examples.en: Savory custard: She mixes the flowers with eggs, chicken stock, soy sauce and diced shitake mushrooms.
examples.zh: 美味蛋奶冻：她将鲜花与鸡蛋、鸡汤、酱油和香菇丁混合在一起。

examples.en: Most cooks add ground pork to savory custards, but she prefers to go meatless.
examples.zh: 大多数厨师都会在美味的蛋奶冻中添加碎猪肉，但她更喜欢不吃肉。

examples.en: "Finding that flavor in the savory and in your drink harmonizes the season, " he says.
examples.zh: “在咸味食品和饮料中找到这种味道可以与季节相协调，”他说。

examples.zh: 我们喜不喜欢他都不重要。

examples.en: Given this existence of this immaterial soul, it's a possibility, indeed a fair likelihood, that we will survive our deaths.
examples.zh: 鉴于这个非物质灵魂的存在，这是可能的，也的确是有这样的可能性的，让我们能在死亡后继续存在。

examples.en: The cost is immaterial.
examples.zh: 费用并不重要。

examples.en: What taxes they are or are not paying on that sum is entirely immaterial.
examples.zh: 他们对这笔钱缴纳或不缴纳什么税完全不重要。

examples.en: In that context, the risk of a bond market collapse akin to 1994 is not immaterial.
examples.zh: 在这种背景下，类似于 1994 年的债券市场崩溃的风险并非无关紧要。

examples.en: The bottom line, he notes, is that the deal is basically immaterial to Apple.
examples.zh: 他指出，最重要的是，这笔交易对苹果来说基本上无关紧要。

examples.zh: 那个聪明的人更可能需要什么？

examples.en: You are smarmy.
examples.zh: 你是奉承我的人。

examples.en: Among Granirer's routines is a feigned phone conversation in which he unsettles a smarmy telemarketer.
examples.zh: 格拉尼勒的日常工作之一是假装打电话，让一位狡猾的电话推销员感到不安。

examples.en: Bias just comes in 37 different flavors, everything from subtle to smarmy to way off in left or right field.

examples.en: They play multiple instruments and sing in harmony about elegant gardens, dystopian futures, striving scientists, a smarmy impresario and much more.
examples.zh: 他们演奏多种乐器，和谐地歌唱优雅的花园、反乌托邦的未来、奋斗的科学家、谄媚的乐队指挥等等。

examples.en: In conversation, he was suave and urbane.

examples.en: Urbane, brainy and funny, he seemed the embodiment of Poland’s hoped-for future.
examples.zh: 他举止得体、智慧过人且幽默风趣，这种种的优点也让他几乎成了波兰梦想的未来的化身。

examples.en: Urbane and dapper, 45-year-old Najib was once aligned with Anwar, but past history will mean little.
examples.zh: 45 岁的纳吉布温文尔雅、衣冠楚楚，一度与安瓦尔结盟，但过去的历史意义不大。

examples.en: With such a pedigree, Mr Achleitner is already being tipped to succeed Allianz's urbane chairman, Henning Schulte-Noelle.
examples.zh: 凭借这样的出身，阿赫莱特纳先生已经被认为将接替安联集团温文尔雅的董事长亨宁·舒尔特-诺埃尔(Henning Schulte-Noelle)。

examples.en: The cultural opposite of the colorful rogues behind Industry, the formally dressed Roski comes across as urbane and mannered.
examples.zh: 与工业背后色彩斑斓的流氓文化相反，穿着正式的罗斯基给人一种温文尔雅、彬彬有礼的感觉。

examples.zh: 狄肯使劲抓住科林的胳膊，但那孩子还没有开始发抖。

examples.en: Recovery may be here, but it could falter.
examples.zh: 经济复苏可能已经开始，但可能出现曲折。

examples.en: They are not perfect, they falter sometimes.
examples.zh: 他们并不完美，有时他们也会与不能坚持。

examples.en: He is a reclusive, timorous creature.

examples.en: Some delegates believe the final declaration is likely to be too timorous.
examples.zh: 一些代表认为这份最后的声明可能有些过于畏首畏尾的感觉。

examples.en: When he worked with that timorous vice president, for example, Mr. Grupper urged her to think about colleagues who commanded attention and respect.

examples.en: The reporter turns into a sappy parody of timorous liberalism.
examples.zh: 记者变成了对胆怯的自由主义的滑稽模仿。

examples.en: India has had a few of these in the 1990s, and some say that prime ministers who know their tenures will be short try to get more done than the timorous and long-serving.
examples.zh: 印度在 20 世纪 90 年代就发生过一些这样的事情，有人说，那些知道自己任期很短的总理会比那些胆怯而长期任职的总理尝试做更多的事情。

examples.zh: 我在这些事情上已经成了一个颇为愤世嫉俗的人。

examples.en: Yes, I'm both a romantic and a cynic.
examples.zh: 是的，我是既浪漫又愤世嫉俗的。

examples.en: And folks wonder why I proudly call myself a cynic when it comes to so-called Wall Street reform?
examples.zh: 人们想知道为什么我在谈到所谓的华尔街改革时自豪地称自己为愤世嫉俗者？

examples.en: Speak slowly and enunciate clearly.

examples.zh: “我从小就讨厌自己的口音，经常试图发音过度，以免听起来像我周围的人，”她回忆道。

examples.en: But the reality is this: you need to speak solemnly, deliberately and enunciate properly in order to reduce the number of errors you see.
examples.zh: 但现实是这样的：你需要严肃地、谨慎地、正确地发音，才能减少你看到的错误。

examples.en: Mr Blair is the first prime minister since the second world war to enunciate a detailed philosophy of British power in the modern world.
examples.zh: 布莱尔先生是二战以来第一位详细阐述英国在现代世界实力哲学的首相。

examples.en: Millions of viewers around the globe watched the coronation ceremony live on television.
examples.zh: 全球数以亿计的观众通过电视直播收看了加冕典礼。

examples.en: The coronation took place at Westminster Abbey in accordance with centuries-old tradition.
examples.zh: 根据沿袭数百年的传统，加冕仪式在威斯敏斯特教堂举行。

examples.en: Winning the World Cup was the ultimate coronation of his stellar football career.
examples.zh: 赢得世界杯是他辉煌足球生涯的终极加冕。

examples.en: The monarch swore the coronation oath before the archbishop and the assembled dignitaries.
examples.zh: 君主在大主教和聚齐的贵宾面前宣读了加冕誓词。

examples.en: Commemorative souvenirs were produced in vast quantities ahead of the coronation.
examples.zh: 加冕典礼前夕，大量生产了纪念性衍生品。

synonyms.note: 解析：指即位、登基典礼或主教就职仪式。区别：Coronation 侧重于加冕这一具体动作和仪式，即把王冠戴在君主头上；Enthronement 侧重于君主坐上王座的过程，或用于高级神职人员的就任。
解析：指登基典礼、授予主教职。区别：Coronation 专指君主的加冕仪式；Enthronization 与 enthronement 同义，强调登上帝座或主教宝座的行为。
解析：指（国王、主教等的）登位、登基。区别：Coronation 强调戴上王冠的仪式；Enthronisation 为英式拼写，强调使上位、掌权的过程，范围包括君主和宗教领袖。

examples.zh: 这场演出使观众笑声不断。

examples.zh: 那件事引得学生和教练大笑不止。

examples.zh: 她发现自己满脸通红，既愤怒又狂喜。

examples.zh: 他想要握手，可我少不更事，笨拙，惊慌。

examples.zh: 另一方面，腐败或无能的顾问可能会花费数十亿美元的养老金。

examples.zh: 随着医学不断进步，大肚汉们可以多活些年月了。

examples.en: Mickey, a short, paunchy, 45-year-old man, walked with a swagger that announced he was in charge.
examples.zh: 米基是一位身材矮小、大腹便便的 45 岁男子，他走路时大摇大摆，宣告着他的掌控权。

examples.en: Pepper had put together a crew of 11 paunchy, middle-aged racers from Ontario, Texas and upstate New York.
examples.zh: 佩珀组建了一支由 11 名大腹便便的中年赛车手组成的团队，他们来自安大略省、德克萨斯州和纽约州北部。

examples.en: Back in Georgia, Mr Barrow faces Lee Anderson, a paunchy Republican farmer with hooded eyes and a thick drawl.
examples.zh: 回到佐治亚州，巴罗先生面对的是李·安德森（Lee Anderson），他是一位大腹便便的共和党农民，眼睛深陷，说话拖长拖长。

examples.zh: 不像其他树，它不是越往上越细，而是自下往上一样粗。

examples.en: Despite strong principles he was never censorious.
examples.zh: 他原则性很强，但从不爱挑剔。

examples.en: But the world is so censorious no character escapes.
examples.zh: 但世人就是这么爱搬弄是非，无人幸免。

examples.en: People have nothing censorious to say about his parents and brothers.
examples.zh: 他以德感化父母兄弟，使人们没有说其家人不是的。

examples.en: John Dryden considered "the great as entitled to encomiastic homage, " wrote a censorious Samuel Johnson.
examples.zh: 挑剔的塞缪尔·约翰逊写道，约翰·德莱顿认为“伟人有权受到赞扬”。

examples.en: Not that Mr Gay defends the contemporary notion of Victorian values: censorious prudery or embarrassed euphemisms.
examples.zh: 盖伊先生并不是在捍卫当代维多利亚时代的价值观：挑剔的拘谨或令人尴尬的委婉说法。

examples.en: The backlash was censorious, strict in its views on the family and personal morality, and predominantly suburban.
examples.zh: 这种强烈反对是挑剔的，对家庭和个人道德的看法很严格，而且主要是在郊区。

examples.en: This method of analysing concepts should seem fairly commonsensical.
examples.zh: 分析概念的这个方法，看来似乎是相当合乎情理的。

examples.en: The commonsensical to do is to cut spending, but nobody wants to cut spending.
examples.zh: 减少开支才是符合常理的做法，但没人愿意这样做。

examples.en: They now offer their cautious, limited, and commonsensical assistance to fully autonomous clients.
examples.zh: 现在，他们给完全自主的客户提供自己谨慎的、有限度的和通情达理的性治疗帮助。

examples.en: We intend to do everything we can to ensure that these commonsensical views prevail in the debates ahead.
examples.zh: 我们打算尽一切努力确保这些常识性观点在未来的辩论中占上风。

examples.en: The new free iPhone app offers a no-frill, commonsensical approach to personal change.
examples.zh: 新的免费 iPhone 应用程序提供了一种简单、常识性的个人改变方法。

examples.en: Ford's instincts could be commonsensical, or they could miss by a mile.
examples.zh: 福特的直觉可能是符合常识的，也可能会大错特错。

examples.en: He is a redoubtable fighter.
examples.zh: 他是个厉害的斗士。

examples.en: The redoubtable American woman played her part.
examples.zh: 可敬的美国妇女作出了其贡献。

examples.en: He soon proved himself a redoubtable warrior, and won the respect of other soldiers.
examples.zh: 他很快证明他自己是一个令人起敬的勇士，并赢得了其他士兵的尊重。

examples.en: After all we in Britain elected the redoubtable Margaret Thatcher three times as prime minister.
examples.zh: 毕竟，我们英国人曾三度选举令人敬畏的玛格丽特·撒切尔夫人担任首相。

examples.en: Only the determination of the Transport Select Committee under its redoubtable chairman, Gwyneth Dunwoody, forced an independent inquiry.
examples.zh: 只有交通特别委员会在其令人敬畏的主席格温妮丝·邓伍迪（Gwyneth Dunwoody）领导下做出的决定才迫使进行独立调查。

examples.en: Businessmen such as the redoubtable union-busting Chris Corrigan, head of Patrick Corporation, disagree.
examples.zh: 诸如令人敬畏的破坏工会的帕特里克公司负责人克里斯·科里根(Chris Corrigan)等商人不同意这种观点。

examples.en: The Yami language includes names for about 450 species offish.
examples.zh: 雅美语中包括了大约450种鱼名。

examples.en: But even before this week's scandal, some donors appeared stand-offish.
examples.zh: 但是，即便在本周的丑闻之前，一些捐助国也开始显得疏远。

examples.en: It also spawned a new term for another breed of parent – the cat dad, who is laid back, stand-offish and slow to anger.
examples.zh: “虎妈”还衍生出另一个新词“猫爸”，形容随和、矜持而不易动怒的父亲。

examples.en: Her stand-offish attitude does not however put off Frankie, played by Craig Ferguson - a recently divorced Sinatra fan.
examples.zh: 然而，她冷漠的态度并没有让弗兰基（克雷格·弗格森饰演）望而却步，弗兰基是一位最近离婚的西纳特拉粉丝。

examples.en: Novell's somewhat stand-offish attitude to the Internet has done it no favours with the current generation of Internet-centric customers.
examples.zh: Novell 对互联网有些冷漠的态度对当前这一代以互联网为中心的客户来说没有任何好处。

examples.en: Prince Hassan, more intellectual and in many ways more gifted than his brother, is stand-offish and does not inspire nearly as much public affection.
examples.zh: 哈桑王子比他的兄弟更有智慧，在很多方面也更有天赋，但他性格冷漠，并没有引起那么多公众的喜爱。

examples.en: We've developed a reputation for being quirky and original.
examples.zh: 我们因古怪、新颖而获得了声誉。

examples.en: The place is quirky, funky and dazzlingly imaginative in design.
examples.zh: 这个地方非同凡响、时髦别致且设计极富想像力。

examples.en: Oversize watches are a great alternative to a cuff or bangle, and menswear-inspired shoes offer a quirky touch.
examples.zh: 超大手表是袖口或手镯的最佳选择，而以男装为灵感设计的鞋子展现出一种别样的感觉。

examples.en: But Hudson did not become a quirky weekend destination by ignoring its sordid history.
examples.zh: 但哈德逊并没有因为忽视其肮脏的历史而成为一个古怪的周末目的地。

examples.en: He also showed a gorgeous tea dress with a wonderful and quirky zebra print.
examples.zh: 他还展示了一件华丽的茶裙，上面有奇妙而古怪的斑马印花。

examples.en: Is GM putting Saab's quirky brand heritage on the line in its drive for global efficiencies?
examples.zh: 通用汽车是否将萨博古怪的品牌传统置于其提高全球效率的道路上？

examples.en: Don't waffle.
examples.zh: 不要胡扯。

examples.en: Keeping things short and sweet not only shows people that you are concise and don't waffle, but that you also know what you want.
examples.zh: 亲切简洁的语言不仅彰显了你简明的个性，不会被误认为是在胡扯，还让对方知道你是一个知道自己想要什么的人。

examples.en: He needs to be a lot clearer and firmer about how he will deal with America's foes and rivals: his first instinct when Russia invaded Georgia was to waffle.
examples.zh: 对于如何对付美国的敌人和对手，他需要更加明确和坚定：当俄罗斯入侵格鲁吉亚时，他的第一反应就是胡扯。

examples.en: The UUP's Danny Kinahan was critical of Mr Bell's speech, describing it as "waffle".
examples.zh: UUP 的丹尼·基纳汉 (Danny Kinahan) 对贝尔先生的演讲提出了批评，称其为“华夫饼”。

examples.en: Does the smell of waffle cones make you reach into your pocket for quarters?
examples.zh: 华夫饼甜筒的味道是否会让您把手伸进口袋去掏25美分硬币？

examples.en: In other words, Mr Havel spun a good line in well-meaning and unexceptionable waffle.
examples.zh: 换句话说，哈维尔先生用善意且无懈可击的胡言乱语说了句好话。

examples.en: What person purloin be after all the money of these people?
examples.zh: 究竟是什么人盗取了这些人的钱呢？

examples.en: That's understandable. So is punishing those who purloin classified materials.
examples.zh: 因此处罚那些偷窃秘密材料的人员也是可以理解的。

examples.en: Once the phishers purloin your account information, they can get right into your bank account and start stealing money or transferring it to other vendors to buy jewels and other merchandise.
examples.zh: 一旦网络钓鱼者窃取了您的帐户信息，他们就可以直接进入您的银行帐户并开始窃取金钱或将其转移给其他供应商以购买珠宝和其他商品。

examples.en: Because Ford and Volvo are joined at the hip in engineering terms, Geely has been forced to go to considerable lengths to reassure Ford that it will not simply purloin the pair's advanced platforms and powertrains for its existing car business.
examples.zh: 由于福特和沃尔沃在工程方面紧密相连，吉利被迫不遗余力地向福特保证，它不会简单地窃取两家公司的先进平台和动力系统用于其现有的汽车业务。

examples.en: Concert organizers branded the group's actions as puerile.
examples.zh: 演唱会举办方谴责了该乐团的幼稚行为。

examples.en: She was tired of answering these puerile questions.
examples.zh: 她回答这些幼稚的问题觉得不胜其烦。

examples.en: The first is a group of puerile men in their mid-20s.
examples.zh: 第一个团体是由一群幼稚的二十五六岁的男性组成。

examples.en: One answer, perhaps, is that audiences in other countries simply do not have the French fondness of puerile farce.
examples.zh: 或许，答案之一是其他国家的观众根本不具备法国人对幼稚闹剧的喜爱。

examples.zh: 今晚的学生代表已经表明，绝大多数圣安德鲁斯学生都比这种幼稚和无礼的行为要好得多。

examples.en: He can be very tactless sometimes.
examples.zh: 他有时太莽撞。

examples.en: It was tactless of you to comment on his hair!
examples.zh: 你竟对他的头发说三道四，真是缺心眼！

examples.zh: 他说话没轻没重，疏远了许多人。

examples.en: More damaging still are reports of tactless comments by Chris Gent, Vodafone's boss, over the Christmas break.

examples.en: Sarkozy being Sarkozy, the message came out all wrong and tactless - but the direction of his thought was sound: that the old cosy contacts with France were holding Africa back.
examples.zh: 萨科齐就是萨科齐，传达出的信息完全是错误的、不圆滑的——但他的想法方向是正确的：与法国过去的亲密接触正在阻碍非洲的发展。

examples.zh: 风中尤显你更是美丽的紫罗兰花。

examples.en: Lapus Lapus Island, an easy dive for beginners, has variegated soft corals, spiny lionfish and rainbow-coloured nudibranches (molluscs).

examples.en: So how does the neophyte collector find his or her way through this jungle?

examples.zh: 创意提供了全新的视角，而愿景建设依靠研究和深刻理解。

examples.en: This month, I introduce a neophyte framework that makes great strides toward easing the pain of testing GUIs.
examples.zh: 本月，我将介绍一种新的框架，它极大地减轻了GUI测试的痛苦。

examples.zh: 戈利萨诺是一名曲棍球新手，曾三度竞选纽约州州长，但均未成功。

examples.zh: 英迪拉去世后，这个真空由她的儿子、政治新手拉吉夫·甘地填补。

examples.zh: 1990年，作为政治新手的林在共和党州长初选中获得第二名。

examples.en: Sophie Conran, the scion of the design dynasty, uses holly and ivy with berries, eucalyptus and pine cones to decorate her home.

examples.en: Or perhaps there is something more ineffable at work.

examples.zh: 在这种神秘当中，隐藏着世界不可磨灭的向善力量。

examples.en: Something as ineffable as where you focus your attention can make your whole brain work differently.

examples.en: What Milton's readers learn is to treat words as approximate signs of the ineffable.

examples.en: Doing so makes preying on the flock difficult, but beyond that, the motivation of these group flights is ineffable.
examples.zh: 这样做会使捕食羊群变得困难，但除此之外，这些群体飞行的动机是难以言表的。

examples.en: The office ordered ten reams of paper for the upcoming printing job.
examples.zh: 办公室为即将到来的打印工作订购了十令纸。

examples.en: Researchers spent months sifting through reams of historical documents.

examples.en: The machinist used a carbide ream tool to enlarge the bore to precise dimensions.
examples.zh: 机械师使用硬质合金铰刀工具将孔径扩大至精确尺寸。

examples.en: The lawyer presented reams of financial data to prove the embezzlement.

examples.en: The boss reamed him out for making a critical error in the budget report.
examples.zh: 老板因为他在预算报告中犯了严重错误而狠狠训斥了他一顿。

etymology.rootMeaning: n./v. 令, 大量；扩(孔), 榨取, 挖
etymology.explanation: 现有词源记录可追溯到 480 年；词形经古法语 reyme 进入或影响英语。
etymology.memory: 先记核心义“令”，再用常用搭配和例句巩固词形，避免编造不存在的词根。

confusables.note: 拼写相近；意为“公羊, 撞锤；猛击, 撞；猛击, 填塞, 反复灌输；只读内存, 随机存取内存, 随机存取存储器；随机存取存储器”
拼写相近；意为“收割, 收获, 获得；收割, 得到报应”

words.analysis:
【细微含义】1) 印刷与出版量词，1 令 = 500 张纸；复数 reams of 常用作比喻，指“大量的书面材料、数据”；2) 工程加工中指用铰刀扩大金属或木材孔径（ream out）；3) 美式俗语中 ream someone out 指“严厉训斥”或“欺骗榨取”。
【使用场景】办公用品、写作与文学（reams of paperwork）、机械工程（reaming）、口语俗语。
【感情色彩】中性（指量词/加工）；reams of 带有“繁琐冗长”意味。
【历史典故】源自阿拉伯语 rizmah（一包、一捆），经古法语 raime 传入英语。
【助记方法】ream 与 cream 同音，一包包整齐放好的纸张就像“一箱箱奶油”。

examples.zh: 利勒黑 1973 年的审判暴露了这位才华横溢的外科医生庸俗的一面，他已婚并育有四个孩子。

examples.en: In 90 percent of cases the patient will relapse within six months.
examples.zh: 90％的病人会在6个月内旧病复发。

examples.en: You are well now, but mind you don't have a relapse.
examples.zh: 你的病虽然好了，可要防止反复。

examples.en: He handed in his resignation at once—and that night the Judge suffered a relapse and died.
examples.zh: 他立刻递交了辞呈——就在那天晚上，法官旧病复发，去世了。

examples.en: It is now realized that some children do go into remission and may relapse later.
examples.zh: 现在人们认识到，有些儿童确实会进入缓解期，但以后可能会复发。

examples.en: People who taper off the medication too quickly are more likely to have a relapse.
examples.zh: 过快停药的人更有可能复发。

examples.en: Not only might they not get much better, there is an excellent chance they could relapse.
examples.zh: 他们不仅不会好转，而且很有可能复发。

examples.en: The remark was made half in jest.
examples.zh: 这话是半开玩笑说出的。

examples.en: For a jest, my prince, we did exchange garments.
examples.zh: 为了开玩笑，我的王子，我们交换了衣服。

examples.en: Would I jest about such a thing?
examples.zh: 这种事我会说着玩吗？

examples.en: Almost in jest you invoke the devil, and to your horror the devil appears.

examples.en: Roger Ailes suggested, perhaps less than half in jest, that Petraeus run for President.
examples.zh: 罗杰·艾尔斯建议彼得雷乌斯竞选总统，这或许不带半开玩笑的意味。

examples.en: The meal that followed was a veritable banquet.
examples.zh: 随后摆上的饭菜俨然是一桌宴席。

examples.en: I began to see a veritable army of mothers and one father pushing a stroller while talking on the cell phone.
examples.zh: 我开始看到一群母亲和一位父亲一边推着婴儿车一边打电话。

examples.en: Constantly working to refine their product, Match.com is a veritable lab of dating science.
examples.zh: Match.com 不断致力于完善其产品，是名副其实的约会科学实验室。

examples.en: Included is a veritable cemetery of old retail haunts, including Circuit City and Border Group.
examples.zh: 其中包括名副其实的老零售店墓地，包括电路城 (Circuit City) 和边境集团 (Border Group)。

examples.en: But that aspect seems like a veritable after-dinner mint swallowed while driving the SUV away from the all-you-can-eat.
examples.zh: 但这方面看起来就像是在驾驶SUV远离自助餐时吞下名副其实的餐后薄荷糖。

examples.zh: 仅有一个原因可以解释为什么威尔玛和弗雷德·福林斯能够生活在一起，尽管威尔玛生性有些暴躁，弗雷德也有些粗鲁滑稽。

examples.en: We stripped off our sodden clothes.

examples.zh: 我们把被雨淋透的外衣挂在门厅里。

examples.zh: 绞刑那是在缅甸，一个泡在雨水中的清晨。

examples.zh: 以一家中型纺织品制造商的经验为例，该制造商代表了许多陷入困境的当地企业。

examples.zh: 夏洛特面无笑容的安检人员从数百名湿透的代表手中没收了雨伞。

examples.en: Police in India spray unruly crowds with coloured water: stained and sodden agitators are easier to identify.
examples.zh: 印度警察向不守规矩的人群喷洒有色水：沾污和浸湿的煽动者更容易识别。

examples.zh: 但这之中隐藏着另一个难题。

examples.en: Foreign investors face a similar conundrum.
examples.zh: 外国投资者面临同样的难题。

examples.en: Layoffs of public workers will add more pressure to the larger American job creation conundrum.
examples.zh: 公职人员的裁员将为美国创造就业的更大难题带来更大压力。

examples.zh: 这一决定背后存在如此鲜明的对比，这一事实表明了一个更大的难题。

examples.zh: 他有赚钱的真本领。

examples.en: He's got the knack of getting people to listen.
examples.zh: 他有让人们倾听的诀窍。

examples.zh: 查普曼是家里的诙谐人物，他有诀窍在任何场合开玩笑。

examples.en: Nearby was a factory which exuded a pungent smell.
examples.zh: 附近是一家散发出一种刺鼻气味的工厂。

examples.en: The goats, scenting the pungent herbs, also hurried up without delay.
examples.zh: 山羊嗅到了辛辣的草药味，也毫不迟疑地赶了上来。

examples.zh: 当我的肩膀拍打在一排湿衣服上时，我可以闻到刺鼻的榴莲果味、烤沙爹味和柠檬洗涤剂的味道。

examples.en: Benton Brothers Fine Cheese stocks pungent offerings from across Canada and around the world.
examples.zh: Benton Brothers Fine Cheese 备有来自加拿大和世界各地的辛辣产品。

examples.en: When my nose first got a whiff of its pungent, acidic odour, my stomach began to churn.
examples.zh: 当我的鼻子第一次闻到刺鼻的酸性气味时，我的胃开始翻腾。

examples.en: To soften its pungent assault, it is served with a dollop of thick mountain honey.
examples.zh: 为了减轻其辛辣的攻击，它与一块厚厚的山蜂蜜一起食用。

examples.en: This reminder did not hearten the servants much; they still held back.
examples.zh: 这个提示并没有使仆人们振作起来；他们仍然踌躇不前。

examples.en: He said a lot to hearten me.
examples.zh: 他对我说了许多鼓励的话。

examples.en: This good news will hearten you.
examples.zh: 这个好消息会使你振作起来。

examples.en: Such vigorous actions would hearten moderates, creating a virtual circle of even more opponents of those who want to destroy civilization.
examples.zh: 这种积极的行动将鼓舞温和派，形成一个由更多反对那些想要摧毁文明的人组成的虚拟圈子。

examples.en: But it should hearten US ambassador Gerald Feierstein, now touring these shores with 10 CEOs active in Yemen, touting the business prospects.
examples.zh: 但这应该会让美国大使杰拉尔德·菲尔斯坦 (Gerald Feierstein) 感到振奋，他目前正在与 10 名活跃在也门的首席执行官一起巡游这些海岸，宣传商业前景。

examples.en: And it will hearten the civilized world more than we imagine.
examples.zh: 它将比我们想象的更让文明世界振奋。

examples.zh: 委员会拒不同意他的方案。

examples.en: Gradually his countenance cleared, and he began to smile long, slow smiles.
examples.zh: 渐渐地，他的脸色开朗了，开始慢慢地长时间地挂着微笑。

examples.en: They'll countenance some very limited tax raising powers in peripheral areas, in return for borrowing rights.
examples.zh: 他们将支持外围地区一些非常有限的征税权，以换取借贷权。

examples.en: They grow red in the face with apoplectic anger that anyone dare have a different view.
examples.zh: 他们因为有人胆敢持不同意见而气得满脸通红。

examples.en: The consigner I heard turned apoplectic as there was no reserve price put on the piece.
examples.zh: 我听到的委托人非常愤怒，因为这件作品没有底价。

examples.en: They'll all be watching - the police, the politicians, the psychologists, the apoplectic and the apologists.
examples.zh: 他们都会注视着——警察、政治家、心理学家、中风者和辩护者。

examples.zh: 除了诱惑我什么都能够抵制是句非常有趣的隽语。

examples.en: Well, here's an axiom, if not an epigram, of my own: "Hitch" is least good when most plotted.
examples.zh: 好吧，这是我自己的一条公理，如果不是警句的话：“搭便车”在情节最多的情况下是最不好的。

examples.en: The basis of the 10Mbps specification, labeled 2.0 by the alliance, comes from a proposal from Epigram, a subsidiary of Broadcom, and Lucent Technologies Microelectronics Group.
examples.zh: 联盟标记为2.0的10Mbps规范的基础来自博通子公司Epigram和朗讯科技微电子集团的一项提案。

examples.en: Reading a succession of lifestyle poems is a reminder that in this century the poetical image and the poetical epigram have had to compete with the photograph and the advertising slogan.
examples.zh: 阅读一系列生活方式诗歌提醒我们，在本世纪，诗意的形象和诗意的警句必须与照片和广告口号竞争。

examples.zh: 第一种连续的带状制作过程涉及到利用两个高温滚轴挤压熔融玻璃，类似于过去的轧棉机。

examples.en: Laughed the editor across the mangle.
examples.zh: 编辑隔着热轧滚筒大笑起来。

examples.en: There are three table options available: filter, NAT and mangle.
examples.zh: 有三种可用的表选项：filter、nat和mangle。

examples.en: Making us mangle wire hangers to activate blindly some tiny reset hole in the back?
examples.zh: 让我们敲碎钢丝衣架来盲目地激活后面的一些微小的重置孔？

examples.zh: 将其通过铃声和粉碎机让所有人看到是另一回事。

examples.zh: 随后卡蒂克滑倒了一个无球球，但阿拉法特只能通过任意球击中对手。

examples.en: His views are out of kilter with world opinion.
examples.zh: 他的观点与世人的看法不一致。

examples.en: Her lifestyle was out of kilter with her politics.
examples.zh: 她的生活方式与她的政治活动格格不入。

examples.en: Long flights throw my sleeping pattern out of kilter for days.
examples.zh: 长途飞行使我的睡眠习惯给打乱了好几天。

examples.en: But an off-kilter entry knocked them off course, to finish without a medal in fourth place.
examples.zh: 但一次失控的参赛让他们偏离了轨道，最终排名第四，没有获得奖牌。

examples.en: "The punishments for computer crimes are seriously off-kilter, and congress needs to fix them, " she added.
examples.zh: “对计算机犯罪的惩罚严重失调，国会需要解决这些问题，”她补充道。

examples.en: The games remaining matches got a bit out of kilter this weekend with FA Cup play.
examples.zh: 本周末足总杯的剩余比赛有点不正常。

examples.zh: 随后德夫为维护奴隶制写了一份有力的辩护，这份辩护成为支持所有后亲奴主义作家的开创性著作。

examples.zh: 由于数据输入是任何CMS中的基本功能，Drupal提供一个Form API(参见参考资料)来描述表单字段。

examples.zh: Design Patterns (Erich Gamma, et al .，Addison - Wesley, 1995)：阅读这本介绍软件工程中模式的用法的经典书籍。

examples.en: Karriere is a seminal bar conceived by Danish artist Jeppe Hein that is also an art collection.
examples.zh: Karriere 是丹麦艺术家 Jeppe Hein 构思的一家开创性酒吧，同时也是一个艺术收藏品。

examples.en: Keyboardist Ray Manzarek helped form the seminal '60s band after meeting then-poet Jim Morrison in California.
examples.zh: 键盘手雷·曼扎里克 (Ray Manzarek) 在加利福尼亚州结识了当时的诗人吉姆·莫里森 (Jim Morrison)，之后帮助组建了这支 60 年代开创性的乐队。

examples.en: Kildall died in a brawl, scarcely remembered outside Silicon Valley for his seminal contribution.
examples.zh: 基尔达尔在一场斗殴中丧生，但他的开创性贡献在硅谷以外几乎没有人记得。

examples.en: He devoted his energies to the reformation of science.

examples.en: She is devoted to her family.

examples.en: She devoted herself to her career.
examples.zh: 她全力倾注于自己的事业。

examples.en: My system came with eight dimly photocopied pages devoted mostly to support, warranty and return policies.
examples.zh: 我的系统附带八张模糊的影印页，主要用于支持、保修和退货政策。

examples.en: Smiling beside Lord Bragg on the platform was Labour's onetime leader and devoted Bevanite, Michael Foot .

words.meaning: adj. 极好笑的；滑稽可笑的；欢闹的
words.analysis: 【细微含义与使用场景】口语与书面语极高频词汇。比 funny（有趣的）程度强得多，指令人大笑不止、爆笑或极度幽默的（extremely funny / side-splitting）。感情色彩积极生动。【助记】hilar-（高兴，如 exhilarate 使兴奋）+ -ious -> 极度高兴/好笑的。

examples.en: The comedian's hilarious observations about daily life had the entire audience in stitches.
examples.zh: 喜剧演员对日常生活的爆笑观察让全场观众捧腹大笑。

examples.en: We watched a hilarious romantic comedy that left us wiping tears of laughter from our eyes.
examples.zh: 我们看了一部极具幽默感的浪漫喜剧，笑得直掉眼泪。

examples.en: An unexpected auto-correct mistake led to a hilarious exchange between the two colleagues.
examples.zh: 一个意外的自动更正错误引发了两名同事之间一段啼笑皆非的对话。

examples.en: She shared a hilarious story about her first disastrous attempt at baking a wedding cake.
examples.zh: 她分享了一个关于她第一次烘焙婚礼蛋糕惨败的爆笑故事。

examples.en: The animated movie appeals to both children and adults with its clever and hilarious dialogue.
examples.zh: 这部动画电影凭借巧妙而爆笑的对话吸引了孩子和成年人。

synonyms.note: 解析：极可笑的，尖叫的。区别：Hilarious 侧重于极其滑稽、引发强烈的欢快；Screaming (形容词) 侧重于好笑到让人尖叫或事态极其显眼。
解析：令人捧腹大笑的，喧闹的。区别：Hilarious 强调幽默程度高；Uproarious 侧重于不仅好笑，而且引发了喧闹和骚动的场景。

phrases.zh: 极其好笑的笑话
觉得某事爆笑/非常滑稽
爆笑戏剧/喜剧
啼笑皆非的误解

examples.zh: 我向他保证我们并不是来改变他的信仰的。

examples.en: I now take the view that religion is harmless so long as it does not compel its members to proselytize.
examples.zh: 我现在认为宗教是无害的，只要它不强迫其成员改变宗教信仰。

examples.en: A wise man will not proselytize you.
examples.zh: 聪明人总会告诉你答案。

examples.en: We need a new information layer to proselytize this form of investment and get people comfortable with it.
examples.zh: 我们需要一个新的信息层来宣传这种投资形式并让人们适应它。

examples.en: White House officials say safeguards would be in place to make sure the religious groups do not use the money to proselytize.
examples.zh: 白宫官员表示，将采取保障措施，确保宗教团体不会用这笔钱传教。

examples.en: Now, I am not about to proselytize about such a dramatic move.
examples.zh: 现在，我不打算劝说如此戏剧性的举动。

examples.zh: 我们不情愿的开始长途跋涉回家。

examples.en: He snorted, and during the rest of that weary trudge addressed his remarks exclusively to Mole.
examples.zh: 他嗤了一声，在这趟令人筋疲力尽的长途跋涉的剩余路程里，他只对鼹鼠莫尔一个人说话。

examples.en: We had to trudge up the track back to the station.
examples.zh: 我们不得不沿着铁轨步履艰难地走回车站。

examples.en: As Tony Blair so often found, you just have to trudge on, however disheartening the failures.
examples.zh: 正如托尼·布莱尔经常发现的那样，你只能艰难前行，无论失败多么令人沮丧。

examples.en: Fleur and Mambounou trudge through streets where homeowners are dumping wheelbarrows full of debris.
examples.zh: 芙蓉和曼布努艰难地穿过街​​道，那里的房主正在倾倒装满碎片的手推车。

examples.en: Even with the blizzard, a tradition prevails at Yale to "trudge through, " Ms. Olson said.
examples.zh: 奥尔森女士说，即使有暴风雪，耶鲁大学仍盛行“艰难前行”的传统。

examples.en: Benefit is calculated on the basis of average weekly earnings.
examples.zh: 补助金按平均周收入计算。

examples.en: The time when a solar eclipse will occur can be calculated.
examples.zh: 日食发生的时间可以推算出来。

examples.en: Her latest play is calculated to shock.
examples.zh: 她最新推出的剧本故意要耸人听闻。

examples.en: It was coldly and crassly calculated, but that doesn't prevent you sometimes from doing some interesting work.
examples.zh: 这是冷酷而粗鲁的计算，但这并不妨碍你有时做一些有趣的工作。

examples.en: Also, the fees are calculated as a percentage of the sale proceeds, not a percentage of the gain.
examples.zh: 此外，费用是按销售收入的百分比计算的，而不是收益的百分比。

examples.en: In many of yesterday's marches, American flags were everywhere, a calculated move by march organizers.
examples.zh: 在昨天的许多游行中，美国国旗随处可见，这是游行组织者精心策划的举动。

examples.en: Then the whole rigmarole starts over again.
examples.zh: 然后，整个冗长复杂的过程又重新开始了。

examples.en: I couldn't face the whole rigmarole of getting a work permit again.
examples.zh: 我无法再次面对获取工作许可证所需的各种冗长复杂的手续。

examples.en: Take the rigmarole it puts users through when they wish to close an account.
examples.zh: 用户想关闭帐户必须通过冗长的对话框。

examples.en: For now, most Britons will have to brace themselves for the occasional wi-fi rigmarole.
examples.zh: 目前，大多数英国人将不得不为偶尔出现的无线网络繁琐做好准备。

examples.en: This just takes care of others' wall posts -- you have to go through a whole 'nother rigmarole to block your photo albums, for example.
examples.zh: 这只是照顾其他人的墙上帖子——例如，您必须通过整个“另一个繁琐的程序来阻止您的相册”。

examples.en: Question: Did Segall know that he might be able to skip the accounting rigmarole and do as well or better by renting the condo only 14 days a year?
examples.zh: 问题：Segall 是否知道他可以通过每年只租 14 天的公寓来跳过繁琐的会计工作，做得同样好甚至更好？

words.meaning: adj. 催眠的，令人昏昏欲睡的；n. 催眠药，安眠镇静剂

phrases.zh: 催眠效果，致眠作用
令人昏昏欲睡的讲座
催眠药，安眠药
催眠音乐，助眠曲

examples.en: The professor's monotonous voice had a soporific effect on the entire auditorium.
examples.zh: 教授单调的声音对全场听众产生了催眠的效果。

examples.en: Warm milk and chamomile tea are traditional remedies with natural soporific properties.
examples.zh: 热牛奶和洋甘菊茶是具有天然助眠特性的传统偏方。

examples.en: The heavy rain rhythmically tapping on the roof created a soporific ambiance.
examples.zh: 屋顶上节奏均匀的滂沱大雨营造出一种令人昏昏欲睡的氛围。

examples.en: The physician warned that the medication carries a strong soporific side effect.
examples.zh: 医生警告说该药物带有强烈的催眠副作用。

examples.en: She put on a soporific track to quiet her racing thoughts before sleep.
examples.zh: 在睡前她播放了一首助眠曲，以平复脑海中纷乱的思绪。

synonyms.note: 解析：催眠的，引人入睡的。区别：Soporific 是最常见的词，指事物无聊或具有催眠作用；Soporiferous 较为罕见，侧重指含有或产生睡眠效果的物质。
解析：催眠的，使人想睡的。区别：Soporific 多用于形容无聊的演讲或事物；Somniferous 偏向医学或文学，强调带来睡眠的属性。
解析：催眠的。区别：Soporific 广泛用于比喻或实际催眠；Somnific 是一个非常罕见的同义词，指产生睡眠的。
解析：入睡前发生的，催眠的。区别：Soporific 指引起睡眠的事物；Hypnogogic 特指在清醒和睡眠之间的过渡状态（如入睡前的幻觉）。

etymology.rootMeaning: adj./n. 催眠的, 想睡的, 令人麻木不仁的；催眠剂, 安眠药
etymology.explanation: 现有词源记录可追溯到 1680 年代；词形经法语 soporifique 进入或影响英语；从现代构词看可辅助拆为 soporif + -ic（形容词后缀，表示……的）。
etymology.memory: 先记核心义“催眠”，再用常用搭配和例句巩固词形，避免编造不存在的词根。

words.analysis:
【细微含义】指引起沉睡或瞌睡的事物。既可用于物理药物（soporific drugs），也可用于形容极其枯燥乏味的大众演讲、故事或气候（a soporific lecture / music）。
【使用场景】医学/药学、文学写作、演讲/课堂评价。
【感情色彩】形容药物时为中性；形容演讲/书本时带贬义（指极度无聊、昏昏欲睡）。
【历史典故】源自拉丁语 sopor（深睡）+ -ficus（产生……的，来自 facere 制造）。
【助记方法】sopor（睡眠，似 soap 让人放松洗澡睡觉）+ fic（做）→ 制造睡眠的 → 催眠的。

words.meaning: n. 神智正常，理智，明智
words.analysis:
【细微含义】指精神状态健康正常、具备合理思考的能力（与 insanity 精神错乱 相对）。【IT测试】sanity check（神智检查 / 健全性检查）指基础的功能可行性快速验证。
【使用场景】心理健康、日常表达、软件开发测试。
【助记方法】san (健康/理智，如 sane, sanitary) + -ity -> 理智。

examples.en: Working long hours without breaks tested his sanity to the absolute limit.
examples.zh: 长时间连续工作不休息，将他的理智考验到了极限。

examples.en: Always run a quick sanity check on your calculations before submitting the final data.
examples.zh: 在提交最终数据前，务必对你的计算进行快速的合理性抽查。

examples.en: Meditation helped her maintain her emotional balance and sanity during tough times.
examples.zh: 在艰难时期，冥想帮助她保持了情绪平衡和头脑清醒。

examples.en: The diplomatic agreement brought a welcome ray of sanity to the international dispute.
examples.zh: 外交协议为这场国际争端带来了一缕令人欣慰的理智曙光。

examples.en: The automated test suite performs a basic sanity check after each software build.
examples.zh: 自动化测试套件在每次软件构建后都会执行基础的健全性检查。

synonyms.note: 心智健全，理智。Saneness 是 sane 的名词形式，意思和 Sanity 一样，但英语中 Sanity 是主流用法，Saneness 很少使用。

confusables.note: 拼写相近；意为“对等；等价；奇偶性或奇偶校验”

phrases.zh: 健全性检查 / 合理性抽查
保持理智
恢复理智/恢复正常秩序
对神志/理智的考验

examples.en: In a rare lucid moment, she looked at me and smiled.

examples.en: In Europe their persecution by the gadje began quickly, with the church seeing heresy in their fortune-telling and the state seeing anti-social behaviour in their nomadism.
examples.zh: 在欧洲，他们很快就受到了加杰家族的迫害，教会认为他们的占卜是异端，而政府则认为他们的游牧行为是反社会的。

examples.en: And, being a contrarian and a dramatist, Mr. Mamet doubtless relishes the attention for his heresy.

examples.en: In Western Europe, the twelfth and early thirteenth centuries were a high tide of heresy.
examples.zh: 在西欧，十二世纪和十三世纪初是异端邪说的高潮。

examples.zh: 在美国，最大的饮用水源是奥加拉拉含水层。

examples.en: Illinois seems to careen from one crisis to the next.
examples.zh: 看起来伊利诺斯州正从一个危机进入到下一个危机中去。

examples.en: The driver lost control and the car careen down the hill.
examples.zh: 因司机失控，那辆汽车就横冲直撞地冲下山去。

examples.zh: 这意味着司机必须侧着脖子才能看清身后的情况。

examples.en: Public pensions and healthcare costs careen toward a certain collision with fiscal reality.
examples.zh: 公共养老金和医疗保健成本倾向于与财政现实发生一定的冲突。

examples.en: As the boy detective and his dog careen from Belgium to the Middle East, the music takes on an international flair.

examples.en: Almost every language has an O vowel, a K consonant, and an A vowel.
examples.zh: 几乎每一种语言都有一个 O 元音、一个 K 辅音和一个 A 元音。

examples.en: The tactic is a bit complicated for a brief article, but the basic idea is to attach each digit to a specific consonant.
examples.zh: 对于一篇短文来说，这个策略有点复杂，但基本的概念是把每个数字跟一个特定的辅音字母关联起来。

examples.en: Spanish Silbo, a whistle language, has only four vowel and four consonant sounds. Audible for miles, it resembles bird calls.
examples.zh: 西班牙的席尔波语是一种口哨语言，只有四个元音和四个辅音。几英里外都能听到它的声音，它就像鸟儿的鸣叫。

examples.en: Obama's decision to gradually withdraw US combat forces from Iraq was fully consonant with Bush's policy.
examples.zh: 奥巴马逐步从伊拉克撤军的决定完全符合布什的政策。

examples.en: It is telling that, down through the years, the final consonant has gone missing.
examples.zh: 很明显，多年来，最后一个辅音已经消失了。

examples.en: And on Israel, American Jewish disapproval of Obama is fully consonant with the views of the general public.
examples.zh: 而在以色列问题上，美国犹太人对奥巴马的不满也完全符合公众的看法。

examples.en: The German regulator said the violations were a minor infraction.
examples.zh: 德国监管者称它们只是轻微的违法。

examples.en: Hundreds of worshippers gathered at the local mosque for Friday prayers.
examples.zh: 数百名礼拜者聚集在当地清真寺参加周五的聚礼。

examples.en: The magnificent blue tiles of the historic mosque drew tourists from around the world.
examples.zh: 这座历史悠久的清真寺上壮丽的蓝色瓷砖吸引了来自世界各地的游客。

examples.en: Preserving ancient mosques requires specialized architectural restoration techniques.

【感情色彩与使用规范】客观中性词。在跨文化交流与国际新闻中，应当秉持宗教与文化尊重使用。

examples.zh: 它会导致囤积和投机，从而导致价格扭曲，即它是自我延续的。

words.meaning: v. 减弱，减轻，减少；废除
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】指风暴、疼痛、热情、价格或污染等自然现象、情绪或强度的“逐渐减弱、缓解”；也可作及物动词指主动“减轻，减扣”。既可用于日常描写，也广泛用于法律与环境科学领域。
【历史典故/词源】源自古法语 abattre（击倒，打下），由 a-（去）+ battre（打，击打，同 beat）构成。本义是“打击使其降下来”。
【专业领域特殊含义】在法律中，abate an action / nuisance 指“中止诉讼 / 消除公害”；在环境工程中，pollution abatement 指“污染治理与削减”。
【助记方法】a（去）+ bate（打/向下）→ 把势头打下去 → 减弱，减轻。

phrases.zh: 风暴减弱

examples.en: The government introduced new measures to abate noise pollution near residential areas.

examples.en: As the medicine took effect, his excruciating headache began to abate.
examples.zh: 随着药物发挥作用，他剧烈的头痛开始缓解。

examples.en: The intense debate gradually abated after both sides agreed to a compromise.
examples.zh: 在双方达成妥协后，激烈的辩论逐渐平息。

examples.en: Local authorities offered tax abatement to attract technology startups.
examples.zh: 地方政府提供税收减免以吸引科技初创企业。

examples.en: Their enthusiasm for the project did not abate despite repeated setbacks.
examples.zh: 尽管屡遭挫折，他们对该项目的热情却丝毫没有减退。

synonyms.note: 平息，减退。区别：subside 侧重于喧嚣、情绪或水位的下沉平息；abate 侧重于强度的逐渐减弱。
减少，变小。区别：diminish 强调数量或规模的缩减；abate 强调势头、力量或严重程度的缓解。

examples.en: He was loath to admit his mistake.
examples.zh: 他不愿承认自己的错误。

examples.en: I felt loath to sully the gleaming brass knocker by handling it.
examples.zh: 我不愿意用手去抓那个闪亮的黄铜门环以免把它弄脏。

examples.en: Sensing he held the advantage, Mr. Danbar was loath to change the subject.
examples.zh: 丹巴先生觉得占有优势，不愿改变话题。

examples.en: Politicians are loath to raise gasoline taxes, which would force people to purchase more fuel-efficient vehicles.
examples.zh: 政客们不愿意提高汽油税，因为这将迫使人们购买更节能的汽车。

examples.en: These entities could make loans to customers that now frightened banks are increasingly loath to make.
examples.zh: 这些实体可以向客户提供贷款，而现在银行越来越不愿意向客户提供贷款。

examples.en: Even conservative politicians are loath to be so direct in their support of wealthier Americans.
examples.zh: 即使是保守派政客也不愿如此直接地支持富裕的美国人。

examples.en: Even Brussels bureaucrats can't homogenize national cultures and tastes.
examples.zh: 即便是布鲁塞尔的官僚们也不能令各种民族文化和品味雷同化。

examples.en: Imagine that an alien species landed on Earth and, through their mere presence, those aliens caused our art to vanish, our music to homogenize, and our technological know-how to disappear.
examples.zh: 想象一下，外星物种登陆地球，而他们的存在会让我们的艺术消逝，同化我们的音乐，也让我们的技术知识消失了。

examples.en: Homogenize the connectivity of assets and services to support the business processes, and.
examples.zh: 同质化资产和服务的连接性以支持业务流程，以及。

examples.en: The selection systems used to pick leaders, which he says homogenize the pool of potential CEOs and presidents.
examples.zh: 他说，用于挑选领导人的选拔系统使潜在首席执行官和总裁的人才库变得同质化。

examples.en: By relying on simple variations on the mean, companies effectively homogenize the data they get, and they miss crucial key information.
examples.zh: 通过依赖平均值的简单变化，公司有效地同质化了他们获得的数据，并且他们错过了关键的关键信息。

examples.en: There has been a fault line in the EU ever since bureaucrats of Brussels tried to homogenize every aspect of European life.
examples.zh: 自从布鲁塞尔官僚试图将欧洲生活的各个方面同质化以来，欧盟内部就一直存在断层线。

examples.en: They are taking undue advantage of the situation.
examples.zh: 他们过分利用了这种情势。

examples.en: The work should be carried out without undue delay.
examples.zh: 进行这项工作不得有不当的延误。

examples.en: While the quality of legal journalism varies greatly, there is an undue reliance amongst many journalists on interpretations supplied to them by lawyers.
examples.zh: 虽然法律新闻报道的质量良莠不齐，但在很多新闻记者中，存在过度依赖律师给他们提供诠释的现象。

examples.en: Furthermore, a strong and durable recovery requires that countries not have an undue advantage.
examples.zh: 此外，强劲而持久的复苏要求各国不能拥有不正当的优势。

examples.en: This will help ensure that there is no undue interference with the existing spectrum users.
examples.zh: 这将有助于确保现有频谱用户不会受到不当干扰。

examples.en: Mr Tedesco maintains that the current plan was inefficient and placed an undue burden on parents.
examples.zh: 特德斯科先生坚持认为，目前的计划效率低下，给家长带来了不应有的负担。

examples.zh: 我建议你们，每天只读一次散文诗，然后就可以意愿梦想根据意愿来改变了。

examples.zh: 他只懂一点法语。

examples.en: I had acquired a smattering of Greek.
examples.zh: 我学会了一丁点儿希腊文。

examples.en: On his wanderings he's picked up Spanish, Italian, French and a smattering of Russian.
examples.zh: 在流浪途中，他学会了西班牙语、意大利语、法语和一点点俄语。

examples.en: Ankiel, recently cut loose by the last-place Houston Astros, received a smattering of cheers each at-bat.
examples.zh: 安基尔最近被垫底的休斯敦太空人队淘汰，每次击球都会收到一些欢呼声。

examples.zh: 如今，该岛的贸易主要依靠其考古遗产，也有少量的旅游业。

examples.en: They sealed two shower curtains together, capturing some pungent Jersey air in a smattering of bubbles.
examples.zh: 他们将两块浴帘密封在一起，将一些刺鼻的泽西空气捕获在少量的气泡中。

examples.en: Casey were the subject of a laudatory retrospective last week in Investors Business Daily ( see the attached).

examples.en: The authors are laudatory of Scott and White Memorial Hospital in Temple, Texas for their short hospital stays.

examples.en: Their spartan lifestyle prohibits a fridge or a phone.
examples.zh: 他们简朴的生活方式使他们不会有冰箱和电话。

examples.en: The bathroom, with its spartan pre-war facilities, is positively arctic.
examples.zh: 这个有简陋战前设施的浴室实在冷极了。

examples.en: After the Battle of Aegospotami, the Spartan navy sailed where it pleased unopposed.
examples.zh: 伊哥斯波塔米战役后，斯巴达海军开赴他们所向披靡的地方。

examples.en: Their living conditions were quite spartan, but here they were taking time out by playing golf.
examples.zh: 他们的生活条件相当简朴，但在这里他们通过打高尔夫球来消遣。

examples.en: Even expedition ships, where spartan accommodation is almost a point of pride, are offering creature comforts.
examples.zh: 即使是探险船，简陋的住宿几乎是一种自豪，也提供物质享受。

examples.en: Spartan Races are timed events at distances that range from a 5K to a half-marathon.
examples.zh: 斯巴达竞赛是一种计时赛事，距离从 5 公里到半程马拉松不等。

examples.en: I felt like an animal caught in a snare.
examples.zh: 我感到自己像是一头陷入网罗的野兽。

examples.en: Prawn-catchers will be cut back too because, though prawns (Scotland's main catch) are plentiful, those who fish for them also snare cod.
examples.zh: 捕虾者也将被削减，因为尽管大虾（苏格兰的主要捕获物）数量充足，但捕虾者也会捕捉鳕鱼。

examples.en: Trust it not, Sir; it will prove a snare to your feet.
examples.zh: 爱信不信，先生，它将会是一个脚下的陷阱。

examples.en: But those sites are mere half-measures in the effort to snare a dream vacation.
examples.zh: 但这些网站只是实现梦想假期的权宜之计。

examples.en: Only the deer's skeleton remained, suggesting it had been caught in the snare some time ago.
examples.zh: 这只鹿只剩下骨架，表明它不久前曾被困在陷阱中。

examples.en: To snare the well padded, Sands lavishes money on the look of his stores.
examples.zh: 为了吸引顾客，金沙在商店的外观上投入了大量资金。

examples.en: He is a possessive, duplicitous, and unreasonable man.
examples.zh: 他是一个占有欲强，奸诈而又不讲理的男人。

examples.en: I'm not alone in adopting this duplicitous parenting style.
examples.zh: 在实施这狡猾的父母态度方面我并不孤单。

examples.en: But the phone and cable companies are themselves being duplicitous.
examples.zh: 但电话和有线电视公司本身就是个滑头。

examples.en: Unless Facebook plans on being duplicitous, it has to ignore that data for enforcement purposes now.
examples.zh: 除非 Facebook 计划表里不一，否则它现在必须出于执法目的而忽略这些数据。

examples.en: However, the duplicitous behaviour may also bring other benefits such as protecting the cubs from marauding males.
examples.zh: 然而，这种两面派的行为也可能带来其他好处，比如保护幼崽免受雄性的掠夺。

examples.en: Would that nice Mr Obama, the precocious possessor of a Nobel peace prize, really be so duplicitous?
examples.zh: 这位早熟的诺贝尔和平奖获得者、善良的奥巴马先生真的会如此两面派吗？

examples.en: Exactly: and that is the ineluctable modality of the audible.
examples.zh: 正是这样。这就是可听事物无可避免的形态。

examples.en: He should be fearless bear his ineluctable fate with equanimity.
examples.zh: 人应当无所畏惧，对不可避免的命运安之若泰。

examples.en: It's natural for the guests to feel anger and despair as they face their ineluctable deaths.
examples.zh: 面对无法逃避的死亡，客人们自然会感到愤怒和绝望。

examples.en: If the salary differentials between ourselves and consultants suddenly increase even further, there will be ineluctable and dire consequences for recruitment to general practice.
examples.zh: 如果我们和顾问之间的薪资差距突然进一步扩大，对于全科医疗的招聘将产生不可避免的可怕后果。

examples.en: After all, the American people have rarely had more occasion to focus on the ineluctable fact that surprise attacks, like that on Oahu, are by definition surprises.
examples.zh: 毕竟，美国人民很少有机会关注这样一个不可避免的事实：像欧胡岛那样的突然袭击，从定义上来说就是意外。

examples.en: The anti-RH groups are mute on this ineluctable fact.
examples.zh: 反 RH 团体对这个不可避免的事实保持沉默。

phrases.zh: 不定芽，附属芽

examples.en: Adventitious buds regeneration from etiolated internode segment of apple cultivar Nagafu no.
examples.zh: 富士苹果黄化茎段再生不定芽的研究。

examples.en: They had to decide whether his misconduct was adventitious or the result of a flaw in his character.
examples.zh: 他们必须确定他的错误行为是偶然发生的还是因为他的性格缺陷造成的。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of adventitious.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“外来的，偶然的”的概念提供了全新的视角。

examples.en: Recent academic studies have highlighted the significance of adventitious in modern research.
examples.zh: 最近的学术研究强调了“外来的，偶然的”在现代科学研究中的重要意义。

examples.en: Her articulate argument demonstrated a deep understanding of adventitious.
examples.zh: 她清晰有力的论证展现了对“外来的，偶然的”的深刻理解。

examples.en: The historical document contains explicit references to adventitious.
examples.zh: 这份历史文献包含了对“外来的，偶然的”的明确记载。

examples.en: The Republicans are promising to "repeal and replace" the bill.
examples.zh: 共和党人承诺“废除并且取代”此法案。

examples.en: Changing habits eroded the rules and led to their formal repeal.
examples.zh: 习惯的改变侵蚀着规则并最终将其废除。

examples.en: He promised anew to repeal DOMA and "don't ask, don't tell".
examples.zh: 他承诺婚姻保护法和“不问不说”政策将会得到修改。

examples.en: Now that they have a majority, House Republicans have promised to make repeal a priority.
examples.zh: 现在，众议院共和党人已占多数，他们承诺将废除该法案作为优先事项。

examples.en: With ObamaCare more unpopular than ever, House Republicans voted last month to repeal it.
examples.zh: 由于奥巴马医改比以往任何时候都更不受欢迎，众议院共和党人上个月投票废除了它。

examples.en: The bill would, on its face, repeal a controversial 2.3% excise tax on medical devices.
examples.zh: 从表面上看，该法案将废除有争议的 2.3% 医疗器械消费税。

words.meaning: v. 重申，反复强调

phrases.zh: 重申承诺
重申……的重要性
重申立场
反复发出警告

examples.en: The CEO reiterated the company's commitment to achieving net-zero carbon emissions by 2030.
examples.zh: 首席执行官重申了公司到2030年实现净零碳排放的承诺。

examples.en: The ambassador reiterated that peace talks could only resume after a ceasefire was declared.
examples.zh: 大使重申，只有在宣布停火后才能重启和平谈判。

examples.en: Allow me to reiterate the key points of our proposal before we begin the Q&A session.
examples.zh: 在我们开始问答环节之前，请允许我重申我们方案的核心要点。

examples.en: Health authorities reiterated their advice for vulnerable populations to get vaccinated.
examples.zh: 卫生部门再次强调并建议易感人群接种疫苗。

examples.en: The professor reiterated the necessity of citing primary sources in academic research.
examples.zh: 教授反复强调了在学术研究中引用一手文献的必要性。

synonyms.note: 重复。用法区别：repeat 是一般用词，指重复说过的话或做过的事；reiterate 较正式，专指为了强调而多次重申同一个观点。
重申，强调。用法区别：ingeminate 是生僻词，指反复申明；reiterate 是现代常用词汇。
反复说。用法区别：iterate 常用于技术领域指反复执行某个过程；reiterate 用于言语上强调。
重新叙述。用法区别：restate 侧重于用不同的方式或更清晰地再次表述；reiterate 侧重于原样重复以示强调。

etymology.rootMeaning: 作为 reiterate 构词基础的词形；核心义参见“反复地说”
etymology.explanation: reiterate 直接建立在 reiterare 之上，是它的派生形式。
etymology.memory: 先记核心义“反复地说”，再用常用搭配和例句巩固词形，避免编造不存在的词根。

words.analysis:
【细微含义】为了强调或澄清某种立场、观点、决心或警告而再次或多次重复声明。比 repeat 更正式，突显说话者的立场坚定或意图明确。
【使用场景】外交声明、商业谈判、官方发言、学术报告。在IT/AI领域，iterate 意为“迭代”，reiterate 则是“重申/重新表达”。
【助记方法】re-（再次） + iterate（重复/迭代） -> 再次重复 -> 重申、反复强调。

examples.en: These are the autonomic and somatic nervous systems.
examples.zh: 这些是自主神经系统和躯体神经系统。

examples.en: The results showed that the mode of reproduction conforms somatic apospory.
examples.zh: 结果表明，其生殖方式符合体细胞孢子。

examples.en: Viscerosomatic reflex hypothesis describes that visceral afferent fibers cause reflex somatic problems.
examples.zh: 内脏反射假说，内脏传入纤维引起反射性躯体问题。

examples.en: Even Dolly the sheep, who was produced by cloning via somatic nuclear cell transfer, benefited from a male imprinted genome.

words.meaning: v. 默许，勉强同意，默认
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】指虽然心里未必完全赞同或满意，但选择“不声张、不抗议地消极接受、默许或顺从”（acquiesce in / to a decision / demand）。语气偏中性至微贬，表示无声的顺从与妥协。书面语与政治、法律高频。
【历史典故/词源】源自拉丁语 acquiescere（平静下来，休息，保持安静），由 ad-（向）+ quiescere（安息，保持安静，同 quiet/quiescent）构成。字面意为“保持安静不再争吵，因而默许”。
【专业领域特殊含义】在合同法与国际法中，acquiescence 指“因未及时提出异议而构成的法律上的默许/推定同意”；在政治学中指民众对权威的沉默服从。
【助记方法】ac（向）+ quiesc（安静，同 quiet）+ e → 保持安静不再反驳 → 默许，默认。

phrases.zh: 默许决定

examples.en: A charlatan murders without a knife.
examples.zh: 庸医杀人不用刀。

examples.en: A fraudster a charlatan and a thief.
examples.zh: 一个骗子，一个吹牛者，还是一个贼。

examples.en: The charlatan boasted that he could charm off any disease.
examples.zh: 这个江湖骗子吹牛说他能用符咒治好各种疾病。

examples.en: He had always been a hybrid: renegade and rabbi, charlatan and saint.
examples.zh: 他一直是一个混合体：叛徒和拉比，江湖骗子和圣人。

examples.en: This appeal always frustrated his political opponents - although there are others who argue Sheridan has never been anything other than a charlatan.
examples.zh: 这种呼吁总是让他的政治对手感到沮丧——尽管也有人认为谢里登只不过是个江湖骗子。

examples.en: They needed two crushing electoral defeats to begin revising their view of Mr Blair as a weightless charlatan whom voters would quickly see through.
examples.zh: 他们需要两次惨重的选举失败才能开始修正他们对布莱尔先生的看法，认为他是一个失重的江湖骗子，选民很快就会看穿他。

examples.en: The normally loquacious Mr. O'Reilly has said little.
examples.zh: 平常话多的奥赖利先生几乎没说什么。

examples.en: Would you guess women are more loquacious?
examples.zh: 你会认为女人更健谈吗？

examples.en: "Loquacious," said Mary Hodges in a hollow voice.
examples.zh: “贫嘴，”玛丽霍奇空洞地说。

examples.en: Their mood was somber and Mr. Simpson, normally loquacious and chatty, had little to say.
examples.zh: 他们的心情很阴郁，辛普森先生平时很健谈，也没什么可说的。

examples.en: Messrs Amato, Morris and Shin worry that today's loquacious central banks play this role in the financial markets.
examples.zh: 阿马托、莫里斯和申先生担心当今喋喋不休的央行在金融市场中扮演着这样的角色。

examples.en: The Lalondes tap real-life evangelists for cameos in their flicks, knowing the loquacious folks will talk them up.
examples.zh: 拉隆德夫妇在电影中邀请现实生活中的布道者客串，因为他们知道那些健谈的人会为他们辩护。
