examples.en: And "bellig" means drunk and belligerent.
examples.zh: “bellig”意思是“喝醉的”、“好战的”。

examples.en: Begin with the most pressing problem, the belligerent Mr Kim.
examples.zh: 目前最棘手的问题就是好战分子金先生。

examples.en: Russia, in turn, has been less belligerent towards the West.
examples.zh: 相应地，俄罗斯对西方的敌视也减少了。

examples.en: Roberts was, if anything, even more belligerent in questioning the lawyer defending the city.
examples.zh: 如果说有什么不同的话，那就是罗伯茨在询问为该市辩护的律师时更加好战。

examples.en: Even the teachers, though calling as usual for huge pay rises, are being less belligerent.
examples.zh: 就连老师们，虽然像往常一样呼吁大幅加薪，但也不再那么好斗了。

examples.en: But he says the media has skewed the debate by focusing on belligerent protesters.
examples.zh: 但他表示，媒体将焦点集中在好战的抗议者身上，从而扭曲了辩论。

examples.en: I'll need a five-hundred-dollar retainer.
examples.zh: 我将需要一笔500美元的预付聘金。

examples.en: The agency will pay you a monthly retainer.
examples.zh: 这个机构将会每月付给你聘用金。

examples.en: Middle-class families contract with a puller to take a child to school and pick him up; the puller essentially becomes a family retainer.
examples.zh: 中产阶级家庭与车夫签订合同，让他送孩子去学校以及接孩子放学。车夫实际上变成了一位家仆。

examples.en: Unless you buy an awful lot of art, keeping an adviser on retainer can get needlessly expensive.
examples.zh: 除非你购买大量艺术品，否则聘请顾问可能会变得不必要的昂贵。

examples.en: If unbundling fees means firms having to pay a fat retainer for advisory work, so be it.
examples.zh: 如果分拆费用意味着公司必须为咨询工作支付高额聘用费，那就这样吧。

examples.en: For a monthly retainer fee, a patient can have access to their family physician at any time.
examples.zh: 只需每月支付固定费，患者就可以随时联系其家庭医生。

examples.en: And due to the network's piddling size, it was, in truth, probably unnecessary.
examples.zh: 而且考虑到当时网络的轻量级规模，或许事实上也是不必要的。

examples.en: In a huge bull market they wind up with piddling profits only to watch their former holdings soar.
examples.zh: 在巨大的上涨行情中他们以小的利益抛售目前持有的飞涨的股票。

examples.en: In a huge bull market they wind up with piddling profits, only to watch their former holdings soar.
examples.zh: 在巨大的上涨行情中，他们以小的利益抛售目前持有的飞涨的股票。

examples.en: "It is our piddling critics and judges which may be the problem, " she said.
examples.zh: “问题可能出在我们那些微不足道的批评家和法官身上，”她说。

examples.en: While the 12-month rate in January was a piddling 5.93%, the greenback zoomed against Asian currencies.
examples.zh: 尽管 1 月份 12 个月期利率只有微不足道的 5.93%，但美元兑亚洲货币却大幅上涨。

examples.en: But the MMA garnered only a piddling 2% of the vote in the 2008 election.
examples.zh: 但 MMA 在 2008 年选举中只获得了微不足道的 2% 的选票。

examples.en: She spent her free time shopping.
examples.zh: 她将空闲时间花在购物上。

examples.en: Detectives have spent months gathering evidence.
examples.zh: 侦探花了数月时间搜集证据。

examples.en: He spent more on feeding the dog than he spent on feeding himself.
examples.zh: 他养狗花的钱比养自己花的钱还多。

examples.en: Taride spent his teenage years hanging around the beach and dreaming of being a musician.
examples.zh: 塔里德青少年时期在海滩闲逛，梦想成为一名音乐家。

examples.en: The two platforms spent recent years copying each other's moves, and they're fairly indistinguishable now.
examples.zh: 这两个平台近年来一直在互相模仿，现在已经很难区分了。

examples.en: Andres spent last summer at the Mexican ambassador's residence in Beijing researching the new menu.
examples.zh: 安德烈斯去年夏天在墨西哥驻北京大使官邸研究新菜单。

examples.en: With boisterous mirth they dropped upon their knees in a body and did mock homage to their prey.
examples.zh: 大家在一阵喧闹的欢笑声中一起跪下，假装对他们作弄的对象表示尊敬。

examples.en: The kings of France paid homage to no one.
examples.zh: 法国国王不对任何人效忠。

examples.en: They stood in silent homage around the grave.
examples.zh: 他们恭敬地站在坟墓周围致默哀礼。

examples.en: The trails are named the Elephant Walks in homage to the wild elephants that once lived here.
examples.zh: 这些小径被命名为“大象步道”，以向曾经生活在这里的野象致敬。

examples.en: Yet every year, the small Australian country town still pays fervent homage to his music and enduring style.
examples.zh: 然而，每年，这个澳大利亚乡村小镇仍然对他的音乐和持久的风格表示热烈的敬意。

examples.en: But he does not pay homage to the modern world's notion of the superstar.
examples.zh: 但他并没有向现代世界的超级巨星概念致敬。

examples.zh: 改动作曲家原有的符号是亵渎行为。

examples.en: Stealing from a place of worship was regarded as sacrilege.
examples.zh: 在礼拜的场所盗窃被认为是渎神行为。

examples.en: Putting water in brandy is (a great) sacrilege.
examples.zh: 在白兰地中掺水是(极)可恶的事。

examples.en: "I thought it was sacrilege, " says Jackson, who describes himself as a devout Catholic.

examples.zh: 跳过当代美国文化中被视为圣诞节的节日并不是一种亵渎。

examples.en: While such shrines are highly revered by Shiites, a number of Sunni radicals believe they amount to sacrilege.
examples.zh: 虽然这些圣地受到什叶派的高度崇敬，但一些逊尼派激进分子认为它们构成了亵渎。

examples.en: Critics and musicians still nitpick over muddy textures in his symphonies and awkward solo writing in his concertos.

examples.en: Petty crime is having a deleterious effect on community life.
examples.zh: 轻罪对于社区生活正在产生有害影响。

examples.en: However, most mutations are deleterious.
examples.zh: 然而，大多数突变是有害的。

examples.en: It is also common knowledge that milk containing deleterious organisms is an unsuitable article of food.
examples.zh: 乳品中含有有害微生物不适合食用是基本常识。

examples.en: Louboutin, however, is not sympathetic to complaints about the deleterious effects of high heels on locomotion.
examples.zh: 然而，鲁布托并不同情有关高跟鞋对运动产生有害影响的抱怨。

examples.en: And what it turns up can have remarkably deleterious impact on hardworking people and businesses.
examples.zh: 结果可能会对勤奋的人们和企业产生非常有害的影响。

examples.en: Days lost in the classroom can be deleterious to learning if the situation persists for long.
examples.zh: 如果这种情况长期持续，在课堂上浪费时间可能会对学习有害。

examples.en: Dakota Gasification of North Dakota captures CO2 at a plant that converts coal into synthetic natural gas.
examples.zh: 北达科他州的达科他气化在一个将煤转化为合成天然气的工厂捕捉二氧化碳。

examples.en: The Weyburn-Midale CO2 project is burying carbondioxide from a coal gasification plant in a depleted oil field.
examples.zh: 维本市—米代尔 CO2 项目正将煤气化厂排放的二氧化碳埋入一个废弃的油田。

examples.en: China has made fertilizers through gasification for decades.
examples.zh: 中国利用气化煤生产化肥已有几十年的历史。

examples.en: Shell aims to combine coal gasification with gas-to-diesel technology in an alliance with coal miner Anglo American.
examples.zh: 壳牌旨在与煤矿企业英美资源集团结盟，将煤炭气化与天然气制柴油技术结合起来。

examples.en: The oil goes into a de-gasification plant, and then four-fifths of it is stored for export.
examples.zh: 石油进入脱气厂，然后五分之四被储存起来以供出口。

examples.en: Coal Gasification is a well-known, tried and true technology, dating back to the mid-1800s.
examples.zh: 煤气化是一项众所周知、经过考验的真实技术，其历史可以追溯到 1800 年代中期。

examples.en: Food will last longer if kept in an airtight container.
examples.zh: 如果贮藏在密封的容器里，食物能保持比较久的时间。

examples.en: Store the peppercorns in an airtight container and grind the pepper as you need it.
examples.zh: 将胡椒子储藏在密封容器里，当你需要的时候把它磨成粉。

examples.en: The casing is nearly airtight, which helps protect the vulnerable egg and later larva.
examples.zh: 外层几乎是密封的，可以保护脆弱的蜂卵，以及后来的幼虫。

examples.en: Under the hood, an airtight enclosure features proprietary neodymium drivers and two opposing passive bass radiators.
examples.zh: 在引擎盖下，密封外壳配有专有的钕驱动器和两个相对的无源低音辐射器。

examples.en: Stored at room temperature in an airtight plastic bag, the cake will keep for several days.
examples.zh: 在室温下将蛋糕存放在密封塑料袋中，可以保存几天。

examples.en: Even a stiff, airtight enclosure and moving-wall radiator won't help it override the laws of physics.
examples.zh: 即使是坚硬、气密的外壳和移动壁散热器也无法帮助它超越物理定律。

examples.en: We are cognizant of the problem.
examples.zh: 我们认识到这个问题的存在。

examples.en: In a grid environment, we have to be cognizant of the fact that people around the world may eventually tap into these applications.
examples.zh: 在网格环境里，我们不得不认识到一个事实，即在世界各地的人们最终都会接触这些应用程序。

examples.en: At the same time, I'm cognizant of the need for people to be insured.
examples.zh: 同时，我认识到人们的需求并不确定。

examples.en: Please be cognizant of the fact that not everyone gets to speak at every event.
examples.zh: 请注意，并非每个人都可以在每次活动中发言。

examples.en: Cognizant of past fiascoes, the GAO strongly makes the argument to discontinue the paper dollar.
examples.zh: 认识到过去的惨败，美国政府问责局强烈主张停止使用纸币。

examples.en: Cognizant has found itself in the sweet spot in the big world of global outsourcing.
examples.zh: Cognizant 发现自己在全球外包的大世界中处于最佳位置。

examples.en: As the boss began to rant, I stood up and went out.
examples.zh: 老板开始咆哮时，我站起来走了出去。

examples.en: Sorry about the negative rant.
examples.zh: 对负面的咆哮方式说抱歉。

examples.en: It's a classic Brian s Hall rant.
examples.zh: 完全是典型的布莱恩·霍尔式演说。

examples.en: In some of the most shocking conversations, Shafia launched into a rant about his daughters' behavior.
examples.zh: 在一些最令人震惊的谈话中，沙菲亚对女儿们的行为发起了咆哮。

examples.en: The lyrics are funny and good-spirited, and effectively turn the tables on the original rant.
examples.zh: 歌词既有趣又乐观，有效地扭转了原来的咆哮。

examples.en: Don't use the session to lay blame or rant about coworkers, bosses or the workplace.
examples.zh: 不要利用这次会议来指责或抱怨同事、老板或工作场所。

examples.en: There may well have been a piquant novelty about her books when they came out.
examples.zh: 她的书刚上市很可能轰动一时。

examples.en: The piquant twist is that Cohen had no idea who was writing about her.
examples.zh: 很糟糕的是，科恩不知道谩骂她的人是谁。

examples.en: But in every semifinal there is deep and piquant regret for a man who did not deserve to lose.
examples.zh: 但是在每一场半决赛中，都会给本不该失败的人留下深深的遗憾。

examples.en: Also included are odd, piquant works from the Smithsonian Institution, by Eyre de Lanux.
examples.zh: 还包括来自史密森尼学会的艾尔·德·拉努克斯 (Eyre de Lanux) 的奇怪而辛辣的作品。

examples.en: Savory sorbets have a refreshing, cool texture and a piquant zing that make your taste buds dance.
examples.zh: 美味的冰糕具有清爽、凉爽的口感和辛辣的味道，让您的味蕾翩翩起舞。

examples.en: But the lessons for companies and their shareholders will be equally piquant if and when the Dow hits 13, 000 or higher.
examples.zh: 但如果道琼斯指数触及 13, 000 点或更高，公司及其股东的教训将同样严峻。

examples.en: Even I boggle at the idea of spending so much money.
examples.zh: 一想到要花这么多钱，连我都有点犹豫。

examples.en: Never boggle at a difficulty.
examples.zh: 切莫见难而止。

examples.en: We shouldn't boggle at this opportunity to make a profit.
examples.zh: 对这个赚钱的机会我们不应犹豫。

examples.en: In other words, she was a friend, we used to play Boggle together.
examples.zh: 换句话说，她是一个朋友，我们曾经一起玩过Boggle。

examples.en: We may discover resources on the moon or Mars that will boggle the imagination, that will test our limits to dream.
examples.zh: 我们可能会在月球或火星上发现令人难以置信的资源，这将考验我们梦想的极限。

examples.en: If the number alone doesn't boggle your mind, consider this: The price is nearly double the previous auction record for a work of art.
examples.zh: 如果这个数字还不足以让您难以置信，请考虑一下：这个价格几乎是之前艺术品拍卖纪录的两倍。

examples.zh: 好吧，那你就是个懒懒散散的隐士了。

examples.zh: 宝格丽在名人游戏中也毫不逊色，经常在特定场合借出一件作品。

examples.en: Some products, such as asparagus, corn, and strawberries, respire at a higher rate than other products, such as apples, oranges, and potatoes.
examples.zh: 一些产品，如芦笋、玉米和草莓，比其他产品，如苹果、橘子和土豆的呼吸速率要高。

examples.en: All living things respire as long as they live.
examples.zh: 一切生物只要活着都要呼吸。

examples.en: It is also produced when living organisms respire.
examples.zh: 二氧化碳也可经由活体生物的呼吸作用而产生。

examples.en: Higher acidity also disrupts marine organisms' ability to grow, reproduce and respire.
examples.zh: 较高的酸度还会破坏海洋生物的生长、繁殖和呼吸能力。

examples.en: The 32-story hotel has nearly 1, 200 all new and cutting edge guest rooms, all part of the new Respire by Hyatt hypo-allergenic program, featuring a six-stage process to remove irritants, including state-of-the-art air filtration.
examples.zh: 这家 32 层的酒店拥有近 1, 200 间全新的尖端客房，所有这些都是凯悦全新 Respire 低过敏计划的一部分，该计划采用六阶段去除刺激物的流程，包括最先进的空气过滤。

examples.zh: 银行在交易时应更加谨慎。

examples.zh: 丹尼和李对他们的写作方法保持谨慎。

examples.en: Other analysts are more circumspect.
examples.zh: 其他分析师更加谨慎。

examples.en: On the subject of future Chinese sports stars to take his place, he remains typically circumspect.
examples.zh: 对于未来中国体育明星将取代他的位置，他仍然保持一贯的谨慎态度。

examples.en: The banks are far more circumspect now and getting a mortgage is not easy.
examples.zh: 现在银行更加谨慎，获得抵押贷款并不容易。

examples.en: U.S. officials were circumspect Tuesday about the actions they're seeking to take against Pyongyang.
examples.zh: 美国官员周二对于他们寻求针对平壤采取的行动持谨慎态度。

examples.en: They want to work in an organization whose values are congruent with their own.
examples.zh: 他们想在一家与他们自己的价值观相同的组织里工作。

examples.en: If you want to succeed, you must be congruent.
examples.zh: 假如你想要成功，那你一定要始终如一。

examples.en: Congruent with statements of other Andromedan contactees.
examples.zh: 与其他仙女星人接触者的报告相一致。

examples.en: It is often assumed that periods of sharp commodity price increase are congruent with periods of overall price inflation.
examples.zh: 人们通常认为商品价格急剧上涨的时期与总体价格通胀的时期是一致的。

examples.en: Anecdotally, in these cases most entrepreneurs choose their values and believe in their ability to cultivate other more congruent business opportunities.
examples.zh: 有趣的是，在这些情况下，大多数企业家选择自己的价值观，并相信自己有能力培育其他更一致的商业机会。

examples.en: The interface eschews the conventional virtualization of a turntable set-up, instead creating a workflow more congruent with the hardware's form factor.
examples.zh: 该界面避开了转盘设置的传统虚拟化，而是创建了与硬件外形更加一致的工作流程。

examples.zh: 他们嘲笑我微不足道的努力。

examples.en: As for recycling, the 9,500 tonnes of electronics, Apple says it has recycled since 1994, is puny given the amount of equipment the firm sells.
examples.zh: 至于废物回收再利用问题，苹果公司自称从1994年以来已回收了9500吨电子元件，但相比其产品总销量微不足道。

examples.en: The lamb was a puny little thing.
examples.zh: 羊羔瘦小孱弱。

examples.en: How can such a puny manufacturing base ever aspire to close such a gaping deficit?
examples.zh: 如此微不足道的制造业基地怎能渴望弥补如此巨大的赤字呢？

examples.en: Now, on its very anniversary (oh cruel irony), the portfolio--all tech stocks--is up a puny 41%.
examples.zh: 现在，在其周年纪念日（哦，残酷的讽刺），该投资组合（全部是科技股）仅上涨了 41%。

examples.en: As it stands, puny ISPs pay for services without a clue about how the terms compare.
examples.zh: 就目前情况而言，微不足道的互联网服务提供商在支付服务费用时并不知道这些条款如何比较。

examples.en: The standards have been raised. The clarion has sounded.
examples.zh: 标准提高了，号角响起了。

examples.en: But I had a clarion moment of truth during the process of that book.
examples.zh: 但是在我写那本书时我有个时刻吹响了真理的号角。

examples.en: This article is my clarion call to everyone to change the world in their own way.
examples.zh: 这篇文章我清晰得倡导每个人用自己的方式改变世界。

examples.en: The Clarion-Ledger of Jackson, Mississippi, posted photographs of a man it identified as Curtis.
examples.zh: 密西西比州杰克逊市的《Clarion-Ledger》刊登了一名被确认为柯蒂斯的男子的照片。

examples.en: After all, what could be more popular than a clarion call for tax fairness and simplicity?
examples.zh: 毕竟，还有什么比呼吁税收公平和简单更受欢迎的呢？

examples.en: The hearing sounded a clarion call for politicians to resist the desire to constantly overregulate.
examples.zh: 听证会吹响了政客们抵制不断过度监管的欲望的号角。

examples.zh: 已经有些人在问科学家是否有权利去干涉此类事情。

examples.en: Canty roared out, "Thou'lt meddle, wilt thou?"
examples.zh: 康第吼道：“你要管闲事，是不是？”

examples.en: He is suspicious of attempts to meddle in the internal business of others.
examples.zh: 他对企图干涉他人内部事务的行为表示怀疑。

examples.en: But we all know that most politicians hate currency boards because it limits their ability to meddle.
examples.zh: 但我们都知道，大多数政客讨厌货币发行局，因为这限制了他们干预的能力。

examples.en: Some people might say, well, what business was it of Frank Ross to meddle?

examples.en: Some worry that Mr Mack, now chairman, will meddle, creating tension at the top.
examples.zh: 一些人担心现任董事长麦克先生会插手干预，从而在高层制造紧张气氛。

examples.en: The doctrine "Confucius never talked about odd, puissance, turmoil and deity" reflects an important part of Confucianism.
examples.zh: “子不语怪、力、乱、神”反映了孔子思想体系的重要内容。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of puissance.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“权力；权势；影响；（马的）越障能力测试”的概念提供了全新的视角。

examples.en: Recent academic studies have highlighted the significance of puissance in modern research.
examples.zh: 最近的学术研究强调了“权力；权势；影响；（马的）越障能力测试”在现代科学研究中的重要意义。

examples.en: Her articulate argument demonstrated a deep understanding of puissance.
examples.zh: 她清晰有力的论证展现了对“权力；权势；影响；（马的）越障能力测试”的深刻理解。

examples.zh: 要知道时刻地讨好谁也做不到。

examples.en: He gave us the travel brochure which is full of the blandishment.
examples.zh: 他给了我们尽是吹捧之词的旅行宣传手册。

examples.en: They would not in the end abandon their vital interests by succumbing to Soviet blandishment.
examples.zh: 他们最终决不会受苏联人的甜言蜜语的诱惑，从而抛弃自己的切身利益。

examples.en: She uses no blandishment other than large scale to emphasize the potent fact that all of us, knowingly or not, are continuously moving through time.
examples.zh: 除了大规模之外，她没有使用任何花言巧语来强调一个强有力的事实：我们所有人，无论是否有意，都在不断地穿越时间。

examples.en: "To people who are really only distantly connected, I'm not sure the blandishment of Facebook wall posting would necessarily be all that influential, " Green said.
examples.zh: “对于那些真正只有远距离联系的人来说，我不确定 Facebook 墙上帖子的甜言蜜语是否一定有那么大的影响力，”格林说。

examples.en: Soon enough, Reisman found herself in a world of blandishment and betrayal, of half-truths and machination worthy of Hollywood, as venture capitalists jockeyed for the chance to crown a winner in the latest Internet game (see box, p. 139).
examples.zh: 很快，赖斯曼发现自己陷入了一个充满甜言蜜语和背叛、半真半假和好莱坞般的阴谋的世界，风险投资家们在最新的互联网游戏中争夺获胜者的机会（见专栏，第 139 页）。

examples.en: Heavy snowstorms severely impeded the rescue team's efforts to reach the stranded hikers.
examples.zh: 强降雪严重阻碍了救援队接近受困登山者的努力。

examples.en: Excessive bureaucratic red tape continues to impede economic growth in the region.
examples.zh: 过度的官僚习气继续阻碍着该地区的经济增长。

examples.en: Tight clothing can impede blood circulation during long-haul flights.
examples.zh: 紧身衣服可能会在长途飞行中阻碍血液循环。

examples.en: A lack of funding should not be allowed to impede scientific research.
examples.zh: 绝不能允许资金缺乏阻碍科学研究的发展。

examples.en: The fallen trees on the road impeded traffic for several hours this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上公路上倒下的树木使得交通受阻数小时。

synonyms.note: 解析：阻碍，妨碍。区别：Hinder 侧重于造成拖延或使某事难以进行；impede 强调通过设置障碍来减慢进度或阻止运动，语气体稍正式。

etymology.rootMeaning: v. 妨碍, 阻碍, 阻止
etymology.explanation: 现有词源记录可追溯到 1600 年；词形经拉丁语 impedire 进入或影响英语。
etymology.memory: 先记核心义“妨碍”，再用常用搭配和例句巩固词形，避免编造不存在的词根。

confusables.note: 拼写相近；意为“内爆, 向内破裂, 爆裂；内裂”

words.analysis: 【细微含义】指通过制造障碍、拖延或困难来减慢、妨碍行动、进程或发展（比 block 稍轻，比 hinder 更正式）。【使用场景】政经分析、学术写作、科技文献、法律公文。感情色彩中性偏负面。【词源/助记】源自拉丁语 impedire（im- 进入 + pes/ped- 脚 → 缠住脚 → 绊倒、阻碍）。【联想比较】hinder（妨碍）、obstruct（阻挡）、hamper（束缚）。

examples.en: Surgery to a balky ankle was required.
examples.zh: 脚踝受伤了，必须接受手术。

examples.en: After the balky start, however, the WHO's pandemic response system is running well.
examples.zh: 自从执拗的开始运作后，然而，目前世界卫生组织的流行病反应系统运行良好。

examples.en: The camera has an LED flash, which helps at close range at night, but the camera itself is balky and slow to focus and fire.
examples.zh: 照相机有一个 LED 闪光灯，在夜晚照近距离相片时很有用，但是，照相机本身迟缓，对焦和拍照都比较慢。

examples.en: Trips down the hall with Robot Rachel were akin to walking a city block with a balky toddler.
examples.zh: 带着机器人雷切尔在大厅里行走就像带着一个顽固的小孩在街区里行走一样。

examples.en: Balky Web browsing and even iTunes connections have highlighted the limitations of Edge.
examples.zh: 不稳定的网络浏览甚至 iTunes 连接都凸显了 Edge 的局限性。

examples.en: And Grunwald suggested the team might put Stoudemire on a playing-time limitation to preserve his balky knees, which required surgeries in October and March.
examples.zh: 格伦沃尔德建议球队可能会限制斯塔德迈尔的上场时间，以保护他顽固的膝盖，这需要在十月和三月进行手术。

examples.en: The difference, according to Harold Finkelstein, an irascible wholesaler from Long Island City, N.
examples.zh: 来自北卡罗来纳州长岛市的脾气暴躁的批发商哈罗德·芬克尔斯坦 (Harold Finkelstein) 表示，这种差异是存在的。

examples.en: This conciliatory tone was in striking contrast to Mr Arzalluz's sometimes irascible and always fiery language.
examples.zh: 这种和解的语气与阿尔扎鲁斯先生时而暴躁、总是火热的语言形成鲜明对比。

examples.zh: 去年夏天，当我问米切尔史蒂文斯脾气暴躁的形象是否准确时，他笑了。

examples.zh: 迷信是人们思想的一大桎梏。

examples.en: But debt can also limit one's freedom-it's a shackle, a contract.
examples.zh: 但是，债务也可以限制一个人的自由——它是一个枷锁，一份合同。

examples.en: He says Gerrard would be an essential signing, while urging the club to shackle Maicon.
examples.zh: 他说杰拉德是一庄重要的签约，而同时他要求俱乐部留住麦孔。

examples.zh: 选民是否会如此迅速地将自己束缚于德国的财政规则则是另一回事。

examples.en: But an unregulated environment attracts all those who do not want to play by the rules that shackle traditional money managers.
examples.zh: 但不受监管的环境吸引了所有那些不想遵守束缚传统基金经理的规则的人。

examples.en: In any of these cases your progeny might need to sell the company, and your name on it may shackle them in negotiations.
examples.zh: 在任何一种情况下，你的后代可能需要出售公司，而你的名字可能会在谈判中束缚他们。

examples.zh: 它几乎自古以来都维持不变。

examples.zh: 自古以来，男人就向女人求婚，并要求夫妇生活。

examples.en: It's been like that since time immemorial.
examples.zh: 自古以来就是这样。

examples.en: People have aggregated their capital, i.e. saved money, and started and expanded businesses since time immemorial.
examples.zh: 自古以来，人们就积累资本，即存钱，开办和扩大企业。

examples.en: Travel in the archipelago has been undertaken in small sailboats since time immemorial.
examples.zh: 自古以来，在群岛上旅行都是乘坐小帆船进行的。

examples.en: Memorials have been a part of the human experience since, well, time immemorial.
examples.zh: 自古以来，纪念馆一直是人类经历的一部分。

words.meaning: v. 潜伏，埋伏；潜行；(危险/怀疑等) 隐匿，暗中潜伏
words.analysis:
【细微含义】指出于坏意图或不愿被人注意而悄悄躲藏、暗中观察；在引申义中指某种危险、隐患或负面情绪暗中潜伏。
【使用场景】文学描写、新闻、网络社区口语。
【感情色彩】中性至贬义（带有神秘或威胁色彩）。
【IT/AI/互联网含义】在网络社区（论坛、Discord、Reddit等）中，“lurker / lurking”特指“只看帖不说话/潜水”的行为。
【助记方法】lurk 发音拟声似“拉客/暗处窥视”，联想在黑影中潜伏。

examples.en: Danger lurks in every corner of this dense forest.
examples.zh: 这座密林里的每个角落都潜伏着危险。

examples.en: A dark figure was lurking near the entrance of the alley.
examples.zh: 一个黑影正潜伏在巷子口附近。

examples.en: Doubts still lurk in the back of my mind.
examples.zh: 我内心深处依然潜伏着一丝疑虑。

examples.en: Many registered users simply lurk without ever posting a comment.
examples.zh: 许多注册用户只是默默潜水，从不发表评论。

examples.en: Hidden vulnerabilities may lurk within complex legacy codebases.
examples.zh: 复杂的遗留代码库中可能暗藏未知的隐患。

synonyms.note: 潜伏，偷偷摸摸地走。Lurk 侧重于隐藏在暗处伺机行动；Skulk 强调出于怯懦、恶意或逃避责任而鬼鬼祟祟地躲藏。

confusables.note:
拼写相近；意为“云雀，百灵鸟，欢乐，嬉耍
vi. 嬉耍，骑马玩乐
vt. 愚弄”

examples.zh: 事实上，许多人假装热爱生命，进而逃避爱之本身。

examples.en: The Commission cannot feign ignorance when inundated with information of malfeasance from industry insiders.
examples.zh: 当收到大量来自业内人士的不当行为信息时，委员会不能假装不知情。

examples.en: Many of the women have given birth before and use that experience to feign another pregnancy.
examples.zh: 许多女性以前生过孩子，并利用这些经历假装再次怀孕。

examples.en: Typically the predator will fall back to feign its own vulnerability and then, at the opportune moment, pounce.
examples.zh: 通常，捕食者会后退，假装自己很脆弱，然后在适当的时候发起猛扑。

examples.en: And Nietzsche were Kings of the aphorism.
examples.zh: 和尼采这样的哲学家们是警句之王。

examples.en: What’s the science behind this old aphorism?
examples.zh: 这句古老的格言背后有什么样的科学依据呢？

examples.en: Mr Sarkozy offers at least a chance of proving this aphorism wrong.
examples.zh: 萨尔科奇的出现，至少给了法国一个机会，去证明此言不可信。

examples.en: For them the Great Recession is not a cute aphorism but a major cataclysm.
examples.zh: 对他们来说，大衰退不是一句可爱的格言，而是一场重大灾难。

examples.en: The old aphorism about six degrees of separation may not apply any more, Facebook research Lars Backstrom reported.
examples.zh: Facebook 研究人员 Lars Backstrom 报道称，关于六度分离的古老格言可能不再适用。

examples.en: They tend to emphasise the first bit of Mr Milliband's aphorism: that there can be no military solution.
examples.zh: 他们倾向于强调米利班德先生格言的第一点：不可能有军事解决方案。

examples.en: She also writes under the pseudonym of Barbara Vine.
examples.zh: 她也用芭芭拉•瓦因的化名从事写作。

examples.en: She writes under a pseudonym.
examples.zh: 她用笔名写作。

examples.en: Both plays were published under the pseudonym of Philip Dayre.
examples.zh: 两个剧本都是以菲利普·戴尔的笔名发表的。

examples.en: Josephine Tey was the pseudonym of Elizabeth Mackintosh, the daughter of a fruiterer from Inverness.
examples.zh: 约瑟芬·泰伊是伊丽莎白·麦金托什的化名，她是因弗内斯一位水果种植者的女儿。

examples.en: William Reed (a pseudonym) was one of the patients on my service that month.
examples.zh: 威廉·里德（化名）是我当月服务的患者之一。

examples.en: The emails came from someone identified as "Peter Williams, " though that may be a pseudonym.
examples.zh: 这些电子邮件来自一个名为“Peter Williams”的人，尽管这可能是化名。

phrases.zh: 观点（或立场等）摇摆，动摇的关键方面
展现出观点（或立场等）摇摆，动摇

examples.en: Like Mr Obama, he will vacillate.
examples.zh: 奥巴马一样会动摇。

examples.en: You are bound to vacillate at times.
examples.zh: 有时你肯定还是会犹豫不决。

examples.en: He or she cannot vacillate over every tiny decision.
examples.zh: 他或她在每个小的决定上不能有半点犹豫。

examples.en: For the next uneasy twelve months, Hillary, now twenty-six, would vacillate about whether to marry Bill.
examples.zh: 在接下来不安的十二个月里，现年二十六岁的希拉里在是否嫁给比尔的问题上犹豫不决。

examples.en: America's lack of fast-track has given too many countries the excuse to vacillate.
examples.zh: 美国缺乏快速通道给了太多国家犹豫不决的借口。

examples.en: An examination of poll data shows that depending on how the question is asked, the American people vacillate between support for and opposition to the health care law.
examples.zh: 对民意调查数据的审查显示，根据提出问题的方式，美国人民在支持和反对医疗保健法之间摇摆不定。

examples.en: The experts say most of us collude with those who lie to us.
examples.zh: 专家说，大多数人和向我们撒谎的人合谋。

examples.en: They can easily collude to ensure that they pay less than the fair market price.
examples.zh: 他们很容易就串通起来压低公平市场价格。

examples.en: Or you can collude with your putative competitors: that's why cartels like OPEC exist.
examples.zh: 或者与你认定的竞争者强强联合，OPEC企业联盟就是一个例子。

examples.en: In what other industry can the biggest suppliers collude and fix prices with impunity?
examples.zh: 在其他哪个行业，最大的供应商可以串通并操纵价格而不受惩罚？

examples.en: In other words, money managers and brokers may collude to the detriment of retail investors.
examples.zh: 换句话说，基金经理和经纪人可能串通，损害散户投资者的利益。

examples.en: It's illegal for companies to carve up a market, collude on bids or fix pricing.
examples.zh: 公司瓜分市场、串通投标或操纵定价的行为都是违法的。

examples.en: The blood had started to congeal.
examples.zh: 血液已经开始凝结。

examples.en: The increasing population density will even further congeal traffic.
examples.zh: 日益增加的人口密度将使交通更加瘫痪。

examples.en: When the cheese started to cool and congeal, which took a good 30 minutes, all I did was stick it back on the stove, stirring until runny.
examples.zh: 奶酪开始冷却、凝结，用了整整30分钟，在这期间，我所做的就是把它再放回炉子上，搅拌直至奶酪开始流淌。

examples.en: It hasn't helped that defenses have struggled to congeal early in the season.
examples.zh: 赛季初防守一直难以凝结，这也无济于事。

examples.en: Which Dad prognosticated would soon triumphantly congeal into linebackerish solidity.
examples.zh: 父亲预言很快就会胜利地凝结成后卫般的坚固。

examples.en: The real action is brewing in the Gulf of Mexico, where a tropical wave has been getting itself together over the last day and is likely to congeal into Tropical Storm Lee.
examples.zh: 真正的行动正在墨西哥湾酝酿，过去一天热带波浪正在聚集，很可能凝结成热带风暴李。

examples.en: Ryan took it as a snub.
examples.zh: 瑞安视其为对他的怠慢。

examples.en: Her refusal to attend the dinner is being seen as a deliberate snub to the President.
examples.zh: 在人们看来，她拒不出席宴会是有意让总统难堪。

examples.en: Scientists made an unexpected discovery in the waters south of New Guinea in 2005: a new species of dolphin called the snub-fin.
examples.zh: 2005年，科学家们在新几内亚的南部水域得到了一个意想不到的发现：一种叫做矮鳍的海豚新物种。

examples.en: I'm taking a morose tone at this point with Garrison Keillor giving me the snub.
examples.zh: 加里森·凯勒对我的冷落此时我的语气变得郁郁寡欢。

examples.en: But the lack of an Oscar nomination was widely seen as a major snub.
examples.zh: 但缺乏奥斯卡提名被广泛认为是一次重大冷落。

examples.en: Equally notable was the failure of Mr Mugabe, their commander-in-chief, to comment on their snub.
examples.zh: 同样值得注意的是，他们的总司令穆加贝未能对他们的冷落发表评论。

examples.en: Listen to the way people malign chocolate: Sinful!
examples.zh: 聆听一下人民对巧克力的污蔑：“罪孽深重！”

examples.en: The malign coincidence of crash and election reinforces the difficulties.
examples.zh: 危机和大选破坏性的巧合使现状更加难堪。

examples.en: But Iran's "malign involvement" in arming and directing Shia militias was also a problem.
examples.zh: 而伊朗“罪恶的介入”，武装和指挥什叶民兵，也同样是个动荡因素。

examples.en: Not one of the malign effects of illegal immigration mentioned is inherent to immigration itself.
examples.zh: 所提到的非法移民的所有有害影响都不是移民本身所固有的。

examples.en: "It's never been an intention of mine to malign his name or character, " she said.
examples.zh: “我从来没有意图诽谤他的名字或性格，”她说。

examples.en: So why would countries seek out foreign money at all, if its impact is so malign?
examples.zh: 那么，如果外国资金的影响如此恶劣，为什么各国还要寻求外国资金呢？

examples.en: He began with extraordinary ardor to plan a crime theoretically.
examples.zh: 他开始以异乎寻常的热情在理论上计划这一罪行。

examples.en: That ardor cooled as Middle East peace talks stalled, and Mr. Obama stuck too long with Hosni Mubarak of Egypt.
examples.zh: 但随着中东和谈搁浅，此热情消褪消散。 另外，奥巴马在埃及的穆巴拉克问题上也纠缠过多。

examples.en: "Here's fresh meat for your axe, Kreis," he said; "a rose-white youth with the ardor of a lover for Herbert Spencer."
examples.zh: “克瑞斯，你那板斧有了新对象了，”他说，“一个纯洁得像白玫瑰的青年，对斯宾塞怀着恋人一样的热情。”

examples.en: Traders drooled with a utopian passion until one day last September when ardor suddenly cooled.
examples.zh: 交易员们怀着一种乌托邦式的热情垂涎三尺，直到去年九月的某一天，热情突然冷却下来。

examples.en: Nearly 65% say their romantic ardor in the office is undampened by the recession.
examples.zh: 近 65% 的人表示，经济衰退并没有削弱他们在办公室的浪漫热情。

examples.en: Nearly 70% say their romantic ardor in the office is undampened by the recession.
examples.zh: 近 70% 的人表示，经济衰退并没有削弱他们在办公室的浪漫热情。

examples.en: With adequate safeguards, i. e., reputation, cronyism may BE avoided.
examples.zh: 因为适当的防护，如声誉、任用亲信可能被避免。

examples.en: Mr Sarkozy's network of business chums invites suspicions of cronyism.
examples.zh: 萨科奇的商业好友圈子有任用亲信的嫌疑。

examples.en: Although "Cangfa" achieved some results to some extent, corruption had not been deterred, because many officials were motivated to take bribes and cronyism by huge personal benefits.
examples.zh: “仓法”施行后虽然取得了些许效果，但是吏人为追求利益贪赃枉法、朋比为奸的现象仍然大量存在。

examples.en: Another student wondered what role, if any, cronyism plays in the decision making of venture capitalists.
examples.zh: 另一位学生想知道任人唯亲在风险投资家的决策中扮演什么角色（如果有的话）。

examples.en: Through cronyism, investors secured funding for many projects that never should have left the drawing board.
examples.zh: 通过任人唯亲，投资者为许多本不应该离开绘图板的项目获得了资金。

examples.en: And by putting resources to less-efficient use, cronyism actually kills jobs rather than creating them.
examples.zh: 通过将资源投入低效使用，任人唯亲实际上会杀死而不是创造就业机会。

examples.en: He felt giddy and light-headed.
examples.zh: 他感到头晕目眩。

examples.en: When I looked down from the top floor, I felt giddy.
examples.zh: 我从顶楼朝下看时感到头晕目眩。

examples.en: The giddy little Lady Jane fired a simple Greek phrase at Tom.
examples.zh: 轻浮的洁恩小公主对汤姆说了一句简单的希腊话。

examples.en: In some ways Google feels like the giddy dot-coms of the stock-market bubble, circa 1999.
examples.zh: 在某些方面，谷歌感觉就像 1999 年左右股市泡沫时期令人眼花缭乱的网络泡沫。

examples.en: But during the giddy precrash era, that track record gave little pause to Citi or others.
examples.zh: 但在令人眼花缭乱的危机前时期，这一记录并没有让花旗或其他公司停下来。

examples.en: Most visitors take in the giddy view and then turn back without ever setting foot on the glacier.
examples.zh: 大多数游客在欣赏完令人眼花缭乱的景色后就折返而没有踏上冰川。

examples.en: What's for lunch? I'm absolutely ravenous.
examples.zh: 午饭吃什么？我饿死了。

examples.en: Amy realized that she had eaten nothing since leaving home that morning, and she was ravenous.
examples.zh: 埃米意识到，她自己从早晨离开家门后什么东西都没有吃，她饿极了。

examples.en: They came back to camp wonderfully refreshed, glad-hearted, and ravenous; and they soon had the camp-fire blazing up again.
examples.zh: 他们回到营地时神清气爽，兴致勃勃，却也饥肠辘辘；不久，他们又把篝火点着了。

examples.en: Carnival's best protection against ravenous tax collectors is the ease with which it could decamp.
examples.zh: 嘉年华公司抵御贪婪的收税者的最佳保护措施是它可以轻松逃走。

examples.en: Indeed, Glencore's rise will be strongly felt in Asia, which has demonstrated ravenous demand for commodities.
examples.zh: 事实上，嘉能可的崛起将在亚洲产生强烈的影响，亚洲已经表现出对大宗商品的旺盛需求。

examples.en: Added to her own two boys, that meant eight ravenous teens raiding the fridge every day.
examples.zh: 再加上她自己的两个儿子，这意味着每天都有八个贪婪的青少年搜查冰箱。

examples.en: This article is rather hackneyed.
examples.zh: 这篇文章写得太呆板。

examples.en: Or maybe we will criticize it for being boring or hackneyed.
examples.zh: 我们或许会批评它，因为它乏味，或者因为它陈腐。

examples.en: I love you is the most hackneyed words but it can make people feel warm.
examples.zh: 我爱你是最老套的情话却能让人心里暖暖的。

examples.en: She not only gets away with these hackneyed themes, but uses them to her advantage.
examples.zh: 她不仅摆脱了这些陈词滥调的主题，而且还利用它们为自己谋利。

examples.en: In that hackneyed phrase, we need a third way between privatisation and centralised state provision.
examples.zh: 用这句老生常谈的话来说，我们需要在私有化和中央集权的国家供给之间找到第三条道路。

examples.en: Replace hackneyed expressions like "strong team player" and "possess organizational skills" with strong, active verbs that demonstrate results.
examples.zh: 用能展示结果的强有力的、主动的动词取代“强大的团队合作者”和“拥有组织能力”等陈词滥调的表达方式。

examples.zh: 他不再依赖酒精。

examples.en: Ooh, hand me that crutch, would you?
examples.zh: 哦，把拐杖递给我，好吗？

examples.en: The hat and crutch are also dancing.
examples.zh: 帽子拐杖也跳起舞来。

examples.en: Is Mousemail.com nothing more than a high-tech crutch, a state-of-the-art substitute for old-fashioned good parenting?
examples.zh: 难道Mousemail.com只不过是一个高科技拐杖，一个老式良好育儿方式的最先进的替代品？

examples.en: As a clear concession to her frailty, she's had the younger Sheryl Crow along as a crutch.
examples.zh: 作为对她身体虚弱的明显让步，她让年轻的谢丽尔·克劳作为拐杖。

examples.en: The PGA Tour has been searching for new stars to help wean itself off its Tiger Woods crutch.
examples.zh: 美巡赛一直在寻找新星来帮助自己摆脱泰格·伍兹的束缚。

examples.en: He is a master of that area even if he is a dilettante.
examples.zh: 虽然他只是个业余爱好者，但却是一流的高手。

examples.en: It is also a phenomenological layers which encourage dilettante contemplation.
examples.zh: 这也是一个鼓励业余爱好者深思的现象层。

examples.en: I'm too serious to be a dilettante and too much a dabbler to be a professional.
examples.zh: 作为一个业余艺术爱好者我过于严肃认真了，而为一个专业人员我又太业余了。

examples.en: Now this obscure writer's book has been transformed into a brilliant movie by Julian Schnabel, the artist and cinematic dilettante.
examples.zh: 现在，这本默默无闻的作家的书已被艺术家和电影爱好者朱利安·施纳贝尔改编成一部精彩的电影。

examples.en: ' I've worked very hard to get away from the impression that I'm some sort of dilettante riding on my inheritance.
examples.zh: ’我非常努力地摆脱这样的印象，即我是某种继承遗产的业余爱好者。

examples.en: He inherited more of his temperament from his grandfather, the driving, autocratic Emperor Meiji, than from his sickly, dilettante father, Emperor Taisho.
examples.zh: 他的性格更多地遗传自他的祖父、强势、专制的明治天皇，而不是他病弱、业余的父亲大正天皇。

examples.en: People eat when they're depressed.
examples.zh: 人们会在沮丧时吃东西。

examples.en: I suddenly felt unutterably depressed.
examples.zh: 我忽然感到无法言说的压抑。

examples.en: Depressed people may mix up their words.
examples.zh: 沮丧的人可能会语无伦次。

examples.en: Commodity prices, a barometer of excessive money creation, are depressed, except for OPEC-manipulated oil.
examples.zh: 作为货币过度创造的晴雨表的大宗商品价格均处于低迷状态，但受欧佩克操纵的石油除外。

examples.en: In a mostly depressed Tokyo market, Orix stock has climbed 43% over the past year.
examples.zh: 在极其低迷的东京市场中，欧力士股价在过去一年中上涨了 43%。

examples.en: But just days before earnings and at such a depressed level, does an investor buy?
examples.zh: 但就在财报发布前几天，在如此低迷的水平下，投资者会买入吗？

examples.en: The myth that labor rates and labor costs are equivalent is supported by business journalists, who frequently confound the two.
examples.zh: 劳动力价格和劳动力成本相等的说法得到了商业记者的支持，他们经常混淆这两者。

examples.en: Don't confound the means with the ends.
examples.zh: 不要混淆手段与目的。

examples.en: Let no fear or foe confound thee.
examples.zh: 莫让忧惧或仇敌，把你騒扰。

examples.en: Congress will find a way to avoid, evade, delay, or otherwise confound these spending limits.
examples.zh: 国会将找到一种方法来避免、规避、延迟或以其他方式混淆这些支出限制。

examples.en: Launching too many products that go in different directions could confound the user base.
examples.zh: 推出太多不同方向的产品可能会让用户群感到困惑。

examples.en: Puzzles will confound you at every turn as you learn new skills and explore new areas.
examples.zh: 当你学习新技能和探索新领域时，谜题会时不时地让你感到困惑。

examples.en: By studying photographs, true artists, he claimed, would be relieved of menial tasks and become free to devote themselves to the more important spiritual aspects of their work.
examples.zh: 他声称，通过研究照片，真正的艺术家能从技术含量较低的工作中解脱，自由地投身于他们工作中更重要的精神层面。

examples.en: For instance, say you have a menial job.
examples.zh: 比如，你的工作很卑微。

examples.en: In lucky Luxembourg hardly any graduates end up in menial jobs.
examples.zh: 在幸运的卢森堡，几乎没有大学毕业生从事体力劳动。

examples.en: The Industrial Age was largely about making those jobs as menial and unskilled as possible.
examples.zh: 工业时代很大程度上是为了让这些工作尽可能地卑微和无技能。

examples.en: As a kid, he did menial jobs around the newspaper office, like sweeping the floor.
examples.zh: 小时候，他在报社周围做一些卑微的工作，比如扫地。

examples.en: The 200-million-strong community was traditionally engaged in menial jobs which the other higher castes consider "unclean".
examples.zh: 这个 2 亿人口的社区传统上从事着其他高种姓认为“不干净”的卑微工作。

examples.en: He was a man of the most equable temper.
examples.zh: 他是个性情很温和的人。

examples.en: Relaxation lowers metabolic rate, as does adequate sleep and in general an equable and balanced personality.
examples.zh: 放松会降低代谢率，充足的睡眠也会降低代谢率，总的来说，人的性格也会变得平和沉稳。

examples.en: It is a very equable film.
examples.zh: 这是一部比较温和的电影。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of equable.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“平静的；变动小的”的概念提供了全新的视角。

examples.en: Recent academic studies have highlighted the significance of equable in modern research.
examples.zh: 最近的学术研究强调了“平静的；变动小的”在现代科学研究中的重要意义。

examples.en: Her articulate argument demonstrated a deep understanding of equable.
examples.zh: 她清晰有力的论证展现了对“平静的；变动小的”的深刻理解。

examples.zh: 他精通雇佣法。

examples.zh: 佩奇十分精通多种风格的爵士乐。

examples.en: Page is well-versed in many styles of jazz.
examples.zh: 佩格通晓多种风格的爵士乐。

examples.zh: 琼斯精通这个级别，并且做得非常出色 - 任何人都不应该忘记这一点。

examples.en: Red-and-white checked linens cover high tables and well-versed waiters spout long lists of local beers and handcrafted sodas.
examples.zh: 高桌上铺着红白格子床单，熟练的侍者端出一长串的当地啤酒和手工苏打水。

examples.en: Sullivan is enormously well-versed in personal finance, which he writes about for the New York Times.
examples.zh: 沙利文非常精通个人理财，他为《纽约时报》撰写了有关个人理财的文章。

examples.en: Ellis was a venal, sly man.
examples.zh: 埃利斯是个贪财、奸诈的人。

examples.en: In Ghana and Cameroon this has allowed venal village chiefs to steal logging revenues.
examples.zh: 在加纳和喀麦隆，这让贪赃枉法的村长得以窃取伐木收入。

examples.en: Objective To find a simple, effective surgical method to deal with venal ulcer in lower limbs.
examples.zh: 目的探讨治疗下肢静脉溃疡有效、简单的方法。

examples.en: Here, the tax pain is the result of legislative sausage making at its most venal.
examples.zh: 在这里，税收的痛苦是立法香肠制作最贪婪的结果。

examples.en: Crowded Haiti has long suffered from squabbling and venal politicians, extreme inequality and ecological stress.
examples.zh: 拥挤的海地长期以来一直饱受政客争吵和唯利是图、极端不平等和生态压力的困扰。

examples.en: This does not suggest that colleges and universities are engaged in either collusive or venal behavior.
examples.zh: 这并不意味着学院和大学存在共谋或营利行为。

examples.en: They've begun to hoard food and petrol and save their money.
examples.zh: 他们已开始贮藏食物和汽油并攒钱。

examples.en: Many Vietnamese opt to hoard dollars, not bank them.
examples.zh: 许多越南人选择存储美元，而不是将钱存入银行。

examples.en: The reason or reasons why people hoard are in dispute.
examples.zh: 对人们为什么囤积的原因还有争议。

examples.en: The Silverdale Hoard was found in a field in September 2011, by a metal detecting enthusiast.
examples.zh: Silverdale 宝藏于 2011 年 9 月被一位金属探测爱好者在田野中发现。

examples.en: No one could have predicted that their customers would rush out and hoard on the bourbon.
examples.zh: 没有人能预料到他们的顾客会蜂拥而出并囤积波本威士忌。

examples.en: This corporate cash hoard now becomes the carrot in GM's upcoming collective-bargaining negotiations, beginning in mid-July.
examples.zh: 这些企业现金储备现在成为通用汽车即将于 7 月中旬开始的集体谈判谈判中的胡萝卜。

examples.zh: 在内心深处，他总是孕育着每个真正英国人都有的乡村生活的梦想，他的企业财富能够让他实现这个梦想。

examples.en: Good idea. I like a rustic style.
examples.zh: 好主意，我喜欢乡村风格的。

examples.en: The rustic charm of the interior once again sucked me in.
examples.zh: 乡村的内在魅力又再一次把我深深的吸引住了。

examples.en: Estancia accommodations range from luxurious suites with private fireplaces to rustic rooms with hardwood floors.
examples.zh: Estancia酒店的住宿范围从带私人壁炉的豪华套房到铺有硬木地板的乡村风格客房。

examples.en: Many of the rustic tables and stools, for instance, are made from recycled bourbon barrel tops.
examples.zh: 例如，许多质朴的桌子和凳子都是由回收的波本桶顶部制成的。

examples.en: The Isle of Skye in the northwest Highlands of Scotland is as rustic and rugged as it gets.
examples.zh: 苏格兰高地西北部的斯凯岛充满了质朴和崎岖。

words.meaning: adj. 厚颜无耻的；明目张胆的；黄铜制的；v. 凭厚脸皮拼过去

phrases.zh: 明目张胆的谎言
肆无忌惮的抢劫/盗窃
公然无视；悍然漠视
厚着脸皮挺过去；佯装无事

examples.en: The thieves executed a brazen daylight robbery right in front of security cameras.
examples.zh: 小偷们在监控摄像头前实施了一起明目张胆的光天化日抢劫案。

examples.en: He told a brazen lie even after clear video evidence was presented to him.
examples.zh: 即使在清晰的视频证据摆在他面前之后，他依然说出了一个厚颜无耻的谎言。

examples.en: The company showed a brazen disregard for environmental safety regulations.
examples.zh: 该公司对环境安全法规表现出了公然的漠视。

examples.en: When caught making a mistake, instead of apologizing, he tried to brazen it out.
examples.zh: 当被发现犯错时，他没有道歉，而是试图厚着脸皮强撑过去。

examples.en: Her brazen attitude shocked the committee members during the ethics hearing.
examples.zh: 在伦理听证会上，她那肆无忌惮的态度震惊了委员会成员。

synonyms.note: 大胆的, 鲁莽的, 胆大妄为的。Audacious 偏向于勇敢、敢于冒险的惊人胆量，有时带褒义；Brazen 则是贬义，强调无视道德约束的厚颜无耻。
公然的, 无耻的, 无面具的。Barefaced 侧重于公然的、不加掩饰的（常指说谎）；Brazen 侧重于傲慢、毫不羞愧的无耻态度。
胆大包天的。Bodacious 是非正式用语，表示非常出色或胆大包天；Brazen 更强调厚脸皮和不顾廉耻。
无掩饰的。Bald-faced 多与 lie 连用（bald-faced lie），指毫无顾忌、明目张胆的谎言；Brazen 的适用范围更广，不仅指说话，也指行为厚颜。

etymology.rootMeaning: adj./v. 黄铜制的, 厚颜无耻的；厚脸皮地对待
etymology.explanation: 现有词源记录可追溯到 1570 年代。

cognates.meaning: 厚颜无耻地

etymology.memory: 把 brazen → brazenly 串成词族，比较词性、后缀和核心义的变化。

words.analysis:
【细微含义与感情色彩】强烈贬义形容词。形容行为极度无耻、毫不掩饰、无视法律或社会道德规范（如 brazen lie, brazen theft）。
【历史/词源典故】源自古英语 bræsen（黄铜制的）。古人认为黄铜坚硬且不易被敲碎，引申形容人的脸皮像黄铜一样厚（即‘铜墙铁壁般的厚脸皮’）。
【习语/动词用法】brazen it out 意为‘硬着头皮顶过去；厚着脸皮装无辜’。

words.meaning: adj. 简明的，扼要的；简短生硬的

phrases.zh: 简短生硬的回复
简洁明了的声明
用简明扼要的话
精炼的散文风格

examples.en: He gave a terse answer and walked out of the room.
examples.zh: 他简短而生硬地回答了一句，便走出了房间。

examples.en: The official statement was terse, offering no detailed explanation for the cancellation.
examples.zh: 官方声明非常简短，未对取消原因作详细说明。

examples.en: Her style of writing is terse, precise, and devoid of unnecessary ornament.
examples.zh: 她的写作风格精炼、准确，没有任何多余的修饰。

examples.en: A terse log level records system events without verbose debugging output.
examples.zh: 精简日志级别仅记录系统关键事件，而不输出冗长调试信息。

examples.en: Despite his terse demeanor, he was known to be a deeply compassionate mentor.
examples.zh: 尽管他神情冷峻语气简生，但他其实是一位充满同情心的导师。

examples.en: 'No comment,' was the manager's terse reply to the waiting reporters.
examples.zh: 面对等待的记者，经理只简短冷淡地回应了一句“不予置评”。

synonyms.note: 干脆的，简明扼要的。用法区别：crisp 带有赞赏意味，指言语干净利落；terse 指简练，有时带有不耐烦或生硬的负面意味。
简短无礼的。用法区别：curt 明确带有粗鲁、不礼貌的意味；terse 可能只是行文简练，不一定无礼。
简洁的，寡言的。用法区别：laconic 侧重于用词极少，往往是因为性格沉默寡言；terse 强调删去了所有多余的词汇，直切主题。

etymology.rootMeaning: 作为 terse 构词基础的词形；核心义参见“简洁”
etymology.explanation: terse 直接建立在 tergere 之上，是它的派生形式；现有词源记录可追溯到 1590 年代；词形经法语 ters 进入或影响英语。
etymology.memory: 先记核心义“简洁”，再用常用搭配和例句巩固词形，避免编造不存在的词根。

words.analysis:
【细微含义与感情色彩】既可指文字、表达“精炼、简洁”（书面语，中性偏褒义），也可指语气“简短生硬、粗鲁”（描写/口语，带否定色彩）。
【历史典故与词源】源自拉丁语 *tersus*（擦干净的、精炼的），演变自 *tergere*（擦拭），本义为“像经过擦拭收拾一样干练干净”。
【IT/技术特殊含义】在软件日志与命令行界面中，terse 模式指“精简日志输出”，仅保留关键状态指标。
【助记方法】词根 ters（擦拭）→ 把废话“擦掉”→ 简明扼要的。

examples.zh: 与其说他很节省，不如说他很小气。

examples.en: What do a miserly duck, a 370-year-old vampire, and a Jazz-age racketeer have in common?
examples.zh: 一只吝啬的鸭子、一个 370 岁的吸血鬼和一个爵士时代的敲诈勒索者有什么共同点？

examples.zh: 现代美国选民在给予任何一方信任方面都是出了名的吝啬。

examples.zh: 吝啬的玩家仍然可以通过接触广告来参与游戏并间接付费。

examples.zh: 这句话所导致的刺耳噪音淹没了一切其他的事情。

examples.zh: 后面的司机还在按喇叭，且那刺耳的声音越来越大。

examples.en: For companies looking for the exits, being heard above the cacophony can be a challenge.
examples.zh: 对于寻求退出的公司来说，在喧嚣中被听到可能是一个挑战。

examples.en: He dashes through the lunchtime cacophony of taxis, camera swinging precariously by its strap.
examples.zh: 他冲过午餐时间出租车的喧闹声，相机的带子摇摇欲坠。

examples.en: There comes a time, however, when action speaks louder than any cacophony of words.
examples.zh: 然而，总有一天，行动胜于雄辩。

examples.zh: 然而不知何故，这个本来应该荒唐可笑的夜晚却呈现出一种意想不到的深刻气氛。

examples.zh: 最坏的结果也不会使他烦恼。

examples.zh: 这并没有让 Roxanne Austin 感到困扰——一旦 DirecTV 的命运确定，她甚至可能找不到工作。

examples.zh: 用一点运气加上策略，大多普通的弹子锁都能被打开——所有在你请锁匠之前，尝试一下这个。

examples.en: It can be easily recognizable by the extreme finesse of their printing on satin papers.
examples.zh: 它可以通过在缎纹纸上印刷的极高技巧来轻松识别。

examples.en: Once, in finesse of fiddles found I ecstasy.
examples.zh: 曾经，在小提琴的精妙里我找到狂喜。

examples.en: Despite the two goals, there was a lack of finesse in the opening period.
examples.zh: 尽管打进了两个进球，但开局阶段还是缺乏技巧。

examples.en: The 2010 has an incredible nose of bramble and mature cherry and an appealing, drinkable finesse.
examples.zh: 2010 年份葡萄酒具有令人难以置信的荆棘和成熟樱桃的香气，口感细腻，极具吸引力。

examples.en: Games have to be designed with a new level of graphical finesse for optimal iPad experience.
examples.zh: 游戏的设计必须具有新水平的图形技巧，才能获得最佳的 iPad 体验。

examples.zh: 他自言自语般地嘟哝着。

examples.zh: 他能听到纳瓦罗的低声咕哝。

examples.en: "Well," he conceded, "I do sometimes mumble a bit."
examples.zh: “嗯，”他承认道，“我有时说话确实有点儿含糊。”

examples.en: My mother did not mumble that the policemen were symptoms of a larger malaise.
examples.zh: 我母亲并没有嘟哝说警察是更大的不适的症状。

examples.en: Antediluvian Phytology was published in 1825.
examples.zh: 《上古植物学》在1825年出版。

examples.en: She was more than old - fashioned, she was antediluvian.
examples.zh: 她何止是过时， 简直就是老古董。

examples.en: To the economists, Mrs Thatcher's approach was positively antediluvian.
examples.zh: 这些经济学家们认为，撒切尔夫人的做法实在是“非常老古董”。

examples.en: Given that so much may be at stake, the way such broadcasts are allocated is antediluvian.
examples.zh: 鉴于可能存在如此多的利害关系，此类广播的分配方式是过时的。

examples.en: The changes to the judiciary mean that antediluvian judges and prosecutors no longer stand in his way.
examples.zh: 司法机构的变革意味着过去的法官和检察官不再阻碍他。

examples.en: By the turn of the century, though, mechanicals had won favor among collectors who prized their antediluvian complexity.
examples.zh: 然而，到了世纪之交，机械装置赢得了收藏家的青睐，他们珍视其古老的复杂性。

examples.en: I had hopes of escaping my quotidian world.
examples.zh: 我曾希望能逃离自己的日常生活。

examples.en: PEOPLE remember emotionally charged events more easily than they recall the quotidian.
examples.zh: 和曰常发生的事情比起来，人们往往会记住引起强烈情绪反应的事件。

examples.en: Since then, other researchers have come up with other quotidian examples of event horizons.
examples.zh: 而之后，其他研究人员也提出了关于视界的其它司空见惯的种种例子。

examples.en: The ritual aspects of makeup, smoke, and unusual typography help everyone leave the quotidian realm faster.
examples.zh: 化妆、烟雾和不寻常的排版等仪式感帮助每个人更快地离开日常生活领域。

examples.en: Most adventure races opt for more quotidian conveyance--foot, bicycle and inflatable kayak are standard.
examples.zh: 大多数冒险比赛选择更日常的交通工具——步行、自行车和充气皮划艇是标准的。

examples.en: Salyes has an ear for regional accents and colloquial dialogue, and an eye for quotidian details.
examples.zh: 萨耶斯善于辨别地方口音和口语对话，并且善于观察日常生活细节。

examples.en: What does cancer have to adumbrate?
examples.zh: 癌症有什么预兆？

examples.en: What does cancer have to adumbrate?
examples.zh: 肺癌有哪些症状，有预兆吗？

examples.en: I adumbrate that I did not like his toys.
examples.zh: 我在暗示我不喜欢他的玩具。

examples.en: Barack Obama's Cabinet choices, right on the money, adumbrate an emerging potent leading indicator, maybe the only one that counts for now.
examples.zh: 巴拉克·奥巴马(Barack Obama)的内阁选择，恰到好处，预示着一个正在出现的强有力的领先指标，也许是目前唯一重要的指标。

examples.en: Treasury TIPS bonds adumbrate a future rate of inflation nearing 3 percent.
examples.zh: TIPS 国债预示未来通胀率接近 3%。

examples.en: The art museum palazzos along the Grand Canal adumbrate hubris, a dangerous trait for anyone who collects art and operates in financial markets.
examples.zh: 大运河沿岸的艺术博物馆宫殿预示着傲慢，这对于任何收藏艺术品和在金融市场经营的人来说都是一种危险的特质。

examples.zh: 没有必要把这篇演说的其余部分写下来。

examples.en: The opening lines of Machiavelli’sdedication recall the classical oration To Nicoles composed by the Greek rhetorician Isocrates.
examples.zh: 马基雅维利奉献的开场白让人回想起希腊修辞学家伊索卡特（Isocrates）组成的经典演说《尼科莱斯》。

examples.en: Please let our rector make the oration first, clap your hands.
examples.zh: 首先请大家以热烈的掌声欢迎我们园长讲话。

examples.en: Paul resumed his oration, snacking on candy at the dinner hour while continuing to speak.
examples.zh: 保罗继续他的演讲，在晚餐时间一边吃着糖果一边继续演讲。

examples.en: It's hard enough to sit through a Giscard oration at the best of times.
examples.zh: 即使在最好的情况下，坐下来听完吉斯卡的演讲也已经够困难的了。

examples.en: If he was first in war, as was said in his funeral oration, he was also first in peace.
examples.zh: 如果说他是第一个参战的人，正如他在葬礼上所说，那么他也是第一个和平的人。

examples.zh: 连行业翘楚哈佛商学院(Harvard Business School)，如今也在中国和印度开设了项目。

examples.zh: 不过，研究部元老级人物，阿里斯泰尔·库克曾指出，该部一直是保守党社会关切的苗床。

examples.en: In 1997, Nuccio Bertone, one of the automobile world's great mentors and the doyen of Italian design, died.

examples.en: The ark comes to rest on a mountaintop, and the hero sends out a bird to reconnoiter the land, to find out if it's dry yet.
examples.zh: 方舟停在一个山顶上，英雄派一只鸟去侦察这片土地，看看是否还干燥。

examples.en: His intention had been to reconnoiter.
examples.zh: 他的意图是侦察一下。

examples.en: The ark also comes to rest on a mountaintop, the hero sends out a bird to reconnoiter the land, to find out if it's dry yet.
examples.zh: 方舟停在山顶上，英雄派一只鸟出去查看大地的情况。

examples.en: Because big data is growing so fast, having a collaborative groundwork laid internally is a much better scenario than having a revolving door, where executives constantly need to reconnoiter as data ( now the equivalent of revenue) passes them by.
examples.zh: 由于大数据增长如此之快，因此在内部奠定协作基础比旋转门要好得多，在旋转门中，高管们需要不断地在数据（现在相当于收入）经过时进行侦察。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of reconnoiter.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“侦察，勘查；vi. 侦察，探究”的概念提供了全新的视角。

examples.en: Recent academic studies have highlighted the significance of reconnoiter in modern research.
examples.zh: 最近的学术研究强调了“侦察，勘查；vi. 侦察，探究”在现代科学研究中的重要意义。

phrases.zh: 害怕遭到报复/惩罚
实施报复/予以惩罚

examples.en: Many witnesses refused to testify in court out of fear of violent retribution.
examples.zh: 出于对暴力报复的恐惧，许多证人拒绝在法庭上作证。

examples.en: The villain in the novel met swift and terrible divine retribution at the story's climax.
examples.zh: 小说中的反派在故事高潮处遭遇了迅速而可怕的天谴报应。

examples.en: He viewed his financial ruin not as bad luck, but as retribution for past misdeeds.
examples.zh: 他认为自己的破产并非倒霉，而是过去做恶所带来的报应。

examples.en: The victims' families demanded just retribution for the heinous crimes committed.
examples.zh: 受害者家属要求对所犯下的滔天罪行给予公正的惩罚。

examples.en: In ancient law codes, justice was largely defined through strict retribution.
examples.zh: 在古代法典中，正义在很大程度上是通过严格的应报惩罚来定义的。

synonyms.note: 解析：酬答，报复，还礼。区别：Requital 可以是善意的回报，也可以是恶意的报复；retribution 则专门指对罪恶或错误行为的严厉惩罚和报应。

etymology.rootMeaning: n. 报应, 惩罚, 报酬；惩罚, 报应, 报答
etymology.explanation: 现有词源记录可追溯到 1560 年代；词形经古法语 retribution 进入或影响英语；从现代构词看可辅助拆为 re-（再次、向后） + tribu + -tion（名词后缀，表示行为、过程或结果）。
etymology.memory: 先记核心义“报应”，再用常用搭配和例句巩固词形，避免编造不存在的词根。

words.analysis: 【细微含义】指因做恶、犯罪或不义行为而遭受的严厉而合理的惩罚或报应（通常指天意、法律或正义的制裁，具有道德正当性色彩）。比 revenge（复仇）更强调神圣、正义或法律上的应得代价。【使用场景】文学、历史、法律哲学、神学及正规新闻。书面语。【词源/助记】re-（回，反）+ tribuere（给予，支付）+ -tion → 给予相应的回报/惩罚 → 报应。

examples.en: He's a retired lieutenant colonel and a bit of a martinet.
examples.zh: 他是位退役中校，有点一板一眼。

examples.en: They discover that the new teacher is a martinet.
examples.zh: 他们发现新来的老师非常严格。

examples.en: The martinet governed his classroom with procrustean discipline, assigning a week's detention to all offenders, no matter what the offense.
examples.zh: 纪律严肃的人用强求一致的训导支配他的教室，分配一个星期内拘留所有的罪犯，无论如何进攻。

examples.en: Newspapers indignantly portrayed him as a martinet who had made himself prime minister in all but name.
examples.zh: 报纸愤怒地将他描绘成一个严守纪律的人，除了名义上自己还担任总理。

examples.en: Here he dresses the part of a colonial martinet: tight jackets, jodhpurs, riding boots, and even affects a cigarette holder.
examples.zh: 在这里，他的着装就像是殖民时期的马丁内特人：紧身夹克、马裤、马靴，甚至还戴着烟嘴。

examples.en: In this 1933 musical comedy, the round-eyed, sweetly leering comedian Eddie Cantor stars as Eddie, a bookish drifter who is run out of the small town of West Rome for speaking truth to the petty martinet of a mayor.
examples.zh: 在这部 1933 年的音乐喜剧中，圆眼睛、甜甜地斜视的喜剧演员埃迪·坎托 (Eddie Cantor) 饰演埃迪 (Eddie)，一个书生气十足的流浪汉，因向狭隘严苛的市长说真话而被赶出西罗马小镇。

examples.en: The good folks come probably from a masquerade!
examples.zh: 好人大概是从化装舞会来的吧！

examples.en: Once into the voicemail system, they could masquerade as owners.
examples.zh: 一旦转入语言系统，他们就可以摇身一变成为成电话的主人。

examples.en: Typically, these can masquerade as a conventional mouse or keyboard.
examples.zh: 这些可以顶替常规的鼠标或键盘。

examples.en: In 2001, a big mask was fastened to his head to promote a masquerade ball.
examples.zh: 2001年，他的头上戴了一个大面具，以宣传化装舞会。

examples.en: Tipping Sacred Cows: Kick the Bad Work Habits That Masquerade as Virtues by Jake Breeden.
examples.zh: 《给圣牛小费：戒除伪装成美德的坏工作习惯》作者：杰克·布里登。

examples.en: The Geneva Conventions recognized that great danger to civilians results when participants in hostilities masquerade as non-combatants.
examples.zh: 《日内瓦四公约》承认，当敌对行动参与者伪装成非战斗人员时，会对平民造成巨大危险。

examples.en: The gentlest of her caresses would contort his already tense body.
examples.zh: 她温柔的爱抚会使他原本绷紧的身体更不自然。

examples.en: Steel fuses (in blue) at the frame's center twist and contort to absorb seismic energy.
examples.zh: 构架中心的钢铁保险丝(蓝色部分)扭曲并扭转着吸收地震能量。

examples.en: The key might not be to try to contort yourself into a schedule that doesn't work for you, but to experiment.
examples.zh: 关键不是强行让自己适应不适合自己的作息时间表，而是去尝试。

examples.en: But, faced with legal accusation rather than moral indignation, both men contort themselves rather than admit guilt.
examples.zh: 但是，面对法律指控而不是道德义愤，两人都扭曲自己而不是承认有罪。

examples.en: However, certain apps only function in portrait mode, and simply will not twist no matter how you contort your wrist.
examples.zh: 然而，某些应用程序只能在纵向模式下运行，并且无论您如何扭曲手腕都不会扭曲。

examples.en: You can tell both girls aren't really feeling themselves because they do things like contort their bodies into positions that even master yogis might find a tad uncomfortable.
examples.zh: 你可以看出这两个女孩都没有真正的感觉，因为她们会做一些事情，比如将身体扭曲成即使是瑜伽大师也会觉得有点不舒服的姿势。

examples.en: He looked sly and furtive.
examples.zh: 他显得偷偷摸摸，鬼鬼祟祟。

examples.en: His furtive behaviour aroused our suspicion.
examples.zh: 他鬼鬼祟祟的行为引起了我们的怀疑。

examples.en: With a furtive glance over her shoulder, she unlocked the door and entered the house.
examples.zh: 随着越过其肩的鬼鬼祟祟的一瞥，她打开锁进了那房子。

examples.en: The original, recorded by James Carr in 1966, is a classic of furtive sneaking-around soul.
examples.zh: 原版由詹姆斯·卡尔 (James Carr) 于 1966 年录制，是鬼鬼祟祟的灵魂乐的经典之作。

examples.en: My sister and I stole furtive glances at each other, not sure how to answer.
examples.zh: 我和姐姐偷偷地看了对方一眼，不知道该如何回答。

examples.en: His only corroborating evidence is an ambiguous taped conversation of a furtive airport meeting.
examples.zh: 他唯一确凿的证据是一次秘密机场会议的一段模棱两可的录音谈话。

examples.en: To recapitulate briefly, the three main points are these...
examples.zh: 简要概括起来，主要有这样三点…

examples.en: It will be put up for sale under the terms already communicated to you, which, to recapitulate, call for a very minimum of publicity.
examples.zh: 其销售将按照已讲的条件进行，概括地说，就是要求尽量少宣传。

examples.en: Let's just recapitulate the essential points.
examples.zh: 让我们只概述一下基本要点吧。

examples.en: Another possible point of resistance in London and Washington may have been strategic: the desire not to recapitulate the problems of Diego Garcia, part of the British Indian Ocean territory.
examples.zh: 伦敦和华盛顿的另一个可能的阻力点可能是战略性的：不想重演英属印度洋领土一部分迪戈加西亚岛的问题。

examples.en: Doing it that way seems to recapitulate, in almost poetic fashion, the mistake publishers made a decade ago in putting their content free online, creating an expectation among consumers that proved hard to break once those same publishers started to think about charging.
examples.zh: 这样做似乎以近乎诗意的方式重述了出版商十年前在网上免费提供内容时所犯的错误，在消费者中产生了一种期望，一旦这些出版商开始考虑收费，这种期望就很难打破。

无政府主义团体

examples.en: The movement was led by anarchists advocating for decentralized community control.
examples.zh: 该运动由主张地方分权与社区自治的无政府主义者领导。

examples.en: Historically, famous anarchist thinkers like Mikhail Bakunin challenged state authority.
examples.zh: 历史上，像米哈伊尔·巴库宁这样的著名无政府主义思想家对国家权威提出了挑战。

examples.en: Police monitored the demonstration after fringe anarchist groups threatened disruptions.
examples.zh: 在边缘无政府主义团体威胁进行破坏后，警方对游行进行了监控。

examples.en: Anarchist literature often emphasizes self-governance and voluntary mutual aid.
examples.zh: 无政府主义文献通常强调自我管理与自愿互助。

examples.en: The novel depicts a dystopian future controlled by competing warlords and anarchist factions.
examples.zh: 这部小说描绘了一个由相互竞争的军阀和无政府主义派系控制的反乌托邦未来。

synonyms.note: 含义：虚无主义者。区别：Nihilist 指否认一切传统信仰、价值观或制度的人，认为世界无意义；anarchist 专指反对任何政府或权威的无政府主义者，侧重于政治诉求。
含义：工团主义者。区别：Syndicalist 指主张通过工会罢工来控制工业和政府的人；anarchist 则是反对任何形式国家政权的人，两者的政治理念不同。

etymology.rootMeaning: n. 无政府主义者
etymology.explanation: 现有词源记录可追溯到 1670 年代；从现代构词看可辅助拆为 anarch + -ist（表示从业者或持某观点的人）。
etymology.memory: 先记核心义“无政府主义者”，再用常用搭配和例句巩固词形，避免编造不存在的词根。

words.analysis: 细微含义：指主张废除一切国家体制、政府权威与强制性统治，倡导基于自愿合作和自主管理的无政府主义思想倡导者或奉行者。使用场景：政治学、历史、社会学、政治评论。感情色彩：中性（学术）至负面（大众文化中常与反叛、混乱相连）。助记方法：an-（无）+ archy（统治/政府）+ -ist（人）→ 主张无政府的人 → 无政府主义者。

examples.en: Don't dissipate your efforts.
examples.zh: 不要浪费你的精力。

examples.en: Was she the pure phantom I loved because I would never touch her, never allow my all too real hands to dissipate the mist?
examples.zh: 她是我爱的那个纯洁的幻影吗？因为我从没接触她，从没允许自己真实的双手来拨开那层雾。

examples.en: Airflow helps to dissipate heat.
examples.zh: 气流有助于散热。

examples.en: As the uncertainty and fear of investors dissipate, opportunities will bubble to the surface.
examples.zh: 随着投资者的不确定性和恐惧消散，机会就会浮出水面。

examples.en: The excited water molecules dissipate their energy by bashing against the enamel and bone.
examples.zh: 激发的水分子通过撞击牙釉质和骨骼来消耗能量。

examples.en: He didn't say anything at the time, hoping it would dissipate on its own.
examples.zh: 当时他什么也没说，希望这件事能自行消散。

examples.en: I might never have heard that entrancing sound, or smelt that bewitching smell!
examples.zh: 我可能从来没有听到过那种令人神魂颠倒的声音，或者闻到过那种迷人的气味！

examples.en: Frank was a quiet young man with bewitching brown eyes.
examples.zh: 弗兰克是一个文静的年轻人，长着一双令人着魔的褐色眼睛。

examples.en: It was always their strength that they wrote bewitching singles.
examples.zh: 他们总有能力写出迷人的单曲。

examples.en: At 60 she remains the best- and most interesting-looking person in the room: imposing, bewitching, singular.
examples.zh: 60 岁的她仍然是房间里最漂亮、最有趣的人：气势磅礴、迷人、独特。

examples.en: What is so bewitching about moral compromise, after all, is that we enter it, as Henry Burton does, half willingly.
examples.zh: 毕竟，道德妥协的迷人之处在于，我们会像亨利·伯顿那样，半自愿地参与其中。

examples.en: After a night of 21st Century clubbing on the Strip, the most bewitching Vegas nightcap can be found inside the Fireside Lounge.
examples.zh: 在拉斯维加斯大道上度过一晚 21 世纪的夜店之后，您可以在 Fireside Lounge 里喝上一杯最迷人的维加斯睡前饮品。

examples.en: The hotel had always been run in a slipshod way.
examples.zh: 该酒店的管理一向马虎。

examples.en: This is very slipshod work.
examples.zh: 这活儿做得太糙。

examples.en: Don't do your work in a slipshod manner. You should be conscientious and have a sense of responsibility.
examples.zh: 对工作不能随随便便，要认真负责。

examples.en: The rotary phones are clunky, the lifts and stencilled warning signs have a slipshod look.
examples.zh: 旋转电话很笨重，电梯和印刷的警告标志看起来很草率。

examples.en: Early in his presidency, John Kennedy exhibited a slipshod, undisciplined, harum-scarum approach to foreign and defense policy.
examples.zh: 约翰·肯尼迪在担任总统初期，在外交和国防政策上表现出了草率、无纪律、鲁莽的态度。

examples.en: This data is not the result of indiscriminate, slipshod and unlawful profiling but of devoted, painstaking police work and hard-won intelligence.
examples.zh: 这些数据并不是不分青红皂白、马虎和非法侧写的结果，而是警方辛勤工作和来之不易的情报的结果。

examples.en: The boat was hit by a squall north of the island.
examples.zh: 船在岛的北边遇到了狂飑。

examples.en: He braced his shoulders defiantly as another squall of wet snow slashed across his face.
examples.zh: 当又一阵雨雪呼啸着划过他的脸庞时，他毫无畏惧地绷紧双肩。

examples.en: Now he faces the squall of an election.
examples.zh: 现在他要面对选举的风浪。

examples.en: Baier's tumultuous year is like a lot of recent tales about entrepreneurs--a story of calm sailing that turns precipitously into a frightening squall.
examples.zh: 拜尔动荡的一年就像最近许多关于企业家的故事一样——一个平静的航行突然变成一场可怕的暴风雨的故事。

examples.en: The market is attempting to regain its footing, but it is too early to claim that the selling squall has run its course.
examples.zh: 市场正试图重新站稳脚跟，但现在断言抛售风暴已经结束还为时过早。

examples.en: At the same moment, in a sudden squall, a white shape broke out in front of him from nowhere, or from between two parked cars.
examples.zh: 与此同时，在一场突然的狂风中，一个白色的身影不知从哪里突然出现在他面前，或者说是从两辆停着的汽车之间突然出现。

examples.en: Nobody can gainsay his claims.
examples.zh: 没人能够反驳他的说法。

examples.en: No one can gainsay his honesty.
examples.zh: 没有能否认他的诚实。

examples.en: The doctors certainly think so, and who am I to gainsay them?
examples.zh: 医生确定地这么认为，而且我是谁否定他们？

examples.en: More immediately, we have to gainsay the outlandish word that the Washington Post is putting out there on the JFK tax cuts.
examples.zh: 更直接的是，我们必须反驳《华盛顿邮报》发表的关于肯尼迪减税的奇怪言论。

examples.en: The foregoing does not gainsay the vital role played by the International Monetary Fund where its austerity measures and other macro-economic adjustments can work.
examples.zh: 上述内容并没有否定国际货币基金组织所发挥的重要作用，其紧缩措施和其他宏观经济调整可以发挥作用。

examples.en: Whatever you think of the man's style, you've got to admire his pluck. (McQueen's, I mean.) As for Heller, you can't gainsay his knowledge of the subject.
examples.zh: 无论你如何看待这个人的风格，你都必须钦佩他的勇气。 （我是说麦昆的。） 至于海勒，你不能否认他对这个主题的了解。

examples.en: She has always displayed a strong sartorial instinct, and has been wearing heels since the age of three.
examples.zh: 她一直表现出很强的潮人本性，从她三岁起她就送是脚踩高跟鞋出现在大家面前。

examples.en: Emmys. Once again, in a competition that's decided by insiders, the readers weighed in on the sartorial standoff.
examples.zh: 在这样一场结果由内部人士决定的竞赛中，读者们只能凭小道消息自己猜度结局啦。

examples.en: Some of the women who have lost their jobs find themselves second-guessing any sartorial liberties they did take.
examples.zh: 一些失去工作的女性对自己过去在穿着打扮方面的随意颇为追悔。

examples.en: The Gods of TED apparently gave Chip Kidd a special dispensation for his sartorial pecadillo.
examples.zh: TED 之神显然给了奇普·基德 (Chip Kidd) 特殊的服装天赋。

examples.en: Grunts can become a player's signature, like a two-handed backhand or a sartorial flourish.
examples.zh: 咕噜声可以成为球员的标志，就像双手反手或服装华丽。

examples.en: You can also take a sartorial cue from the Italians and wear pastel colored suits.
examples.zh: 您还可以效仿意大利人的着装风格，穿上柔和色彩的西装。

展现出倒退，回归；（尤指因催眠或精神疾患）回到从前；（统计）回归；n. 退回；（哲）倒溯论证

examples.en: At the moment of victory, we regress.
examples.zh: 在胜利的时刻，我们后退了。

examples.en: Normally, they regress into four to five fused vertebrae (the coccyx).
examples.zh: 通常情况下，它们回归为四到五块融合在一起的椎骨(尾骨)。

examples.en: Some even regress and do not need to be treated - they are harmless.
examples.zh: 有的甚至会自行退化因而不需要治疗——因为它们是无害的。

examples.en: But going back to diffuse non-dense agrarian sources for energy is to regress , not progress.
examples.zh: 但回到分散的、非密集的农业能源来源是倒退，而不是进步。

examples.en: They also commonly occur during the early stages of pregnancy and can regress after pregnancy.
examples.zh: 它们也通常发生在怀孕早期，并可以在怀孕后消退。

examples.en: The analytics include statistical modeling, functional grouping, multiple regress analysis and time series analysis, she said.
examples.zh: 她说，分析包括统计建模、功能分组、多重回归分析和时间序列分析。

examples.en: Officials refuse to divulge details of the negotiations.
examples.zh: 官员们拒绝透露谈判的细节。

examples.en: He refused to divulge any information regarding the man's whereabouts.
examples.zh: 他拒绝透露任何关于那个男人下落的消息。

examples.en: As we explored, Ms. Foster announced that she had a final tidbit to divulge.
examples.zh: 当我们探索时，福斯特女士宣布她有最后的花絮要透露。

examples.zh: 周四标志着 SwiftKey 首次能够透露主要制造合作伙伴。

examples.en: The New York Police Department confirmed that it uses the technology but wouldn't divulge specifics.
examples.zh: 纽约警察局证实其使用了该技术，但没有透露具体细节。

examples.en: Favoritism in official access can fan public perceptions of corruption.
examples.zh: 官方的偏袒会激起公众对腐败的感知。

examples.en: Every office has its share of favoritism, inefficiency and dumb decisions.
examples.zh: 每个办公室都有他偏袒、低效并且愚蠢的决定。

examples.en: The court's ruling is legally sound in defining a kind of favoritism that is not criminal.
examples.zh: 法院的裁决定义了一种不构成犯罪的偏袒，这在法律上是合理的。

examples.en: Not wanting to show favoritism to a particular candidate, the caucus then supported their favorite pizza.
examples.zh: 由于不想偏袒特定候选人，核心小组随后支持了他们最喜欢的披萨。

examples.en: Such favoritism suggests things aren't going to change any time soon for Sony and Microsoft.
examples.zh: 这种偏袒表明索尼和微软的情况不会很快改变。

examples.en: Ken views that as a mutual love of soccer, not as favoritism per say.
examples.zh: 肯认为这是对足球的共同热爱，而不是所谓的偏袒。

examples.en: At last he said, "Oh, you wretched beard-cleaner, you piebald fool, you hungry mouse-hunter, what can you be thinking of?"
examples.zh: 最后他说：“哦，你这个讨厌的大胡子倒霉蛋儿，你这个花斑傻瓜，你这个饥饿的捕鼠者，你在想什么呢？”

examples.en: From my own goat, the piebald one.
examples.zh: 我自己的羊，就是那只花斑的。

examples.en: Note a perfect piebald is preferable a muddy brindle or defective solid color.
examples.zh: 注意：正确的花斑色比污浊的虎斑色或有缺陷的纯色更可取。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of piebald.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“（马）花斑的；黑白两色的；n. 花斑马（或其他花斑动物）”的概念提供了全新的视角。

examples.en: Recent academic studies have highlighted the significance of piebald in modern research.
examples.zh: 最近的学术研究强调了“（马）花斑的；黑白两色的；n. 花斑马（或其他花斑动物）”在现代科学研究中的重要意义。

examples.en: Her articulate argument demonstrated a deep understanding of piebald.
examples.zh: 她清晰有力的论证展现了对“（马）花斑的；黑白两色的；n. 花斑马（或其他花斑动物）”的深刻理解。

examples.en: She spoke in a slow southern drawl.

examples.en: Jack's southern drawl had become more pronounced as they'd travelled southward.
examples.zh: 随着他们愈往南行，杰克拖腔拉调的南方口音就愈发明显了。

examples.en: The Chambers secret sauce: sugar-sweet salesmanship baked slowly over a native West Virginia drawl.
examples.zh: 钱伯斯的秘密武器：甜甜的推销技巧在西弗吉尼亚州本土慢吞吞的慢调中慢慢烘烤。

examples.en: His first voice was plainspoken, halting, in a Texas drawl that connected to the everyday man.
examples.zh: 他的第一个声音是直白的、结结巴巴的，带着一种德克萨斯式的慢吞吞的腔调，与普通人很相似。

examples.en: "He was a bit of a big shot, " says Johnny in his thick, Italy-via-New Jersey drawl.
examples.zh: “他有点像个大人物，”约翰尼用他那浓重的、从意大利到新泽西的慢吞吞的语气说道。

examples.en: Colour has a profound, though often subliminal, influence on our senses and moods.
examples.zh: 颜色对我们的感觉和情绪有一种很深远的影响，尽管常常是潜意识的。

examples.en: Such sentences do not always occur in thinking, and when they do they are merged with vague imagery and the hint of unconscious or subliminal activities going on just out of range.
examples.zh: 这样的句子并不总是出现在思维中，即使出现了，它们也会与模糊的意象和无意识或潜意识活动的暗示混杂在一起。

examples.en: And yes, the unconscious effects of subliminal images may be a variant of blindsight, although the jury remains out on just how similar the two phenomena are.
examples.zh: 是的，飞快的图像造成的无意识效果也许是盲视的一种变形，尽管这两种现象之间的相似之处的评判还在进行当中。

examples.en: The researchers speculated that dirty money acts as a subliminal prime towards dodgy dealing and ill-gotten gains.
examples.zh: 研究人员推测，脏钱是进行不正当交易和不义之财的潜意识因素。

examples.en: There's at least a subliminal link to Mary Queen of Scots, who was born in the palace.
examples.zh: 至少在潜意识中与出生在这座宫殿的苏格兰玛丽女王有某种联系。

examples.en: Maybe the good idea was heard at a subconscious or subliminal level, not clearly at the conscious level.
examples.zh: 也许这个好主意是在潜意识或潜意识层面上听到的，而不是在意识层面上清楚地听到的。

examples.en: She was dreading having to broach the subject of money to her father.
examples.zh: 她正在为不得不向父亲提出钱的事犯愁。

examples.en: They still have to broach many tricky subjects.
examples.zh: 他们终将处理许多棘手问题。

examples.zh: 他能轻而易举地在各学科之间换来换去。

examples.en: Lightning floodlights gnarled trees and a giant iron bell. Monks with umbrellas flit about in robes and slippers.

examples.en: Swimming along the edge of a reef wall, vast shoals flit at jagged angles around each other.
examples.zh: 巨大的浅滩沿着礁墙的边缘游动，彼此以锯齿状的角度掠过。

examples.en: About 3.6 million unique visitors flit to the Daily Fill site every month.
examples.zh: 每月约有 360 万独立访问者访问 Daily Fill 网站。

words.meaning: n. 简短，简洁；短暂
words.analysis:
【细微含义】指语言、文字表达的简练得体（brevity is the soul of wit），或指时间上的短促短暂。
【使用场景】书面语/文学/写作修辞。【历史典故】源于莎士比亚《哈姆雷特》中波洛霓裳名句“Brevity is the soul of wit”。
【助记方法】brev- (短，如 brief) + -ity -> 简短，简洁。

examples.en: The report was praised for its remarkable clarity and brevity.
examples.zh: 该报告因其非凡的清晰度与简洁性而受到赞扬。

examples.en: For the sake of brevity, details are omitted in this introductory chapter.
examples.zh: 为了简明起见，细节在本引言章节中予以省略。

examples.en: As Shakespeare wrote in Hamlet, 'brevity is the soul of wit.'
examples.zh: 正如莎士比亚在《哈姆雷特》中所写：“简洁是智慧的灵魂。”

examples.en: The brevity of the flowering season makes the blossom viewing even more precious.
examples.zh: 花期的短暂使得赏花变得尤为珍贵。

examples.en: Effective communication often relies on brevity without sacrificing important context.
examples.zh: 有效的沟通往往依赖于在不牺牲重要上下文前提下的简练。

phrases.en: brevity is the soul of wit
phrases.zh: 言以简洁为贵 / 简洁是智慧的灵魂

examples.en: You mulish guy, what the hell are you seeking?

examples.zh: 他很顽固，我的告诫对他只不过是耳边风。

examples.zh: 一支庞大的骡马队伍从青海省香日德城出发了。

examples.en: It can be downright mulish about burying its rare moments of violence or sex.
examples.zh: 它可能会非常固执地埋葬罕见的暴力或性时刻。

examples.en: Robbins can seem mulish and out of it, but then, as an impish grin takes over his face, he suddenly becomes inspired.
examples.zh: 罗宾斯看起来很固执，但随后，当他脸上露出顽皮的笑容时，他突然受到了启发。

examples.en: It was like a parody of the balcony scene from Romeo and Juliet.
examples.zh: 它就像《罗密欧与朱丽叶》阳台上那一幕的模仿作。

examples.en: There seems to be something like a gentle parody, maybe even a mocking tone that fills the lines of the elder brother's ecstatic speech.
examples.zh: 似乎有一种温柔的戏仿，可能甚至是一种嘲弄的语气，充满了哥哥狂热的演讲中。

examples.en: By the end of his life, Presley's vocals often descended close to self-parody.
examples.zh: 在人生的最后阶段，猫王普雷斯利的歌曲大不如前，通常几近于自我嘲弄。

examples.en: It's as if someone was trying to parody right-wing narratives of government bureaucracy and incompetence.
examples.zh: 就好像有人试图模仿右翼关于政府官僚主义和无能的叙述。

examples.en: Former Palm CEO Jon Rubinstein also got a parody Twitter account over the weekend.
examples.zh: Palm 前首席执行官乔恩·鲁宾斯坦 (Jon Rubinstein) 周末也获得了一个模仿 Twitter 帐户。

examples.en: The 16 pictures are baldly factual temporal maps and read like a parody of street photography.
examples.zh: 这 16 张照片是赤裸裸的事实时间地图，读起来就像是对街头摄影的模仿。

examples.en: At the words, the door opened and a dapper little old man came in.
examples.zh: 听到这话，门开了，一个衣冠楚楚的小老头走了进来。

examples.en: All hats make a man look more dapper.
examples.zh: 所有的帽子都可以让男人的脸看起来很小巧。

examples.en: A dapper gentleman of about sixty stepped into the room and faced us.
examples.zh: 一位60岁左右、身姿矫健的男子走进房间，面向我们。

examples.en: Dapper gentlemen frequent Harry Rosen and the nouvelle barbershop Cru , both in Yorkville.
examples.zh: 衣冠楚楚的绅士们经常光顾位于约克维尔的 Harry Rosen 和新锐理发店 Cru 。

examples.en: Urbane and dapper, 45-year-old Najib was once aligned with Anwar, but past history will mean little.
examples.zh: 45 岁的纳吉布温文尔雅、衣冠楚楚，一度与安瓦尔结盟，但过去的历史意义不大。

examples.en: Even the dapper Mr Lucinschi is hard put to say what it means to be Moldovan.
examples.zh: 即使是衣冠楚楚的卢辛斯基先生也很难说出作为摩尔多瓦人意味着什么。

examples.en: Inert gases like neon and argon have eight electrons in their outer shell.
examples.zh: 像氖和氩这样的惰性气体，在它们的外电子层有8个电子。

examples.en: Agronomists studying the herb have discovered that it produces large amounts of histidine, an amino acid that, in test-tube solutions, renders these metals chemically inert.
examples.zh: 研究这种药草的农学家发现，它会产生大量的组氨酸，这种氨基酸在试管溶液中会使这些金属具有化学惰性。

examples.en: The novel itself remains oddly inert.
examples.zh: 那小说本身异常乏味。

examples.en: Not all of the placebo treatments that the researchers looked at in this study are inert.
examples.zh: 研究人员在本研究中观察到的安慰剂治疗并非都是惰性的。

examples.en: Investigators made sure the materials in what appeared to be a bomb were inert.
examples.zh: 调查人员确定炸弹中的材料是惰性的。

examples.en: Tailings are rendered inert and any arsenic in the ore is said to be 100% fixed.
examples.zh: 尾矿被赋予惰性，矿石中的任何砷据说都被 100% 固定。

examples.en: Next time don't loll out your tongue out.
examples.zh: 下次可别伸出舌头来嘲笑人了。

examples.en: Don't loll about in the street after school.
examples.zh: 放学后不要在街上到处闲逛。

examples.en: Donkey:Yes, but how funny it is you loll your tongue out !
examples.zh: 是的，但是你把舌头伸出来很滑稽呢！

examples.en: Overnight guests can loll about in four poster beds and roll top baths, enjoy candlelit dinners and peruse the family heirlooms at their leisure.
examples.zh: 过夜的客人可以懒洋洋地躺在四张海报床上和卷顶浴缸中，享受烛光晚餐，并在闲暇时细细品味家庭传家宝。

examples.en: So I was left in peace during July and August to loll about Jesus Green, reading Churchill, bored, waiting for the weekend and the hike to the bus stop on the city boundary.
examples.zh: 因此，我在七月和八月期间安静地闲逛耶稣格林，阅读丘吉尔，无聊，等待周末并徒步前往城市边界的公交车站。

examples.en: The castigating rhetoric of hedge fund managers emanating from both Sohn and SALT, whose tongues loll out of their mouths from their break-neck pursuit of the runaway benchmark indexes, has not been lost on the FOMC.
examples.zh: 索恩和 SALT 因疯狂追求失控的基准指数而大张旗鼓，FOMC 也没有忽视对冲基金经理的严厉言论。

examples.en: You know I have no intention of being awkward and obstreperous.
examples.zh: 你知道我无意存心作对。

examples.en: He becomes obstreperous when he's had a few drinks.
examples.zh: 他喝了些酒就爱撒酒疯。

examples.en: In the class that day was an obstreperous man who was creating turmoil.
examples.zh: 那天教室里有个任性的男人在捣乱。

examples.en: IMF, and the cheap loans it provided, but were forced to by Indonesia's obstreperous parliament.
examples.zh: 国际货币基金组织及其提供的廉价贷款，但却是被印度尼西亚顽固的议会强迫的。

examples.en: The government of Panama was sometimes obstreperous but ultimately bent to American muscle.
examples.zh: 巴拿马政府有时固执己见，但最终还是屈服于美国的力量。

examples.en: But the Republican bosses, in particular, do not know how obstreperous the firebrands in the lower ranks will prove.
examples.zh: 但共和党的老板们尤其不知道下层的煽动者会变得多么顽固。

examples.en: It was with some trepidation that I viewed the prospect of cycling across Uganda.
examples.zh: 想到要骑自行车穿越乌干达，我感到有点惊恐不安。

examples.en: But trepidation of the spheres.
examples.zh: 但是来自空间天体的异动。

examples.en: I approached this project with great trepidation.
examples.zh: 我诚惶诚恐地着手这个项目。

examples.en: "People are viewing the weekly jobless numbers with a little bit of trepidation, " he said.
examples.zh: 他说：“人们带着一点恐惧看待每周的失业数据。”

examples.en: Zedan had some trepidation about whether she was up for the rigors of college coursework.
examples.zh: 泽丹对自己能否承受大学课程的严格要求感到有些不安。

examples.en: We will have to wait and see, with some trepidation, what will go on today.
examples.zh: 我们必须怀着忐忑不安的心情等待看看今天会发生什么。

examples.en: I refused to wear headphones because they can perforate your eardrums.

examples.en: The arrow is tipped with an iron arrowhead to perforate its target.
examples.zh: 箭头上镶有铁的箭簇以便射穿目标物。

examples.en: In advanced stages the opaque corneas may ulcerate and even perforate.
examples.zh: 在疾病后期，不透明的角膜可能产生溃疡，甚至穿孔。

examples.en: And the main way they do it is through what they call hydraulic fracturing, which after they drill the well bore, they perforate it.
examples.zh: 他们这样做的主要方法是通过所谓的水力压裂，在钻完井眼后，他们将其射孔。

examples.en: Next up is to re-perforate the well so that new holes are created to get to the hydrocarbon reservoir and bypass the ones that are plugged up.
examples.zh: 接下来是重新对井进行射孔，以便形成新的孔，到达碳氢化合物储层并绕过被堵塞的孔。

examples.en: Abrams, is the most streamlined to date, with a succession of gargantuan set pieces (the best of them in the Vatican) and dogged attempts to perforate the eardrums of the audience.
examples.zh: 艾布拉姆斯是迄今为止最精简的，他有一系列巨大的布景（梵蒂冈最好的）和顽强的尝试来刺穿观众的耳膜。

examples.zh: 学校无可指摘的目的是让家长更多的参与到孩子的教育中来。

examples.zh: 法官的职业道德必须是无懈可击的。

examples.zh: 这些声明看似平淡无奇，但对新芬党来说却是一个巨大的转变。

examples.en: As I say, the kinds of modernisation we've been talking about really are unexceptionable in any other walk of life.
examples.zh: 正如我所说，我们一直在谈论的现代化在任何其他行业中确实是无可例外的。

examples.en: There was a crescendo of press criticism.
examples.zh: 媒体的批评逐渐升温。

examples.en: Voices rose in a crescendo and drowned him out.

examples.en: The applause rose to a crescendo and cameras clicked.
examples.zh: 掌声越来越来响，照相机咔嚓咔嚓地响。

examples.en: What happened next was perhaps the loudest crescendo of the blowing of taps ever performed.
examples.zh: 接下来发生的事情可能是有史以来最响亮的敲击声。

examples.en: Just as the air of anticipation hit its crescendo, it sputtered, deflated and drifted away.
examples.zh: 就在期待的气氛达到高潮时，它又噼啪作响、泄气并飘散开来。

examples.en: As the music reaches a crescendo, so, too, does the hysteria of the crowd.
examples.zh: 随着音乐达到高潮，人群的歇斯底里也随之而来。

examples.zh: 他有时候真让人难以忍受，自我中心又自恋。

examples.zh: 她一点也没有表现出同龄人那种自恋和虚无主义倾向。

examples.en: "We're very narcissistic," says Ms Enright.

examples.en: There is also a narcissistic delight in verbal dexterity, in dealing out the trenchant phrase.

examples.en: We are, after all, talking about an era dominated by millennials, described as the most narcissistic generation in modern history.

examples.en: The audience grew restive.
examples.zh: 观众变得不耐烦了。

examples.en: Anxious firms may be joined by other restive groups.
examples.zh: 在忧虑的公司之外还有不愿保持沉默的利益群体。

examples.en: No wonder that the migrants are increasingly restive.
examples.zh: 因此外来人员日益感到不安也就不足为奇了。

examples.en: Yet Iran, vast and restive, had a way of revealing itself, even in bad times.
examples.zh: 然而，幅员辽阔且难以驾驭的伊朗，即使在困难时期也有办法展现自己。

examples.en: And the American public is still restive and seeking at least some degree of retribution.
examples.zh: 美国公众仍然焦躁不安，并寻求至少某种程度的报复。

examples.en: He was one of several foreigners abducted by the Abu Sayyaf in the restive region.
examples.zh: 他是在动荡地区被阿布沙耶夫绑架的几名外国人之一。

examples.en: While he was still young and strong all paid obeisance to him.
examples.zh: 他年轻力壮时所有人都对他毕恭毕敬。

examples.en: They made obeisance to the sultan.
examples.zh: 他们向那苏丹鞠躬致敬。

examples.en: How to still do obeisance them now?
examples.zh: 怎么现在还拜他们？

examples.en: What sets Callahan apart from other sector speculators is some obeisance to a classic Benjamin Graham notion of intrinsic value.
examples.zh: 卡拉汉与其他行业投机者的不同之处在于他对经典的本杰明·格雷厄姆内在价值概念的尊重。

examples.en: He would draw it after him, as if in obeisance to some natural law that magic could not violate, and then she would be left with nothing.
examples.zh: 他会把它画在他身后，就好像服从某种魔法无法违反的自然法则一样，然后她就会一无所有。

examples.en: Bolger says he is ready to set aside his differences to save his six-year-old government, and Labor's leader, Helen Clark, is also ready to pay the necessary obeisance.
examples.zh: 博尔格表示，他已准备好搁置分歧，以拯救成立六年的政府，而工党领袖海伦·克拉克也已准备好表达必要的敬意。

words.meaning: n. [经] 重新分配

phrases.zh: [经] 重新分配的关键方面
展现出[经] 重新分配
深刻的[经] 重新分配
[经] 重新分配的本质

examples.en: One of government's primary duties is the redistribution of income, so that the better off can help the worse off out of poverty.
examples.zh: 政府的主要职责之一就是收入的重新分配，这样富裕的人能帮助贫穷的人摆脱贫困。

examples.en: You get a redistribution and mixing of soil as deep roots are ripped up from the ground.
examples.zh: 当深根被从地上拔起时，你会得到土壤的重新分配和混合。

examples.en: Using Bonferroni statistical tests, intervertebral motion redistribution of each construct was compared with the intact.
examples.zh: 使用邦弗朗尼统计学测试，将每个构建体的椎间运动重新分布与完整状态进行比较。

examples.en: "Yes, it's redistribution, but it's redistribution based on energy profligacy and dependence, " says Kaiser.
examples.zh: 凯泽说：“是的，这是再分配，但这是基于能源挥霍和依赖的再分配。”

examples.en: Or perhaps it would lead to the harmless redistribution of rents from firms to employees.
examples.zh: 或者，这可能会导致租金从公司无害地重新分配给雇员。

examples.en: And nearly everyone agrees that the answer to more mobility is education, not income redistribution.
examples.zh: 几乎所有人都同意，增加流动性的答案是教育，而不是收入再分配。
