examples.en: I was under the misapprehension that the course was for complete beginners.
examples.zh: 我误以为这门课是给纯粹的初学者开的。

examples.en: Men still appear to be labouring under the misapprehension that women want hairy, muscular men.
examples.zh: 男人们似乎仍误以为女人喜欢体毛多的肌肉男。

examples.en: His statement cleared away some misapprehension.
examples.zh: 他的声明澄清了一些误解。

examples.en: "I think I was operating under a misapprehension that theater was incredibly cool, " she said.
examples.zh: “我认为我是在一种误解下工作的，认为剧院非常酷，”她说。

examples.en: Cecil gave a snuffy smile as if at some rather basic misapprehension.
examples.zh: 塞西尔露出了一个闷闷不乐的笑容，仿佛是因为某种相当基本的误解。

examples.en: Private equity still has a long way to go, though, until the industry has ceased to be a source of fear and misapprehension.
examples.zh: 不过，在该行业不再成为恐惧和误解的根源之前，私募股权还有很长的路要走。

examples.en: Why don't you chide me for being here still?
examples.zh: 你为什么不责备我还在这里？

examples.en: Who then could chide the gloomy tears you shed?
examples.zh: 谁能呵责你流下忧伤的泪滴。

examples.en: Emilia. do not you chide; I have a thing for you.
examples.zh: 爱米利娅不要骂；我有一件好东西给你。

examples.en: In addition, of course, he is alert to the opportunity thus offered to chide and condemn the UK government.
examples.zh: 此外，他当然也警惕由此提供的斥责和谴责英国政府的机会。

examples.en: The junta complained to the Vatican, but whatever Rome's own misgivings about the cardinal, it declined to chide him.
examples.zh: 军政府向梵蒂冈抱怨，但无论罗马对这位红衣主教有何疑虑，它都拒绝责备他。

examples.en: Their brief tenure at the helm of the interim government reveals little, though observers chide them for allowing some dubious investment schemes to keep going.
examples.zh: 尽管观察家指责他们允许一些可疑的投资计划继续进行，但他们执掌临时政府的短暂任期并没有透露什么信息。

examples.en: It WAS a rare victory for fiscal rectitude.
examples.zh: 这是财政清廉的一个罕见的胜利。

examples.en: On the other hand, the benefits of rectitude can be striking.
examples.zh: 另一方面，品行端正的益处会很显著。

examples.en: They worry that he has strayed from the path of fiscal rectitude.
examples.zh: 他们担心卢拉已经偏离了财政廉洁的轨道。

examples.en: For Mrs Merkel, rules and rectitude would narrow bond spreads and make Eurobonds unnecessary.
examples.zh: 对于默克尔来说，规则和正直将缩小债券利差，并使欧洲债券变得不必要。

examples.en: He also brought with him the Hanseatic business rectitude that he had learnt in Hamburg.
examples.zh: 他还带来了他在汉堡学到的汉萨商业诚信。

examples.en: At that time, Accenture was still part of Andersen, which was still a paragon of rectitude.
examples.zh: 当时，埃森哲仍然是安达信的一部分，而安达信仍然是正直的典范。

examples.en: The owner was so irate he almost threw me out of the place.
examples.zh: 主人那么生气，他差点儿把我从那个地方赶出去。

examples.en: The speech was designed to pacify the irate crowd.
examples.zh: 讲话的目的是安抚愤怒的群众。

examples.en: Customer support calls from VIPs — Very Irate Persons — are down.
examples.zh: 来自VIP(非常生气的人)的客户支持呼叫随之下降。

examples.en: Could an irate (but silent) customer create a similar emotion in those around him?
examples.zh: 愤怒（但沉默）的顾客能否在他周围的人中产生类似的情绪？

examples.en: More likely, irate shoppers will head off to another pharmacy that will take their insurance.
examples.zh: 更有可能的是，愤怒的购物者会前往另一家接受保险的药店。

examples.en: He recounts being berated by an irate scholar in India for reworking Shakespeare beyond recognition.
examples.zh: 他讲述了自己因将莎士比亚作品改得面目全非而受到印度一位愤怒学者的斥责。

examples.en: She lay in bed looking frail.
examples.zh: 她躺在床上，看上去很虚弱。

examples.en: Human nature is frail.
examples.zh: 人性脆弱。

examples.en: My grandmother was becoming more and more sad and frail as the years went by.
examples.zh: 随着岁月的流逝，我的祖母变得越来越伤感和虚弱。

examples.en: The issue is not whether human knowledge is frail, but whether it is disbursed.
examples.zh: 问题不在于人类知识是否脆弱，而在于它是否被分配。

examples.en: He still looks somewhat frail, relying on a cane and using a wheelchair and walker occasionally.
examples.zh: 他看起来仍然有些虚弱，需要拄着拐杖，偶尔使用轮椅和助行器。

examples.en: If she does, she's so frail it can be very dangerous to her health.
examples.zh: 如果她这样做，她会非常虚弱，对她的健康非常危险。

examples.zh: 这部电影充满着明显而陈腐的观点。

examples.en: It sounds trite, but it's true.
examples.zh: 这听起来很老套，是吧？但这可是真理。

examples.en: The mole's reasons for spying for Russia, once they are revealed, seem a little trite.
examples.zh: 内奸为俄罗斯从事间谍活动的理由一旦被揭露，就显得有些陈词滥调了。

examples.en: Beyond this trite warning, there is a clear discipline we can follow to avoid similar pitfalls.
examples.zh: 除了这个陈词滥调的警告之外，我们还可以遵循明确的规则来避免类似的陷阱。

examples.en: This sort of line can be viewed as either trite and tautological, or dangerously blinkered.
examples.zh: 这种说法要么被视为陈词滥调、同义反复，要么被视为危险的狭隘观点。

examples.zh: 新人瑞安·施雷德扮演福尔摩斯。

examples.en: Rookie coach Doug Marrone has no intention of placing limitations on how many times C.
examples.zh: 新秀教练道格·马罗尼无意限制C.

examples.en: Rookie Carlos Munoz of Colombia finished second, Hunter-Reay finished third and Marco Andretti placed fourth.

examples.en: All the evidence needed is an examination of the rookie contracts currently being signed.
examples.zh: 所需的所有证据就是对目前正在签署的新秀合同的检查。

examples.en: She was written off then as a political nonentity.
examples.zh: 作为政坛上的小人物，那时没人拿她当回事。

examples.en: Aged 76, he succumbed to a rare moment of self-pity: "So I am to become a nonentity, am I?"
examples.zh: 当他七十六岁时，他忍不住地自怜起来，“难道我现在就成了这样一个无名之人吗？”

examples.en: Aged 76, he succumbed to a rare moment of self-pity: "So I am to become a nonentity, am I?" Hardly.
examples.zh: 当他七十六岁时，他忍不住地自怜起来，“难道我现在就成了这样一个无名之人吗？不会的。”

examples.en: Mr Leonard also accused the council of overlooking places likes Louth and wasting money funding "nonentity" events as part of the festival.
examples.zh: 伦纳德先生还指责市议会忽视了劳斯这样的地方，并浪费金钱资助节日期间的“无足轻重”的活动。

examples.en: As to actual powers, these are few: compared with finance ministers in other countries, the treasury secretary of the United States is a nonentity.
examples.zh: 就实际权力而言，这些权力很少：与其他国家的财政部长相比，美国财政部长简直是无足轻重。

examples.en: The first crack at forming a coalition will therefore go to an amiable nonentity, Kjell Magne Bondevik, leader of the middle-of-the-road Christian People's Party, which made big gains.
examples.zh: 因此，组建联合政府的第一批人将是一位和蔼可亲的无名小卒谢尔·马格纳·邦德维克（Kjell Magne Bondevik），他是中间道路基督教人民党的领导人，该党取得了巨大的进展。

examples.en: Did Pepsi stonewall and ignore it as we have seen happen with previous online contests?
examples.zh: 百事会像我们已看到的先前网上大赛所发生的事情一样设置障碍忽视掉它了吗？

examples.en: He got the name "Stonewall" at the Battle of Bull Run in the summer of eighteen sixty-one.
examples.zh: 在1861年夏的布尔朗战役中，他获得了“石墙(斯通威尔)”的称号。

examples.en: Just because your bias or your tendency or your experience tells you to sulk and stonewall, you don't have to react that way.
examples.zh: 如果只因为您的偏见或者是您的意向或经验就让您生气或采取抵制行为，那么最好不要那样做。

examples.en: Mr. GARY STONEWALL (Listener): I expect this money to go back into the market and grow.
examples.zh: 加里·斯通沃尔先生（听众）：我希望这笔钱能够回到市场并增长。

examples.en: Gay equality charity Stonewall Scotland is sending postcards to MSPs urging them to support same-sex marriage.
examples.zh: 同性恋平等慈善机构斯通沃尔苏格兰正在向苏格兰议员寄明信片，敦促他们支持同性婚姻。

examples.en: Mr Evans is backing an initiative by charity Stonewall to support gay politicians and Westminster staff.
examples.zh: 埃文斯先生支持慈善机构 Stonewall 发起的一项支持同性恋政客和威斯敏斯特工作人员的倡议。

examples.zh: 军队被调来镇压反叛者。

examples.zh: 朱莉娅不得不克制住自己，不去抚摩他的头发。

examples.en: He forced himself to subdue and overcome his fears.
examples.zh: 他强迫自己克制并战胜他的恐惧。

examples.en: But if you subdue an NPC then successfully hide him, you neither lose nor gain.
examples.zh: 但如果你制服了一个NPC，然后成功隐藏了他，你既不失，也不收获。

examples.en: In 1689, General Mackay led troops loyal to William of Orange to subdue the Scottish Jacobites under Dundee.
examples.zh: 1689年，麦凯将军率领忠于奥兰治威廉的军队征服了邓迪领导下的苏格兰雅各布派。

examples.en: In many ways, it followed the training that flight crews receive in how to subdue unruly or dangerous passengers.
examples.zh: 在许多方面，它遵循了机组人员接受的如何制服不守规矩或危险乘客的培训。

examples.zh: 政客喜欢自以为是地谈论不断下降的标准。

examples.en: Pope Formosus died after a pontificate of four and a half years.
examples.zh: 教皇福尔摩苏斯上任四年半后去世。

examples.en: The central meaning of his pontificate is to restore papal authority.
examples.zh: 他任职教皇的中心意图就是要恢复教皇权力。

examples.en: It will hold conferences around the world to pontificate on various global ills, real or imagined.
examples.zh: 它将在世界各地举行会议，对各种全球弊病（无论是真实的还是想象的）进行武断。

examples.en: For us it's easy to pontificate that the same holds true today with the new Nifty Fifty.
examples.zh: 对我们来说，很容易断言今天的新“漂亮五十”也是如此。

examples.en: Benedict took extraordinary measures to bring the society back under Rome's wing during his pontificate, but negotiations stalled.
examples.zh: 本笃在任期间采取了非常措施，将社会重新置于罗马的庇护之下，但谈判陷入僵局。

examples.zh: 然而，也有两个人并不愿诋毁思斯奇林。

examples.en: "A libel tending to asperse or vilify the house of Commons" (Letters of Junius).
examples.zh: “倾向于诋毁、中伤众议院的诽谤言论”(米尼·厄斯的信件)。

examples.en: And yet he has found a way to think kindly of those who oppress his people and vilify his name.
examples.zh: 但他已找到一种方法，认为这些善意谁压迫他的人民和丑化他的名字。

examples.zh: 但我们在这样做的时候应该小心，不要诽谤这个职业。

examples.zh: 许多保守派人士诽谤参议员在移民、竞选财务、税收和其他问题上与他们决裂。

examples.en: He also believes that it is wrong to use those budget problems to denigrate or vilify public sector employees.
examples.zh: 他还认为，利用这些预算问题来诋毁或诽谤公共部门雇员是错误的。

examples.zh: 有人指责政府想不事声张地开征这种税。

examples.en: Stealth by Accident?
examples.zh: 意外隐形？

examples.zh: 当你再次走开时，它们会变暗，手柄缩回，汽车进入隐形模式。

examples.en: In fact, businesses can guide consumers to sustainability by stealth, rather than by doctrine.
examples.zh: 事实上，企业可以通过偷偷摸摸的方式引导消费者走向可持续发展，而不是通过教条。

examples.en: So a stealth takeover, if that's what Nasdaq intends, will be slow in coming.
examples.zh: 因此，如果纳斯达克有意这样做的话，秘密收购将会缓慢进行。

examples.en: People like Vicky and her friends represent the leading edge, the trailblazers for a huge mass of young, eagerly aspirant consumers.
examples.zh: 像 Vicky 和她的朋友们这样的人代表着社会的前沿，是一大批渴望消费的年轻人的先驱者。

examples.zh: 如果这么说。我会认为你哥哥不是一个上进的人。

examples.en: Mr. Romney is hardly the first Republican presidential aspirant to take that tack against a Democratic incumbent.

words.meaning: n. 刚毛，猪鬃；v. 怒发冲冠，发怒；密集，充满
words.analysis:
【细微含义】名词指刷子上的硬毛；动词本义为毛发竖立（如猫狗受惊），引申为因愤怒而强硬反弹（bristle at/with），或指某地充斥着大量危险/尖锐事物（bristle with）。
【使用场景】文学描写/新闻表达。
【助记方法】毛发像 brush 刷子上的硬毛一样竖立起来。

examples.zh: 当陌生人靠近时，猫的毛倒竖，背部毛发支起。

examples.en: He bristled at the suggestion that he was not qualified for the job.
examples.zh: 听到有人暗示他不胜任这份工作，他感到非常愤怒。

examples.en: The fortress bristled with heavy artillery and guarded towers.
examples.zh: 要塞上林立着重型火炮和警卫塔楼。

examples.zh: 油画家因天然刚毛刷的耐用性而更偏爱它们。

examples.en: The city center bristled with armed police during the high-level summit.

synonyms.note: 充满，大量存在。Abound 强调数量极多或资源丰富；Bristle 常形容某物密集地布满（如困难、武器），有拥挤且具有威慑力的意味。
爆发，破裂。Burst 强调因为充满感情或能量而几乎要爆炸（如 burst with joy）；Bristle 则侧重于密密麻麻地竖立或显现。

confusables.note: 拼写相近；意为“脆的；易断裂的；缺乏韧性的”

examples.en: His mordant wit appealed to students.
examples.zh: 他那尖刻的妙语受到学生的欢迎。

examples.en: Actors feared the critic's mordant pen.
examples.zh: 演员都惧怕这位批评家辛辣尖刻的笔调。

examples.en: Cannot use wet mop or mordant liquid (like suds, benzine) wipe a floor.
examples.zh: 不能用湿拖把或有腐蚀性的液体(如肥皂水、汽油)擦拭地板。

examples.en: Mordant advertisements that he designed and a film in which he appeared are on view.
examples.zh: 他设计的尖刻广告和他出演的电影正在展出。

examples.en: Some insiders call Raikes' division the dead cash cow, a mordant joke for a guy who grew up around cattle.
examples.zh: 一些内部人士称雷克斯的部门为“死去的摇钱树”，对于一个在牛身边长大的人来说，这是一个尖刻的笑话。

examples.en: We desperately need topical humorists with sharp eyes and sharp wits: Jon Stewart at his mordant best fills the bill.
examples.zh: 我们迫切需要目光敏锐、机智敏锐的话题幽默家：乔恩·斯图尔特（Jon Stewart）最能满足这一要求。

examples.en: Their pay was late because of a computer bungle.
examples.zh: 由于计算机出错，他们的工资晚发了。

examples.en: Don't let him mend your bike. He's sure to bungle the job.
examples.zh: 别让他修理你的自行车。他肯定会弄得一团糟的。

examples.en: I've got to exert myself more for I don't want to make a bungle of this book.
examples.zh: 我必须更加努力，因为我可不想把这本书写砸。

examples.en: Commissioner, already gives the IRS some leeway to grant taxpayers relief when banks or brokers bungle.
examples.zh: 专员已经给国税局一些余地，以便在银行或经纪人搞砸时给予纳税人救济。

examples.en: And there is a non-trivial chance that the Washington will bungle the hot-button debt limit negotiations.
examples.zh: 华盛顿很有可能搞砸棘手的债务上限谈判。

examples.en: Or did the police bungle what should have been a relatively straightforward case?
examples.zh: 还是警方搞砸了这起本来应该相对简单的案件？

examples.en: He stopped to quench his thirst at a stream.
examples.zh: 他停在一条小溪边喝水解渴。

examples.en: Water from a rain puddle or a mountain stream would quench his thirst and cool his hot dry throat.
examples.zh: 雨水坑或山涧里的水可以解渴，清凉他干热的喉咙。

examples.en: Firemen tried to quench the flames raging through the building.
examples.zh: 消防队员奋力扑救大楼中熊熊的火焰。

examples.en: First Quench has 1, 300 stores in total in the UK, with 6, 500 employees.
examples.zh: First Quench 在英国共有 1, 300 家门店，拥有 6, 500 名员工。

examples.en: Aramco can quench its gargantuan thirst for development: It's easily the most profitable company on the planet.
examples.zh: 沙特阿美可以满足其对发展的巨大渴望：它很容易成为地球上最赚钱的公司。

examples.en: One effect of the intense magnetic field would be to quench radio pulses.
examples.zh: 强磁场的影响之一是抑制无线电脉冲。

etymology.memory: 先记核心义“（喝水）止（渴）；满足（欲望）；扑灭，熄灭（火）；抑制，压制（感情）；（尤指用冷水或油）将……淬火，使冷却；控制（发光、震动或放电等效果）；n. 淬火”，再结合高频搭配与经典例句巩固词形。

words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】核心含义为“（喝水）止（渴）；满足（欲望）；扑灭，熄灭（火）；抑制，压制（感情）；（尤指用冷水或油）将……淬火，使冷却；控制（发光、震动或放电等效果）；n. 淬火”。作动词使用时，强调动作的施加、状态的转变或某种特定倾向的引发。 常用搭配如 “quench oil”（淬火油）、“water quench”（水淬（热处理））。
【专业领域特殊含义】在物理学与工程学中，用于精确描述物体的物理特性、波动规律或能量转换过程。

examples.en: As he stood on the winner's rostrum, he sang the words of the national anthem.
examples.zh: 当他站在领奖台上，他唱起了国歌中的词句。

examples.en: His eyes ranged over the audience before he mounted the rostrum.
examples.zh: 在登上讲台之前他用目光向观众扫视了一下。

examples.en: Keep your body language up-beat - don't stay stuck behind a rostrum.
examples.zh: 使您的身体语言充满自信——别僵在讲台后面。

examples.en: Seven years have passed since I first stood before you at this rostrum.
examples.zh: 自从我第一次站在这个讲台上，已经过去七年了。

examples.en: But, ultimately, the former is a group of your friends telling people that a game they have not seen either will be awesome, and the other is often a series of rostrum camera shots of concept art and non-interactive 3D renders.
examples.zh: 但归根结底，前者是一群朋友告诉人们，他们都没有看过的游戏将会很棒，而另一个通常是概念艺术和非交互式 3D 渲染的一系列讲台摄像机镜头。

examples.en: Others decry what they see as outside forces running roughshod over the old Harlem.
examples.zh: 另一些人则谴责他们所看到的外部势力对哈莱姆旧城区横行霸道。

examples.en: He is impatient with those who decry the plan.
examples.zh: 他无法忍受那些批评这项计划的人。

examples.en: But I'm not here to decry the evils of touchscreen typing.
examples.zh: 当然我这么说绝对不是为了念叨触摸屏输入的种种不是。

examples.en: They regularly decry the tendency of poor Filipinos to vote for scoundrels based on name recognition.
examples.zh: 他们经常谴责贫穷的菲律宾人根据知名度投票给恶棍的倾向。

examples.en: The authors rightly decry the degree to which scientists have sometimes manufactured and exaggerated environmental uncertainties.
examples.zh: 作者正确地谴责了科学家有时制造和夸大环境不确定性的程度。

examples.en: It is fashionable to decry the regard that politicians pay these days to opinion polls.
examples.zh: 如今，谴责政客们对民意调查的重视已成为一种时尚。

examples.en: She denies obtaining a pecuniary advantage by deception.
examples.zh: 她否认通过欺骗获得了金钱方面的好处。

examples.en: Positive pecuniary externalities create incentives.
examples.zh: 正面的经济外部性会产生激励。

examples.en: But they said that pecuniary considerations played no part in their scholarship.
examples.zh: 但他们说，金钱的考虑不会在学术上起什么作用。

examples.en: Either that or they value teaching and affiliation with the college more so than strictly pecuniary benefits.
examples.zh: 或者说，他们更看重教学和与大学的联系，而不是严格的金钱利益。

examples.en: And so, here we sit, with the physical ability to provide for ourselves but lacking the pecuniary wherewithal.
examples.zh: 因此，我们坐在这里，有能力养活自己，但缺乏金钱。

examples.en: The council's monitoring officer then investigated "certain irregularities relating to declarations of pecuniary interest", a council spokesperson said.
examples.zh: 委员会发言人表示，该委员会的监察官员随后调查了“与金钱利益申报有关的某些违规行为”。

examples.en: He was a daredevil when young.
examples.zh: 他年青的时候也是个不怕死的人。

examples.en: The show's full of daredevil feats.
examples.zh: 这场表演充满着惊险的特技。

examples.en: A new circus is in town, with Siberian white tigers and daredevil bikers.
examples.zh: 镇里来了一个新的马戏团，有西伯利亚白老虎和不怕死的自行车表演客。

examples.en: She is a good reporter and must be a daredevil to do what she has.
examples.zh: 她是一名优秀的记者，一定是一个敢于做她所做的事情的人。

examples.en: "He could sit back and dream up daredevil schemes that other men would hazard, " writes Anwar.
examples.zh: 安瓦尔写道：“他可以坐下来想象其他人会冒险的大胆计划。”

examples.en: The book is an excellent vignette of some of the major debates in science.
examples.zh: 这本书非常清晰且扼要地介绍了科学界的一些主要争议。

examples.en: Vignette: Rejuvenating Their Enterprise CMS Brand
examples.zh: Vignette：重塑企业内容管理品牌

examples.en: If so, maybe you bought stock in Vignette when they did their IPO in February 1999.
examples.zh: 如果你记得，可能你还在1999年Vignette公司首次公开上市的时候买过他们的股票。

examples.en: But many times companies switch off of older services like Vignette to Drupal, Erickson says.
examples.zh: 但埃里克森表示，很多时候公司会关闭 Vignette 等旧服务，转而使用 Drupal。

examples.en: Take the guy in the vignette, above, who was terrified of addressing his company.
examples.zh: 以上面小插图中的那个人为例，他害怕向他的公司讲话。

examples.en: This time Vignette got it right and orders began flowing in for the product, called StoryServer.
examples.zh: 这次，Vignette 做对了，这款名为 StoryServer 的产品的订单开始源源不断地涌来。

examples.en: Fast-food firms have to be a thick-skinned bunch.
examples.zh: 快餐公司必须由一群厚脸皮的人经营。

examples.en: He was thick-skinned enough to cope with her taunts.
examples.zh: 他脸皮厚，不怕她嘲弄。

examples.en: He is thick-skinned and annoying.
examples.zh: 他脸皮厚又惹人讨厌。

examples.en: The conventional wisdom holds that politicians must be packaged as feeling family types, rather than thick-skinned, sharp-elbowed machines dedicated to self-advancement.
examples.zh: 传统观点认为，政客必须被包装成有感情的家庭类型，而不是厚脸皮、强硬的、致力于自我提升的机器。

examples.en: You come to see that the women attracted to finance are categorically smart, thick-skinned people, many of whom are used to being academically or professionally successful.
examples.zh: 你会发现，被金融所吸引的女性绝对是聪明、脸皮厚的人，其中许多人习惯于在学术或职业上取得成功。

examples.en: Are Americans more thick-skinned than Brits?
examples.zh: 美国人脸皮比英国人厚吗？

examples.en: The buoy floated back and forth in the water.
examples.zh: 浮标在水里漂来漂去。

examples.en: We tried to throw a life buoy. She could not grab it.
examples.zh: 我们试着扔救生圈给她，但是她抓不住。

examples.en: Electrical equipment monitors the power the buoy generates.
examples.zh: 电子设备监测浮标的发电情况。

examples.en: This lightness began to buoy me and urge me, unfettered, along the highways of southwestern France.
examples.zh: 这种轻松感开始鼓舞我，催促我不受束缚地沿着法国西南部的高速公路行驶。

examples.en: If the boat is stopped, the crew cuts loose the shipment, which sinks, buoy and all.
examples.zh: 如果船停下来，船员们就会把货物解开，然后货物就会沉没，包括浮标在内。

examples.en: If Hun Sen wants to buoy Cambodia, he should hope Rainsy finds Phnom Penh comfortable.
examples.zh: 如果洪森想要振兴柬埔寨，他应该希望兰西让金边感到舒适。

examples.en: The two men loathe each other.
examples.zh: 这两个男人相互厌恶。

examples.en: They loathe each other.
examples.zh: 他们相互讨厌。

examples.en: I loathe modern art.
examples.zh: 我很不喜欢现代艺术。

examples.en: The crowds are convivial and loathe to leave as the clock ticks toward last call.
examples.zh: 时间一分一秒地过去，人群一片欢腾，不愿离开。

examples.en: Many Tories loathe Brussels, hate Coalition, distrust their leader and are terrified of UKIP.
examples.zh: 许多保守党厌恶布鲁塞尔，憎恨联盟党，不信任他们的领导人，并且害怕英国独立党。

examples.en: Love it or loathe it, it breaks new ground for this 50 year old retailer.
examples.zh: 不管你喜欢还是讨厌，它为这家拥有 50 年历史的零售商开辟了新天地。

examples.en: The truth is something you blurt out. That takes strength, for sure.
examples.zh: “实话实说”应该是一瞬间的，你所说的那个实话应该是你脱口而出的，这当然很难，需要内心足够强大。

examples.en: If you can blurt out 500 sentences, you can be a successful international businessman.
examples.zh: 脱口而出500句英语，你可以成为成功的国际商人。

examples.en: You know those situations where everyone knows something yet no one is courageous enough to just blurt out the obvious?
examples.zh: 你知道这样的情况吗：每个人都知道一些事情，但没有人有足够的勇气脱口而出显而易见的事情？

examples.en: Whenever my parents call me for a pick, I think about it for five seconds, no more, and blurt one out.
examples.zh: 每当我的父母叫我挑选时，我都会思考五秒钟，然后脱口而出。

examples.en: More often they just stare intently or blurt insults at the screens.
examples.zh: 更多时候，他们只是全神贯注地盯着屏幕，或者脱口而出侮辱性的言论。

phrases.zh: 可怕的；以死亡为主题的；令人毛骨悚然的（等于 macaber）的关键方面

examples.en: Italian artist Bolla has transformed them into something a bit more sinister—macabre tokens of death that include an AK-47 assault rifle and human remains.
examples.zh: 意大利艺术家波拉将它们变成了一种更加凶险的东西——令人毛骨悚然的死亡象征，其中包括一把 AK-47 突击步枪和一些人类遗骸。

examples.en: Most objects are violent, raw, macabre, and deliberately so.
examples.zh: 大多数展品看上去粗暴，原始而又骇人，而且是刻意为之的。

examples.en: But before macabre meant macabre why call the dance of death macabre?
examples.zh: 那macabre怎么又跟死亡之舞扯上了？

examples.en: His aesthetic is that of darkness and beauty, mixing two such polar elements with macabre elegance.
examples.zh: 他的审美观是黑暗与美丽，将两种极端的元素与令人毛骨悚然的优雅融为一体。

examples.en: While the macabre aspect of his scheme offends many, it did not make Caramadre squeamish.
examples.zh: 虽然他的计划的可怕之处冒犯了许多人，但这并没有让卡拉马德感到不安。

examples.en: Although mortality was a topic of discussion, the dinner party was far from macabre.
examples.zh: 尽管死亡是讨论的话题，但晚宴远非令人毛骨悚然。

words.meaning: adj. 刺眼的，显眼的；打扰的，冒失的，逼人的
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】指某物或某人的行为过于突出、显眼或唐突，给人带来不适、打扰或厌烦感（如 obtrusive ads 烦人的广告, obtrusive behavior 冒失的行为）。
【词源与逻辑】源自拉丁语 obtrudere（强行插入、推入），ob-（对着/强行）+ trudere（推）→ 强行推到人眼前 → 突兀的、令人不爽地显眼的。
【助记方法】ob（强行）+ trus（推，同 thrust）+ ive → 强行推出来给人看 → 刺眼的、打扰人的。

examples.en: Pop-up banners that block main article text are considered highly obtrusive by web users.
examples.zh: 遮挡主要文章文本的弹窗横幅被网络用户视为极度烦人的侵入式设计。

examples.en: The security guards maintained a discreet watch without being obtrusive to guests.
examples.zh: 安保人员保持低调警惕，没有给客人带来唐突或打扰的感觉。

examples.en: The large neon sign felt loud and obtrusive in the quiet historical district.
examples.zh: 巨大的霓虹灯招牌在这片宁静的历史街区里显得张扬而刺眼。

examples.en: Good UI design seamlessly assists the user without intrusive or obtrusive popups.
examples.zh: 良好的 UI 设计顺畅地辅助用户，不会弹出侵扰或打扰人的弹窗。

examples.en: He apologized if his questions seemed overly personal or obtrusive.
examples.zh: 如果他的提问显得过于私密或唐突，他表示了歉意。

examples.en: Architects used subtle natural stone colors to keep the modern building from looking obtrusive in the landscape.
examples.zh: 建筑师采用微妙的天然石材色彩，以防现代建筑在自然景观中显得过于突兀。

synonyms.note: 解析：显而易见的。区别：obtrusive 带有贬义，指显眼得令人不悦、强加于人的；noticeable 是中性词，仅表示容易被注意到。

confusables.note: 拼写相近；意为“不唐突的，不引人注目的，谦虚的”

phrases.zh: 侵入式/烦人的弹窗广告
唐突/冒失的行为
高度打扰的/非常刺眼的
视觉上突兀刺眼的

cognates.meaning: 不唐突的，不引人注目的，谦虚的

etymology.memory: 把 obtrusive → unobtrusive 串成词族记忆，比较词性和后缀变化。

examples.en: His intent is clearly not to placate his critics.
examples.zh: 他的目的显然不是要安抚批评他的人。

examples.en: He smiled, and made a gesture intended to placate me.
examples.zh: 他微笑了一下，做了一个意在安抚我的手势。

examples.en: The concessions did little to placate the students.
examples.zh: 让步根本未能平息学生的愤怒。

examples.en: And he needed to figure out how to split up Motorola to placate shareholders like Carl Icahn.
examples.zh: 他还需要弄清楚如何拆分摩托罗拉，以安抚像卡尔·伊坎这样的股东。

examples.en: The British government decided that the best way to do this was to placate the Afrikaners.
examples.zh: 英国政府认为，最好的办法就是安抚南非荷兰语人。

examples.en: Obama's Republican adversaries were quick to accuse him of selling out allies to placate Russia.
examples.zh: 奥巴马的共和党对手很快指责他出卖盟友来安抚俄罗斯。

examples.zh: 我的祖父总是把手表放在口袋里，这是他的一种怪习性。

examples.en: I shall never attempt to palliate my own foible by expose the error of another.
examples.zh: 我从不想暴露别人的错误，以图减轻自己的缺点。

examples.en: Second, and more important, it will make those who are inclined to shirk their responsibilities think twice.
examples.zh: 其次，更重要的是，这会让那些倾向于逃避责任的人三思而后行。

examples.zh: 一个决计要下手的窃贼会不惜破窗而入。

examples.en: The government will not shirk from considering the need for further action.
examples.zh: 政府将不会回避考虑进一步行动的需要。

examples.en: Not having many physical assets makes it easy for these companies to shirk responsibility.
examples.zh: 由于没有太多的实物资产，这些公司很容易逃避责任。

examples.en: The story underscores a societal reality: People will go to great lengths to shirk jury duty.
examples.zh: 这个故事强调了一个社会现实：人们会不遗余力地逃避陪审团的职责。

examples.en: With Ben by her side, Shirk regained a sense of optimism and control over her life.

examples.en: Credulous people are easily misled by false advertisements.
examples.zh: 轻信的人很容易上虚假广告的当。

examples.en: He has suffered several times because he is credulous.
examples.zh: 他太轻信，吃了好几次苦头。

examples.en: The manager of the bank was credulous individual named Mr. Fish.
examples.zh: 银行经理称“鱼先生，”是个轻信的人。

examples.en: It makes the spirtual wary of the sciences but overly credulous of non-scientific therapies.
examples.zh: 它使人们对科学保持精神警惕，但对非科学疗法过于轻信。

examples.en: The main problem, however, was an entrenched practice of credulous diplomacy, says Mr. Heinonen.
examples.zh: 然而，海诺宁表示，主要问题是轻信外交的根深蒂固的做法。

examples.en: And so, early last week, Haaretz editor Dov Alfon approached credulous foreign journalists and spun a tale.
examples.zh: 因此，上周初，《国土报》编辑多夫·阿方（Dov Alfon）接近轻信的外国记者，编造了一个故事。

examples.en: He was averse to any change.
examples.zh: 他反对任何改变。

examples.zh: 他不反对宣传，只要是正当的。

examples.zh: 我向凯特提起这个想法，她不反对。

examples.en: Conversely, during market crashes (and huge losses), the traders became apathetic and excessively risk-averse.
examples.zh: 相反，在市场崩溃（和巨大损失）期间，交易者变得冷漠且过度规避风险。

examples.en: The U.S. investor remains risk averse, with heavy flows into low yielding U.S. debt.
examples.zh: 美国投资者仍然厌恶风险，大量资金流入低收益美国债务。

examples.en: Security teams must remain vigilant against potential phishing attacks.
examples.zh: 安全团队必须对潜在的钓鱼攻击保持高度警惕。

examples.en: The mother kept a vigilant eye on her young child playing near the water.
examples.zh: 母亲用警惕的目光注视着在水边玩耍的幼儿。

examples.en: Health authorities urged the public to stay vigilant as the flu season approached.
examples.zh: 随着流感季临近，卫生部门敦促公众保持警惕。

examples.en: The company's success relies on being ever vigilant of shifting market trends.
examples.zh: 该公司的成功依赖于时刻对不断变化的市场趋势保持警觉。

examples.en: Vigilant guards patrolled the perimeter of the military facility round the clock.
examples.zh: 警觉的卫兵昼夜不停地在军事设施外围巡逻。

synonyms.note: 警惕的。Argus-eyed 含有极其敏锐、能洞察一切的意味（源于神话百眼巨人）；Vigilant 则侧重于保持警觉，防范危险。
留神的; 警觉的; 公开的; 坦率的。Open-eyed 更强调眼睛睁大，显得好奇、惊讶或警觉的状态；Vigilant 强调主动防备危险的警惕性。
觉醒的, 警觉的, 戒备的, 不能入睡的, 失眠的, 不眠的。Wakeful 强调不眠、清醒的状态，有时指失眠；Vigilant 则强调为了防范而故意保持警觉的心理状态。

etymology.rootMeaning: adj. 警觉的, 警戒的, 警惕的；警醒的, 警戒的, 注意的

words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】褒义/中性形容词。指警觉严密、时刻注意危险或潜在威胁。常用于网络安全、医疗监护、边防巡逻及公共安全语境中（如 remain vigilant）。
【词源与助记】源自拉丁语 vigil（警惕、守夜）。衍生词：vigilance（名词，警惕）、vigilante（维安队员/私刑者）。
【IT/AI/网络安全含义】在网络安全领域，系统管理员和自动化检测软件必须保持 vigilant 以拦截实时网络攻击。

words.meaning: adj. 永久的，持久的，不灭的；遵循的
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】指某种感情、信仰、兴趣或影响历经岁月洗礼而“持久不变、长存不衰”（an abiding love / abiding interest / law-abiding）。带有明显的赞许或深沉情感，多用于文学作品、人物传记和正式表达中。
【历史典故/词源】由动词 abide（停留，忍受，遵守）的现在分词转化而来。abide 源自古英语 abidan（停留，等待），由 a-（持续）+ bidan（等待）构成。
【专业领域特殊含义】在法学中，law-abiding citizen 指“守法公民”；在心理学中，abiding effect 指“心理创伤或印刻效应的持久影响”。
【助记方法】abide（停留/坚持）+ ing（形容词后缀）→ 能长久停留驻足的 → 持久的，长存的。

phrases.zh: 永恒的爱，长久的爱
持久的兴趣
守法的
坚定不移的信念

examples.en: She has an abiding affection for the small coastal town where she grew up.
examples.zh: 她对从小长大的海滨小镇怀有持久而深厚的感情。

examples.en: His abiding commitment to human rights inspired generations of activists.
examples.zh: 他对人道事业坚定不移的承诺激励了一代又一代倡导者。

examples.en: Law-abiding citizens deserve to feel safe in their own neighborhoods.
examples.zh: 守法公民理应在自己的社区里感到安全。

examples.en: The experience left an abiding impression on his young mind.
examples.zh: 那次经历在他年轻的心灵深处留下了永不磨灭的印象。

examples.en: Despite many hardships, their friendship remained an abiding source of strength.
examples.zh: 尽管历经艰难，他们的友谊依然是力量的持久源泉。

synonyms.note: 持久的，不朽的。区别：enduring 侧重经受住考验或磨难后依然存在；abiding 侧重感情或信念的深沉长存。
永恒的。区别：everlasting 强调时间上的无休无止；abiding 强调内在持久稳定性。

words.meaning: adj. 丰富的，大量的，充沛的
words.analysis:
【细微含义与感情色彩】中性偏褒义，形容数量非常庞大或供应极度充足（如大量的笔记、丰富的降水、充沛的泪水）。
【使用场景】书面语、学术写作、描述性散文。
【助记方法】源自拉丁语 copia（丰富、大量；Cornucopia 丰饶之角）+ -ous（形容词后缀）→ 极多的、大量的。

examples.en: She took copious notes throughout the three-hour lecture on molecular biology.
examples.zh: 在长达三个小时的分子生物学讲座中，她记下了大量的笔记。

examples.en: The region benefits from copious rainfall, making it ideal for agricultural development.
examples.zh: 该地区受益于充沛的降雨，非常适合农业发展。

examples.en: Historians have gathered copious evidence supporting the ancient trade route theory.
examples.zh: 历史学家收集了大量证据，支持古代贸易路线的学说。

examples.en: The project documentation contained copious details on system architecture and APIs.
examples.zh: 项目文档包含了关于系统架构和 API 的海量详细信息。

examples.en: After working under the blazing sun, he drank copious amounts of water.
examples.zh: 在烈日下劳作之后，他喝了大量的水。

synonyms.note: adj. 庞大的，卷帙浩繁的。Copious 侧重于数量上的丰富或充足，常修饰笔记、信息等；Voluminous 侧重于体积庞大、衣服宽大或著作篇幅极长。

examples.en: If the past is prologue, then it ought to be possible to draw some modest conclusions about the future from the wealth of data about America's present.
examples.zh: 如果过去是一个序幕，那么应该有可能从有关美国现状的大量数据中得出一些关于未来的适度的结论。

examples.en: The prologue to the novel is written in the form of a newspaper account.
examples.zh: 该小说的前言是以新闻报道的形式写的。

examples.en: The historical prologue, thirdly, explains why Israel accepts her place in the suzerain-vassal relationship.
examples.zh: 第三点，这个历史旁白解释了为什么犹太人接受了他们在领主与奴隶关系里的地位。

examples.en: The prologue, set in 1967, tells of their first meeting as teenagers in a hospital ward.
examples.zh: 序言以 1967 年为背景，讲述了他们青少年时期在医院病房的第一次见面。

examples.en: Though past is not prologue, learning from past mistakes can make a considerable difference.
examples.zh: 尽管过去不是序幕，但从过去的错误中吸取教训可以带来很大的改变。

examples.en: In the prologue of John's book, he tells the story about the kids holding the house down.
examples.zh: 在约翰的书的序言中，他讲述了孩子们压垮房子的故事。

words.meaning: n. 安慰，抚慰；心灵寄托；vt. 安慰，抚慰
words.analysis: 【细微含义与使用场景】指在痛苦、悲伤、孤独时获得的心理抚慰或情绪支撑（find solace in sth）。文学色彩浓厚，感情色彩温暖而庄重。比 comfort 更强调深层心灵上的解脱与平复。【助记】源自拉丁语 solari（安慰），与 console（安慰）、solitude（孤独）同源 → 在孤独绝望中给予安慰。

examples.en: After the tragic loss of her father, she found solace in writing poetry and painting.
examples.zh: 在遭遇痛失父亲的悲剧后，她在诗歌创作和绘画中找到了心灵寄托。

examples.en: The quiet beauty of the mountain forest offered solace to the weary traveler.
examples.zh: 山林的幽静之美给疲惫的旅人带来了心灵的抚慰。

examples.en: Friends gathered around the grieving widow, attempting to offer whatever solace they could.
examples.zh: 朋友们聚在悲伤的寡妇身边，尽己所能为她提供抚慰。

examples.en: Throughout centuries of hardship, music remained a constant source of solace for the people.
examples.zh: 在几个世纪的苦难中，音乐始终是人们永恒的心灵抚慰源泉。

examples.en: He solaced his lonely evenings with classic literature and warm tea.
examples.zh: 他用经典文学与热茶抚慰着自己孤独的夜晚。

synonyms.note: 【解析】安慰，慰藉。【区别】solace 较正式且具文学色彩，指在深切的悲伤或苦难中得到的安慰或减轻痛苦的事物；consolation 较常用，指因失去某物而获得的安慰。
【解析】安慰。【区别】solace 为常用词形式；solacement 较为生僻，是 solace 的名词衍生形式，含义相同。
【解析】舒适，安慰。【区别】solace 侧重于心理上的慰藉和痛苦的减轻；comfort 为常用词，指身体上的舒适，或因同情而给予的精神安慰。
【解析】缓和，抚慰。【区别】solace 多作名词指安慰；soothe 作动词，侧重指通过温柔的行为使疼痛减轻，或使激动的情绪平息。

adv. 马虎地，缓慢地
vt. 放松，使缓慢
vi. 松懈，减弱，松弛”

examples.en: The transition from libertine to prig was so complete.
examples.zh: 从自由不羁到一本正经，这样的转变实在是太彻底了。

examples.en: I lost Ruth and gained an undeserved reputation as a potential libertine.
examples.zh: 我失去了露丝，却冤枉地担上了准浪子的名声。

examples.en: One king was a fornicating libertine, another captivated by a strange animal, while one of the queens was obsessed by her wish for a child.
examples.zh: 一位国王是与人私通的浪荡子，另一位国王被一种奇怪的动物所迷惑，还有一位王后迫切地想要个孩子。

examples.en: Though not as libertine as Dubai, Qatar is a bastion of civil liberties--women can drive, alcohol is not illegal--compared with neighboring Saudi Arabia.
examples.zh: 尽管不像迪拜那么自由，但与邻国沙特阿拉伯相比，卡塔尔是公民自由的堡垒——女性可以开车，酗酒并不违法。

examples.en: In the bat world, it seems that you do not have to be cleverer to be a libertine than to be a faithful husband.
examples.zh: 在蝙蝠的世界里，做一个浪荡子似乎并不比做一个忠诚的丈夫更聪明。

examples.en: Building on the success of Pizzology, a popular pizzeria and pub in Carmel, a suburb of Indianapolis, chef and restaurateur Neal Brown opened the Libertine just in time for the Super Bowl extravaganza.
examples.zh: 印第安纳波利斯郊区卡梅尔的一家颇受欢迎的披萨店兼酒吧 Pizzology 取得了成功，在此基础上，主厨兼餐厅老板尼尔·布朗 (Neal Brown) 在超级碗盛宴期间开设了 Libertine 餐厅。

examples.zh: 即使最挑剔的食客也能在这儿找到开胃美食。

examples.en: Customers are finicky.
examples.zh: 客户是挑剔的。

examples.en: Long dependent on finicky foreign capital to stimulate growth, emerging markets have often collapsed when capital left.
examples.zh: 新兴市场长期依赖挑剔的外国资本来刺激增长，当资本离开时，新兴市场往往会崩溃。

examples.en: Compulsively neat and obsessed with details, Grove was an outstanding choice for the finicky semiconductor business.
examples.zh: 格鲁夫有着强烈的整洁意识和对细节的痴迷，对于挑剔的半导体行业来说是一个出色的选择。

examples.en: The downside is a finicky touchpad -- HP's machine is clearly superior in that regard.
examples.zh: 缺点是触摸板很挑剔——惠普的机器在这方面显然更胜一筹。

examples.en: Mr. Smith , a true gentlemen, is always beneficent to poor.
examples.zh: 史密斯先生，一个真正的绅士，总是对穷人行善。

examples.en: Unfortunately history offers no guarantee that a more humane and beneficent style of life inevitably prevails.
examples.zh: 可惜历史并没有保证那更人道、更慈善的生活方式必然获胜。

examples.en: Unfortunately, history offers no guarantee that a more humane and beneficent style of life inevitably prevails.
examples.zh: 可惜历史并没有保证那更人道，更慈善的生活方式必须获胜。

examples.zh: 任何有思想的人都会认识到它对我们的机构和人民的有益影响。

examples.zh: 即使是生物专业的大学生都可能会反对动物实验。

examples.zh: 为了全人类的解放，即使牺牲生命也在所不惜。

examples.en: A few will balk.
examples.zh: 有一些会犹豫。

examples.en: Would you balk at funding a program that spends 23% of its budget to raise money?
examples.zh: 对于一个花费 23% 预算来筹集资金的项目，您是否会犹豫不决？

examples.zh: 他们可能不会对作业本身犹豫不决，但可能会对方法提出质疑。

examples.en: While an actual alliance with OPEC seems far-fetched, concerns already run high in the U. S. and Europe that Moscow is trying to increase its chokehold over Europe's energy needs.
examples.zh: 虽然同欧佩克达成正式协议远非一蹴而就之事，可美国和欧洲已十分担忧莫斯科会在能源需求问题上进一步向欧洲施压。

examples.en: Rousey, who had never been so seriously threatened in a bout, barely escaped the chokehold.
examples.zh: 鲁西从未在比赛中受到如此严重的威胁，勉强逃脱了窒息。

examples.en: There is also what project head Nandan Nilekani calls the chokehold of the "cycle of documentation" on people.
examples.zh: 还有项目负责人 Nandan Nilekani 所说的“文档循环”对人们的束缚。

examples.en: That gives Tajikistan a much-needed road route to the Pakistani port of Karachi, free of its ex-Soviet neighbours' chokehold.
examples.zh: 这为塔吉克斯坦提供了一条通往巴基斯坦卡拉奇港急需的公路路线，摆脱了前苏联邻国的封锁。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of chokehold.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“掐脖子”的概念提供了全新的视角。

examples.en: Recent academic studies have highlighted the significance of chokehold in modern research.
examples.zh: 最近的学术研究强调了“掐脖子”在现代科学研究中的重要意义。

examples.en: Hamilton's other proposals, including protection tariffs for nascent American industry, were defeated.
examples.zh: 汉密尔顿的其他建议，包括对新生的美国工业征收保护关税，都被否决了。

examples.en: Another nascent technology takes a different approach.
examples.zh: 另一种新生技术另辟蹊径。

examples.en: But finding nascent massive stars has proven difficult.
examples.zh: 但找到新生的巨型恒星很不容易。

examples.en: Despite these developments, Papua New Guinea retains an aura of uncharted territory, with a decidedly nascent tourism infrastructure.
examples.zh: 尽管取得了这些发展，巴布亚新几内亚仍然保留着未知领域的光环，其旅游基础设施显然处于新生状态。

examples.en: But our team is not only concerned with the nascent genetic side of anthropology.
examples.zh: 但我们的团队不仅关注人类学新生的遗传学方面。

examples.en: Of course oil prices could always slump, puncturing the nascent domestic oil and gas boom.
examples.zh: 当然，石油价格随时可能暴跌，从而破坏刚刚兴起的国内石油和天然气繁荣。

examples.zh: 他们会妨碍我，打搅我。

examples.zh: 你不该让这些沉重的书阻碍你学习。

examples.zh: 这些交易的净效应是用留置权和抵押贷款来限制财产。

examples.en: With regard to the latter, the bill actually would encumber highly enriched uranium production as well as plutonium.

examples.zh: 货币以金、银和铜计价，但您的所有货币始终可用且不会妨碍您。

examples.zh: 并不热心的试图写一部小说。

examples.en: Such apologies as they make are deemed halfhearted and insincere.
examples.zh: 他们为此作出的辩护，被看作心不在焉而且毫无诚意。

examples.zh: “嗨，迈克。”我喊着，向他挥手。我不能在这样一个早晨表现得毫无兴致。

examples.zh: 不止一家拉斯维加斯大道餐厅半心半意地尝试重现复古的用餐体验。

examples.en: The political platforms of the center-left parties are halfhearted and almost entirely domestic in their focus.
examples.zh: 中左翼政党的政治纲领是半心半意的，几乎完全关注国内事务。

examples.en: "You could see the halfhearted attempt to hold the stock at 38 this morning during premarket trading, " Mr. Shea said.

examples.en: Let's not protract the debate any further.
examples.zh: 我们不要再继续争论下去了。

examples.en: Their guest did not protract his stay that evening above an hour longer.
examples.zh: 那天晚上他们的客人逗留不到一个钟头。

examples.en: Using this method, we can protract vector analysis atlas of planetary gear drive mechanism.
examples.zh: 应用此方法，可定性地绘制出行星齿轮传动机构速度分析图谱。

examples.en: The alternative is to protract the collective suffering with short-term deficit reductions that only guarantee bigger deficits in the future.
examples.zh: 另一种选择是通过短期赤字削减来延长集体痛苦，但这只会导致未来出现更大的赤字。

examples.en: There is good news, then, for those who enjoy parliamentary pyrotechnics: Mr Willetts's plan seems destined to protract the debate over university funding rather than resolve it.
examples.zh: 那么，对于那些喜欢议会烟火的人来说，有一个好消息：威利茨先生的计划似乎注定会延长而不是解决有关大学经费的争论。

examples.en: Remember, ultimately, the United States fights short wars brilliantly and long wars poorly, and the enemy knows that, and therefore, his object here is to use the suicide bomber to protract the campaign, affect the will of the Iraqi people and preserve his force in being.
examples.zh: 请记住，归根结底，美国在短期战争中表现出色，在长期战争中表现不佳，而敌人也知道这一点，因此，他的目标是利用自杀式炸弹袭击者来拖延战事，影响伊拉克人民的意志并保存其力量。

words.meaning: adj. 无色的；非彩色的（黑白灰）；消色差的（光学）
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】在物理学与光学中指“消色差的”（achromatic lens，指光线通过时不产生色散晕圈）；在艺术、设计与色彩学中指黑、白、灰等“非彩色系”（achromatic colors）。学术性强，光学、摄影、设计与生物学高频。
【历史典故/词源】由希腊语前缀 a-（无，没有）+ chroma / chromat-（颜色，同 chromosome/monochrome）构成。字面意思为“没有颜色的”。
【专业领域特殊含义】在光学仪器中，achromatic lens 指“消色差透镜”；在视觉生理学中，achromatic vision 指“全色盲/无彩色视觉”；在色彩管理中指“无彩色度”。
【助记方法】a（无）+ chrom（颜色，同 chrome/monochrome）+ atic → 无颜色的，消色差的。

examples.en: Engineers designed an achromatic optical system for the new space telescope.
examples.zh: 工程师们为新型空间望远镜设计了一套消色差光学系统。

examples.en: Modern minimalist interiors often feature achromatic aesthetics.
examples.zh: 现代极简主义室内设计常以无彩色的美学为特色。

synonyms.note: 无色的。区别：colorless 为通用词；achromatic 侧重专业光学消色差或设计色彩学上的无彩度。
单色的。区别：monochromatic 侧重单一颜色；achromatic 特指无彩色（黑白灰）。

examples.en: She has been a stalwart supporter of environmental conservation for three decades.
examples.zh: 三十年来，她一直是环境保护的坚定支持者。

examples.en: Party stalwarts gathered at the annual convention to rally behind the candidate.
examples.zh: 党派骨干们聚集在年度大会上，为候选人摇旗呐喊。

examples.en: His stalwart character earned him the deep respect of his colleagues.
examples.zh: 他坚毅可靠的品质赢得了同事们的深切尊重。

examples.en: The veteran player provided a stalwart defense throughout the final match.
examples.zh: 这位老将在整个决赛中提供了坚如磐石的防守。

examples.en: Despite the storm, the stalwart lighthouse remained undamaged.
examples.zh: 尽管经历了风暴，那座坚固的灯塔依然完好无损。

synonyms.note: 含义：艰苦的，坚硬的，勇敢的。区别：Hardy 侧重于能经受严寒、恶劣环境或困难的忍耐力；而 stalwart 侧重于体格健壮或意志坚定、忠诚不渝。
含义：结实的，坚毅的。区别：Stout 常用来形容人身体壮硕、偏胖，或指物品厚实坚固；stalwart 多指高大健壮且勇敢忠诚。
含义：强健的，结实的。区别：Sturdy 侧重于不易折断或不易受损的结实程度，常指物品或人的体质；stalwart 则多包含忠诚和支持的意味。
含义：忠诚的人，拥护政府者。区别：Loyalist 是名词，指在政治上忠诚于既定政权或党派的人；而 stalwart 可作形容词或名词，强调坚定不移的忠诚或支持。

words.analysis: 【词源&细微含义】源自古英语 stælwierþe（值得站立之处的、坚固的）。形容人身材高大健壮（stalwart frame），或态度/立场极其坚定可靠（stalwart defender / supporter）。作名词指组织或党派中长期默默奉献、不可或缺的骨干或忠实追随者（party stalwarts）。【使用场景&感情色彩】正规书面语、政治与新闻报道，高度赞赏的褒义词。【助记】stal（站立，如 stand）+ wart（值得，如 worth）→ 站得住脚的 → 坚定的、骨干。

words.meaning: adj. 渴望获得的，贪得无厌的，有占有欲的
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】形容个人、企业或社会对于财富、物资、权力或知识表现出“强烈的占有欲、渴望不断获取”（an acquisitive nature / society）。通常带有轻微的批判性色彩（若指物质贪婪），但有时也可指对知识的热切求索。书面语与社会学高频。
【历史典故/词源】源自拉丁语 adquisitivus，由 ad-（向）+ quaerere/quisit-（寻求，同 acquire）构成。字面意为“总是想要抓取占有的”。
【专业领域特殊含义】在社会学与经济思想史中，an acquisitive society（如 R. H. Tawney 的著作）指“以追求财富占有为主要驱动力的功利主义社会”。
【助记方法】acquisit（获得/占有）+ ive（形容词后缀，表示倾向）→ 总是想占有获取的 → 渴望获得的，有占有欲的。

phrases.zh: 占有欲强的本性
唯利是图/追求占有的社会
占有本能
渴望获取知识的心智

examples.en: We live in an increasingly acquisitive society focused on material wealth.
examples.zh: 我们生活在一个越来越注重物质财富、充满占有欲的社会中。

examples.en: His acquisitive instinct drove him to buy up competitors aggressively.
examples.zh: 他的占有本能驱动着他激进地收购竞争对手。

examples.en: She has an acquisitive mind that eagerly absorbs new ideas and information.
examples.zh: 她拥有一颗渴望求索的心智，热切吸收着新想法与新信息。

examples.en: Critics condemned the CEO's acquisitive behavior during the financial crisis.
examples.zh: 批评人士谴责了 CEO 在金融危机期间贪得无厌的并购囤积行为。

examples.en: The child showed an acquisitive attitude toward his friends' toys.
examples.zh: 这个孩子对朋友们的玩具表现出了强烈的占有欲。

synonyms.note: 垂涎的，贪婪的。区别：covetous 侧重觊觎他人之物；acquisitive 侧重渴望不断积累占有。
贪婪的。区别：greedy 为口语通用词；acquisitive 属于正式社会学术语。

examples.en: Her verbose explanation confused the audience rather than clarifying the issue.
examples.zh: 她啰嗦的解释非但没有阐明问题，反而使听众更加困惑。

examples.en: Refactoring verbose code makes the codebase easier to read and maintain.
examples.zh: 重构冗长的代码能使代码库更易阅读和维护。

synonyms.note: 冗长的，啰嗦的。Long-winded 多指讲话或文章过于冗长、枯燥，使人感到厌烦，有“长气”的贬义；Verbose 是较正式的用词，指使用了比需要多得多的词语。
单调乏味的，沉闷的。Tedious 强调事物因持续时间长或单调而令人疲倦；Verbose 专门指语言表达上的字数过多。
多风的，长篇大论的。Windy 属于非正式用语，形容人说话滔滔不绝但内容空洞；Verbose 则侧重词藻冗杂。
冗长的，啰嗦的。Wordy 和 Verbose 意思非常相近，指话太多；但 Verbose 更正式，有时含有喜欢使用冷僻词汇以显学问的意味，Wordy 更口语化。

phrases.zh: （计算机）详细/冗长模式
详细日志记录
过于冗长啰嗦的

examples.en: To remove from the throne; depose.
examples.zh: 从宝座上移走；免除。

examples.en: The right to elect chieftains and to depose them.
examples.zh: 选举和撤换酋长的权利。

examples.en: It is vital for the lengthy and difficult reconstruction of Libya that Libyans themselves depose Colonel Qaddafi.
examples.zh: 鉴于利比亚的重建将会漫长而困难，利比亚人民需要自己来罢黜卡扎菲，这十分重要。

examples.en: Merrill denied the allegations, and sought to depose former employers Oppenheimer and Goldman Sachs.
examples.zh: 美林否认了这些指控，并试图罢黜前雇主奥本海默和高盛。

examples.en: The hapless king might also have met the man there who would eventually depose him.
examples.zh: 不幸的国王也可能在那里遇到了最终废黜他的人。

examples.en: As both acted in the first place to depose him, that would not seem likely.
examples.zh: 由于两人一开始就采取行动废黜他，所以这似乎不太可能。

examples.en: A heavy downpour interrupted the football match.
examples.zh: 一场骤雨中断了这场足球赛。

examples.en: On this day, after a downpour, it smells musty.
examples.zh: 那天，一场倾盆大雨过后，房子里有股霉味。

examples.en: The downpour plastered his shirt to his body.
examples.zh: 倾盆大雨把他的衬衫像贴膏药一样贴在他身上。

examples.en: An "exceptional downpour" was responsible for flooding in Goole last week, Yorkshire Water said.
examples.zh: 约克郡水务公司表示，上周一场“特大暴雨”导致古尔发生洪水。

examples.en: The race kicked off under a heavy downpour as the runners snaked around wet London streets.
examples.zh: 比赛在倾盆大雨中拉开帷幕，参赛者在潮湿的伦敦街道上蜿蜒前行。

examples.en: The downpour is now a drizzle, and the clouds have moved on to swallow other mountains.
examples.zh: 倾盆大雨现在变成了毛毛雨，云彩已经吞没了其他山峰。

examples.en: His hair was unkempt and filthy.
examples.zh: 他的头发没梳洗，十分脏腻。

examples.en: The old man was shabby and unkempt.
examples.zh: 老头蓬头垢面，衣衫褴褛。

examples.en: He had long unkempt hair and a stubbly chin.
examples.zh: 他头发蓬乱，脸上胡子拉碴。

examples.en: And Bradley Cooper, despite being on trend with a modified baseball jacket, just looked tired and unkempt.
examples.zh: 布莱德利·库珀 (Bradley Cooper) 尽管穿着经过改良的棒球夹克很流行，但看上去却很疲倦且蓬头垢面。

examples.zh: 他穿着红色监狱连身裤，留着浓密的胡须和蓬乱的深棕色头发。

examples.en: You see dirty clothing, unkempt hair, or other clues that she has forgotten to take care of herself.
examples.zh: 你会看到脏衣服、蓬乱的头发或其他迹象表明她忘记照顾自己。

examples.zh: 他就是奥彭名画的前景中那个戴圆顶礼帽的人物。

examples.zh: 在前景，大厅是黑暗的，令人昏昏欲睡。

examples.en: The figure in the foreground is the artist's mother.
examples.zh: 图画前景中的人是画家的母亲。

examples.en: The new ads-inside entail far more than plopping a can of Coke into the foreground.
examples.zh: 新的内部广告不仅仅是将一罐可乐放在前台。

examples.en: It shows Pistorius in the distance with the bars of a metal fence in the foreground.
examples.zh: 它显示了远处的皮斯托利斯，前景是金属栅栏的栅栏。

examples.zh: 长亭的墙壁勾勒出珊瑚海的壮丽全景，前景是无边泳池。

examples.en: "Those were uncouth birds," answered the Parrot.
examples.zh: “那些是粗野的鸟。”鹦鹉回答。

examples.en: At the very end of the poem, the uncouth swain, "rose, and twitch his mantle blue, tomorrow to fresh woods and pastures new."
examples.zh: 在这首诗的最后，粗鄙的乡村青年：“起身，抖抖他的蓝披风，明天到新的森林和牧场去。”

examples.en: It's dirty and has an uncouth culture.
examples.zh: 那里脏兮兮的，文化又粗俗。

examples.en: But its learning curve has been painfully long, its manners uncouth and its coalition partners loutish.
examples.zh: 但它的学习曲线漫长得令人痛苦，其举止粗俗，其联盟伙伴也粗鲁无礼。

examples.en: Spurned by the British as a colonial, from an uncouth continent, he exacted the perfect revenge: he colonized their imagination.
examples.zh: 他来自一个粗鲁的大陆，被英国人视为殖民地而唾弃，但他实施了完美的报复：他殖民了他们的想象力。

examples.en: And Lee took cast and crew to the Gobi Desert to film the scenes where Jen and the uncouth Lo meet and fall in love.
examples.zh: 李则带着剧组前往戈壁滩拍摄珍妮和粗鲁的罗相遇并相爱的场景。

examples.en: The economy was hidebound by public spending and private monopolies.
examples.zh: 该经济体由于公共开支和私有垄断而变得僵化。

examples.en: London doesn't seem as hidebound by tradition as some of the other European cities.
examples.zh: 不像其他欧洲城市，伦敦并不因传统而守旧。

examples.en: The more hidebound European universities must be wondering what on earth they have started.
examples.zh: 思想更为顽固的欧洲大学必须考虑他们出发点到底为何。

examples.en: Hidebound Red Sox fans have finally come to embrace Wally since his 1997 unveiling.
examples.zh: 自从沃利 1997 年亮相以来，Hidebound 红袜队的球迷终于开始拥抱他了。

examples.en: His lessons are applicable to any hidebound grad student or business executive: Rewrite the rules.
examples.zh: 他的课程适用于任何墨守成规的研究生或企业高管：重写规则。

examples.en: Startups are not saddled with legacy systems nor do they have hidebound procedures to worry about.
examples.zh: 初创公司不必背负遗留系统，也不必担心墨守成规的程序。

examples.zh: 几句笑话可给枯燥无味的演讲增添活跃的气氛。

examples.en: He found congenial officers who knew how to leaven war's rigours with riotous enjoyment.
examples.zh: 他找到了和他志趣相投的懂得用狂欢来冲淡战争的残酷的军官。

examples.en: Purge out therefore the old leaven, that ye may be a new lump, as ye are unleavened.
examples.zh: 你们既是无酵的面，应当把旧酵除净，好使你们成为新团。

examples.en: The departure of such strivers has removed the leaven from the housing estates that they quit.
examples.zh: 这些奋斗者的离开，让他们退出的小区失去了酵母。

examples.en: In scene after scene, the characters sit in a room talking politics, and no attempt is made to leaven their conversations with action of any kind.
examples.zh: 在一个又一个的场景中，角色们坐在房间里谈论政治，并且没有试图用任何形式的行动来丰富他们的谈话。

examples.en: Early settlers in the West, especially those adventurers who traveled north to Alaska, relied on sourdough to leaven bread before commercial baking powder and yeast were readily available.
examples.zh: 西方的早期定居者，尤其是那些向北前往阿拉斯加的冒险家，在商业发酵粉和酵母出现之前依靠酵母来发酵面包。

examples.zh: 他分析了自己的比赛，发现还有待提高。

examples.zh: 这一新系统经测试发现不够好。

examples.zh: 任何想要从一个地方骑到另一个地方的人都可以使用它们。

examples.zh: 每天，都有随机的人来找她和她的男朋友聊天。

examples.en: From childhood, he was evidently at once rebellious and precocious.

examples.en: She burst on to the world tennis scene as a precocious 14-year-old.

examples.en: Rock 'n' roll had entered a period of stasis.
examples.zh: 摇滚乐已经进入了一个停滞期。

examples.en: My return after stasis will be in stages.
examples.zh: 停滞期后我的回归将分几个阶段。

examples.en: Since 2005, the base class library was in stasis.
examples.zh: 自2005年以来，基类库就处于停滞之中。

examples.en: These two poles, stasis and dynamism, increasingly define our political, intellectual, and cultural landscape.
examples.zh: 静态和动态这两个极点日益定义了我们的政治、知识和文化格局。

examples.en: After four years of stasis on the trade front, the new environment is a welcome change.
examples.zh: 贸易方面经历了四年的停滞之后，新的环境是一个可喜的变化。

examples.zh: 阿吉米以这种技巧捕捉到的心理停滞是未经审视的生活的光明厄运。

words.meaning: adj. 病理学的，由疾病引起的；[行为] 病态的，无法自控的；[数学/IT] 变态的，极端的
words.analysis: 【细微含义与使用场景】医学指与疾病或病变直接相关的（pathological tissue 病理组织）；心理/社会中指某种行为不正常且无法自控（pathological liar 病态撒谎者）；数学/计算机科学中指某种输入或函数极端怪异、违反常规表现（pathological case/example 极端病态样例）。【IT/数学/算法特殊含义】Pathological input（导致算法退化至最坏时间复杂度的极端病态输入，如针对快排构造的已有序数组）。【感情色彩】贬义（指行为时），中性专业（指医学/数学时）。【助记方法】patho-（痛苦/疾病，如 sympathy）+ logy（学科）+ -ical → 病理的、病态的。

examples.en: Pathological examination of the tumor biopsy confirmed that it was benign.
examples.zh: 肿瘤活检的病理检查确认其为良性。

examples.en: His compulsive gambling has escalated into a pathological addiction requiring therapy.
examples.zh: 他的病态赌博已升级为需要心理治疗的病态成瘾。

examples.en: Algorithm designers must handle pathological inputs that could trigger catastrophic worst-case behavior.
examples.zh: 算法设计者必须处理可能引发灾难性最坏情况行为的极端病态输入。

examples.en: Psychologists classified her obsession with perfectionism as pathological.
examples.zh: 心理学家将她对完美主义的痴迷归类为病态。

examples.en: The Weierstrass function is a famous pathological function that is continuous everywhere but differentiable nowhere.
examples.zh: 魏尔斯特拉斯函数是一个著名的病态函数，它处处连续但处处不可导。

synonyms.note: 病理学的，病态的。Pathological和pathologic含义相同，前者在现代英语中（尤其是美式英语和日常表达中）更为常见，后者多见于医学文献。

words.meaning: n. 嘉奖，赞许，荣誉，授爵仪式
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】指对某人杰出成就给出的“公开发表的嘉奖、赞许、荣誉或奖项”（win accolades / highest accolade）；历史起源于中世纪骑士授爵时用剑轻按肩颈的“授爵礼”。感情色彩明确褒义，艺术界、学术界与新闻表彰高频使用。
【历史典故/词源】源自法语 accolade，由 ad-（向）+ collum（脖子，颈部，同 collar）构成。本义是授爵时国王或领主“拥抱封爵者的颈部或用剑轻触其肩膀”的庄严仪式。
【专业领域特殊含义】在文化与新闻界，win critical accolades 指“赢得影评界/文化界的高度嘉奖”；在历史学中指骑士授爵仪式。
【助记方法】ac（向）+ col（脖子/领口，同 collar）+ ade → 搂着脖子授爵奖赏 → 嘉奖，荣誉。

phrases.zh: 赢得嘉奖/赞誉

examples.en: The young chef received numerous accolades for her innovative cuisine.
examples.zh: 这位年轻主厨因其创新的菜肴赢得了无数赞誉。

examples.en: Winning the Nobel Prize is considered the highest accolade in science.
examples.zh: 获得诺贝尔奖被视为科学界最高荣誉。

examples.en: The architectural firm earned international accolades for its eco-friendly design.
examples.zh: 该建筑事务所因其环保设计赢得了国际嘉奖。

examples.en: Despite receiving accolades for his film, he remained remarkably humble.
examples.zh: 尽管因他的电影收获了无数赞赏，他依然保持着难得的谦逊。

examples.en: The veteran actor was honored with a lifetime achievement accolade.
examples.zh: 这位资深演员被授予终身成就奖项。

synonyms.note: 荣誉，勋章。区别：honor 强调地位、声誉或授勋；accolade 强调公开发表表彰与赞许。
致敬，颂词。区别：tribute 侧重表达敬意与感谢的言词或礼物。

words.meaning: n. 替代品；代理人；adj. 代理的；替代的
words.analysis: 指临时或正式代表另一事物、人或概念起作用的替代者。常用于代孕（surrogate mother）、代理决策者、代理指标等。正式书面语、医学/法律/科技术语。1) 机器学习：代理模型（surrogate model，用于近似极其昂贵的复杂仿真）；2) 统计与医学：代理终点/代理指标（surrogate marker / endpoint，如用血压代替心脏病发作风险）。助记：sub-/sur- (在下面/代替) + rog- (请求/提出) + -ate → 被指定在下面替补的人 → 替代者/代理。

examples.en: Researchers used Gaussian processes to build a surrogate model for aerodynamic simulation.
examples.zh: 研究人员利用高斯过程为空气动力学仿真构建了代理模型。

examples.en: Reduction in tumor size served as a surrogate endpoint for overall survival rate in the clinical trial.
examples.zh: 肿瘤体积缩小在临床试验中作为衡量总生存率的代理终点指标。

examples.en: In many database schemas, an auto-incrementing integer functions as a surrogate key.
examples.zh: 在许多数据库模式中，自增整数充当代理键。

examples.en: She agreed to act as a legal surrogate for her incapacitated relative during medical decisions.
examples.zh: 她同意在医疗决策中充当其丧失行为能力的亲属的法定代理人。

examples.en: For many solitary pet owners, a dog becomes a surrogate child.
examples.zh: 对许多独居宠主来说，狗狗成为了替代孩子的寄托。

examples.en: Surrogate optimization techniques substantially decrease the computational expense of dark matter simulations.
examples.zh: 代理优化技术大幅降低了暗物质数值模拟的计算开销。

synonyms.note: 代养的，培养的。Surrogate指替代他人履行职责的人（如代孕），而foster多指没有血缘关系但提供抚养或照顾的（如寄养家庭）。
交替的，候补的。Surrogate侧重于功能或角色的完全替代，而alternate强调两个事物的轮流交替或作为备用选择。
替代品，接替者。Surrogate多指在特定角色或功能上的代理人，而replacement泛指取代旧事物、损坏物或离职者的任何新的人或物。

phrases.zh: 代理模型（机器学习/仿真）

examples.en: I poured my thoughts out on paper in an attempt to rationalize my feelings.
examples.zh: 我将自己的想法倒出，写在纸上以求理顺情绪。

examples.en: Fatalism- Fatalism is a way people rationalize despair.
examples.zh: 宿命论是人们合理化绝望的一个借口。

examples.en: They attempted to rationalize the new working method.
examples.zh: 他们力图使新的作业方法更趋合理。

examples.en: With a little technology we could strengthen security and rationalize immigration policy in the bargain.
examples.zh: 只要有一点技术，我们就可以加强安全并合理化移民政策。

examples.en: We rationalize the bad times with the belief that the contractions provide an opportunity for renovation.
examples.zh: 我们将困难时期合理化，相信经济收缩提供了革新的机会。

examples.en: These are the kinds of approaches that congress should embrace to rationalize the funding.
examples.zh: 这些是国会应该采取的使资金合理化的方法。

examples.en: This is another half-baked scheme that isn't going to work.
examples.zh: 这又是一个考虑不周的计划，是不会成功的。

examples.en: But according to the checker's report the packing is half-baked.
examples.zh: 根据检验员的报告，检查时货物的包装是不完整的。

examples.en: A minimal product is not synonymous with a half-baked or buggy product.
examples.zh: 最小可行产品不等同于半成品或者低等产品。

examples.en: And when Clinton visited Africa this past March, he issued only an elliptical, half-baked apology.
examples.zh: 当克林顿今年三月访问非洲时，他只发表了一个简短的、半生不熟的道歉。

examples.en: Maybe because of our half-baked plan, each day seemed more remarkable than the last.
examples.zh: 也许是因为我们的计划不成熟，每一天都显得比前一天更加非凡。

examples.en: How can I tell when my ideas are actually legitimate notions or nothing but half-baked schemes?
examples.zh: 我如何判断我的想法实际上是合理的想法，还是只是半生不熟的计划？

examples.en: Please help me, I entreat you.
examples.zh: 请帮帮我吧，求你了。

examples.en: I entreat you, give no place to despondency.
examples.zh: 我恳求你，不要为沮丧留地步。

examples.en: I entreat your help.
examples.zh: 我恳求你帮助。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of entreat.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“恳求；请求；vi. 恳求；乞求”的概念提供了全新的视角。

examples.en: Recent academic studies have highlighted the significance of entreat in modern research.
examples.zh: 最近的学术研究强调了“恳求；请求；vi. 恳求；乞求”在现代科学研究中的重要意义。

examples.en: Her articulate argument demonstrated a deep understanding of entreat.
examples.zh: 她清晰有力的论证展现了对“恳求；请求；vi. 恳求；乞求”的深刻理解。

examples.en: The hodgepodge system we have now demeans nearly all those who touch it.
examples.zh: 目前这种杂乱的体系，会让几乎所有接触到它的人都有失身份。

examples.en: "The Castle in the Forest" is a gleeful hodgepodge of ideas, held together by this Satanic conceit.
examples.zh: 《林中城堡》是一本令人愉悦的观点大杂烩，以这种邪恶怪诞的想法拼凑在一起。

examples.en: The hodgepodge system we have now demeans nearly all those who touch it. It is time to tear it down and start again.
examples.zh: 目前这种杂乱的体系，会让几乎所有接触到它的人都有失身份。是时候拆毁重来了。

examples.en: The ski village, however, while a welcome hive of activity, has long been an architectural hodgepodge.
examples.zh: 然而，滑雪村虽然是一个受欢迎的活动中心，但长期以来一直是一个建筑大杂烩。

examples.en: It was a sloppy user interface slapped on machines assembled by a hodgepodge of companies.
examples.zh: 这是一个草率的用户界面，安装在由大杂烩公司组装的机器上。

examples.en: Father's Day is celebrated in some 98 countries over a hodgepodge of different dates.
examples.zh: 大约 98 个国家/地区庆祝父亲节的日期多种多样。

examples.en: Magistrates were given wider discretionary powers.
examples.zh: 地方法官们被赋予了更广泛的酌情决定权。

examples.en: You may be eligible for a discretionary grant for your university course.
examples.zh: 读大学课程可能会有资格获得学校自行决定是否发放的助学金。

examples.en: Of course, I have discretionary income.
examples.zh: 当然，我有可自由支配的收入。

examples.en: The GOP says it would cut government spending to pre-2009 levels and cap future discretionary spending.
examples.zh: 共和党表示将把政府支出削减至 2009 年之前的水平，并限制未来的可自由支配支出。

examples.en: Surprisingly, provided the job situation, the consumer discretionary sector is burning hot right now.
examples.zh: 令人惊讶的是，考虑到就业情况，非必需消费品行业目前异常火热。

examples.en: Tight budgets, for example, make it harder for the government to increase discretionary spending.
examples.zh: 例如，预算紧张使政府更难增加可自由支配支出。

examples.en: Your efforts shall have been nugatory.
examples.zh: 你的努力也就没有价值了。

examples.en: Even the scrawniest of types possess more than enough energy stored in their (nugatory) fat reserves to run several marathons back to back.
examples.zh: 即使最瘦骨如柴的人身体里储存的（无用的）脂肪也够他跑几个来回的马拉松了。

examples.en: This opinion was in practice formulated based on the nugatory answer to a linguistic conception that whether a music segment is clearly signified is justified on the basis of its signified relations.
examples.zh: 这种观念实际上源于语言学概念(即以其所指的关系来判断音乐材料是否所指明确)并得出否定性答案而形成。

examples.en: The chance of this result being a fluke is a nugatory one in 1043.
examples.zh: 在 1043 年，这一结果纯属侥幸的可能性微乎其微。

examples.en: The combination of low Treasury yields and nugatory credit spreads provides an irresistible opportunity for emerging countries to issue lots of cheap debt.
examples.zh: 低国债收益率和无效信用利差的结合为新兴国家发行大量廉价债务提供了不可抗拒的机会。

examples.en: First, with growth nugatory or negative in the rich world, firms have come to depend on surging emerging markets, especially China, to keep expanding.
examples.zh: 首先，随着富裕国家经济增长无效或出现负增长，企业开始依赖蓬勃发展的新兴市场（尤其是中国）来持续扩张。

examples.en: I grudge having to pay so much tax.
examples.zh: 得付这么多的税我很不情愿。

examples.en: I bear him no grudge.
examples.zh: 我对他不怀任何积怨。

examples.en: You surely don't grudge her her success?
examples.zh: 她获得成功，你没有不以为然吧？

examples.en: Di Maria will now be suspended for next weekend's "Clasico", the uber-grudge match against archrival Barcelona.
examples.zh: 迪马利亚现在将因下周末的“国家德比”而停赛，这是一场对阵宿敌巴塞罗那的激烈比赛。

examples.en: Another version has it that Mr Litvinenko was poisoned by someone in Russia with a grudge.
examples.zh: 另一种说法是，利特维年科先生是被俄罗斯怀恨在心的人毒死的。

examples.en: As Cerf noted, many attacks come from users with authorized access who bear a grudge.
examples.zh: 正如 Cerf 指出的那样，许多攻击来自拥有授权访问权限但怀有怨恨的用户。

examples.zh: 整个夏天，贝尔法斯特北部的宗派局势紧张，冲突不时爆发。

examples.en: We used to think scriptures were a library of a sectarian community, but now I think that they think it was a pottery factory or something.
examples.zh: 我们过去曾认为经文应该在一个教派群体的文库中，但是现在我想大家认为它存在于一个类似于陶瓷厂的地方。

examples.zh: 警方说这是一起派系谋杀。

words.meaning: n. 警告，提醒；限制条件，注意事项
words.analysis:
详细解析：
1. 细微含义：指在同意某事、发表声明或提供建议时提出的特定限制条件、警示、附加说明或特别注意事项，提醒人们注意潜在风险或适用边界。
2. 使用场景：学术研究、法律合同、商业谈判、科技报告。
3. 历史典故与拉丁文：源自拉丁文 caveat（意为“让其当心”）。著名拉丁成语 caveat emptor 意为“买者自负”（buyer beware）；caveat lector 意为“读者自负/读者当心”。
4. 助记方法：cave (洞穴/小心) + at → 提醒你前面有洞穴要小心 → 警告、限制条件。

examples.en: The study offers promising results, but with the major caveat that the sample size was small.
examples.zh: 该研究提供了令人鼓舞的结果，但主要限制条件是样本量较小。

examples.en: I agree to back your proposal, with one caveat: we must stick strictly to the budget.
examples.zh: 我同意支持你的提议，但有一个限制条件：我们必须严格遵守预算。

examples.en: The report supports the new medical treatment, though with several important caveats.
examples.zh: 该报告支持这种新医疗方案，尽管附带了几项重要的注意事项。

examples.en: The principle of caveat emptor applies to all purchases made at auctions.
examples.zh: 买者自负的原则适用于拍卖会上的所有竞购。

examples.en: She accepted the job offer, but added a caveat regarding her remote working hours.
examples.zh: 她接受了这份工作要约，但就远程工作时长添加了一条附加说明。

examples.en: Before implementing the algorithm, developers should heed the performance caveats outlined in the documentation.
examples.zh: 在实现该算法之前，开发人员应当注意文档中列出的性能注意事项。

synonyms.note: 【解析】警告，谨慎。【区别】caveat 属于较正式或法律用语，指具体的告诫或免责声明；caution 指为了避免危险而提出的警告或提醒，也可指谨慎的态度。

synonyms.note: 解析：轰炸，炮击。区别：Bombardment 侧重于持续不断的猛烈轰炸（包括物理炸弹或言语质问）；barrage 原指弹幕射击，常引申为密集的（提问、抗议等）。
解析：流露，倾泻。区别：Outpouring 多用于形容情感、话语的大量涌现和流露；barrage 则带有强烈的攻击性和压迫感。
解析：猛攻，突击。区别：Onslaught 强调极其猛烈、极具破坏性的直接攻击；barrage 强调密集的、连续不断的攻势（如连珠炮般的提问）。
解析：轰击，炮击。区别：Bombard 是动词，指进行连续轰炸或质问；barrage 多作名词，指这种密集的攻击状态。

words.meaning: n. 计谋，策略，诡计
words.analysis:
详细解析：
1. 细微含义：指为了欺骗、逃脱或达到某种隐秘目的而设计的机智手段或花招。语气偏中性至轻微贬义，强调“巧妙的伪装/圈套”。
2. 使用场景：文学作品、新闻报道、军事历史、政治分析。
3. 历史典故/词源：古法语 ruse（退缩、避开，源自猎鹿时鹿逃跑的迂回路线/诡计）。
4. IT/网络安全：在网络安全（社会工程学）中，黑客常使用各种 ruse（伪装骗局）诱骗用户泄露密码。
5. 助记方法：谐音“入死”→ 诱敌深入死局的“诡计/计谋”。

examples.en: The phone call was just a ruse to get him out of the house.
examples.zh: 那通电话只是把他骗出房间的调虎离山之计。

examples.en: He saw right through her clever ruse and refused to sign the contract.
examples.zh: 他一眼识破了她巧妙的诡计，拒绝签署合同。

examples.en: The Trojan Horse is one of the most famous ruses in military history.
examples.zh: 特洛伊木马是军事史上最著名的计谋之一。

examples.en: Phishing attacks often rely on a convincing ruse to trick employees into giving up credentials.
examples.zh: 钓鱼攻击通常依赖于逼真的伪装骗局来诱骗员工交出凭证。

examples.en: She manufactured a fake excuse as a ruse to avoid attending the boring party.
examples.zh: 她编造了一个假借口作为脱身的借口，以避免参加无聊的派对。

synonyms.note: 诡计，欺骗。Ruse 指为了迷惑对手而使用的巧妙花招；Artifice 侧重于运用聪明才智进行的欺骗或巧妙的设计。

examples.en: Don't assume your baby automatically needs feeding if she's fretful.
examples.zh: 不要你的婴儿一焦躁就假定她必然需要喂食。

examples.en: Mary became quite still and Colin looked fretful.
examples.zh: 玛丽变得很安静，科林显得很烦躁。

examples.en: Mary sat in her corner of the railway carriage and looked plain and fretful.
examples.zh: 玛丽坐在火车车厢的角落里，相貌平平，烦躁不安。

examples.en: With the loan balance rising, and the job market in the dumps, Donna is becoming increasingly fretful.
examples.zh: 随着贷款余额的增加和就业市场的低迷，唐娜变得越来越焦躁。

examples.en: Mr Royama and others are likely to find the coming week a very fretful one indeed.
examples.zh: 罗山先生和其他人可能会发现接下来的一周确实非常令人不安。

examples.en: For as long as she could, his fretful mother inspected his underwear for signs of tapeworm.
examples.zh: 他烦躁的母亲尽可能地检查他的内裤是否有绦虫的迹象。

examples.en: The twin lights, the shifting grey and the steadfast red, mastered the Water Rat and held him bound, fascinated, powerless.
examples.zh: 变幻莫测的灰色和坚定不变的红色，这两道光芒控制住了河鼠，使他处于动弹不得，痴痴迷迷，又无能为力的状态。

examples.en: He remained steadfast in his belief that he had done the right thing.
examples.zh: 他仍然坚信自己做了正确的事情。

examples.en: He remained steadfast in his determination to bring the killers to justice.
examples.zh: 他要将杀人凶手绳之以法的决心一直没有动摇。

examples.en: And as they do, we will be proud to stand with them as a steadfast partner.
examples.zh: 正如他们所做的那样，我们将自豪地作为坚定的合作伙伴与他们站在一起。

examples.en: Most telling of all are the stirrings of disquiet in America, Israel's most steadfast ally.
examples.zh: 最能说明问题的是以色列最坚定的盟友美国的不安情绪。

examples.en: But one market continues to thrive on the steadfast barrage of economic uncertainty: luxury housing.
examples.zh: 但在经济不确定性的持续打击下，有一个市场继续蓬勃发展：豪华住房。

examples.zh: 这是令人颇为担忧的一天。

examples.en: Things are as fraught as ever in the office.
examples.zh: 办公室的情况和往常一样令人担心。

examples.en: Going from zero to sixty on it in a week is fraught with peril.
examples.zh: 一周内从零到六十是充满危险的。

examples.en: However, the whole process is rather more fraught with difficulty than many seem to think.
examples.zh: 然而，整个过程比许多人想象的要困难得多。

examples.en: Simultaneously we got yet another lesson why long-term forecasts are often fraught with peril.
examples.zh: 同时，我们还得到了另一个教训，为什么长期预测往往充满危险。

examples.en: She gave me a coy smile.
examples.zh: 她羞答答地对我笑了笑。

examples.en: She was a little coy about how much her dress cost.
examples.zh: 她对她那件衣服花了多少钱有点吞吞吐吐。

examples.en: Mr. Alexander is not the slightest bit coy about his ambitions.
examples.zh: 亚历山大先生对自己的抱负一丁点也不保留。

examples.en: Ross has been coy about whether he will step in and invest in Ambac or other bond insurers.
examples.zh: 罗斯对于是否会介入并投资 Ambac 或其他债券保险公司一直讳莫如深。

examples.en: Mrs Clinton has been coy about a possible White House run in four years' time.
examples.zh: 对于四年后可能参选白宫，克林顿一直守口如瓶。

examples.en: Mr. COY: That's an excellent question, and that is another part of their problem.

examples.en: He was sustained by the unflagging support of his family.
examples.zh: 他有着来自家庭的持久的支持。

examples.en: But market pressures are real and unflagging.
examples.zh: 不过市场的压力却是真真切切，无可躲避。

examples.en: Every time I left her side, I was energized by her courage and unflagging spirit.
examples.zh: 每次从母亲身边离开，我都被她勇气不懈的精神所鼓舞着。

examples.en: He is generally considered low-keyed and cool, a number cruncher but also a committed, unflagging philosophical liberal.
examples.zh: 人们普遍认为他低调、冷静，是一位数字计算专家，但也是一位坚定、坚定的哲学自由主义者。

examples.en: Still, her unflagging commitment kept alive hope that the evening would redeem itself, even if that moment never came.
examples.zh: 尽管如此，她坚定不移的承诺仍然保持着希望，希望这个夜晚能够自我救赎，即使那一刻从未到来。

examples.en: In fact, since late September 2010, DVN has marched consistently higher along the unflagging support of its 10-week moving average.
examples.zh: 事实上，自 2010 年 9 月下旬以来，DVN 一直在其 10 周移动平均线的坚定支撑下持续走高。

examples.en: The movie is just a rehash of the best TV episodes.
examples.zh: 这部电影不过是把电视剧里最精彩的几集改编了一下。

examples.en: The critic found the play "a feeble rehash of familiar Miller themes."
examples.zh: 评论家们认为这部剧“是大家熟悉的米勒式主题的拙劣翻版”。

examples.en: I'm not going to rehash all that here.
examples.zh: 我不打算在这里重复所有的问题。

examples.en: That seems like as good an opportunity as any to rehash my own views on the matter.
examples.zh: 这似乎是一个很好的机会来重申我自己对此事的看法。

examples.en: For the Moxley family, the court proceedings were a rehash of old and hurtful information, Mr. Moxley said.
examples.zh: 莫克斯利先生说，对于莫克斯利家族来说，法庭诉讼程序是对旧的、有害的信息的重述。

examples.en: Again, the point here is not to rehash the debate over global warming.
examples.zh: 再次强调，这里的重点不是重复关于全球变暖的争论。

examples.en: The exaggerated drawl of bassist Oliver Sim precedes the more human-scale croon of guitarist Romy Madley Croft.

examples.en: The upcoming karaoke device complete with microphone allows you to croon at home.

examples.en: In "Stonewall, " Hamman takes his sharp-edged croon for a lumbering, jazzy stroll.

words.meaning: n. 总体，整体；合奏组，剧团；（统计物理/AI）系综，集成模型；全套服装
words.analysis:
【细微含义】源自法语，本义为“一起”。在艺术中指交响乐团/合唱团/剧团配合的整体；在时装中指搭配协调的全套服装；在统计物理中指“系综”；在 AI/机器学习中指“集成学习”（Ensemble Learning）。
【IT/AI含义】Ensemble Methods（集成方法，如 Random Forest、XGBoost）通过组合多个弱学习器提高预测精度与泛化能力。
【助记方法】en- + semble（相似/在一起，对比 assemble 集合），即“协调在一起的整体”。

examples.en: The chamber music ensemble performed a stunning movement by Mozart.
examples.zh: 室内乐团演奏了一乐章令人惊艳的莫扎特作品。

examples.en: Ensemble learning combines predictions from multiple models to achieve superior accuracy.
examples.zh: 集成学习结合了多个模型的预测，以获得更优异的准确率。

examples.en: She wore an elegant silk ensemble for the anniversary gala.
examples.zh: 她穿了一套优雅的丝绸全套晚礼服出席周年庆典。

examples.en: The movie boasts an impressive ensemble cast of award-winning actors.
examples.zh: 这部电影拥有由屡获殊荣的演员组成的强大演员阵容。

examples.en: Weather forecasters use ensemble models to assess the probability of hurricane paths.
examples.zh: 天气预报员使用集成模型来评估飓风路径的概率。

examples.zh: 但在华盛顿再多财政廉洁也没有大风险。

examples.zh: 他的名声大多来自母亲，母亲因廉洁奉公而备受尊敬。

examples.en: Though they may also be less likely to claim corruption as a sign of probity.
examples.zh: 尽管他们也不太可能将腐败视为廉洁的标志。

examples.en: And the Lib Dems are in danger of losing more than their reputation for probity.

examples.en: He tried to muffle the alarm clock by putting it under his pillow.

examples.en: Blake held his handkerchief over the mouthpiece to muffle his voice.
examples.zh: 布莱克用手帕遮住话筒来压低声音。

examples.en: In reality, some people are vocal and may moan and groan, other folks may muffle any sounds with a pillow, and yet others may not make a single peep.
examples.zh: 事实上，有些人会出声，他们可能会唉声叹气，其他人可能会用枕头闷住任何声音，还有另一些人可能不会发出任何声音。

examples.en: Other options include sound equalizers, similar to those on MP3 players, and sound-cancellation features, similar to headsets that muffle annoying noise.
examples.zh: 其他选项包括声音均衡器（类似于 MP3 播放器上的均衡器）和消音功能（类似于消除恼人噪音的耳机）。

examples.en: It aims to muffle the gene for a protein called apoliprotein B, or ApoB, that carries fatty cholesterol to the arteries, creating thick plaques.

examples.en: They just barely muffle the roar of the jets outside.
examples.zh: 他们只是勉强掩盖了外面喷气式飞机的轰鸣声。

words.meaning: adj. 崇高的，壮丽的；绝妙的，超群的；v. (化学) 升华；(使)纯化

phrases.en: from the sublime to the ridiculous
phrases.zh: 从崇高到荒谬（极度反差）
崇高/壮绝之美
无比的自信；毫无顾忌的自信
超凡脱俗的体验
精湛超绝的技艺

examples.en: Standing at the edge of the Grand Canyon, they marveled at the sublime scenery.
examples.zh: 站在科罗拉多大峡谷边缘，他们对这壮丽崇高的景色赞叹不已。

examples.en: Beethoven's Ninth Symphony is celebrated as a sublime masterpiece of classical music.
examples.zh: 贝多芬的《第九交响曲》被誉为古典音乐中极为崇高的杰作。

examples.en: In chemistry, iodine crystals sublime into a rich purple vapor when heated.
examples.zh: 在化学中，碘晶体在加热时会升华为浓郁的紫色蒸气。

examples.en: There is only one step from the sublime to the ridiculous, as Napoleon famously remarked.
examples.zh: 正如拿破仑名言所说：‘从崇高到荒谬只有一步之遥。’

examples.en: The chef executed the traditional dish with sublime skill and modern flair.
examples.zh: 大厨以精湛超绝的技艺和现代风味烹制了这道传统佳肴。

examples.en: Philosophers during the Romantic era wrote extensively on the concept of the sublime in nature.
examples.zh: 浪漫主义时代的哲学家对自然界中‘崇高’的概念进行了大量的论述。

synonyms.note: 天空的，天界的。用法区别：empyreal 带有强烈的神话和宇宙色彩；sublime 多指思想、艺术或自然美景上的极其崇高和伟大。
天界，最高天。用法区别：empyrean 通常作名词指天国；sublime 一般作形容词指事物的崇高性质。
使升华。用法区别：sublimate 是动词，指转化为更高尚的状态（或物理升华）；sublime 多作形容词表示已达到的崇高境界。

etymology.rootMeaning: adj./v./n. 高尚的, 壮观的, 卓越的；提高, (使)变高尚, (使)纯化, (使)升华；庄严, 崇高, 顶点
etymology.explanation: 现有词源记录可追溯到 1580 年代；词形经拉丁语 sublimis 进入或影响英语；从现代构词看可辅助拆为 sub-（在下、次级） + lime。
etymology.memory: 先记核心义“高尚”，再用常用搭配和例句巩固词形，避免编造不存在的词根。

words.analysis:
【细微含义】形容词表示令人惊叹、超越凡俗的绝美与高尚；在哲学/美学中，“崇高”（the sublime）指令人敬畏甚至带有一丝震慑感的宏大美；在化学中动词指固体不经过液体直接变为气体的升华现象。
【使用场景】文学/美学/化学。
【历史典故/美学】康德与伯克的美学论述中，sublime 与 beautiful 相对，前者强调无限、威严、震撼，后者强调和谐与优美。
【助记方法】sub-（接近）+ lime（极限，limen 门槛）-> 接近极限、达到极致 -> 崇高的、升华。

examples.en: In fact, he sounded somber and contrite.
examples.zh: 事实上，他的声音听起来又沮丧又后悔。

examples.en: The sacrifices He accepts are broken and contrite hearts.
examples.zh: 因为神所悦纳的祭，乃是忧伤痛悔的心。

examples.en: “I’m not sure how it converts fuel to energy,” Tom replied with a contrite smile.
examples.zh: “我不太清楚它是如何把燃料转变成能的。” 汤姆回答道，脸上露出歉疚的笑容。

examples.en: When people are as contrite as the folks at JetBlue, you have to forgive them, right?
examples.zh: 当人们像捷蓝航空的员工一样悔悟时，你就必须原谅他们，对吧？

examples.en: At a Senate subcommittee hearing on tax haven banks in mid-July, the bank was suitably contrite.
examples.zh: 在 7 月中旬举行的参议院小组委员会关于避税天堂银行的听证会上，该银行表现出了适当的悔悟。

examples.en: Sitting in his office on the Upper West Side of Manhattan, John Katzman is contrite.
examples.zh: 约翰·卡兹曼坐在曼哈顿上西区的办公室里，正在懊悔之中。

words.meaning: n. 学者；专家；n. （Savant）人名；（捷）萨万特

phrases.zh: 学者；专家； （Savant）人名；（捷）萨万特的关键方面
展现出学者；专家； （Savant）人名；（捷）萨万特
深刻的学者；专家； （Savant）人名；（捷）萨万特
学者；专家； （Savant）人名；（捷）萨万特的本质

examples.en: However another link, between savant syndrome and autism, is well established.
examples.zh: 但是学者症候群和自闭症之间的联系却毋庸置疑。

examples.en: Nevertheless, gold has become cheaper for Indians two ways over the last few days, Savant said.
examples.zh: 尽管如此，萨万特表示，过去几天，黄金对印度人来说已经变得更便宜了，这有两个原因。

examples.en: Abby Joseph Cohen, star savant of the 1990s, thinks 11, 500 and climbing, albeit slower than before.
examples.zh: 艾比·约瑟夫·科恩 (Abby Joseph Cohen)，20 世纪 90 年代的明星专家，认为 11、500 和攀登，尽管比以前慢。

examples.en: It annihilated Montana, beat California and defended erstwhile offensive savant Indiana into submission in the regional semifinals.
examples.zh: 它在地区半决赛中击败了蒙大拿州，击败了加利福尼亚州，并击败了昔日的进攻专家印第安纳州。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of savant.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“学者；专家； （Savant）人名；（捷）萨万特”的概念提供了全新的视角。

examples.en: Recent academic studies have highlighted the significance of savant in modern research.
examples.zh: 最近的学术研究强调了“学者；专家； （Savant）人名；（捷）萨万特”在现代科学研究中的重要意义。

examples.en: The ambrosial aroma of the roast whetted our appetites.
examples.zh: 烤肉的美味香气刺激了我们的食欲。

examples.en: The ambrosial aroma of the roast whetted our appetites.
examples.zh: 烤肉的香味刺激了我们的食欲。

examples.en: The ambrosial and essential part of the fruit is lost with the bloom which is rubbed off in the market cart, and they become mere provender.
examples.zh: 水果的美味和它那本质的部分，在装上了车子运往市场去的时候，跟它的鲜丽一起给磨损了，它变成了仅仅是食品。

examples.en: With a garden salad each and a bowl of crisp slices of pear, it is ambrosial.
examples.zh: 每份配一份田园沙拉和一碗脆梨片，真是美味极了。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of ambrosial.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“特别美味的；芬香的”的概念提供了全新的视角。

phrases.zh: 对立的，正相反的的关键方面

examples.en: Their priorities are antithetical to those of environmentalists.
examples.zh: 他们的重点与环保主义者的重点是对立的。

examples.en: This antithetical couplet is my father's handwriting.
examples.zh: 这幅对联是父亲的亲笔。

examples.en: Busyness is antithetical to creativity.
examples.zh: 忙碌是与创造性背道而驰的。

examples.en: Today, the notion of eCommerce being an entirely separate function is antithetical to most organizations.
examples.zh: 如今，电子商务作为一个完全独立的功能的概念与大多数组织背道而驰。

examples.en: Giving workers flexibility to integrate personal life with work is viewed as antithetical to boosting performance.
examples.zh: 给予员工将个人生活与工作结合起来的灵活性被认为与提高绩效是对立的。

examples.en: But a chunk reflects views deeply antithetical to all that the EU stands for.
examples.zh: 但其中很大一部分反映了与欧盟所代表的一切截然不同的观点。

words.meaning: n. 预测，占卜

phrases.zh: 预测，占卜的关键方面
展现出预测，占卜
深刻的预测，占卜
预测，占卜的本质

examples.en: As a result of divination, Apollo was angry with the Greeks. Because Agamemnon robbed his father's maiden, and his father was the high priest of Apollo.
examples.zh: 占卜的结果是，阿波罗对希腊人发怒了。因为阿伽门农抢了自己父亲的女仆，而他父亲是阿波罗的大祭司。

examples.en: There is no sorcery against Jacob, no divination against Israel.
examples.zh: 断没有法术可以害雅各，也没有占卜可以害以色列。

examples.en: Don't you know that a man like me can find things out by divination?
examples.zh: 你们岂不知象我这样的人必能占卜吗？

examples.en: Following Mary Douglas, to say that this constitutes the divination of sacrificial entrails is not an analogy - that is precisely what it is.
examples.zh: 按照玛丽·道格拉斯的说法，这构成了祭祀内脏的占卜，这并不是类比，而是事实。

examples.en: Another of their important functions, according to Celtic tales and mythologies, was they were able to exhibit a range of magical powers, such as divination and prophesy, healing, levitation, shapechanging and they could even control the weather.
examples.zh: 根据凯尔特传说和神话，它们的另一个重要功能是能够展现一系列魔法力量，例如占卜和预言、治愈、悬浮、变形，甚至可以控制天气。

words.meaning: adj. 极恶劣的；令人发指的；十恶不赦的

phrases.zh: 令人发指的罪行
极其恶劣的行为
残忍的暴行
严重罪行

examples.en: The perpetrator was convicted of committing a series of heinous crimes.
examples.zh: 行凶者因犯下一系列令人发指的罪行而被判有罪。

examples.en: The judge described the attack as a heinous act against innocent civilians.
examples.zh: 法官将这次袭击定性为针对无辜平民的恶劣暴行。

examples.en: Public outrage grew after details of the heinous atrocity were revealed.
examples.zh: 在令人发指的暴行细节披露后，公众的愤怒进一步升级。

examples.en: No societal justification can ever excuse such heinous offenses.
examples.zh: 没有任何社会理由可以为如此十恶不赦的罪行开脱。

examples.en: The international court is dedicated to prosecuting heinous violations of human rights.
examples.zh: 国际法庭致力于惩治严重侵犯人权的极恶罪行。

examples.en: Even hardened investigators were shocked by the heinous nature of the evidence.
examples.zh: 即便经验丰富的调查人员也被证据中展示出的极其恶劣的性质所震惊。

synonyms.note: 极恶的, 残忍的。区别：Heinous 指犯罪等极其邪恶、令人发指；Flagitious 是较正式用语，指极其残忍或罪恶深重。

etymology.rootMeaning: adj. 可憎的, 令人发指的
etymology.explanation: 词形经古法语 hainos 进入或影响英语；从现代构词看可辅助拆为 hein + -ous（形容词后缀，表示具有某种性质）。
etymology.memory: 先记核心义“可憎”，再用常用搭配和例句巩固词形，避免编造不存在的词根。

words.analysis: 【细微含义与使用场景】强烈谴责性词汇，专用于形容极其残忍、邪恶、丧尽天良的罪行或暴行（如 heinous crime/atrocity）。带有极强的道德谴责色彩，多见于法律文书、司法判决、新闻报道及严肃文学作品中。【词源与助记】源自古法语 haineus（充满仇恨的），词根 haine（仇恨）。助记：“黑恶（heinous）至极，令人发指”。【使用场景】常与 crime, act, atrocity, offender 等词搭配，语气极其严肃严厉。

examples.en: He nodded (his) assent.
examples.zh: 他点头同意了。

examples.en: Nobody would assent to the terms they proposed.
examples.zh: 谁也不会同意他们提出的条件。

examples.en: The director has given her assent to the proposals.
examples.zh: 负责人已表示同意提案。

examples.en: How could our high schoolers assent to serving as walking billboards for shoe and sweatshirt manufacturers?
examples.zh: 我们的高中生怎么能同意充当鞋类和运动衫制造商的行走广告牌呢？

examples.en: If approved there, it would be sent to Parliament for approval and Royal Assent.
examples.zh: 如果在那里获得批准，它将被送交议会批准和御准。

examples.en: The public mood is also one of grudging assent, if not exactly fervent support.
examples.zh: 公众的情绪即使不是热烈支持，也是一种勉强同意的情绪。

examples.en: Spokewise prestressed cable-truss structure is a new type of spatial structure.
examples.zh: 轮辐式预应力索桁结构是一种新型空间结构。

examples.en: Lac-NCTD was synthesized with ethanediamine as truss arm.
examples.zh: 利用乙二胺为连接臂合成乳糖化-去甲斑蝥素修饰物。

examples.en: Truss the chicken before you roast it.
examples.zh: 烤鸡前先将鸡贴身扎紧。

examples.en: Ms Truss believes the experience of France illustrates that quality is not jeopardised by higher ratios.
examples.zh: 特拉斯女士认为，法国的经验表明，较高的比率不会损害质量。

examples.en: Using the arm, the astronaut lifted the platform's fifth truss, or backbone, segment into place.
examples.zh: 宇航员用手臂将平台的第五根桁架或主干部分提升到位。

examples.en: The authors include Elizabeth Truss and Dominic Raab, both tipped to be promoted in a future reshuffle.
examples.zh: 作者包括伊丽莎白·特拉斯（Elizabeth Truss）和多米尼克·拉布（Dominic Raab），两人都有望在未来的改组中得到晋升。

examples.en: He caught a whiff of her perfume.
examples.zh: 他闻到一股她身上的香水味。

examples.en: He caught a whiff of perfume as he leaned towards her.
examples.zh: 他探身靠近她时闻到一股香水味。

examples.en: When the lid of the nest box on an ant colony is raised, a whiff of dead cockroach wafts by.
examples.zh: 当蚁群的巢箱盖子被揭开时，一股死蟑螂的气息扑面而来。

examples.en: When my nose first got a whiff of its pungent, acidic odour, my stomach began to churn.
examples.zh: 当我的鼻子第一次闻到刺鼻的酸性气味时，我的胃开始翻腾。

examples.en: Like their very names, Ms Wiggins's characters never quite dispel a whiff of contrivance.
examples.zh: 就像他们的名字一样，威金斯女士的角色从来没有完全消除一丝做作的味道。

examples.en: At one point, the smell of laundry drifted into the dining room, a whiff of steerage.
examples.zh: 有一次，洗衣房的气味飘进了餐厅，一股统舱的味道。

examples.en: The housing market is moribund.
examples.zh: 住房市场奄奄一息。

examples.en: Is Estonia joining a moribund currency?
examples.zh: 爱沙尼亚加入了一个行将没落的货币么？

examples.en: The lumber and paper industries are moribund.
examples.zh: 木材业和造纸业也在垂死挣扎。

examples.en: Japan is under intense pressure to revive its long-moribund economy, especially as it sinks into recession.
examples.zh: 日本面临着重振长期停滞的经济的巨大压力，尤其是在陷入衰退之际。

examples.en: Millennium went public in 1996 and the stock immediately popped 50%, reviving a moribund biotech IPO market.
examples.zh: Millennium 于 1996 年上市，股价立即上涨 50%，重振了停滞不前的生物技术 IPO 市场。

examples.en: Amidst lingering unemployment and moribund consumer confidence, fears of a double dip recession grow increasingly frightening.
examples.zh: 在失业率挥之不去和消费者信心低迷的情况下，对二次探底衰退的担忧变得越来越可怕。

examples.en: To worship someone or something is to venerate him, her, or it—not necessarily as you would revere a deity, but at least with extreme devotion or admiration.
examples.zh: 崇拜某人或某物，就是崇敬他、她或它——不一定要你像敬畏一个神那样去做，但起码要发自极度的虔诚或赞美。

examples.en: Most Italians venerate the name of Dante.
examples.zh: 大多数意大利人崇拜但丁的名字。

examples.en: And love, young men, and venerate the ideal.
examples.zh: 青年人啊，热爱理想吧，崇敬理想吧。

examples.en: Shia Muslims also venerate the example of Hussein, who was killed for his faith.
examples.zh: 什叶派穆斯林也崇敬侯赛因的榜样，他因信仰而被杀。

examples.en: This will be followed by a chance to venerate the relics until 20:30 GMT.
examples.zh: 随后将有机会瞻仰圣物，直至格林尼治标准时间 20:30。

examples.en: Local residents built a temple in her honour and began to venerate her as a goddess.
examples.zh: 当地居民为她建造了一座寺庙，并开始将她尊奉为女神。

examples.en: His command of English was lamentable.
examples.zh: 他的英语水平糟得很。

examples.en: She shows a lamentable lack of understanding.
examples.zh: 她显得缺乏理解能力，实在令人遗憾。

examples.en: This lamentable state of affairs lasted until 1947.
examples.zh: 这一令人遗憾的事态一直持续至1947年。

examples.en: Last month she infuriated Latvia's judges with an attack on the lamentable state of justice.
examples.zh: 上个月，她对可悲的司法状况的攻击激怒了拉脱维亚的法官。

examples.en: If that was lamentable enough, England then gifted three of their next four wickets to run-outs.
examples.zh: 如果这还够可悲的话，英格兰队接下来的四个三柱门中的三个都被淘汰了。

examples.en: Speaking at the count, Blackburn MP Jack Straw said blamed the government for a "lamentable" turnout.
examples.zh: 布莱克本议员杰克·斯特劳在计票时表示，将“可悲”的投票率归咎于政府。
