words.meaning: n. 小故障，微小差错；短暂的技术异常；v. 发生故障，卡顿
words.analysis:
【细微含义与场景】指设备、系统或计划中突然发生但通常短暂、可修复的小故障/小错误。感情色彩较轻微，不同于 catastrophic failure（灾难性故障）。
【IT/AI/游戏含义】源自宇航与无线电工程，在计算机、电子游戏与 AI 领域极高频。指图形渲染错误、程序短暂卡顿或算法异常（glitch art 故障艺术；A software glitch 软件小故障）。
【助记方法】读音近似 switch，联想电路开关 switch 瞬间闪烁抽风产生的“小故障”。

examples.en: A temporary technical glitch delayed the live broadcast for several minutes.
examples.zh: 一个临时的技术故障使直播延迟了数分钟。

examples.en: Engineers are working to fix a minor software glitch in the navigation system.
examples.zh: 工程师们正在努力修复导航系统中的一个小软件故障。

examples.en: Despite a few initial glitches during launch, the app is now running smoothly.
examples.zh: 尽管上线时有一些最初的小差错，但该应用现在运行非常顺畅。

examples.en: Screen glitches can sometimes occur when graphics drivers are outdated.
examples.zh: 当显卡驱动过时时，有时会出现屏幕画面卡顿和故障。

examples.en: The automatic payment system experienced a glitch, charging some users twice.
examples.zh: 自动支付系统发生故障，导致对部分用户进行了重复扣款。

synonyms.note: 解析：缺陷，故障。区别：Glitch 侧重于系统或机器中突然出现的、短暂且通常不严重的小故障；Bug 侧重于计算机程序或系统中需要时间排查的缺陷或错误。

confusables.note:
拼写相近；意为“程度，坡度，顶点，前倾，倾斜，投掷，音高，螺距，节距，摊位，树脂，沥青
vt. 投，掷，向前倾跌，扎营，竭力推销，为...定调，定位于，用沥青涂
vi. 搭帐篷，投掷，向前跌，猛然摔倒，坠落，倾斜
 孔距”

拼写相近；意为“痒，渴望，疥疮
vi. 发痒，渴望”

examples.en: Social structures are not discrete objects; they overlap and interweave.
examples.zh: 社会结构不是离散的客体；他们重叠并交织在一起。

examples.en: Put simply, a class is a discrete block or bundle of variables and methods.
examples.zh: 简单地说，类是一个由变量和方法组成的离散块或束。

examples.en: The discrete units that make up language can be put together in different ways.
examples.zh: 这种组成语言的离散单元能够以不同的方式组合起来。

examples.en: Fifty years ago, Japanese electricity was generated by smaller, discrete coal- and oil-fired plants.
examples.zh: 五十年前，日本的电力是由规模较小、分散的燃煤和燃油发电厂生产的。

examples.en: The series also boasts up to 2TB(1) hard drives and on some models, discrete graphics.
examples.zh: 该系列还拥有高达 2TB(1) 的硬盘驱动器，某些型号还配备独立显卡。

examples.en: It is to allow us to be discrete and to make the record crystal clear.
examples.zh: 这是为了让我们能够保持谨慎，并使记录清晰可见。

examples.en: The station I was bound for was the terminus of the line.
examples.zh: 我要到达的车站是这条线的终点。

examples.en: In his deepest depression he felt he'd arrived at a terminus.
examples.zh: 在他最抑郁的时候，他感觉自己已经走到头了。

examples.en: "It was a terminus for the gold caravans crossing the Sahara," he said.
examples.zh: “对于穿越撒哈拉沙漠的黄金商队来说，这里是终点站”，他表示。

examples.en: At Spa Terminus, butchers, bakers and cheesemakers are among the local food producers with Saturday open houses.
examples.zh: 在 Spa Terminus，当地的食品生产商、屠夫、面包师和奶酪制造商都会举办周六开放日活动。

examples.en: Passengers on one cancelled Ryanair flight were told their baggage would be left outside the terminus.
examples.zh: 瑞安航空一架被取消航班的乘客被告知，他们的行李将被留在终点站外。

examples.en: Working from a quiet office park across from a railroad terminus in Richmond, Calif.
examples.zh: 在加利福尼亚州里士满铁路总站对面的一个安静的办公园区工作。

examples.zh: 她的签名潦草难辨。

examples.en: The letter was handwritten, in a hasty, barely decipherable scrawl.
examples.zh: 这封信是手写的，字迹潦草，几乎无法辨认。

examples.en: Dillworthy was staring into space, with a scrawl of doodles on the pad in front of him.
examples.zh: 迪尔沃西凝望着天空，面前的纸上满是涂鸦。

examples.en: Felt Marker Thin: Simulate the casual scrawl of letters created by a felt-tip marker.
examples.zh: 薄毡记号笔：模拟用毡尖记号笔随意潦草书写的字母。

examples.en: I struggle to keep my temper with the kids when they misbehave.
examples.zh: 孩子们淘气时，我强捺住性子不发脾气。

examples.en: Paying children too much attention when they misbehave can be self-defeating.
examples.zh: 孩子有不良行为时，小题大做可能适得其反。

examples.en: Kids misbehave every day.
examples.zh: 孩子们每天都不守规矩。

examples.en: "The locals do not appreciate it when tourists clearly misbehave, " said Machteld Ligtvoeld from the Amsterdam Tourist Board.
examples.zh: 阿姆斯特丹旅游局的马赫特尔德·利特沃尔德 (Machteld Ligtvoeld) 表示：“当游客明显行为不端时，当地人并不欣赏。”

examples.en: Kids there who misbehave online can now face serious consequences, even when they're not at school.
examples.zh: 现在，即使不在学校，网上行为不端的孩子也可能面临严重后果。

examples.en: This sense of entitlement is crucial to understanding why people misbehave in high office.
examples.zh: 这种权利感对于理解为什么人们在高位时行为不端至关重要。

examples.en: Is there iniquity in my tongue?
examples.zh: 我的舌上岂有不义吗。

examples.en: or what is our iniquity?
examples.zh: 我们有什么罪孽呢。

examples.en: Hide your face from my SINS and blot out all my iniquity.
examples.zh: 求你掩面不看我的罪，涂抹我一切的罪孽。

examples.en: But the small market-town is perceived as a den of sin and iniquity.
examples.zh: 但这个小集镇被视为罪恶和不法的巢穴。

examples.en: If Pope Francis loves justice and hates iniquity, he may indeed find himself an exile in this world but then so did Jesus himself.
examples.zh: 如果教皇方济各热爱正义，憎恨罪恶，他可能确实会发现自己在这个世界上被流放，但耶稣本人也是如此。

examples.en: Mr Kourouma denounces the iniquity of adults who, in Africa as elsewhere, fight their wars by proxy, sending children to their death on the front line.
examples.zh: 库鲁马先生谴责成年人的罪恶，在非洲和其他地方一样，他们通过代理人进行战争，将儿童送上前线送死。

examples.en: She invents fantasy lives for her own vicarious pleasure.
examples.zh: 她幻想过着各种奇妙的生活，从这种想象中获得乐趣。

examples.en: He got a vicarious thrill out of watching his son score the winning goal.
examples.zh: 他看着儿子射入获胜的一球，也同样感到欣喜若狂。

examples.en: You'll sometimes see people refer to this as vicarious punishment.
examples.zh: 有时候你会听到人们把它叫作替代惩罚。

examples.en: This vicarious or secondary traumatic stress is relatively rare, but "we've all identified it, " he said.
examples.zh: 这种替代性或继发性创伤性压力相对罕见，但“我们都发现了它，”他说。

examples.en: Invoking a concept called "vicarious liability, " the woman's lawyer asked the court to make Chase pay up.
examples.zh: 该女子的律师援引“替代责任”的概念，要求法院让蔡斯赔偿。

examples.en: Children of all ages build empathy and a storehouse of emotional readiness through vicarious experiences gained while reading.
examples.zh: 所有年龄段的孩子都可以通过阅读时获得的替代经验来建立同理心和情感准备库。

words.meaning: v. 产生共鸣，引起共振；反响强烈；(声音) 洪亮回荡
words.analysis:
【细微含义】物理上指声波或电磁波发生共振、回响；在社会、文学与心理学中，特指某种观念、演讲、情感或作品与听众/读者的内心产生深刻共鸣（resonate with sb）。
【使用场景】演讲传播、艺术与文学评论、物理学、产品与营销设计。
【感情色彩】褒义/中性。
【IT/AI/信号处理含义】在信号处理与声学算法中指谐振；在产品设计中指与用户需求“产生共鸣”（product-market resonance）。
【助记方法】re (再次) + son (声音) + ate -> 声音再次回响 -> 产生共鸣。

examples.en: His speech about freedom and equality resonated deeply with the audience.
examples.zh: 他关于自由与平等的演讲在听众心中引起了深远的共鸣。

examples.en: The church bell resonated across the quiet mountain valley.
examples.zh: 教堂的钟声在宁静的山谷中回荡。

examples.en: The candidate's message failed to resonate with working-class voters.
examples.zh: 该候选人的主张未能引起工人阶级选民的共鸣。

examples.en: Modern marketing strategies must resonate with the target demographic's core values.
examples.zh: 现代营销策略必须与目标人群的核心价值观产生共鸣。

examples.en: Her moving violin performance resonated in the acoustic hall.
examples.zh: 她动人的小提琴演奏在声学音乐厅里久久回响。

synonyms.note: 震动，颤动。Resonate 强调产生共鸣、回声，或在情感上引起共鸣；Vibrate 侧重于物理上的快速且有规律的震动或颤动。

phrases.zh: 与……产生共鸣；与……一致
引起深远共鸣
在……范围内回荡/产生广泛影响

etymology.rootMeaning: 作为 resonate 词源基础的历史词形；现代核心义参见“(使)共鸣，(使)共振”
etymology.explanation: resonate 直接建立在 resonare 之上，是它的派生形式；现有词源记录可追溯到 1873 年；词形经拉丁语 resonatus 进入或影响英语。
etymology.memory: 先记住核心义“(使)共鸣，(使)共振”，再用常用搭配巩固词形，避免编造不存在的词根。

examples.en: I don't grovel to anybody.
examples.zh: 我对谁都不会卑躬屈膝。

examples.en: Were I such they would grovel at my feet.
examples.zh: 倘若我真是暴君，他们就会俯伏在我的脚下了。

examples.en: To gawk and grovel and stare at Prince Ali!
examples.zh: 目瞪口呆，卑躬屈膝，并盯著阿里王子看！

examples.en: That should have been enough to make Mr Khan grovel.
examples.zh: 这应该足以让汗先生屈服。

examples.en: Never before, I said, could aspiring journalists write, shoot photos and video, produce and publish without having to grovel at the feet of an elite professional class wielding the spoils of power.
examples.zh: 我说，有抱负的记者从来没有能够在不屈服于掌握权力的精英专业阶层脚下的情况下进行写作、拍摄照片和视频、制作和出版。

examples.en: Few miseries compare to landing in a city at 6 a.m. only to while away the morning in traveler's purgatory awaiting an "early" 1 p.m. check-in that you had to grovel to get.
examples.zh: 没有什么比早上 6 点降落在一个城市，然后在旅行者的炼狱中等待下午 1 点“早”的航班来消磨早晨时光更令人痛苦的了。你必须卑躬屈膝才能办理入住手续。

examples.en: The other half of the name represents another ingredient, less infamous, perhaps, but also strangely potent: the kola nut.
examples.zh: 名字的另一半代表了另一种成分，也许不那么臭名昭著，但也有奇特的效力：可乐果。

examples.en: The ship crashed into the infamous Sker Point rocks and broke into three pieces.
examples.zh: 这艘船撞上了恶名远扬的斯戈尔尖岬暗礁群，断为三截。

examples.en: During the rest of the time, I got a title "the Infamous Perjurer Twain" on this paper.
examples.zh: 剩下的时间里，我在报纸上找到了一个叫《臭名昭著的伪证者吐温》的标题。

examples.en: The Duke was infamous amongst the chattering classes for his mounting debts and extensive antiques collection.
examples.zh: 公爵因其不断增加的债务和大量的古董收藏而在闲聊阶层中声名狼藉。

examples.en: The article 'The infamous architecture of Chicago' was published in partnership with Lonely Planet.
examples.zh: 文章“芝加哥臭名昭著的建筑”是与孤独星球合作发表的。

examples.en: The infamous sign was stolen in December last year and recovered in three pieces three days later.
examples.zh: 这个臭名昭著的标牌于去年12月被盗，三天后被分成三块。

examples.en: A sycophant flatterer is neither a guru or a preacher.
examples.zh: 一个谄媚者既非古茹也不是传教士。

examples.zh: 佞人环绕且有海外存款的穆加贝衣食无忧、怡然自得，他很可能做出同样的事来。

examples.zh: 他们这样做是得到了阿谀奉承的选民政府的事实上的支持。

examples.en: Accentuating the parental role as sycophant is the insane amount of money many spend on training, equipment and travel teams in search of that Holy Scholarship.
examples.zh: 许多人为了寻求神圣奖学金而在培训、设备和旅行团队上花费了大量的金钱，这凸显了父母阿谀奉承的角色。

examples.zh: 尽管他从来不是一个阿谀奉承者，但他让古板的银行家们感到被爱，自我感觉良好，并让他们相信支持商业象牙完全是他们自己的主意。

words.meaning: v. 弃权（投票）；克制，戒除（不良爱好）
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】指在表决或选举中主动选择“弃权”（abstain from voting）；或指凭自控力“自我克制、戒除”烟酒、欲望或某种行为（abstain from alcohol / sweets）。语气理性客观，常见于议会公文、医疗建议及生活自律。
【历史典故/词源】源自拉丁语 abstinere（把手缩回，按捺住），由 abs-（离开，自…拉回）+ tenere（握住，保持，同 retain/contain）构成。字面意思为“把手收回来不拿”。
【专业领域特殊含义】在政治学与议会规则中，abstention 指“弃权票”；在医学与健康学中，abstinence syndrome 指“戒断综合征”。
【助记方法】abs（离开）+ tain（握住，同 retain）→ 手收回来不握住 → 弃权，克制。

phrases.zh: 弃权不投票
戒酒，克制饮酒
拒绝发表评论
吃素，戒肉

examples.en: Ten nations voted in favor of the resolution, two voted against, and five abstained.
examples.zh: 十个国家对该决议投赞成票，两国投反对票，五国弃权。

examples.en: His doctor advised him to abstain from alcohol and high-fat foods.
examples.zh: 他的医生建议他戒酒并克制高脂食物。

examples.en: The representative decided to abstain from voting due to a conflict of interest.
examples.zh: 由于利益冲突，代表决定放弃投票。

examples.en: During Lent, many believers abstain from luxury goods and meat.
examples.zh: 在大斋期期间，许多信徒节制享用奢侈品和肉食。

examples.en: She chose to abstain from commenting on the ongoing litigation.
examples.zh: 她选择不对正在进行的诉讼发表评论。

synonyms.note: 抑制，忍住。区别：refrain 侧重抑制做某事的冲动；abstain 侧重正式弃权或长期戒除某种爱好。
克制，忍耐。区别：forbear 侧重面对挑衅或权力时的宽容忍让。

phrases.zh: 世界主宰；强大的破坏力的关键方面

examples.en: The group became a sales juggernaut in the commodity options business.
examples.zh: 这个集团已经成为一个商品期权交易的销售巨头。

examples.en: Don't doubt the Dan Brown juggernaut.
examples.zh: 可别小看丹·布朗运筹帷幄的能力。

examples.en: But don't expect such qualms to stop the juggernaut.
examples.zh: 但是不要期望这样的疑虑会阻止这些高官们。

examples.en: Apple has without question been the de facto consumer-technology juggernaut of the new millennium.
examples.zh: 毫无疑问，苹果公司是新千年事实上的消费技术巨头。

examples.en: In print, even more than in movies and on TV, Superman continues to be a juggernaut.
examples.zh: 在印刷品中，超人仍然是一个主宰者，甚至比在电影和电视中还要多。

examples.en: Over its eight-year run, Idol has proved far more than a ratings juggernaut for the network.
examples.zh: 在八年的运营中，《美国偶像》已证明其不仅仅是该网络的收视霸主。

examples.en: The skin graft failed to take.
examples.zh: 皮肤移植未能成功。

examples.en: To prep the eye to receive the tooth and lens, the doctors placed a graft over the eye to promote moisture.
examples.zh: 为了使眼睛做好接收牙齿和晶状体的准备，医生在眼睛上方放置一片移植物以增加水分。

examples.en: I am having a skin graft on my arm soon.
examples.zh: 我很快就要做手臂的植皮手术了。

examples.en: There's also a 5% chance that the graft will slip, requiring an additional operation.
examples.zh: 移植物还有 5% 的可能性会滑落，从而需要进行额外的手术。

examples.en: Spaniards have long suspected that there is graft in their town halls, whichever party runs them.
examples.zh: 西班牙人长期以来一直怀疑他们的市政厅存在腐败行为，无论是由哪个政党管理的。

examples.en: Blatant graft corrodes voters' support in the rich world for debt relief and aid.
examples.zh: 明目张胆的腐败削弱了富裕国家选民对债务减免和援助的支持。

phrases.zh: 草草记下

examples.en: Could you just jot his name on there?
examples.zh: 你能就把他的名字简单记在那儿吗？

examples.en: I'll just jot down the address for you.
examples.zh: 我得赶快把地址给你写下来。

examples.en: Have a pad and pencil ready and jot down some of your thoughts.
examples.zh: 准备一本便笺簿和一支铅笔，迅速地记下你的一些想法。

examples.en: But to be bothered more than a jot about whether any of it sold product?
examples.zh: 但是否会担心其中是否有产品出售？

examples.en: This is where Ian Fleming came to drink martinis and jot notes for his Bond novels.
examples.zh: 伊恩·弗莱明 (Ian Fleming) 曾在这里喝马提尼酒并为他的邦德小说做笔记。

examples.en: Has man's nature evolved so much as a jot or a tittle in 5, 000 years?
examples.zh: 五千年来，人类的本性是否已进化得如此之大？

words.meaning: adj. 矫揉造作的，不自然的，人为设计的
words.analysis:
细微含义：指剧本、借口、情节或表情缺乏自然流露感，显露出人工刻意编造、牵强附会的痕迹。
使用场景：文学文艺批评、影评、日常评论，带显著的负面贬义色彩。
助记方法：contrive（谋划/发明）+ -ed → 经过人工谋划的 → 不自然的/牵强的。

examples.en: Critics panned the movie for its contrived dialogue and unbelievable ending.
examples.zh: 影评人批评该电影对话矫揉造作、结局令人难以置信。

examples.en: Her apology felt contrived and lacked genuine remorse.
examples.zh: 她的道歉显得牵强附会，缺乏真诚的悔意。

examples.en: The novel relies too heavily on contrived coincidences to advance the story.
examples.zh: 这部小说过于依赖刻意安排的巧合来推进故事情节。

examples.en: The rivalry between the two contestants appeared entirely contrived for reality TV.
examples.zh: 这两名选手之间的对立看起来完全是为了真人秀节目刻意制造出来的。

examples.en: He forced a contrived smile to mask his disappointment during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 在仪式上，他强作欢颜以掩饰内心的失望。

confusables.note: 拼写相近；意为“发明，设计，图谋”

phrases.zh: 牵强的剧情
矫揉造作的微笑 / 勉强拉出的笑容
显得刻意/不自然
刻意安排的巧合

examples.en: I wasn't frightened by what he said—it was all bluster.
examples.zh: 我没有被他的话吓倒—那不过是在吓唬人。

examples.en: Ms Forde's lawyer argued that this was bluster.
examples.zh: 福德女士的律师认为，这是虚而不实的言论。

examples.en: Strip away the bluster, and this was a fight about electoral advantage.
examples.zh: 剥开空泛之谈，这是一场选举利益之争，如今胜负未定。

examples.en: For a moment of panic, a daft notion, a stupid indulgence in bluster and bravado.
examples.zh: 一时的恐慌，一个愚蠢的想法，一个愚蠢的放纵咆哮和虚张声势。

examples.en: Yet for all its power and bluster, Anonymous is challenged by one obvious issue: credibility.
examples.zh: 然而，尽管“匿名者”组织拥有如此强大的力量和威严，但它仍然受到一个明显问题的挑战：可信度。

examples.en: The more seasoned cast members relish their opportunities to melodramatically sneer, flounce and bluster as required.
examples.zh: 经验丰富的演员们很享受根据需要夸张地冷笑、怒骂和咆哮的机会。

examples.en: Like any placebo, it must be dispensed with authority to be effective.
examples.zh: 就像任何安慰剂一样，它只有在权威指导下（使用）才能发挥效用。

examples.en: We can, perhaps, attribute mediocre results to an inadequate placebo effect.
examples.zh: 也许，我们可以把平庸的结果归因于安慰剂效应的不足。

examples.en: We performed a double-blind, multicenter study, comparing MMX mesalamine vs placebo for the treatment of active ulcerative colitis.
examples.zh: 我们进行了一项双盲，多中心研究，比较了美沙美拉明与美沙酮对安慰剂治疗活动性溃疡性结肠炎的疗效。

examples.en: The study showed virtually the same symptoms among mycoprotein eaters and a placebo group.
examples.zh: 该研究显示，食用真菌蛋白的人和安慰剂组的症状几乎相同。

examples.en: Not all of the placebo treatments that the researchers looked at in this study are inert.
examples.zh: 研究人员在本研究中观察到的安慰剂治疗并非都是惰性的。

examples.en: In IBS-C clinical trials, diarrhea occurred in 20% of patients vs 3% on placebo.
examples.zh: 在 IBS-C 临床试验中，20% 的患者出现腹泻，而安慰剂组为 3%。

words.meaning: adj. 庞大的，巨大的

phrases.zh: 庞大的，巨大的的关键方面
展现出庞大的，巨大的
深刻的庞大的，巨大的
庞大的，巨大的的本质

examples.en: Fossil bones of the huge herbivorous dinosaurs known as sauropods were first discovered and studied between 1840 and 1880, providing evidence for the gargantuan dimensions of the adults.
examples.zh: 1840年至1880年间首次发现并研究了这种被称为蜥脚类动物的巨型食草恐龙的骨骼化石，为成年型恐龙的巨大特征提供了证据。

examples.en: Convertibility of the currency is a gargantuan barrier.
examples.zh: 货币的可兑换性就是一个巨大的障碍。

examples.en: You get to eat gargantuan amounts of food after marathons.
examples.zh: 你在马拉松后吃了大量的食物。

examples.en: The company's gargantuan volume allows it to keep costs below many of its competitors.
examples.zh: 该公司庞大的销量使其能够将成本保持在低于许多竞争对手的水平。

examples.en: If Texans were Muslim, this would be the sort of gargantuan building they would attempt.
examples.zh: 如果德克萨斯人是穆斯林，他们就会尝试建造这种巨型建筑。

examples.en: The Supercommittee was created in a fit of ambiguous revulsion against the truly gargantuan, obnoxious, deficit.
examples.zh: 超级委员会的成立是出于对真正庞大的、令人讨厌的赤字的一种模棱两可的反感。

etymology.rootMeaning: adj. 庞大的，巨大的

words.meaning: adj. 无理由的，无根据的

phrases.zh: 无理由的，无根据的的关键方面
展现出无理由的，无根据的
深刻的无理由的，无根据的
无理由的，无根据的的本质

examples.en: I can say with confidence that such rumours were totally groundless.
examples.zh: 我可以很有把握地说这些传言完全没有根据。

examples.en: Fears that the world was about to run out of fuel proved groundless.
examples.zh: 担心地球燃料即将用尽被证明是没有根据的。

examples.en: Provided this technology is effective, those fears are groundless.
examples.zh: 如果这项技术是有效的，那些担心则是没有根据的。

examples.en: Mr Duncan, the International Development Minister, told the programme that such allegations are groundless.
examples.zh: 国际发展部长邓肯先生告诉该节目，此类指控毫无根据。

examples.en: Hopefully such groundless sensationalism will not derail a regulation so clearly in the public interest.
examples.zh: 希望这种毫无根据的煽情行为不会破坏如此明显符合公共利益的监管。

examples.en: The medical uses of herbs are legion.
examples.zh: 草本植物的医药效用数不胜数。

examples.zh: 它在荣誉军团博物馆的第一个场景中如催眠般滑行，然后经历了无数的变形。

examples.zh: 周一、周五和周六，该中心的工作人员将由来自英国皇家军团的志愿者提供服务。

examples.zh: 在情绪过度劳累时，要准确地记住说过的话往往会很难。

examples.en: The most obvious pattern, however, is the media's tendency to get overwrought about almost anything.
examples.zh: 然而，其中最明显的，就是媒体总是对每一件小事都精神紧张。

examples.en: Many overwrought workers eat junk food, drink excessive alcohol or zone out in front of the TV, he says.
examples.zh: 他说，很多员工劳累过度了就吃垃圾食物、大量喝酒，或是在电视前昏昏沉沉。

examples.en: But the fears being sown by the likes of Barak and Haaretz columnists are overwrought.
examples.zh: 但巴拉克和国土报等专栏作家所散布的恐惧是过度的。

examples.en: But murmurs that this is the beginning of the end for consoles are overwrought, as usual.
examples.zh: 但有人窃窃私语说，这是终结的开始，因为游戏机像往常一样过度紧张。

examples.en: Was it going to be another overwrought and ultimately unsatisfying Top Spin 3?
examples.zh: 这是否又会是一部过度紧张且最终令人不满意的《Top Spin 3》？

examples.zh: 此次爆炸发生在这家博特尼亚工厂的低压恶臭气体传输管线上，当时正值该纸浆厂经过48小时保养停产之后的重新启动。

examples.en: And don't be embarrassed if it happens to you, he adds. Even professors of dentistry and experts in the field of bad breath sometimes have malodorous mouths.
examples.zh: 如果这发生在你身上也不用窘迫，甚至牙科专家及教授也会有难闻的口臭。

examples.en: Some emphases on further research are indicated, such as the mechanism of removing amine and ether from malodorous gas and the optimisation of extracting process.
examples.zh: 指出对恶臭气体中的胺类和醚类除臭机理、对植物提取液提取工艺优化的研究是今后研究的重点。

examples.en: In this steamy, frantic, uglybeautiful, often malodorous megalopolis, the people know how to live.
examples.zh: 在这个闷热、疯狂、丑陋、美丽、常常恶臭的大都市里，人们知道如何生活。

examples.en: Barofsky uses colorful language throughout the book to describe the malodorous conditions his team worked under.
examples.zh: 巴洛夫斯基在整本书中使用了丰富多彩的语言来描述他的团队在恶臭的条件下工作。

examples.en: From time to time, the parents dispatched their children to fetch bags of tiny shellfish, spatchcocked squid from the grill, malodorous 'stinky tofu'.
examples.zh: 父母们时不时地派孩子去取一袋袋的小贝类、烤架上的鱿鱼、臭豆腐。

examples.zh: 它是一个过失由国际足联，他们必须对受到指责的某种见解或行为加以申辩解释。

examples.zh: 15%的民众认为“你知道我的意思”是最大的言语过失。

examples.zh: 首节比赛，由于霍尔特比的失误，流浪者队以1-0领先。

examples.en: If we are going to use cliches, perhaps this was a "blunder" rather than a "gaffe".
examples.zh: 如果我们要使用陈词滥调的话，也许这是一个“错误”而不是“失态”。

examples.en: In 2011 while Groupon was preparing to go public, it made gaffe after gaffe.
examples.zh: 2011年，当Groupon准备上市时，却犯了一个又一个的错误。

examples.zh: 我在下午的活动中的出席是多余的。

examples.zh: 她看了他一眼，这已表明一切，无须多言了。

examples.en: Or are you superfluous?
examples.zh: 或者你是多余的？

examples.en: If DVDs and online tests replaced the classroom, a lot of teachers would be rendered superfluous.
examples.zh: 如果DVD和在线考试取代了课堂，很多老师就会变得多余。

examples.en: The question instead becomes if shutting down theses superfluous titles will help stop the bleeding.
examples.zh: 相反，问题是关闭这些多余的游戏是否有助于止血。

examples.zh: 换句话说，这些国家想要没收黄金来换取多余的纸张。

examples.zh: 突然暴风雨来临了—一场常见的大暴雨。

examples.en: Adding request workflow capabilities to WebSphere cloudburst.
examples.zh: 在WebSphere CloudBurst上添加申请工作流功能。

examples.en: Configure CloudBurst 2.1 software stack to support multiple networks.
examples.zh: 配置CloudBurst 2.1软件集以支持多个网络。

examples.en: The fury of a single monsoon cloudburst can precipitate enough water to overflow river banks.
examples.zh: 一次猛烈的季风暴雨就能沉淀出足够的水溢出河岸。

examples.en: Michael Clarke had time to pull Merv Dillon to mid on before the home side were saved by a further cloudburst.
examples.zh: 迈克尔·克拉克 (Michael Clarke) 有时间将梅尔夫·狄龙 (Merv Dillon) 拉至中路，随后主队被进一步的暴雨拯救。

examples.en: The pitch is still drying out from that terrifying cloudburst, meaning England was forced to cancel its pre-game training session here.
examples.zh: 由于那场可怕的大暴雨，球场仍然处于干燥状态，这意味着英格兰队被迫取消了这里的赛前训练。

examples.en: you misrepresent what's in the plan, we will call you out.
examples.zh: 如果你歪曲了计划中的内容，我们将告诉你。

examples.en: The mass media consistently misrepresent science and medicine.
examples.zh: 大众媒体在不断地歪曲科学和医学。

examples.zh: 但为什么好莱坞选择如此歪曲西方真正的种族多样性呢？

examples.zh: 然而，这在某种程度上歪曲了英国和大多数其他国家在斯里兰卡问题上的立场。

examples.zh: 众所周知，他们歪曲了信息，导致了被称为“重新老化”的 7 年时间范围的延长。

words.meaning: vt. 掩饰，掩盖；假装；vi. 隐藏，掩饰（思想、感情等）

phrases.zh: 掩饰，掩盖；假装；vi. 隐藏，掩饰（思想、感情等）的关键方面

examples.en: Henry was not slow to dissemble when it served his purposes.
examples.zh: 形势一对他有利，亨利就马上开始隐瞒。

examples.en: It means we need not dissemble.
examples.zh: 这意味着我们不需要任何掩饰。

examples.en: She tried to dissemble her disappointment with a joke.
examples.zh: 她用笑话掩盖她的失望。

examples.en: Where individual idea recognition and information gathering is not valued, top-down corporations give members an incentive to hide information and dissemble in order to keep the bar for performance low.
examples.zh: 在不重视个人想法识别和信息收集的情况下，自上而下的公司会激励成员隐藏信息和掩饰信息，以保持较低的绩效标准。

examples.en: One of the most troubling characteristics of those who make a living doing arms control and other feats of diplomatic derring-do is their tendency to dissemble about the true nature of things.
examples.zh: 那些靠军备控制和其他外交壮举谋生的人最令人不安的特征之一是他们倾向于掩饰事物的真实本质。

examples.en: For whatever reason, it was to dissemble.
examples.zh: 不管出于什么原因，这都是为了掩饰。

examples.en: One of the problem areas is lax security for airport personnel.
examples.zh: 其中一个问题是对机场人员的安全措施不严格。

examples.en: There have been allegations from survivors that safety standards had been lax.
examples.zh: 幸存者们指控安全标准不严格。

examples.en: It is shot through with waste, lax academic standards and mediocre teaching and scholarship.
examples.zh: 它充斥着浪费、宽松的学术标准和平庸的教学和学识。

examples.en: "This smells, this really smells, " he said of the FAA's apparently lax oversight of Valujet before the crash.
examples.zh: “这味道，这真的是味道，”他谈到坠机前美国联邦航空局对 Valujet 的监管明显松懈时说道。

examples.en: He also says the U.S. economy is the big beneficiary of lax U.S.-Mexico border control.
examples.zh: 他还表示，美国经济是美墨边境管制宽松的最大受益者。

examples.en: The lax regulatory regime made it possible for the crisis to happen--but it wasn't the cause.
examples.zh: 宽松的监管制度使危机的发生成为可能，但这并不是原因。

phrases.zh: 惊愕；惊惶失措；恐怖的关键方面
展现出惊愕；惊惶失措；恐怖

examples.en: The announcement of her retirement caused consternation among tennis fans.
examples.zh: 她宣布挂拍告退的消息引起了网球迷的震惊。

examples.en: This phase filled the old lady's heart with consternation.
examples.zh: 这使老太太心中充满了惊恐。

examples.en: A sickening consternation struck through him; he recognised his mother!
examples.zh: 一阵极不愉快的惊恐袭上他的心头；他认出了他的母亲！

examples.en: But Sag Harbor has been changing, rapidly, and to the consternation of some including Ms. Grosjean's group.
examples.zh: 但萨格港一直在迅速发生变化，这让包括格罗斯让女士的团队在内的一些人感到震惊。

examples.en: Such opinions have caused consternation among nuclear energy's long-standing opponents, notably Europe's green movement.
examples.zh: 这些观点引起了核能长期反对者，特别是欧洲绿色运动的恐慌。

examples.en: Now, to the consternation of politicians, viewers and especially advertisers, this magnificent medium is fragmenting.
examples.zh: 现在，令政治家、观众，尤其是广告商感到惊愕的是，这一宏伟的媒体正在支离破碎。

phrases.zh: 排除；避免；消除的关键方面

examples.en: The use of a lawyer trained as a mediator would obviate the need for independent legal advice.
examples.zh: 聘请受过训练做调解人的律师，就没必要再找独立的法律咨询了。

examples.en: Machine translation could be good enough to obviate the need for a primary global language.
examples.zh: 机器翻译已经足够好了，可以避免全球出现某个语言主导的情况。

examples.en: Those numbers are likely to obviate the need for spare batteries for the majority of average consumers.
examples.zh: 这些数字或能说明，对于多数一般消费者而言，没有携带备用电池的必要。

examples.en: To obviate these problems Brand Keys fielded the 2012 Digital Platform Engagement Index (DPEI).
examples.zh: 为了避免这些问题，Brand Keys 发布了 2012 年数字平台参与度指数 (DPEI)。

examples.en: To obviate a revolt at last year's Labour Party conference, the government promised a review.
examples.zh: 为了避免在去年的工党会议上出现反抗，政府承诺进行审查。

examples.en: The holistic focus of the research does not obviate the importance of concussion, said Sansiveri.
examples.zh: 桑西韦里说，研究的整体重点并没有消除脑震荡的重要性。

words.meaning: n. 补偿，赔偿；保障；赔偿物

phrases.zh: 索赔
损害补偿保证书
保险赔偿
双倍赔偿

examples.en: Political exiles had not been given indemnity from prosecution.
examples.zh: 政治流亡者还没有被给予免于起诉的保证。

examples.en: I was also given an indemnity form, which I duly completed and returned.
examples.zh: 我还收到了一份赔偿表，我按时填好并交了回来。

examples.en: Using letter of indemnity to obtain a clean B/L is a common practice.
examples.zh: 用保函换取清洁提单被普遍采用。

examples.en: IRS-CI started an undercover operation whereby its agents posed as the owners of Continental Indemnity, Ltd.
examples.zh: IRS-CI 开始秘密行动，其特工冒充 Continental Indemnity, Ltd. 的所有者。

examples.en: Under the pact England renounced its claims to French territory in return for an indemnity.
examples.zh: 根据该协议，英国放弃对法国领土的要求，以换取赔偿。

examples.en: All reputable credit hire companies will have an indemnity in place to protect clients from financial exposure.
examples.zh: 所有信誉良好的信贷租赁公司都将提供赔偿，以保护客户免受财务风险。

examples.en: An agricultural worker, digging in the grounds of a derelict plantation, scraped open a grave.
examples.zh: 一名农业人员在一个废弃的种植园里挖掘，挖开了一个坟墓。

examples.en: Most of the five-storey building is dusty and derelict.
examples.zh: 大多数的五层楼建筑往往尘土飞扬破乱不堪。

examples.en: There were many more bullet-scarred and derelict houses.
examples.zh: 被废弃的弹痕累累的房屋更多了。

examples.en: Centred around Shiliupu Dock, the district was transformed from derelict warehouses to a vibrant new entertainment hub.
examples.zh: 以十六铺码头为中心，该地区从废弃的仓库转变为充满活力的新娱乐中心。

examples.en: Firefighters are to partially demolish a derelict building in Manchester city centre, following a large fire.
examples.zh: 大火发生后，消防队员将部分拆除曼彻斯特市中心一座废弃建筑。

examples.en: The oil sands are pretty controversial stuff, however, associated with derelict, broken landscapes and carbon emissions.
examples.zh: 然而，油砂是相当有争议的东西，与废弃、破坏的景观和碳排放有关。

examples.en: We could hear sounds of revelry from next door.
examples.zh: 我们能够听到隔壁纵饮狂欢的声音。

examples.en: The feasting, drinking, dancing and revelry continued for several days.
examples.zh: 宴会、畅饮、跳舞和狂欢持续了几天。

examples.en: By midnight the revelry was at its height.
examples.zh: 到了午夜，欢宴达到了高潮。

examples.en: Still, mixing nuptial revelry with reminders of poverty and distress can be a tricky business.
examples.zh: 尽管如此，将婚礼狂欢与贫穷和痛苦的提醒混在一起可能是一件棘手的事情。

examples.en: He knows that accounts of revelry or expenditure on gourmet food and drink are ultimately antiquarian.
examples.zh: 他知道，有关狂欢或美食美酒支出的记载最终都是过时的。

examples.en: The best beaches to experience the crescendo-level revelry is at Juhu beach in North Mumbai or Chowpatty Beach in South Mumbai.
examples.zh: 体验渐强狂欢的最佳海滩是孟买北部的 Juhu 海滩或孟买南部的 Chowpatty 海滩。

words.meaning: adj. 易处理的；温顺的，易管教的；（数学/计算）可解的
words.analysis:
详细解析：
1. 细微含义：形容人/动物时表示“温顺、易牵引管教”；形容问题/任务时表示“易于解决、易处理”；在计算机科学/数学中指“能够在多项式时间内求解的（computationally tractable）”。
2. 使用场景：学术、数学、计算机科学、日常管理。反义词为 intractable。
3. 历史典故/词源：源自拉丁语 tractare（拉、牵引、处理，与 tractor/attract 同源）+ -able → 容易拉动/引导的。
4. IT/AI/算法：在算法复杂度分析中，'tractable problem' 指易解问题（通常对应 P 类问题，而非 NP-hard 问题）。
5. 助记方法：tract（拖拉/牵引）+ able → 能够被拉着走的 → 温顺的、易处理的。

examples.en: Breaking a complex task into smaller parts makes it much more tractable.
examples.zh: 将复杂任务分解为较小的部分会使其变得更容易处理。

examples.en: The dog was friendly and tractable, making it easy to train.
examples.zh: 这只狗友善且温顺，非常容易训练。

examples.en: In theoretical computer science, we aim to design algorithms that make hard problems computationally tractable.
examples.zh: 在理论计算机科学中，我们的目标是设计使难题在计算上变得可解的算法。

examples.en: Thanks to new technology, previously intractable mathematical equations are now tractable.
examples.zh: 得益于新技术，以前无法求解的数学方程现在变得可解了。

examples.en: The negotiator transformed a hostile conflict into a tractable discussion.
examples.zh: 谈判专家将一场充满敌意的冲突转化为了易于处理的讨论。

synonyms.note: 可操纵的。Tractable 侧重于人或动物温顺、易于管教和控制；Manipulable 侧重于事物或人容易被操控或摆布，常带有贬义。

examples.zh: 她很敏捷地服从他的指示：也许她没有想违法犯规的心思。

examples.en: And Moses said, Wherefore now do ye transgress the commandment of the LORD? But it shall not prosper.
examples.zh: 摩西说，你们为何违背耶和华的命令呢，这事不能顺利了。

examples.en: At cricket matches, beach balls that transgress onto the playing area are confiscated and punctured.
examples.zh: 在板球比赛中，侵入比赛区域的沙滩球将被没收并刺破。

examples.en: Since the Iranians, theoretically, will get only transit revenues, the Americans have now decided that the deal does not transgress their edict.
examples.zh: 由于从理论上讲，伊朗人只会获得过境收入，因此美国人现在决定该交易不会违反他们的法令。

examples.en: In theory, a politician may still transgress beyond what is acceptable, but Bill Clinton's presidency has shown how difficult it can be to reach this boundary.
examples.zh: 从理论上讲，政治家仍然可能会超越可接受的范围，但比尔·克林顿的总统任期已经表明，达到这一界限是多么困难。

examples.en: The whole story sounds very far-fetched.

examples.en: Rumours of a takeover by Hanson are probably far-fetched, but the company is worried about other predators.
examples.zh: 被汉森公司收购的谣言可能是捕风捉影，但公司仍担心其他觊觎者。

examples.en: However far-fetched that number, it shows the sea change in mindset of traditionally parochial Indian businessmen.
examples.zh: 无论这个数字多么牵强，它都显示了传统狭隘的印度商人心态的巨大变化。

examples.en: But the notion that Germany is poised to stalk out of the euro is far-fetched.
examples.zh: 但德国准备退出欧元区的想法有些牵强。

examples.en: It might sound far-fetched but young English inventor Giles Cardoso has already made it a reality.

examples.en: The honk of horn fluster the driver.
examples.zh: 汽车喇叭的响声使司机感到慌乱。

examples.en: Accept the fluster of lost door keys.
examples.zh: 耐心地忍受丢失钥匙的狼狈。

examples.en: She was a very calm person. Nothing could fluster her.
examples.zh: 她是个非常沉着的人。没什么能让她惊慌的。

examples.en: But the problem--publishers who inflate pay-per-click ad fees with automatic clicking software--doesn't fluster Ghosemajumder or other Googlers.
examples.zh: 但出版商利用自动点击软件抬高按点击付费广告费的问题并没有让 Ghosemajumder 或其他 Google 员工感到惊慌。

examples.en: Well, at first, there may be a fluster in the trees or a violent shake in the canopy above your head.
examples.zh: 嗯，一开始，树木可能会慌乱，或者你头顶的树冠会剧烈摇晃。

examples.en: With limitless funds, it could snap up firms in each of its three businesses, driving down costs and using scale to fluster competitors.
examples.zh: 凭借无限的资金，它可以收购其三项业务中的每一项业务，从而降低成本并利用规模来震慑竞争对手。

words.meaning: v. 降低…的地位/身份；使屈辱，使自卑
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】指在地位、尊严、声望或道德上降低自己或他人（abase oneself / be abased），带有强烈的贬抑或自卑色彩。属于高阶正式书面语，常见于文学、政论与宗教典籍中。
【历史典故/词源】源自古法语 abaissier（使低落），由 a-（向，使）+ bas（低的，底层）构成，与 base（基础/低劣的）同源。
【专业领域特殊含义】在伦理学与心理学中，self-abasement 指“自我贬低/自卑心理机制”；在社会学中用于描述阶级或权威地位被剥夺的社会过程。
【助记方法】a（使）+ base（低下的）→ 使处于低下的地位 → 降低，使屈辱。

phrases.zh: 自卑，自贬，奴颜婢膝
感到屈辱
损害尊严

examples.en: He would not abase himself by begging for a promotion.
examples.zh: 他绝不会通过乞求升职来贬低自己。

examples.en: The arrogant dictator was eventually abased by the uprising.
examples.zh: 傲慢的独裁者最终在起义中尊严扫地。

examples.en: A true leader never abases her subordinates in public.
examples.zh: 真正的领导者绝不会在公开场合羞辱下属。

examples.en: Faced with defeat, the proud general refused to abase himself before the conqueror.
examples.zh: 面对失败，傲慢的将军拒绝在征服者面前屈膝投降。

examples.en: The scandal served to abase the politician's once-spotless reputation.
examples.zh: 这桩丑闻损害了这位政治家曾经无可瑕疵的声誉。

synonyms.note: 贬低，降低身份。区别：demean 侧重于损害人格或体面；abase 更强调把地位或姿态降到极低。
使蒙羞，羞辱。区别：humiliate 侧重于公然使人难堪或无地自容；abase 侧重地位与尊严的贬降。

examples.zh: 她靠耐心和交际手腕，到头来是能引诱他与她结婚的。

examples.zh: 在厚普的帮助下，卡波特和哈泼·李继续投入到镇上其它主要人物的生活中，尤其是杜威一家，卡波特后来跟他们成了一生的好友。

examples.zh: 在年龄范围的另一端，他希望通过承诺任何辅导孩子 500 小时的人都可以为孙子获得大学奖学金，从而吸引两倍数量的退休人员重返教学岗位。

examples.zh: 亨利的约会十分简洁，整晚他只说了两句话。

examples.zh: 不过，他变得越来越冷淡了，在餐桌上不大开口，也很少待在家里。

examples.zh: 达希尔·哈米特的旧改编作品中的语言简洁但高效，甚至雄辩。

examples.zh: 在斯堪的纳维亚，对谦虚和社会团结等美德的信仰使人们不敢以不同的方式对待聪明的孩子。

英 / əˈberənt; ˈæbərənt /
美 / əˈberənt; ˈæbərənt /
words.meaning: adj. 偏离正道的，异常的，变态的
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】指偏离正常轨迹、社会规范、标准模式或生物学常规的行为、形态或心理状态。带有明显的学术与理性色彩，多用于科学、医学、心理学与社会学研究中。
【历史典故/词源】源自拉丁语 aberrans，由 ab-（偏离）+ errare（漫游，犯错，同 err/error）构成。本义是“迷路漫游离正轨”。
【专业领域特殊含义】在生物学与医学中，aberrant cell / gene / pathway 指“变异/畸变细胞、基因或通路”；在心理学与犯罪学中，aberrant behavior 指“偏离常态的行为”。
【助记方法】ab（偏离）+ err（漫游/错误）+ ant（形容词后缀）→ 偏离正确轨道漫游的 → 偏离正道的，异常的。

phrases.zh: 异常行为，偏态行为
变异细胞
异常基因表达
偏离常态的模式

examples.en: The psychologist studied the aberrant behavior of troubled teenagers.
examples.zh: 心理学家研究了问题青少年偏离常态的行为。

examples.en: Such aberrant weather conditions are increasingly linked to climate change.
examples.zh: 这种异常的天气状况越来越与气候变化联系在一起。

examples.en: The biopsy revealed the presence of aberrant cells requiring further analysis.
examples.zh: 活检显示存在需要进一步分析的变异细胞。

examples.en: Scientists identified an aberrant protein pathway associated with the disease.
examples.zh: 科学家发现了一条与该疾病相关的异常蛋白质通路。

examples.en: His aberrant remarks during the press conference raised eyebrows among reporters.
examples.zh: 他在新闻发布会上的反常言论引发了记者的疑虑。

synonyms.note: 不正常的，异常的。区别：abnormal 为通用词；aberrant 侧重偏离既定轨道或标准，更具学术感。
异常的，不规则的。区别：anomalous 侧重难以用现有规则解释的反常现象；aberrant 侧重偏离正轨或规范。

examples.en: The car took a lurch forward.
examples.zh: 汽车一个趔趄，向前冲去。

examples.en: His heart gave a lurch when he saw her.
examples.zh: 他见到她时心怦然一跳。

examples.en: But by 1978, music had migrated to FM, leaving AM in a programming lurch.
examples.zh: 但到 1978 年，音乐已转向 FM，AM 节目陷入困境。

examples.en: We are a good couple of miles away, but it still makes my innards lurch.
examples.zh: 我们相距好几英里，但仍然让我的内脏颤抖。

examples.en: Election year wrangling over energy policy left the popular piece of legislation in the lurch.
examples.zh: 选举年围绕能源政策的争论使这项受欢迎的立法陷入困境。

examples.en: You have no reason to be apprehensive of the future.
examples.zh: 你没有理由忧虑未来。

examples.en: People are still terribly apprehensive about the future.
examples.zh: 人们对未来依旧极为担心。

examples.en: She was deeply apprehensive that something might go wrong.
examples.zh: 她很担心可能要出什么差错。

examples.en: Still, people living in the area appear to be growing increasingly apprehensive as the storm approaches.
examples.zh: 尽管如此，随着风暴的临近，居住在该地区的人们似乎越来越担心。

examples.en: Some Brazilians are apprehensive of what the continuation of a Lula administration could mean.
examples.zh: 一些巴西人对卢拉政府继续执政可能意味着什么感到担忧。

examples.en: With these two biases combined, it's only natural that your son is apprehensive about moving West.
examples.zh: 将这两种偏见结合在一起，你的儿子对搬到西部感到担忧是很自然的。

examples.en: That's followed by the final dramatic element—the denouement or the resolution, when all the loose ends have to be tied up in a logical way.
examples.zh: 接下来是最后一个戏剧元素——结局或决议，这时所有开放的情节都必须按符合逻辑的方式联系起来。

examples.en: Act three is the denouement.
examples.zh: 第三幕是收场。

examples.en: And Dennis Kelly's book could see some more finessing, particularly with Trunchbull's silent final denouement.
examples.zh: 丹尼斯·凯利的书可以看到更多的技巧，特别是特朗奇布尔沉默的最后结局。

examples.en: Putting up regulatory road blocks might delay the denouement, but ultimately those efforts are pointless.
examples.zh: 设置监管障碍可能会推迟结局，但最终这些努力都是毫无意义的。

examples.en: And it is picking up unexpected new recruits as the campaign approaches its denouement.
examples.zh: 随着竞选活动接近尾声，它正在招募意想不到的新成员。

examples.en: Lee Ki-Churl, a corporation official, said he expected Tanzanians to benefit from the deal.

examples.en: She took care to paint her toe nails a lurid red or orange.
examples.zh: 她小心翼翼地把脚趾甲涂成艳丽的红色或桔色。

examples.en: It was whispered, by those who peered after her, that the scarlet letter threw a lurid gleam along the dark passageway of the interior.
examples.zh: 那些在她身后窥视的人低声说，那红字在屋内漆黑的过道上投下了一道血红的闪光。

examples.en: The trio make lurid allegations about specific incidents.
examples.zh: 三个女性对具体事件作出了耸人听闻的指控。

examples.en: Her narrative, though sometimes tangential and disjointed, rattles enjoyably through a lurid and restless landscape.
examples.zh: 她的叙述虽然有时离题和脱节，但却愉快地讲述了一个可怕而不安的风景。

examples.en: The result is part trip, part secret journal, spliced together into a lurid public memorandum.
examples.zh: 结果就是一半是旅行，一半是秘密日记，最后拼接成一份耸人听闻的公开备忘录。

examples.en: But don't be misled by stock market gloom and lurid headlines on the credit crisis.
examples.zh: 但不要被股市的低迷和信贷危机的耸人听闻的头条新闻所误导。

examples.en: At the age of twelve, his father sent him to Harrow Public School, which was famous for training English gentlemen.
examples.zh: 12岁时，他的父亲把他送到哈罗公学，这所学校以培养英国绅士而闻名。

examples.en: So did Winston Churchill, who almost failed out of Harrow, an elite British school.
examples.zh: 温斯顿·丘吉尔也是如此，他差点从英国一所精英学校哈罗公学退学。

examples.en: The waste will come from Brent, Ealing, Harrow, Hillingdon, Hounslow and Richmond upon Thames.
examples.zh: 废物将来自布伦特、伊灵、哈罗、希灵登、豪恩斯洛和泰晤士河畔里士满。

examples.en: As a boy, the former British PM won a poetry prize at Harrow School.
examples.zh: 这位英国前首相小时候曾在哈罗公学获得过诗歌奖。

examples.en: It is this document Harrow Estates wants to change to allow less frequent water testing.
examples.zh: 哈罗庄园希望修改这份文件，以减少水质检测的频率。

examples.en: He was a punctilious young man.
examples.zh: 他是个拘谨的年轻人。

examples.en: He was punctilious about being ready and waiting in the entrance hall exactly on time.
examples.zh: 他拘于礼数地准备妥当，按时在门厅的入口处等候。

examples.en: Norman was a punctilious student of statistics.
examples.zh: 诺曼曾是一个拘泥细节的统计学研究者。

examples.en: He was as punctilious about his honour, as fine a horseman and as deep in debt as any of them.
examples.zh: 他和他们中的任何一个人一样，对自己的荣誉一丝不苟，是一名优秀的骑手，但也负债累累。

examples.en: The Germans and Scandinavians, notably punctilious in legal matters, are expected to hold out against any watering down of the court's statute.
examples.zh: 德国人和斯堪的纳维亚人在法律事务上尤其一丝不苟，预计将坚决反对任何淡化法院法规的行为。

examples.en: Williams was finally reported missing by a co-worker August 23, more than a week after the normally punctilious employee had last shown up at work.
examples.zh: 8 月 23 日，威廉姆斯终于被一名同事报告失踪，距离这位一向一丝不苟的员工最后一次上班已经过去一周多了。

examples.en: The kid's Tyro is an able pick for kids.
examples.zh: 孩子的初学者是一个能够为孩子们挑选。

examples.en: Judging by the snowboards it was easy for me to know who the veterans were and who were the tyro snowboarders.
examples.zh: 看的滑雪板很容易我知道谁是老战士，谁是初学者滑雪。

examples.en: What separates the professional from the tyro is knowing when to apply the power of scripting and when to eschew it.
examples.zh: 专家和新手的区别在于：知道什么时候 运用该脚本，什么时候 避免使用它。

examples.en: Still, you'd never take him for a tyro from the strong performances by his excellent cast.
examples.zh: 尽管如此，你永远不会因为他出色的演员阵容的出色表演而把他视为新手。

examples.en: The relationship with Beauvoir propelled this twenty-six-year-old tyro into the highest reaches of French culture.
examples.zh: 与波伏娃的关系将这位二十六岁的新手推向了法国文化的最高层。

examples.en: Also among those who have advised the tyro Illinois Senator are James Ludes, former national security policy adviser to Sen.
examples.zh: 为这位初出茅庐的伊利诺伊州参议员提供建议的人中还有詹姆斯·卢德斯（James Ludes），他是参议员的前国家安全政策顾问。

examples.en: These movies seem to epitomize the 1950s.
examples.zh: 这些影片似乎就是20世纪50年代的缩影。

examples.en: Dressed in their traditional costumes, the castellers seem to epitomize an easier time, before Barcelona became a world metropolis and the Mediterranean's most dynamic city.
examples.zh: 在巴塞罗那成为世界大都市和地中海最具活力的城市之前，身着传统服装的叠人塔似乎是一个更安逸的时代的缩影。

examples.en: A fascinating part of this tremendous societal change is the people who epitomize it.
examples.zh: 这个巨大的社会变化中的一个迷人的部分，是那些有代表性的人们。

examples.en: Bill Casey, I think as Ed made very clear, did epitomize the best that is in America.
examples.zh: 我认为，正如埃德所明确指出的那样，比尔·凯西确实代表了美国最好的事物。

examples.en: Hugh and his fellow competitors epitomize the future of desktop fabrication and manufacturing.
examples.zh: 休和他的竞争对手代表了桌面制造和制造的未来。

examples.en: Stern broke SEIU off from the AFL-CIO two years ago and has come to epitomize the contemporary union boss.
examples.zh: 斯特恩两年前将 SEIU 从 AFL-CIO 中分离出来，成为当代工会老板的缩影。

words.meaning: n. 效忠；忠诚；拥戴
words.analysis: 【细微含义与使用场景】正式书面语。指对国家、君主、政党、领袖或某种信念的忠诚义务与誓约（pledge/swear allegiance to）。情感色彩庄重深刻。【历史典故】源自中世纪法文 liege（领主与封臣的关系），指封臣向领主宣誓效忠。【助记】al-（朝向）+ liege（领主）+ -ance -> 向领主尽忠 -> 效忠。

examples.en: New citizens raise their right hand to pledge allegiance to the constitution during the ceremony.
examples.zh: 新公民在仪式上升起右手宣誓效忠宪法。

examples.en: The general refused to break his oath of allegiance to the elected government.
examples.zh: 将军拒绝违背他对民选政府效忠的誓言。

examples.en: Voters in swing states often shift their allegiance between major parties during election cycles.
examples.zh: 摇摆州的选民在选举周期中往往会在主要政党之间转变效忠立场。

examples.en: Immature politicians who constantly switch allegiances rarely earn long-term trust.
examples.zh: 不断改变立场的朝三暮四的政客很少赢得长期信任。

examples.en: He found himself torn by divided allegiances between his country of birth and his adopted home.
examples.zh: 他发现自己夹在出生国与定居国之间的双重忠诚中难以抉择。

synonyms.note: 解析：承诺，责任感。区别：Allegiance 侧重于对国家、君主等在政治上的效忠与拥护；Commitment 侧重于对目标或事业的长期承诺和全身心投入。
解析：忠诚。区别：Allegiance 带有义务或法律色彩的效忠；Loyalty 是普通用词，侧重于对家人、朋友或国家在感情上的坚定不移。
解析：奉献。区别：Allegiance 强调顺从和支持；Dedication 侧重于为了某种理想或事业而无私奉献时间和精力。

words.meaning: v. 蓄意破坏，暗中破坏；n. 破坏活动，怠工
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】指为了政治、军事、商业或竞争目的，秘密或故意毁坏设备、基础设施、计划或谈判定局（sabotage equipment / negotiations / plans）。
【感情色彩】强烈的贬义词。
【词源故事】来自法语 sabot（木鞋）。早期工人在工业革命时期将木鞋扔进纺织机中破坏机器以示抗议，因而得名 sabotage。
【IT/网络安全扩展】Cyber sabotage（网络破坏/数字攻击破坏设施）；insider sabotage（内部人员破坏代码或数据）。
【助记方法】sabot（木鞋）+ -age -> 扔木鞋捣乱 -> 破坏。

examples.en: Disgruntled employees attempted to sabotage the factory production line.
examples.zh: 不满的员工试图暗中破坏工厂的生产线。

examples.en: Investigators suspected cyber sabotage when the power grid suffered a sudden blackout.
examples.zh: 当电网遭遇突然停电时，调查人员怀疑是网络破坏所致。

examples.en: Leaking confidential documents was a calculated attempt to sabotage the peace talks.
examples.zh: 泄露机密文件是蓄意破坏和平谈判的算计举动。

examples.en: Do not let self-doubt sabotage your chances of succeeding in the interview.
examples.zh: 不要让自我怀疑破坏你在面试中取得成功的机会。

examples.en: The military operation was crippled by acts of enemy sabotage behind front lines.
examples.zh: 前线后方敌人的破坏行为瘫痪了军事行动。

synonyms.note: v. 破坏，削弱。Undermine 侧重于在暗中或不知不觉中逐渐削弱地基、声誉或力量；Sabotage 侧重于通过蓄意行动进行的实质性破坏。
v. 破坏，反击。Countermine 侧重于用计谋反制对方的计谋；Sabotage 侧重于内部人员或敌特人员的蓄意破坏。
v. 抵消，阻碍。Counteract 侧重于采取行动来抵消或中和某种负面影响；Sabotage 侧重于恶意的、具有破坏性的暗中妨碍。
v. 颠覆，破坏。Subvert 侧重于通过暗中手段颠覆政府、制度或信仰；Sabotage 侧重于对设备、计划或行动的蓄意破坏。

phrases.zh: 破坏努力/计划
网络破坏
破坏行为
破坏设备

examples.en: If his early form in France reflected hesitance, the six-foot four-inches tall striker, came into his own in his second season.
examples.zh: 如果说他在法国的早期表现反映出了犹豫的话，那么这位身高六英尺四英寸的前锋在他的第二个赛季就展现了自己的实力。

examples.zh: 我们是白天活动的生物，眼睛已经适应了在阳光下的生活。

examples.en: Kangaroos are diurnal animals.
examples.zh: 袋鼠是昼出动物。

examples.en: Sceloporus lizards, like most others, are diurnal - active during the day - and cold-blooded, so they can't regulate their body temperature.
examples.zh: 绿刺蜥和其它大多数物种一样，是昼行性(在白天活动)冷血动物，因此，它们不能调整自身体温。

examples.en: They are mostly diurnal - sleeping at night and active during the day.
examples.zh: 它们大多是昼行性的——晚上睡觉，白天活动。

examples.en: Melatonin is vital for maintaining the body's correct diurnal rhythms - helping a person sleep at night and stay awake during the day.
examples.zh: 褪黑激素对于维持身体正确的昼夜节律至关重要 - 帮助人们在晚上入睡并在白天保持清醒。

examples.en: Mice and humans are physiologically alike, so a similar effect might be expected for people, but the fact that mice are nocturnal and humans diurnal is a serious complicating factor.
examples.zh: 小鼠和人类在生理上是相似的，因此人类可能会产生类似的效果，但事实上，小鼠是夜间活动的，而人类是白天活动的，这是一个严重的复杂因素。

examples.en: She just sat there looking morose.
examples.zh: 她就那样阴郁地坐在那儿。

examples.en: She was morose, pale, and reticent.
examples.zh: 她闷闷不乐，面色苍白，沉默寡言。

examples.en: I'm taking a morose tone at this point with Garrison Keillor giving me the snub.

examples.en: One myth is that he was a misanthrope, a grumbling recluse, whose work was as morose as his life.
examples.zh: 一个神话是，他是一个愤世嫉俗者，一个爱发牢骚的隐士，他的工作和他的生活一样阴郁。

examples.zh: 他的动机主要是为了让座席开心，其理论是快乐的员工在电话中听起来比忧郁的员工听起来更好。

examples.en: Mild jaundice in the newborn is common and often clears without treatment.
examples.zh: 新生儿有轻微的黄疸较为常见，通常会不治自愈。

examples.en: Incompatibility between the mother's and the baby's blood groups may cause jaundice.
examples.zh: 母亲和胎儿的血型不合有可能导致黄疸。

examples.zh: 标准医学术语中，“黄疸”是一种皮肤变黄的症状。

examples.zh: 但有时20年后，慢性丙型肝炎会引起黄疸、恶心和腹痛。

examples.en: Both are suffering from jaundice, but the treatment is routine and their conditions are not serious, Swift said.

examples.en: At Osram Sylvania labs in Danvers, Mass. researchers are experimenting with blankets woven with LEDs to treat babies with severe jaundice.

examples.en: "Who is it?" A man's low, garbled voice asked through the speaker grate.
examples.zh: “哪位？” 一个男子低沉含糊的声音通过扬声器的格栅问道。

examples.en: Put the ginger in a plastic bag and put it in the freezer, grate it as needed.
examples.zh: 把姜放进塑料袋后，把它放进冰箱，需要的时候磨碎它。

examples.en: This is the reflection of trees in a rusting grate in a park near Chiang Mai train station in Thailand.
examples.zh: 这是在泰国清迈火车站附近的公园，锈迹斑斑格栅中的树丛的倒影。

examples.en: Grate the lemon peel into the same bowl, taking care to avoid the white pith.
examples.zh: 将柠檬皮磨碎放入同一个碗中，注意避免白色髓。

examples.en: You don't have to get on your hands and knees and clean out the grate.
examples.zh: 您不必用手和膝盖来清理炉排。

examples.en: Her legs remind you of a grate, everything's with holes up to the knees.
examples.zh: 她的腿让你想起了栅栏，从膝盖到膝盖处全都是破洞。

examples.en: We knew we were in for a pretty long, jejune evening.
examples.zh: 我们知道自己身处一个相当漫长而乏味的夜晚。

examples.en: She seems a rather creepy, jejune and adolescent fantasy.
examples.zh: 她是一个怪异，不成熟的青春幻想产物。

examples.en: We were surprised by their jejune responses to our problems.
examples.zh: 他们空洞的响应让我们很惊奇。

examples.en: The tribalists badly underestimated Mr Cameron, blindly dismissing him as a jejune, upstart toff.
examples.zh: 部落主义者严重低估了卡梅伦先生，盲目地将他视为一个幼稚的暴发户贵族。

examples.en: She seems a rather creepy, jejune and adolescent fantasy.
examples.zh: 她似乎是一个相当令人毛骨悚然、幼稚和青春期的幻想。

examples.en: Sometimes it makes American religious belief look unsophisticated and jejune - in fact it merely represents, it seems to me, a truth about the nation: the search for God is not just a search in the lazy passive European way: it is a search with an end in sight.
examples.zh: 有时，它使美国的宗教信仰显得简单而幼稚——事实上，在我看来，它仅仅代表了一个关于这个国家的真理：对上帝的探索不仅仅是欧洲人懒惰被动的方式的探索：这是一种有终点的探索。

examples.en: Here, the service is deadpan and prices sharp.
examples.zh: 这里的服务没有笑脸，价格却不低廉。

examples.en: 'From punching people in the face,' he replied, deadpan.
examples.zh: 他冷冷的告诉我，也是在打别人脸的时候。

examples.en: The film’s outrageous deadpan humour recalls the early efforts of its producer, Peter Jackson.
examples.zh: 这部电影不同寻常的冷幽默还要得益于其制片人皮特•杰克逊早期的努力。

examples.en: Merritt's vocals tend toward the deadpan tuneless, but he writes lovely melodies with a sting.
examples.zh: 梅里特的声音倾向于冷漠无调，但他写出的旋律却带有刺痛感。

examples.en: With a deadpan expression, Mairbek explained that the genie inside the girl was 340 years old.
examples.zh: 梅尔贝克面无表情地解释说，女孩体内的精灵已经有 340 岁了。

examples.en: My mother had recently filled half a red Silvine exercise book with startlingly deadpan revelations.
examples.zh: 我母亲最近在半本红色的西尔文练习本上写满了令人震惊的面无表情的启示。

examples.en: As the individual matures, that overt talking to oneself becomes covert talking to oneself, but thinking still shows up as a laryngeal habit.
examples.zh: 随着个体的成熟，公开的自言自语变成了隐蔽的自言自语，但思考仍然表现为一种喉部习惯。

examples.en: He stole a covert glance at her across the table.
examples.zh: 他隔着桌子偷偷地瞥了她一眼。

examples.en: Then he made his deliberations covert.
examples.zh: 然后，他进行不公开的审议。

examples.en: Now at 17, she has recently been appointed as an agent in the Covert Operations Division.
examples.zh: 现年 17 岁的她最近被任命为秘密行动部门的特工。

examples.en: But approaching photography like a covert operation is not the most ethical way to get a great shot.
examples.zh: 但将摄影视为秘密行动并不是获得精彩镜头的最道德方式。

examples.en: Other covert horticulturalists have even inspired local residents to get involved in the greening.
examples.zh: 其他隐蔽园艺师甚至激励当地居民参与绿化。

examples.en: Convergent questions have one correct answer.
examples.zh: 聚合型问题只有一个正确答案。

examples.en: However, from a consistency perspective, only convergent consistency is given.
examples.zh: 但是，从一致性方面来看，只提供收敛一致性。

examples.en: Another approach to questioning asks if they require convergent or divergent answers.
examples.zh: 提问的另外一种方式，就是询问是需要聚合型还是发散型答案。

examples.en: Innovative breakthroughs are the result of the interplay between convergent and divergent modes of thinking.
examples.zh: 创新突破是趋同和发散思维模式相互作用的结果。

examples.en: The interplay between convergent and divergent thinking is recapitulated even in something as trivial as memory.
examples.zh: 即使在像记忆这样微不足道的事情中，聚合思维和发散思维之间的相互作用也得到了概括。

examples.en: The kind of convergent, focussed thinking people seek from Adderall can interfere with divergent, creative thought.
examples.zh: 人们从阿得拉那里寻求的那种收敛、集中的思维可能会干扰发散的、创造性的思维。

examples.en: I was given a free hand in designing the syllabus.
examples.zh: 我获准全权制订教学大纲。

examples.en: We need to design a new syllabus for the third year.
examples.zh: 我们需要为三年级学生制订一个新的课程大纲。

examples.en: The syllabus prescribes precisely which books should be studied.
examples.zh: 教学大纲明确规定了哪些是必读的书。

examples.en: Thus, in some sense, the Reporting Africa syllabus reflects the spirit of the UNESCO Model Curricula.
examples.zh: 因此，从某种意义上说，《非洲报告》教学大纲反映了教科文组织示范课程的精神。

examples.en: All communication systems serve a purpose, a pragmatic function of some sort.
examples.zh: 所有的通信系统都有一个目的，某种实用的功能。

examples.en: Knowledge of chronobiological patterns can have many pragmatic implications for our day-to-day lives.
examples.zh: 关于生物钟模式的知识可以对我们的日常生活产生许多实际影响。

examples.en: One reason for the striking upsurge of social psychology in the United States lies in the pragmatic tradition of this country.
examples.zh: 美国社会心理的显著高涨，其原因之一在于这个国家的实用主义传统。

examples.en: When she faces criticism, the knock is she's too pragmatic as often as too pushy.
examples.zh: 当她面临批评时，人们的批评是她太务实，也常常太咄咄逼人。

examples.en: We ought to take the same pragmatic approach to debates over monetary policy and broadband policy.
examples.zh: 我们应该对货币政策和宽带政策的辩论采取同样务实的态度。

examples.en: In public, she appears sensible, pragmatic, occasionally glum-looking, ever careful not to cause offence.
examples.zh: 在公共场合，她显得明智、务实，偶尔会显得闷闷不乐，但总是小心翼翼地避免冒犯他人。

examples.en: The book does not purport to be a complete history of the period.
examples.zh: 本书无意标榜为那个时期的全史。

examples.en: A number of tools purport to visualize Ant targets.
examples.zh: 有很多的工具都旨在可视化表示Ant目标。

examples.en: Many theories purport to explain growth in terms of a single cause.
examples.zh: 许多理论都标榜以单一的原因解释生长。

examples.en: It took me nearly 10 years to work out the American purport of the word quite.
examples.zh: 我花了近十年的时间才弄清楚“相当”这个词在美国的含义。

examples.en: Instead, most books purport to teach you how to pick winning stocks or time the market.
examples.zh: 相反，大多数书籍都声称教你如何挑选获胜股票或把握市场时机。

examples.en: And several studies purport to show that playing violent video games raises aggression levels.
examples.zh: 多项研究表明，玩暴力电子游戏会提高攻击性水平。

examples.en: He has become a legend in the annals of military history.
examples.zh: 他成了军事编年史上的一个传奇。

examples.en: He noted that biomedical journals such as Annals of Internal Medicine, the Journal of the American Medical Association and The Lancet pay strong attention to statistical review.
examples.zh: 他指出，《内科医学年鉴》、《美国医学会杂志》和《柳叶刀》等生物医学期刊非常重视数据审查。

examples.en: But he noted that biomedical journals such as Annals of Internal Medicine, the Journal of the American Medical Association and The Lancet pay strong attention to statistical review.
examples.zh: 但他指出，《内科医学年鉴》、《美国医学会杂志》和《柳叶刀》等生物医学期刊非常重视统计评论。

examples.en: Cloning extinct or endangered species should come as no surprise in the annals of anthropogenic busywork.
examples.zh: 在人类繁琐的工作史中，克隆灭绝或濒临灭绝的物种应该不足为奇。

examples.en: It became a classic in advertising annals, one studied by ad pros even today.
examples.zh: 它成为广告史上的经典，至今仍为广告专业人士所研究。

examples.en: They get written about, win awards and then slowly slip into the annals of history.
examples.zh: 他们被报道、获奖，然后慢慢载入史册。

examples.en: Findings from several studies on corporate mergers and acquisitions during the 1970's and 1980's raise questions about why firms initiate and consummate such transactions.
examples.zh: 20世纪70年代和80年代对公司合并和收购的几项研究的结果提出了这样一个问题：公司为什么要发起并完成这类交易？

examples.en: She was a consummate performer.
examples.zh: 她是个技艺非凡的表演者。

examples.en: He acted the part with consummate skill.
examples.zh: 他以精湛的演技饰演了这个角色。

examples.en: Creating more wealth isn't the driver This consummate dealmaker is motivated by unfinished business.
examples.zh: 创造更多财富并不是驱动因素 这位完美的交易撮合者的动机是未完成的业务。

examples.en: He remains the consummate amateur, drawing his authority from the peculiar independence of his work.
examples.zh: 他仍然是一位完美的业余爱好者，他的权威来自于他工作的独特独立性。

examples.en: He is also a consummate schmoozer who has been accumulating business cards since college.
examples.zh: 他也是一位出色的闲聊者，从大学起就一直在积累名片。

examples.en: I'm never sparing with the garlic.
examples.zh: 我从不吝啬使用大蒜。

examples.en: He was always sparing with his praise.
examples.zh: 他从不轻易说赞扬话。

examples.en: Doctors now advise only sparing use of such creams.
examples.zh: 现在大夫建议，这种乳霜要慎用。

examples.en: That means fewer tractors and the carbon-sparing equivalent of taking 6 million cars off the road.
examples.zh: 这意味着减少拖拉机的数量，相当于减少 600 万辆汽车的碳排放量。

examples.en: How about the same method to deliver vaccines, sparing the costs of refrigeration and needles?
examples.zh: 用同样的方法来输送疫苗，节省冷藏和针头的成本怎么样？

examples.en: Firing Back is full of wreckage and hard-fought redemption, sparing little detail and never going gooey.
examples.zh: 《火力反击》充满了残骸和艰苦的救赎，不遗余力地保留小细节，而且永远不会变得粘糊糊的。

examples.en: He became a taciturn man, a man not easy to live with. Later, when the older children married and had children of their own, he mellowed a little.
examples.zh: 他变成了一个沉默寡言的人、一个不容易相处的人。后来，等大点的孩子们结了婚，也有了他们自己的孩子，他变得平和了些。

examples.en: The King chafed bitterly over the stupendous indignity thus put upon his royalty, but Hendon was moody and taciturn.
examples.zh: 国王对他的王权受到的巨大侮辱感到非常愤怒，亨顿更是憋住一肚子气，沉默寡言。

examples.en: Well before he died of cancer in 2008, Harold Pinter knew he had earned a reputation for being "enigmatic, taciturn, terse, prickly, explosive and forbidding".
examples.zh: 早在2008年哈罗德·品特因癌症去世之前，他就知道了自己赢得了“高深莫测、沉默寡言、简洁、多刺、暴躁以及令人生畏”的名声。

examples.en: My taciturn brother had become even more silent, as if he himself had turned into stone.
examples.zh: 沉默寡言的哥哥变得更加沉默，仿佛自己变成了石头。

examples.en: Pic, a taciturn Frenchman, has the hair of a surfer and the demeanor of a poet.
examples.zh: 皮克是一位沉默寡言的法国人，有着冲浪者的头发和诗人的风度。

examples.en: He is neither a rotten manager nor a particularly taciturn one, but an English-speaking American.
examples.zh: 他既不是一个烂经理，也不是一个特别沉默寡言的经理，而是一个说英语的美国人。

examples.en: She was getting into trouble over playing truant from school.
examples.zh: 她由于逃学而遇到了麻烦。

examples.en: In his small studio on West 37th Street, Mr. Wu, wore a cardigan and a necktie and looked like a truant from a boarding school.
examples.zh: 在西第37号街他小小的工作室里，吴先生穿一件羊毛衫、带着一条领带，看上去好像从寄宿学校逃学的学生。

examples.en: I have been nothing but a truant and a vagabond.
examples.zh: 我一直只是个无用的流浪汉。

examples.en: Children who played truant were being condemned to a life of unemployment and crime, he said.
examples.zh: 他说，逃学的孩子注定要过失业和犯罪的生活。

examples.en: The truant is young Sam Shakusky (Jared Gilman), and he has gone to find Suzy.
examples.zh: 逃学的人是年轻的萨姆·沙库斯基（贾里德·吉尔曼饰），他去找苏西了。

examples.en: And the courts see truant students the next week instead of months later, helping to speed intervention.
examples.zh: 法院会在下周而不是几个月后审理逃学学生的案件，这有助于加快干预速度。

examples.en: It would be presumptuous to judge what the outcome will be.
examples.zh: 断定结果将会如何未免冒失。

examples.en: It is too presumptuous of him to do so.
examples.zh: 他这样做太放肆了。

examples.en: One should never be presumptuous and opinionated.
examples.zh: 切不可自以为是。

examples.en: Because women in politics are always by definition seen as presumptuous: They presume to lead men.

examples.en: It seems that humankind is to be destroyed because they irritate the gods with their tumult and noise.
examples.zh: 似乎是人类是要被毁灭的，因为人类的骚乱和噪音惹怒众神。

examples.en: Right now a great and ancient civilization is going through a time of tumult and transformation.
examples.zh: 现在，一个伟大而古老的文明正在经历一个动荡和变革的时期。

examples.en: Despite the tumult, the industry lauds that the annual festival is continuing, and growing.

examples.en: A scent associated with a good experience can bring a rush of joy, while a foul odour or one associated with a bad memory may make us grimace with disgust.
examples.zh: 一种与美好经历有关的气味会带来快乐，而一种恶臭或与糟糕的记忆有关的气味可能会让我们厌恶地做鬼脸。

examples.en: 'What's that?' she asked with a grimace.
examples.zh: “那是什么？”她皱着眉头问道。

examples.en: He took another drink of his coffee. "Awful," he said with a grimace.
examples.zh: 他又喝了一口咖啡，“太难喝了”，他边说边扮了个怪相。

examples.en: Kansas State had two-tone purple uniforms that looked like Barney sharing a bunk-bed with Grimace.
examples.zh: 堪萨斯州立大学有两种色调的紫色校服，看起来就像巴尼和鬼脸共用一张双层床。

examples.en: Sometimes -- often -- I grimace and panic, look wildly about as I totter and flail.
examples.zh: 有时——经常——我会做鬼脸、惊慌，当我摇摇欲坠、连枷时，我会疯狂地环顾四周。

examples.en: Garfield noticed that when team members lifted to exhaustion, they would invariably grimace at the painful effort.
examples.zh: 加菲猫注意到，当团队成员筋疲力尽时，他们总是会因痛苦的努力而做鬼脸。

words.meaning: v. 痛恨，深恶痛绝，极其讨厌
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】表达对某种事物或行为在道德、心理或生理感官上的极度厌恶与憎恨（abominate cruelty / dishonesty）。属于高级正式书面语，语气十分强烈。
【历史典故/词源】源自拉丁语 abominatus，由 ab-（远离）+ omen/omin-（凶兆，预兆）构成。古罗马时期意为“把某物当作不祥之兆而避之唯恐不及”，后引申为“极度厌恶”。
【专业领域特殊含义】在文学与神学中常用于对罪恶、非人道行径或邪恶不详之物的绝对排斥表达。
【助记方法】ab（远离）+ omen（凶兆）+ ate → 像避开凶兆一样远离 → 痛恨，极度厌恶。

phrases.zh: 痛恨残忍行为
深恶痛绝虚伪
备受憎恶的做法
极其厌恶背叛

examples.en: They abominate all forms of cruelty to animals.
examples.zh: 他们深恶痛绝任何形式的虐待动物行为。

examples.en: She abominates the dishonesty she sees in modern politics.
examples.zh: 她对现代政治中看到的虚伪欺骗感到极其厌恶。

examples.en: He abominates cold weather and longs to move to the tropics.
examples.zh: 他极其讨厌寒冷的天气，渴望搬到热带居住。

examples.en: Religious leaders abominated the lawless violence spreading through the country.
examples.zh: 宗教领袖对全国蔓延的无无法纪的暴力行为表示极度愤慨。

examples.en: I abominate racial prejudice in any guise.
examples.zh: 我极其痛恨任何形式的种族偏见。

synonyms.note: 痛恨，深恶痛绝。区别：abhor 与 abominate 近义，均指极度厌恶；abominate 词源带有不祥凶兆的威压感。
极度讨厌。区别：loathe 含有令人作呕的生理恶心感；abominate 强调道德反感。

examples.en: She felt a deep sense of apprehension as she stepped onto the stage for her first live performance.
examples.zh: 当她登上舞台进行首次现场演出时，心中涌起一阵强烈的忧虑与紧张。

examples.en: The police announced the swift apprehension of two suspects following the robbery.
examples.zh: 警方宣布在抢劫案发生后迅速逮捕了两名嫌疑人。

examples.en: There is growing apprehension among workers that automation will replace their jobs.
examples.zh: 工人中越来越担心自动化会取代 their 工作。

examples.en: His subtle apprehension of complex philosophical theories impressed the faculty.
examples.zh: 他对复杂哲学理论的敏锐领悟力给教职员留下了深刻印象。

examples.en: Despite her apprehensions about moving abroad, she embraced the new challenge eagerly.
examples.zh: 尽管对移居国外感到担忧，她还是热切地迎接了新的挑战。

synonyms.note: 解析：忧虑，担心。区别：Apprehension 可指逮捕、理解或对未来的忧虑；Apprehensiveness 专门指忧心忡忡、害怕的状态。
解析：恐惧，害怕。区别：Apprehension 是一种夹杂着不安和焦虑的担忧；Dread 是一种更为强烈和深沉的恐惧，通常是对即将发生的可怕事情的畏惧。

etymology.rootMeaning: n. 理解, 忧惧, 逮捕；领会
etymology.explanation: 现有词源记录可追溯到 1570 年代；词形经古法语 apreension 进入或影响英语；从现代构词看可辅助拆为 apprehen + -sion（名词后缀，表示行为或结果）。
etymology.memory: 先记核心义“理解”，再用常用搭配和例句巩固词形，避免编造不存在的词根。

words.analysis:
【细微含义】包含三个核心义项：1. 对未来坏事即将发生的隐隐担忧和不安（最常用）；2. 法律上的逮捕/拘押（如 apprehension of suspects）；3. 对概念、道理的理解与领会（较书面语）。
【使用场景与感情色彩】多用于书面语、心理描写及法律报道。
【助记方法】apprehend（理解/逮捕/忧虑）+ -ion（名词后缀）。ap-（去）+ prehend（抓住）-> 抓住犯人（逮捕）、抓住含义（理解）、心被悬着抓紧（忧虑）。

examples.en: Her popularity has been on the wane for some time.
examples.zh: 她的人气一段时间以来江河日下。

examples.en: While his interest in these sports began to wane, a passion for lacrosse developed.
examples.zh: 他对这些运动项目的兴趣开始减退的同时，对长曲棍球的兴趣却浓厚起来。

examples.en: Without demonstrable progress, the negotiators will begin to see their influence wane.
examples.zh: 没有可展示的进展，磋商者将会开始看到他们的影响力减弱。

examples.en: While almost every country now votes, public faith in democracy is on the wane.
examples.zh: 尽管现在几乎每个国家都会投票，但公众对民主的信心正在减弱。

examples.en: But now there are fears that this aspect of Singapore's culinary heritage is on the wane.
examples.zh: 但现在有人担心新加坡烹饪传统的这一方面正在衰落。

examples.en: Both factors are temporary and when they wane we predict a hard landing for gold.
examples.zh: 这两个因素都是暂时的，当它们减弱时，我们预计黄金将硬着陆。

examples.en: She is currently writing a sequel to Daphne du Maurier's "Rebecca."
examples.zh: 她目前正在写达夫妮·杜穆里埃的《蝴蝶梦》续集。

examples.en: The creators of the original X-Men abbreviated the title of its sequel to simply X2.
examples.zh: 第1部《X战警》的创作者们把其续集的片名缩写成简单的《X2》。

examples.en: The sequel will finally unveil the family secret of why Po's father is a duck.
examples.zh: 续集将最终揭开为什么阿宝的父亲是只鸭子的家庭秘密。

examples.en: News that creator Hidetaka Miyazaki was not directing the sequel only made matters worse.
examples.zh: 创作者宫崎英高不再执导续集的消息只会让事情变得更糟。

examples.en: This year's sequel is the work of Elizabeth Corcoran, our Silicon Valley bureau chief.
examples.zh: 今年的续集是我们硅谷分社社长伊丽莎白·科克兰 (Elizabeth Corcoran) 的作品。

examples.en: Paramount did a few very smart things during the production of this Jon Chu-helmed sequel.
examples.zh: 派拉蒙在制作这部乔恩·朱执导的续集期间做了一些非常聪明的事情。

examples.en: I've known him ever since he was a fledgling.
examples.zh: 我从他羽翼未丰时就认识他了。

examples.en: One positive outcome that could arise from bumping into a friendly ETI is that it takes our fledgling race under its wing (tentacle).
examples.zh: 若是遇到友善的外星智慧生物，其积极后果之一就是会将我们这个幼稚的文明置于其卵翼（或触手）之下。

examples.en: His conquest of Silesia gave Prussia's fledgling industries access to raw materials.
examples.zh: 他征服了西里西亚，使普鲁士的新兴产业获得原材料。

examples.en: Several years ago, Bruce Judson experimented with online advertising to attract prospects to his fledgling businesses.
examples.zh: 几年前，布鲁斯·贾德森尝试通过在线广告来吸引潜在客户加入他刚刚起步的企业。

examples.en: It was about a fledgling charity formed by author and Detroit media personality Mitch Albom.
examples.zh: 这是关于作家兼底特律媒体名人米奇·阿尔博姆 (Mitch Albom) 成立的一个新兴慈善机构的故事。

examples.en: Abdul has launched AuditionBooth.com, a site that allows fledgling entertainers connect with Hollywood big wigs.
examples.zh: Abdul 推出了 AuditionBooth.com，该网站让初出茅庐的艺人可以与好莱坞大牌建立联系。

examples.en: What a shifty arguer he is, refusing ever to give a straight answer to a straight question.
examples.zh: 他真是一个狡猾的辩手，一直拒绝对一个直接的问题给予直截了当的回答。

examples.en: But it's no problem for shifty workers to manage this.
examples.zh: 不过游荡着的工人来管理这个一点都没问题。

examples.en: We got to look out for the signs - empty hangers and shifty looks.
examples.zh: 我们得注意一切偷窃的迹象，包括店里空空的衣架和顾客诡诈的眼神。

examples.en: There's an ugly truth about the inevitability of moral compromise, embodied by the shifty Renault.
examples.zh: 道德妥协是不可避免的，这是一个丑陋的事实，狡猾的雷诺就体现了这一点。

examples.en: The Scottish Labour leader is out to paint the SNP leader and First Minister as shifty.
examples.zh: 这位苏格兰工党领袖将苏格兰民族党领袖和首席部长描绘成狡猾的人。

examples.en: That is, until their televised debate, in which JFK looked calm and sweetly reasonable, Nixon sweaty and shifty.
examples.zh: 也就是说，直到他们的电视辩论中，肯尼迪显得冷静而甜蜜合理，而尼克松则汗流浃背、狡猾。

words.meaning: adj. 极坏的，糟透的；深不可测的，无底的
words.analysis:
【细微含义与使用场景】形容质量、表现、生活条件或服务“极其低下、糟糕透顶、惨不忍睹”（abysmal performance / conditions / failure）；也可保留字面意指深不见底的（abysmal depths）。带有极强的批评与不满，高级口语与书面语高频。
【历史典故/词源】衍生自 abyss（深渊，无底洞），来自希腊语 abyssos（无底的），由 a-（无）+ byssos（底）构成。
【专业领域特殊含义】在海洋学与地质学中，abysmal (abyssal) zone 指“深海带/无底深渊层”；在经济评论中形容业绩“惨绝人寰”。
【助记方法】abyss（深渊）+ mal（坏）→ 像掉入深渊一样糟糕透顶 → 极坏的，糟透的。

phrases.zh: 极糟糕的表现
极其恶劣的条件
惨重的失败
极度的无知

examples.en: The team's abysmal performance resulted in a crushing defeat.
examples.zh: 该队极糟糕的表现导致了一场惨败。

examples.en: The prisoners were kept in abysmal conditions without proper food or sanitation.
examples.zh: 囚犯们被关押在极度恶劣的条件下，没有适当的食物和卫生设施。

examples.en: Her understanding of basic economics proved to be abysmal.
examples.zh: 事实证明她对基础经济学的理解极其匮乏贫瘠。

examples.en: Customer service at the firm reached an abysmal low last quarter.
examples.zh: 该公司的客户服务水平在上季度降到了极其糟糕的低谷。

examples.en: Light could not penetrate the abysmal depths of the oceanic trench.
examples.zh: 光线无法穿透海洋海沟深不可测的深处。

synonyms.note: 骇人听闻的，极其糟糕的。区别：appalling 侧重让人惊骇震惊；abysmal 侧重质量极低或糟糕至极。
残暴的，极坏的。区别：atrocious 带有令人发指的恶劣意味。

confusables.note: n. 深渊，无底洞

etymology.rootMeaning: 底部

etymology.memory: abyss(深渊) + mal -> 深入深渊般糟糕 -> 极坏的，糟透的

examples.en: A little before the progress was ended, the Duke was obliged to ride forward, and make remonstrance.
examples.zh: 出巡将近结束的时候，公爵不得不骑马上前，作出提醒。

examples.en: Minnie remembered Hanson's remonstrance.
examples.zh: 敏妮想起了汉生的告诫。

examples.en: I eschewed upbraiding, I curtailed remonstrance.
examples.zh: 我避免责备，少作规劝。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of remonstrance.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“抗议；规劝；谏书”的概念提供了全新的视角。

examples.en: Recent academic studies have highlighted the significance of remonstrance in modern research.
examples.zh: 最近的学术研究强调了“抗议；规劝；谏书”在现代科学研究中的重要意义。

examples.en: Her articulate argument demonstrated a deep understanding of remonstrance.
examples.zh: 她清晰有力的论证展现了对“抗议；规劝；谏书”的深刻理解。

examples.en: He bellowed in a stentorian voice.
examples.zh: 他用洪亮的声音大吼。

examples.en: The stentorian tones of auctioneer, calling out to clear, now announced that the sale to commence.
examples.zh: 拍卖人用洪亮的声音招呼大家闪开一点，然后宣布拍卖即将开始。

examples.en: The stentorian tones of auctioneer, calling out to clear , now announced that the sale to commence.
examples.zh: 拍卖人用洪亮的声音招呼大家闪开一点， 然后宣布拍卖即将开始。

examples.en: For all the shrill noise of his scrawled marginalia, Mr Twombly's tone can often be very grand and stentorian.
examples.zh: 尽管托姆布雷先生的旁注潦草，声音刺耳，但他的语气往往非常宏大和洪亮。

examples.en: My poker-faced host recited the day's dishes in stentorian tones while looking out at the street, and I scrambled to understand.
examples.zh: 面无表情的主人一边看着外面的街道，一边大声地念叨着当天的菜肴，我忙着去理解。

examples.en: Excerpt: Oddly enough, the more tired you get as you write and rewrite, the more likely you are to abandon any self-conscious semi-stentorian writing and write more like yourself.

examples.en: In a car you are fortified from the weather, and have comfortable way and plentitude of room to carry grouping and luggage.
examples.zh: 在小轿车里，你可以躲避风吹日晒，你有舒适的座位，充足的地方载人带物。

examples.en: The paper shows the plentitude and complication of Hamlet's artistic nature, which is full of poetry of history, culture and society.
examples.zh: 它交融着人类涵蕴丰富的历史、文化、社会及其审美心理的幽咽颤栗的诗性。

examples.en: But for the moment, the plentitude of plans is a problem, some say, because to be truly useful, a numbering system has to be universal.
examples.zh: 但此时此刻，这些计划的充分性依然是个问题。有人指出，要做到真正的有用，这个编号系统必须是世界性的。

examples.en: Downtown Windsor is filled with shops, historic buildings and a plentitude of restaurants, from historic pubs to modern fast food.
examples.zh: 温莎市中心遍布商店、历史建筑和众多餐厅，从历史悠久的酒吧到现代快餐店。

examples.en: The scholar's analysis provided new insight into the concept of plentitude.
examples.zh: 学者的分析为理解“充分（表示情况、状态丰富）”的概念提供了全新的视角。

examples.en: Recent academic studies have highlighted the significance of plentitude in modern research.
examples.zh: 最近的学术研究强调了“充分（表示情况、状态丰富）”在现代科学研究中的重要意义。

examples.en: Sea air is Nature's best tonic for mind and body.
examples.zh: 海上的空气是大自然赋予的对人们身心的最佳补品。

examples.en: At the time, coca leaf extract mixed with wine was a common tonic, and Pemberton's sweet brew was a way to get around local laws prohibiting the sale of alcohol.
examples.zh: 当时，古柯叶提取物混合酒是一个常见的滋补品，潘伯顿的甜酒则是一种可以绕过当地禁止售酒的法律的方法。

examples.en: I'll have a gin and tonic, please.
examples.zh: 请来一杯加奎宁水的杜松子酒。

examples.en: After a fireside gin and tonic and a dinner of dal bhat, or lentil soup and rice.
examples.zh: 享用炉边杜松子酒和滋补品，晚餐享用木豆汤或扁豆汤和米饭。

examples.en: So I created the Mortoni by substituting tonic for the vermouth and vodka for the gin.
examples.zh: 所以我用补品代替苦艾酒，用伏特加代替杜松子酒，创造了莫托尼。

examples.en: No commodity super-cycles in sight is a tonic for low inflation and comfortably cruising price-earnings ratios.
examples.zh: 目前看不到大宗商品超级周期对于低通胀和舒适的市盈率来说是一剂强心剂。

examples.zh: 我上了特级烹调课。

examples.en: The miners forced their way through a police cordon.
examples.zh: 那些矿工们冲破了警察的封锁线。

examples.en: The city doubled the cordon zone in 2007 and reduced the enforcement period by one hour.
examples.zh: 2007年，该市将警戒线范围扩大了一倍，并将执行时间缩短了一个小时。

examples.en: Security forces armed with riot gear and water cannons formed a cordon around the protesters.
examples.zh: 配备防暴装备和高压水枪的安全部队在抗议者周围形成了警戒线。

examples.en: Their main argument is fallacious.
examples.zh: 他们的主要论点是荒谬的。

examples.zh: 这是一个相当靠不住的论调。

examples.zh: 谬误的假设和方法就像佩利翁山叠到奥萨山上那样层出不穷。

examples.zh: 这是错误的经济学，其基础是我们可以让自己变得富有。

examples.en: Even more fallacious is the restrictionist argument that legalizing these kids will only encourage more illegal immigration.
examples.zh: 更错误的是限制主义者的论点，即使这些孩子合法化只会鼓励更多的非法移民。

examples.en: These bills are a welcome first step in immigration reform, and should not be derailed by fallacious arguments.
examples.zh: 这些法案是移民改革中值得欢迎的第一步，不应因错误的论点而偏离轨道。

examples.en: Her attitude is imperious at times.
examples.zh: 她的态度有时很专横。

examples.en: This was in tune with the international consensus, but it was nonetheless perceived as imperious.
examples.zh: 这符合国际共识，但仍然被认为是专横的。

examples.zh: 许多人认为，对于一个以酒店业为生的人来说，她显得异常专横。

examples.zh: 学会控制自己的病情给了威廉姆斯恢复到最佳状态的希望。

examples.zh: 巴洛克风格的圣里昂纳多教堂值得短暂留步。

examples.en: It looks like a baroque palace from Prague or Munich enlarged a hundred times.
examples.zh: 它看起来像一座扩建了100倍的布拉格或慕尼黑的巴洛克式宫殿。

examples.en: They gradually stopped performing any kind of Baroque music on the piano, even Scarlatti's.
examples.zh: 他们逐渐停止在钢琴上演奏任何类型的巴洛克音乐，甚至是斯卡拉蒂的。

examples.zh: 在角落里系上一个石像鬼，你会以为自己身处巴洛克欧洲。

examples.en: We're in the baroque oyster bar, one of the loveliest rooms in Britain, complete with ghost.
examples.zh: 我们在巴洛克风格的牡蛎酒吧，这是英国最可爱的房间之一，里面充满了鬼魂。

examples.en: For the theater, Mr. Pflueger featured a mix of Art Deco and Spanish Baroque styles.
examples.zh: 对于剧院，普夫鲁格先生将装饰艺术和西班牙巴洛克风格融为一体。

examples.zh: 那冒犯性的评论实际上是一名观众的起哄。

examples.zh: 他去他们的会议起哄。

examples.en: A small group of youths stayed behind to heckle and shout abuse.
examples.zh: 一小群小青年没走，在起哄、叫骂。

examples.en: They wished to disengage themselves from these policies.
examples.zh: 他们希望能摆脱这些政策的束缚。

examples.en: She tried to disengage herself from his grip.
examples.zh: 她企图挣脱他的牢牢抓住的手。

examples.en: It makes it hard to disengage and leads to a lot of bleed-over into the family routine.
examples.zh: 这很难让人不沉浸其中，也会导致家庭日常受到重大影响。

examples.en: In fact, the brain must disengage from one activity in order to engage in another.
examples.zh: 事实上，大脑必须脱离一项活动才能从事另一项活动。

examples.en: As a result, many report feeling stalled in their careers and have begun to disengage.
examples.zh: 结果，许多人表示感觉自己的职业生涯停滞不前，并开始脱离。

examples.en: The question is, if these talks fail at an early stage, will this administration disengage?
examples.zh: 问题是，如果这些谈判在早期阶段失败，本届政府会退出吗？

examples.en: He was brought up by pious female relatives.
examples.zh: 他是由虔诚的女性亲属抚养大的。

examples.en: Catherine was a pious, earnest woman.
examples.zh: 凯瑟琳是位虔诚、真挚的女子。

examples.en: Okay? Not pious tales.
examples.zh: 知道吗？，不是寓言故事。

examples.en: So in the infamous words of the GOP's beloved Newt Gingrich: Spare me the pious baloney.
examples.zh: 因此，用共和党挚爱的纽特·金里奇（Newt Gingrich）的臭名昭著的话来说：别再胡说八道了。

examples.en: Both she and Brother Jobe were dressed in the severe clothing of the pious.
examples.zh: 她和乔布弟兄都穿着虔诚的严肃服装。

examples.en: He said we needed to be pure and pious but was himself quite volatile.
examples.zh: 他说我们需要纯洁和虔诚，但他自己却很不稳定。

examples.en: He could be accused of passion, but never belligerence.
examples.zh: 他也许可以被指责为性情冲动，但决不是生性好斗。

examples.en: Her increasing belligerence alienated her from her old friends.
examples.zh: 她的日益增长的好战性使她和她的老朋友们疏远了。

examples.en: Japan's troubles with its neighbours are still vexed by past belligerence.
examples.zh: 日本同其邻邦间的恩怨也源于他曾经的好战。

examples.en: Trade, and the mutual dependencies that result from it, will eliminate belligerence between powers, liberals suppose.
examples.zh: 自由主义者认为，贸易以及由此产生的相互依赖将消除大国之间的交战。

examples.en: Mr Putin, despite his belligerence about the 1990s, is the very epitome of that period.
examples.zh: 尽管普京对 90 年代表现出好战态度，但他却是那个时期的缩影。

examples.en: Mr. Kwiecien's all-out belligerence is theatrically convincing and unsettling, so you do not miss the vocal sheen.
examples.zh: 奎辛先生的全面好战在戏剧上令人信服且令人不安，所以你不会错过他的声音光泽。

examples.en: Our products will satisfy the most captious customers.
examples.zh: 我们的产品会令最挑剔的客户满意。

examples.en: There is no captious client but faulty product and service.
examples.zh: 没有挑剔的客户，只有不完善的产品和服务。

examples.en: Captious : Marked by a disposition to find and point out trivial faults.
examples.zh: 倾向于找出并指出细小错误的。

examples.en: But only the captious would miss the coherence and steadfastness of Buckley's thought and work over many years.
examples.zh: 但只有挑剔的人才会忽视巴克利多年来思想和工作的连贯性和坚定性。

examples.en: Stocks, the other headline topic, stumbled harder and faster than most would have guessed, although some of you regular posters, such as Sir Padgett and Captious Nut, predicted this with perfect accuracy over the last several months.
examples.zh: 另一个头条新闻股票的跌势比大多数人想象的更严重、更快，尽管一些经常发帖的人，比如帕吉特爵士和挑剔的坚果，在过去几个月里非常准确地预测了这一点。

examples.en: Giuliani has always won by playing the long game -- ignoring captious howls of the moment from civil libertarians and the editorial board of the New York Times until, in the fullness of time, he found himself vindicated by, say, lower crime rates.
examples.zh: 朱利安尼总是通过打持久战来取胜——无视公民自由主义者和《纽约时报》编辑委员会当时挑剔的呼声，直到时机成熟时，他发现自己被证明是正确的，比如说，较低的犯罪率。

examples.en: Don't worry, we won't belabor this topic.
examples.zh: 别担心，我们不会就这个问题喋喋不休的。

examples.en: We won't belabor the theory and background.
examples.zh: 我们不会就理论和背景做太多的论述。

examples.en: We would not belabor this point but only wish each to ponder it.
examples.zh: 我们不会反复讨论这个观点，而仅是希望每个人去仔细考量它。

examples.en: Do you belabor the description of your technology or its overwhelming multitude of features?
examples.zh: 您是否对您的技术或其众多功能进行了冗长的描述？

examples.en: If he were a prizewinning political theorist, Krugman might raise an issue at once more serious and more grave than the one he chooses to belabor.
examples.zh: 如果克鲁格曼是一位屡获殊荣的政治理论家，他可能会提出一个比他选择阐述的问题更严肃、更严重的问题。

examples.en: If I belabor this point, it is out of self-preservation.
examples.zh: 如果我反复强调这一点，那是出于自我保护。

examples.en: He was subservient and servile.
examples.zh: 他恭敬顺从，卑躬屈膝。

examples.en: Her willingness to be subservient to her children isolated her.
examples.zh: 她对她的孩子们顺从的意愿使她陷于孤立。

examples.en: The woman's needs are seen as subservient to the group interest.
examples.zh: 这名妇女的需要被视为从属于集体利益。

examples.en: But Canadians do not like their governments to be subservient to their more powerful neighbour.
examples.zh: 但加拿大人不喜欢他们的政府屈服于更强大的邻国。

examples.en: Real Men do not fill the need to place women in a subservient role if they are secure with themselves.
examples.zh: 如果女性对自己有安全感，真正的男人就不会满足将女性置于从属角色的需要。

examples.en: Thatcher was going to be damned if she made Britain subservient to Germany.
examples.zh: 如果撒切尔夫人让英国屈服于德国，她就会受到诅咒。

examples.en: We paid a fleeting visit to Paris.
examples.zh: 我们短暂游览了巴黎。

examples.en: Time is fleeting.; Time flies.
examples.zh: 时光飞逝。

examples.en: Tom hinted at things he had to attend to; things that must be done; and time was fleeting.
examples.zh: 汤姆暗示了他有事情要处理，必须做的事情，而且时间在飞逝。

examples.en: Beneath the big, galloping fun of American Slang lies a unifying theme about the fleeting nature of youth.
examples.zh: 在美国俚语的巨大乐趣之下，隐藏着一个关于青春转瞬即逝的统一主题。

examples.en: She had a fleeting image of Aron standing in her bathroom, wearing silly shorts.
examples.zh: 她脑海中浮现出阿伦穿着傻乎乎的短裤站在浴室里的画面。

examples.en: And I was reminded that while our time on Earth is fleeting, He is eternal.
examples.zh: 我想起，虽然我们在地球上的时间转瞬即逝，但他却是永恒的。

examples.zh: 我们对自己的经历变得不敏感，这意味着我们处理的信息更少，而时间似乎在加速。

examples.en: There is nothing sinful or immoral about being emotional, unless your emotions make you inhuman, insensitive and cruel to others.
examples.zh: 情绪化不罪恶，也合乎道德，除非你的情绪让你变得不人道、麻木不仁、对他人残忍。

examples.en: He had become insensitive to cold.
examples.zh: 他已经感觉不到寒冷了。

examples.en: The insensitive handling of the news prompted its fair share of Internet jabs at Karp.
examples.zh: 对这一消息的麻木不仁的处理引发了网络上对卡普的猛烈抨击。

examples.en: Labour MP Dame Anne Begg said that Atos's sponsorship of the athletes' equipment was insensitive.
examples.zh: 工党议员 Anne Begg 女士表示，Atos 对运动员装备的赞助是麻木不仁的。

examples.en: She said the show implicitly promotes obesity and took what many called an insensitive tone.
examples.zh: 她说，这部剧含蓄地宣扬肥胖，并采取了许多人所说的麻木不仁的语气。

examples.en: Strange estrange, I will not blame you, you have the right to choose happiness.
examples.zh: 怪天怪地，我都不会怪你，你有选择幸福的权利。

examples.en: Matt Diskin went over straight after the break and Heath L'Estrange's score put the result beyond doubt.
examples.zh: 中场休息后，马特·迪斯金 (Matt Diskin) 直接过人，希思·莱斯特兰奇 (Heath L'Estrange) 的得分让比赛结果毋庸置疑。

examples.en: Shortly after, L'Estrange powered over and Ah Van added the conversion to leave the scores level at the break.
examples.zh: 不久之后，L'Estrange 发力，阿文完成转换，在中场休息时将比分扳平。

examples.en: He has since recovered and begun pre-season training with fellow new Australian recruits Glenn Hall and Heath L'Estrange, both from Manly.
examples.zh: 此后他已经康复，并开始与来自曼利的澳大利亚新兵格伦·霍尔和希思·莱斯特兰奇一起进行季前训练。

words.meaning: adj. 热情洋溢的；沸腾的

phrases.zh: 热情洋溢的；沸腾的的关键方面
展现出热情洋溢的；沸腾的
深刻的热情洋溢的；沸腾的

examples.en: The Prime Minister was in ebullient mood.
examples.zh: 首相兴致勃勃。

examples.en: John was as bouncy and ebullient as Helen was diffident and reserved.
examples.zh: 约翰活泼、热情；而海伦却羞怯、矜持。

examples.en: She looked tired and much less ebullient than when I saw her in jail.
examples.zh: 她看起来疲惫不堪，没有上次我在监狱里见到的那样精力充沛了。

examples.en: When he took his seat at Westminster in 1972, he arrived in London in ebullient fashion.
examples.zh: 1972 年，当他在威斯敏斯特就职时，他满怀热情地抵达伦敦。

examples.en: But apart from a few cuts and bruises, he seems back to his normal, ebullient self.
examples.zh: 但除了一些割伤和瘀伤之外，他似乎又恢复了正常、热情的样子。

examples.en: GM's revenues in the fourth quarter were 2.1% higher than in the ebullient period a year earlier.
examples.zh: 通用汽车第四季度的收入比去年同期高出2.1%。
